     290  # Manually implemented because os.path.realpath tries to resolve local symlinks
     291  def linux_real_path(path: str):
     292      components = path.split('/')
     293  
     294      result = []
     295      for e in components:
     296          if e == '.' or not e:
     297              continue
     298          elif e == '..':
     299              if result:
     300                  del result[-1]
     301              continue
     302  
     303          result.append(e)
     304  
     305      real_path = '/'.join(result)
     306      if path and path[0] == '/':
     307          return '/' + real_path
     308      else:
     309          return real_path

     311  def get_tar_file(tar, path: str, follow_symlink=False, symlink_depth=10):
     312      if symlink_depth < 0:
     313          print(f'Warning: Exceeded maximum symlink depth when reading: {path}')
     314          return None, None
     315  
     316      # Tar members can be formatted as /{path}, {path}, or ./{path}
     317      if path.startswith('/'):
     318          paths = [path, '.' + path, path[1:]]
     319      elif path.startswith('./'):
     320          paths = [path, path[1:], path[2:]]
     321      else:
     322          paths = [path, './' + path, '/' + path]
     323  
     324      def follow_if_symlink(info, path: str):
     325          if follow_symlink and info.issym():
     326              if info.linkpath.startswith('/'):
     327                  return get_tar_file(tar, info.linkpath, follow_symlink=True, symlink_depth=symlink_depth - 1)
     328              else:
     329                  return get_tar_file(tar, linux_real_path(os.path.dirname(path) + '/' + info.linkpath), follow_symlink=True, symlink_depth=symlink_depth -1)
     330          else:
     331              return info, path
     332  
     333      # First try accessing the file directly
     334      for e in paths:
     335          try:
     336              return follow_if_symlink(tar.getmember(e), e)
     337          except KeyError:
     338              continue
     339  
     340      if not follow_symlink:
     341          return None, None
     342  
     343      # Then look for symlinks
     344      # The path might be covered by a symlink, check if parent exists and is a symlink
     345      parent_path = os.path.dirname(path)
     346      if parent_path != path:
     347          try:
     348              parent_info, real_parent_path = get_tar_file(tar, parent_path, follow_symlink=True, symlink_depth=symlink_depth - 1)
     349              if real_parent_path is not None and real_parent_path != parent_path:
     350                  return get_tar_file(tar, f'{real_parent_path}/{os.path.basename(path)}', follow_symlink=True, symlink_depth=symlink_depth -1)
     351          except KeyError:
     352              pass
     353  
     354      return None, None

      77  def node_equals(left, right):
      78      if isinstance(left, ConfigJSONScalar):
      79          return left() == right()
      80  
      81      elif isinstance(left, ConfigJSONArray):
      82          return len(left) == len(right) and all(node_equals(l, r) for l, r in zip(left, right))
      83      else:
      84          return subset(left, right) and subset(right, left)

     254      def list_directory(path: str):
     255          files = []
     256          for e in all_files:
     257              if e.startswith(path):

     290  # Manually implemented because os.path.realpath tries to resolve local symlinks
     291  def linux_real_path(path: str):
     292      components = path.split('/')
     293  
     294      result = []
     295      for e in components:
     296          if e == '.' or not e:
     297              continue
     298          elif e == '..':
     299              if result:
     300                  del result[-1]
     301              continue
     302  
     303          result.append(e)
     304  
     305      real_path = '/'.join(result)
     306      if path and path[0] == '/':
     307          return '/' + real_path
     308      else:
     309          return real_path

     311  def get_tar_file(tar, path: str, follow_symlink=False, symlink_depth=10):
     312      if symlink_depth < 0:
     313          print(f'Warning: Exceeded maximum symlink depth when reading: {path}')
     314          return None, None
     315  
     316      # Tar members can be formatted as /{path}, {path}, or ./{path}
     317      if path.startswith('/'):
     318          paths = [path, '.' + path, path[1:]]
     319      elif path.startswith('./'):
     320          paths = [path, path[1:], path[2:]]
     321      else:
     322          paths = [path, './' + path, '/' + path]
     323  
     324      def follow_if_symlink(info, path: str):
     325          if follow_symlink and info.issym():
     326              if info.linkpath.startswith('/'):
     327                  return get_tar_file(tar, info.linkpath, follow_symlink=True, symlink_depth=symlink_depth - 1)
     328              else:
     329                  return get_tar_file(tar, linux_real_path(os.path.dirname(path) + '/' + info.linkpath), follow_symlink=True, symlink_depth=symlink_depth -1)
     330          else:
     331              return info, path
     332  
     333      # First try accessing the file directly
     334      for e in paths:
     335          try:
     336              return follow_if_symlink(tar.getmember(e), e)
     337          except KeyError:
     338              continue
     339  
     340      if not follow_symlink:
     341          return None, None
     342  
     343      # Then look for symlinks
     344      # The path might be covered by a symlink, check if parent exists and is a symlink
     345      parent_path = os.path.dirname(path)
     346      if parent_path != path:
     347          try:
     348              parent_info, real_parent_path = get_tar_file(tar, parent_path, follow_symlink=True, symlink_depth=symlink_depth - 1)
     349              if real_parent_path is not None and real_parent_path != parent_path:
     350                  return get_tar_file(tar, f'{real_parent_path}/{os.path.basename(path)}', follow_symlink=True, symlink_depth=symlink_depth -1)
     351          except KeyError:
     352              pass
     353  
     354      return None, None

     364  
     365                  if first_file is None:

     367  
     368      return first_file, found_xattrs

     482  def read_url(url: dict, elf_magic):
     483       hash = hashlib.sha256()
     484       address = url['Url']()
     485  
     486       if not address.endswith('.wsl'):
     487           warning(url, f'Url does not point to a .wsl file: {address}')
     488  
     489       tar_format = None
     490       if address.startswith('file://'):
     491           with open(address.replace('file:///', '').replace('file://', ''), 'rb') as fd:
     492              while True:
     493                  e = fd.read(4096 * 4096 * 10)
     494                  if not e:
     495                      break
     496  
     497                  hash.update(e)
     498

      67  def subset(inner, outer) -> bool:

      72          if not node_equals(value, outer[key]):

      77  def node_equals(left, right):
      78      if isinstance(left, ConfigJSONScalar):
      79          return left() == right()
      80  
      81      elif isinstance(left, ConfigJSONArray):
      82          return len(left) == len(right) and all(node_equals(l, r) for l, r in zip(left, right))
      83      else:
      84          return subset(left, right) and subset(right, left)

     290  # Manually implemented because os.path.realpath tries to resolve local symlinks
     291  def linux_real_path(path: str):
     292      components = path.split('/')
     293  
     294      result = []
     295      for e in components:
     296          if e == '.' or not e:
     297              continue
     298          elif e == '..':
     299              if result:
     300                  del result[-1]
     301              continue
     302  
     303          result.append(e)
     304  
     305      real_path = '/'.join(result)

     307          return '/' + real_path
     308      else:
     309          return real_path

     311  def get_tar_file(tar, path: str, follow_symlink=False, symlink_depth=10):
     312      if symlink_depth < 0:
     313          print(f'Warning: Exceeded maximum symlink depth when reading: {path}')
     314          return None, None
     315  
     316      # Tar members can be formatted as /{path}, {path}, or ./{path}
     317      if path.startswith('/'):
     318          paths = [path, '.' + path, path[1:]]
     319      elif path.startswith('./'):
     320          paths = [path, path[1:], path[2:]]
     321      else:
     322          paths = [path, './' + path, '/' + path]
     323  
     324      def follow_if_symlink(info, path: str):
     325          if follow_symlink and info.issym():
     326              if info.linkpath.startswith('/'):
     327                  return get_tar_file(tar, info.linkpath, follow_symlink=True, symlink_depth=symlink_depth - 1)
     328              else:
     329                  return get_tar_file(tar, linux_real_path(os.path.dirname(path) + '/' + info.linkpath), follow_symlink=True, symlink_depth=symlink_depth -1)
     330          else:
     331              return info, path
     332  
     333      # First try accessing the file directly
     334      for e in paths:
     335          try:
     336              return follow_if_symlink(tar.getmember(e), e)
     337          except KeyError:
     338              continue
     339  
     340      if not follow_symlink:
     341          return None, None
     342  
     343      # Then look for symlinks
     344      # The path might be covered by a symlink, check if parent exists and is a symlink
     345      parent_path = os.path.dirname(path)
     346      if parent_path != path:
     347          try:
     348              parent_info, real_parent_path = get_tar_file(tar, parent_path, follow_symlink=True, symlink_depth=symlink_depth - 1)
     349              if real_parent_path is not None and real_parent_path != parent_path:
     350                  return get_tar_file(tar, f'{real_parent_path}/{os.path.basename(path)}', follow_symlink=True, symlink_depth=symlink_depth -1)
     351          except KeyError:
     352              pass
     353  
     354      return None, None

     356  def find_unsupported_attrs(tar):

     367  
     368      return first_file, found_xattrs

     311  def get_tar_file(tar, path: str, follow_symlink=False, symlink_depth=10):

     313          print(f'Warning: Exceeded maximum symlink depth when reading: {path}')
     314          return None, None
     315  
     316      # Tar members can be formatted as /{path}, {path}, or ./{path}
     317      if path.startswith('/'):
     318          paths = [path, '.' + path, path[1:]]
     319      elif path.startswith('./'):
     320          paths = [path, path[1:], path[2:]]
     321      else:
     322          paths = [path, './' + path, '/' + path]
     323  
     324      def follow_if_symlink(info, path: str):
     325          if follow_symlink and info.issym():
     326              if info.linkpath.startswith('/'):
     327                  return get_tar_file(tar, info.linkpath, follow_symlink=True, symlink_depth=symlink_depth - 1)
     328              else:
     329                  return get_tar_file(tar, linux_real_path(os.path.dirname(path) + '/' + info.linkpath), follow_symlink=True, symlink_depth=symlink_depth -1)
     330          else:
     331              return info, path
     332  
     333      # First try accessing the file directly
     334      for e in paths:
     335          try:
     336              return follow_if_symlink(tar.getmember(e), e)
     337          except KeyError:
     338              continue
     339  
     340      if not follow_symlink:
     341          return None, None
     342  
     343      # Then look for symlinks
     344      # The path might be covered by a symlink, check if parent exists and is a symlink
     345      parent_path = os.path.dirname(path)

     349              if real_parent_path is not None and real_parent_path != parent_path:
     350                  return get_tar_file(tar, f'{real_parent_path}/{os.path.basename(path)}', follow_symlink=True, symlink_depth=symlink_depth -1)
     351          except KeyError:
     352              pass
     353  
     354      return None, None

      67  def subset(inner, outer) -> bool:
      68      for key, value in inner:
      69          if key not in outer:
      70              return True
      71  
      72          if not node_equals(value, outer[key]):
      73              return False
      74  
      75      return True

      77  def node_equals(left, right):
      78      if isinstance(left, ConfigJSONScalar):
      79          return left() == right()
      80  
      81      elif isinstance(left, ConfigJSONArray):
      82          return len(left) == len(right) and all(node_equals(l, r) for l, r in zip(left, right))
      83      else:
      84          return subset(left, right) and subset(right, left)

     235  def read_systemd_enabled_units(node, tar) -> dict:
     236      config_dirs = ['/usr/local/lib/systemd/system', '/usr/lib/systemd/system', '/etc/systemd/system']
     237  
     238      all_files = tar.getnames()
     239  
     240      def link_target(unit_path: str):
     241          try:
     242              info = tar.getmember(unit_path)
     243          except KeyError:
     244              info = tar.getmember('.' + unit_path)
     245  
     246          if not info.issym():
     247              return unit_path
     248          else:
     249              if info.linkpath.startswith('/'):
     250                  return get_tar_file(tar, linux_real_path(info.linkpath), follow_symlink=True)[1]
     251              else:
     252                  return get_tar_file(tar, linux_real_path(os.path.dirname(unit_path) + '/' + info.linkpath), follow_symlink=True)[1]
     253  
     254      def list_directory(path: str):
     255          files = []
     256          for e in all_files:
     257              if e.startswith(path):
     258                  files.append(e[len(path) + 1:])
     259              elif e.startswith('.' + path):
     260                  files.append(e[len(path) + 2:])
     261  
     262          return files
     263  
     264      def is_dev_null(path: str) -> bool:
     265          return path == './dev/null' or path == '/dev/null'
     266  
     267      def is_masked(unit: str):
     268          try:
     269              target = link_target(f'/etc/systemd/system/{unit}')
     270          except KeyError:
     271              return False # No symlink found, unit is not masked
     272  
     273          return is_dev_null(target)
     274  
     275      units = {}
     276      for config_dir in config_dirs:
     277          targets = [e for e in list_directory(config_dir) if e.endswith('.target.wants')]
     278  
     279          for target in targets:
     280              for e in list_directory(f'{config_dir}/{target}'):
     281                  fullpath = f'{config_dir}/{target}/{e}'
     282  
     283                  unit_target = link_target(fullpath)
     284  
     285                  if is_dev_null(unit_target) and not is_masked(e):
     286                      units[e] = fullpath
     287  
     288      return units

     290  # Manually implemented because os.path.realpath tries to resolve local symlinks
     291  def linux_real_path(path: str):
     292      components = path.split('/')
     293  
     294      result = []
     295      for e in components:
     296          if e == '.' or not e:
     297              continue
     298          elif e == '..':
     299              if result:
     300                  del result[-1]
     301              continue
     302  
     303          result.append(e)
     304  
     305      real_path = '/'.join(result)
     306      if path and path[0] == '/':
     307          return '/' + real_path
     308      else:
     309          return real_path

     311  def get_tar_file(tar, path: str, follow_symlink=False, symlink_depth=10):
     312      if symlink_depth < 0:
     313          print(f'Warning: Exceeded maximum symlink depth when reading: {path}')
     314          return None, None
     315  
     316      # Tar members can be formatted as /{path}, {path}, or ./{path}
     317      if path.startswith('/'):
     318          paths = [path, '.' + path, path[1:]]
     319      elif path.startswith('./'):
     320          paths = [path, path[1:], path[2:]]
     321      else:
     322          paths = [path, './' + path, '/' + path]
     323  
     324      def follow_if_symlink(info, path: str):
     325          if follow_symlink and info.issym():
     326              if info.linkpath.startswith('/'):
     327                  return get_tar_file(tar, info.linkpath, follow_symlink=True, symlink_depth=symlink_depth - 1)
     328              else:
     329                  return get_tar_file(tar, linux_real_path(os.path.dirname(path) + '/' + info.linkpath), follow_symlink=True, symlink_depth=symlink_depth -1)
     330          else:
     331              return info, path
     332  
     333      # First try accessing the file directly
     334      for e in paths:
     335          try:
     336              return follow_if_symlink(tar.getmember(e), e)
     337          except KeyError:
     338              continue
     339  
     340      if not follow_symlink:
     341          return None, None
     342  
     343      # Then look for symlinks
     344      # The path might be covered by a symlink, check if parent exists and is a symlink
     345      parent_path = os.path.dirname(path)
     346      if parent_path != path:
     347          try:
     348              parent_info, real_parent_path = get_tar_file(tar, parent_path, follow_symlink=True, symlink_depth=symlink_depth - 1)
     349              if real_parent_path is not None and real_parent_path != parent_path:
     350                  return get_tar_file(tar, f'{real_parent_path}/{os.path.basename(path)}', follow_symlink=True, symlink_depth=symlink_depth -1)
     351          except KeyError:
     352              pass
     353  
     354      return None, None

     356  def find_unsupported_attrs(tar):
     357      found_xattrs = set()
     358      first_file = None
     359  
     360      for e in tar.getmembers():
     361          for name in e.pax_headers:
     362              if any(name.startswith('SCHILY.xattr.' + xattr) for xattr in WSL1_UNSUPPORTED_XATTRS):
     363                  found_xattrs.add(name.replace('SCHILY.xattr.', ''))
     364  
     365                  if first_file is None:
     366                      first_file  = e.name
     367  
     368      return first_file, found_xattrs

     483       hash = hashlib.sha256()

     485  
     486       if not address.endswith('.wsl'):

     489       tar_format = None

     492              while True:
     493                  e = fd.read(4096 * 4096 * 10)
     494                  if not e:
     495                      break
     496  
     497                  hash.update(e)
     498  
     499                  if tar_format is None:
     500                      tar_format = MAGIC.from_buffer(e)
     501  
     502              fd.seek(0, 0)

     520  
     521                  file.seek(0, 0)
     522                  read_tar(url, file, elf_magic)

     526       if expected_sha is None:

      21      std::string output(Input);

      87      RemoveMountAndEnvironmentOnScopeExit(const char* EnvironmentName) : m_environmentName(EnvironmentName)

      92      RemoveMountAndEnvironmentOnScopeExit& operator=(const RemoveMountAndEnvironmentOnScopeExit&) = delete;

      95      RemoveMountAndEnvironmentOnScopeExit(RemoveMountAndEnvironmentOnScopeExit&& Other)
      96      {

     100      RemoveMountAndEnvironmentOnScopeExit& operator=(RemoveMountAndEnvironmentOnScopeExit&& Other)
     101      {
     102          m_environmentName = Other.m_environmentName;
     103          Other.m_environmentName = nullptr;

     105          m_mountPath = Other.m_mountPath;
     106          Other.m_mountPath = nullptr;

     108          return *this;
     109      }
     110  
     111      ~RemoveMountAndEnvironmentOnScopeExit()
     112      {
     113          if (m_environmentName != nullptr)
     114          {
     115              if (unsetenv(m_environmentName) < 0)
     116              {
     117                  LOG_ERROR("unsetenv({}) failed {}", m_environmentName, errno);
     118              }
     119          }

     121          if (m_mountPath != nullptr)
     122          {
     123              if (umount2(m_mountPath, MNT_DETACH) < 0)
     124              {
     125                  LOG_ERROR("umount2({}, MNT_DETACH) failed {}", m_mountPath, errno);
     126                  return;

     132              }
     133          }

     161          }
