     251  void ConfigAppendNtPath(EnvironmentBlock& Environment, char* NtPath)
     252  
     253  /*++
     254  
     255  Routine Description:
     256  
     257      This routine updates the $PATH variable of the provided environment block.
     258  
     259  Arguments:
     260  
     261      Environment - Supplies the environment block to update.
     262  
     263      NtPath - Supplies a semicolon-separated list of NT paths to translate and
     264          append to the $PATH variable. If no $PATH variable exists, one is
     265          created.
     266  
     267  Return Value:
     268  
     269      None.
     270  
     271  --*/
     272  
     273  try
     274  {
     275      auto TranslatedPath = UtilTranslatePathList(NtPath, true);
     276      if (!TranslatedPath.has_value())
     277      {
     278          return;
     279      }
     280  
     281      ConfigAppendToPath(Environment, TranslatedPath.value());
     282      return;
     283  }
     284  CATCH_LOG()
     285  
     286  void ConfigAppendToPath(EnvironmentBlock& Environment, std::string_view PathElement)
     287  
     288  /*++
     289  
     290  Routine Description:
     291  
     292      This routine adds the specified path element to the $PATH variable of the
     293      supplied environment block.
     294  
     295  Arguments:
     296  
     297      Environment - Supplies the environment block to update.
     298  
     299      PathElement - Supplies a path element to add to the $PATH variable. If no
     300          $PATH variable exists, one is created.
     301  
     302  Return Value:
     303  
     304      None.
     305  
     306  --*/
     307  
     308  try
     309  {
     310      //
     311      // If no PATH variable is present, create a new variable. If a PATH is
     312      // present, add the path element onto the end of the existing value.
     313      //
     314  
     315      auto Path = Environment.GetVariable(PATH_ENV);
     316      if (Path.empty())
     317      {
     318          Environment.AddVariable(PATH_ENV, PathElement);
     319      }
     320      else
     321      {
     322          std::string NewPath{Path};
     323          if (NewPath.back() != ':')
     324          {
     325              NewPath += ':';
     326          }
     327  
     328          NewPath += PathElement;
     329          Environment.AddVariable(PATH_ENV, NewPath);
     330      }
     331  
     332      return;
     333  }
     334  CATCH_LOG()
     335  
     336  void ConfigHandleInteropMessage(
     337      wsl::shared::SocketChannel& ResponseChannel,
     338      wsl::shared::SocketChannel& InteropChannel,
     339      bool Elevated,
     340      gsl::span<gsl::byte> Message,
     341      const MESSAGE_HEADER* Header,
     342      const wsl::linux::WslDistributionConfig& Config)
     343  
     344  /*++
     345  
     346  Routine Description:
     347  
     348      This routine handles a message received from a Linux client using init's
     349      interop socket.
     350  
     351  Arguments:
     352  
     353      ResponseChannel - Supplies channel used to send responses.
     354  
     355      InteropChannel - Supplies a channel to the host to be used for create
     356          process requests.
     357  
     358      Elevated - Supplies a boolean specifying if the elevated DrvFs share should be used.
     359  
     360      Message - Supplies the message buffer.
     361  
     362      Header- Supplies the message Header.
     363  
     364  Return Value:
     365  
     366      None.
     367  
     368  --*/
     369  
     370  try
     371  {
     372      switch (Header->MessageType)
     373      {
     374      case LxInitMessageCreateProcessUtilityVm:
     375          if (InteropChannel.Socket() > 0)
     376          {
     377              InteropChannel.SendMessage<LX_INIT_CREATE_NT_PROCESS_UTILITY_VM>(Message);
     378          }
     379  
     380          break;
     381  
     382      case LxInitMessageQueryDrvfsElevated:
     383      {
     384          ResponseChannel.SendResultMessage<bool>(Elevated);
     385          break;
     386      }
     387  
     388      case LxInitMessageQueryEnvironmentVariable:
     389      {
     390          auto* Query = gslhelpers::try_get_struct<LX_INIT_QUERY_ENVIRONMENT_VARIABLE>(Message);
     391          if (!Query)
     392          {
     393              LOG_ERROR("Unexpected MessageSize {}", Message.size());
     394              return;
     395          }
     396  
     397          auto Value = UtilGetEnvironmentVariable(Query->Buffer);
     398          wsl::shared::MessageWriter<LX_INIT_QUERY_ENVIRONMENT_VARIABLE> Response(LxInitMessageQueryEnvironmentVariable);
     399          Response.WriteString(Value);
     400          ResponseChannel.SendMessage<LX_INIT_QUERY_ENVIRONMENT_VARIABLE>(Response.Span());
     401      }
     402  
     403      break;
     404  
     405      case LxInitMessageQueryFeatureFlags:
     406      {
     407          assert(Config.FeatureFlags.has_value());
     408          ResponseChannel.SendResultMessage<int32_t>(Config.FeatureFlags.value());
     409          break;
     410      }
     411  
     412      case LxInitMessageCreateLoginSession:
     413      {
     414          auto* CreateSession = gslhelpers::try_get_struct<LX_INIT_CREATE_LOGIN_SESSION>(Message);
     415          if (!CreateSession)
     416          {
     417              LOG_ERROR("Unexpected MessageSize {}", Message.size());
     418              return;
     419          }
     420  
     421          bool success = false;
     422          auto sendResponse = wil::scope_exit([&]() { ResponseChannel.SendResultMessage<bool>(success); });
     423  
     424          if (!Config.BootInit || Config.InitPid.value_or(0) != getpid())
     425          {
     426              LOG_ERROR("Unexpected LxInitMessageCreateLoginSession message");
     427          }
     428          else
     429          {
     430              success = CreateLoginSession(Config, CreateSession->Buffer, CreateSession->Uid);
     431          }
     432  
     433          break;
     434      }
     435  
     436      case LxInitMessageQueryNetworkingMode:
     437          assert(Config.NetworkingMode.has_value());
     438          ResponseChannel.SendResultMessage<uint8_t>(static_cast<uint8_t>(Config.NetworkingMode.value()));
     439          break;
     440  
     441      case LxInitMessageQueryVmId:
     442      {
     443          wsl::shared::MessageWriter<LX_INIT_QUERY_VM_ID> Response(LxInitMessageQueryVmId);
     444          if (Config.VmId.has_value())
     445          {
     446              Response.WriteString(Config.VmId.value());
     447          }
     448  
     449          ResponseChannel.SendMessage<LX_INIT_QUERY_VM_ID>(Response.Span());
     450          break;
     451      }
     452  
     453      default:
     454          LOG_ERROR("unexpected message {}", Header->MessageType);
     455          break;
     456      }
     457  }
     458  CATCH_LOG()
     459  
     460  wsl::linux::WslDistributionConfig ConfigInitializeCommon(struct sigaction* SavedSignalActions)
     461  
     462  /*++
     463  
     464  Routine Description:
     465  
     466      This routine sets up common devices and mounts.
     467  
     468  Arguments:
     469  
     470      SavedSignalActions - Supplies an array to save default signal actions.
     471  
     472  Return Value:
     473  
     474      0 on success, -1 on failure.
     475  
     476  --*/
     477  
     478  {
     479      wil::unique_fd DevNullFd;
     480      unsigned int Index;
     481  
     482      //
     483      // Set the umask to 0 to ensure that devices and files that init creates
     484      // have the correct mode.
     485      //
     486  
     487      umask(0);
     488  
     489      //
     490      // Perform initialization required for logging to kmsg.
     491      //
     492  
     493      if (!UtilIsUtilityVm())
     494      {
     495          for (Index = 0; Index < COUNT_OF(LxssStartupLoggingWsl); Index += 1)
     496          {
     497              THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(ConfigInitializeEntry(&LxssStartupLoggingWsl[Index]) < 0);
     498          }
     499      }
     500      else
     501      {
     502          for (Index = 0; Index < COUNT_OF(LxssStartupLoggingVmMode); Index += 1)
     503          {
     504              THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(ConfigInitializeEntry(&LxssStartupLoggingVmMode[Index]) < 0);
     505          }
     506      }
     507  
     508      //
     509      // Open /dev/kmsg for logging.
     510      //
     511  
     512      THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(InitializeLogging(true) < 0);
     513  
     514      //
     515      // Ignore all signals except SIGHUP and signals that cannot be ignored.
     516      //
     517      // N.B. Ignoring SIGCHLD automatically reaps zombie processes.
     518      //
     519      // N.B. Child processes reset signals to default before calling execv.
     520      //
     521  
     522      THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(UtilSaveSignalHandlers(SavedSignalActions) < 0);
     523  
     524      THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(UtilSetSignalHandlers(SavedSignalActions, true) < 0);
     525  
     526      //
     527      // Load the configuration file.
     528      //
     529  
     530      wsl::linux::WslDistributionConfig Config{CONFIG_FILE};
     531  
     532      if (getenv(LX_WSL2_SYSTEM_DISTRO_SHARE_ENV) != nullptr)
     533      {
     534          Config.GuiAppsEnabled = true;
     535      }
     536  
     537      //
     538      // Initialize the static entries.
     539      //
     540  
     541      for (Index = 0; Index < COUNT_OF(LxssStartupCommon); Index += 1)
     542      {
     543          THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(ConfigInitializeEntry(&LxssStartupCommon[Index]) < 0);
     544      }
     545  
     546      //
     547      // Initialize WSL1 and WSL2 specific environment.
     548      //
     549  
     550      if (!UtilIsUtilityVm())
     551      {
     552          THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(ConfigInitializeWsl() < 0);
     553      }
     554  
     555      //
     556      // Open /dev/null for the stdin and stdout in case libraries try to use
     557      // them (but keep stderr open for kmsg logging).
     558      //
     559  
     560      DevNullFd = TEMP_FAILURE_RETRY(open("/dev/null", O_RDWR));
     561      THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(!DevNullFd);
     562  
     563      for (const auto& Fd : {STDIN_FILENO, STDOUT_FILENO})
     564      {
     565          THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(dup2(DevNullFd.get(), Fd) < 0);
     566      }
     567  
     568      //
     569      // Initialize cgroups based on what the kernel supports.
     570      //
     571  
     572      ConfigInitializeCgroups(Config);
     573  
     574      //
     575      // Attempt to register the NT interop binfmt extension.
     576      //
     577      // N.B. Registration for VM mode is done by mini_init.
     578      //
     579  
     580      if ((!UtilIsUtilityVm()) && (Config.InteropEnabled))
     581      {
     582          ConfigRegisterBinfmtInterpreter();
     583      }
     584  
     585      //
     586      // Ensure the target for automounts exists.
     587      //
     588  
     589      if ((Config.AutoMount) || ((UtilIsUtilityVm())))
     590      {
     591          UtilMkdirPath(Config.DrvFsPrefix.c_str(), AUTO_MOUNT_PARENT_MODE, false);
     592      }
     593  
     594      //
     595      // Initialization successful.
     596      //
     597  
     598      return Config;
     599  }
     600  
     601  void ConfigInitializeX11(const wsl::linux::WslDistributionConfig& Config)
     602  try
     603  {
     604      auto socketPath = "/tmp/" X11_SOCKET_NAME;
     605      THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(UtilMkdir(socketPath, 0775) < 0);
     606  
     607      std::string source{Config.DrvFsPrefix};
     608      source += WSLG_SHARED_FOLDER;
     609      source += "/" X11_SOCKET_NAME;
     610      THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(mount(source.c_str(), socketPath, NULL, (MS_BIND | MS_REC), NULL) < 0);
     611  
     612      // The .X11-unix folder is mounted read-only so the socket file can't be removed.
     613      // It's left writable in the system distro since wslg is supposed to write to that folder to create it.
     614      if (WI_IsFlagClear(Config.FeatureFlags.value(), LxInitFeatureSystemDistro))
     615      {
     616          THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(mount("none", socketPath, NULL, (MS_RDONLY | MS_REMOUNT | MS_BIND), NULL) < 0);
     617      }
     618  }
     619  CATCH_LOG()
     620  
     621  int ConfigInitializeInstance(wsl::shared::SocketChannel& Channel, gsl::span<gsl::byte> Buffer, wsl::linux::WslDistributionConfig& Config)
     622  
     623  /*++
     624  
     625  Routine Description:
     626  
     627      This routine initializes the instance's externally controlled state, which
     628      is received from the service.
     629  
     630      N.B. When setting these values errors are treated as non-fatal to account
     631           for unexpected distro state.
     632  
     633  Arguments:
     634  
     635      MessageFd - Supplies a file descriptor to send the response message.
     636  
     637      Buffer - Supplies the message buffer.
     638  
     639  Return Value:
     640  
     641      0 on success, -1 on failure.
     642  
     643  --*/
     644  
     645  try
     646  {
     647      //
     648      // Validate input parameters.
     649      //
     650  
     651      const auto* Message = gslhelpers::try_get_struct<const LX_INIT_CONFIGURATION_INFORMATION>(Buffer);
     652      if (!Message)
     653      {
     654          FATAL_ERROR("Unexpected configuration size {}", Buffer.size());
     655      }
     656  
     657      //
     658      // Set the host name and domain name buffers.
     659      //
     660  
     661      std::string Hostname = wsl::shared::string::FromSpan(Buffer, Message->HostnameOffset);
     662      auto* Domainname = wsl::shared::string::FromSpan(Buffer, Message->DomainnameOffset);
     663      auto* WindowsHosts = wsl::shared::string::FromSpan(Buffer, Message->WindowsHostsOffset);
     664      auto* DistributionName = wsl::shared::string::FromSpan(Buffer, Message->DistributionNameOffset);
     665      auto* Plan9SocketPath = wsl::shared::string::FromSpan(Buffer, Message->Plan9SocketOffset);
     666      auto* Timezone = wsl::shared::string::FromSpan(Buffer, Message->TimezoneOffset);
     667      bool Elevated = Message->DrvfsMount == LxInitDrvfsMountElevated;
     668  
     669      const std::string ThreadName = std::format("{}({})", (Config.BootInit ? "init-systemd" : "init"), DistributionName);
     670      UtilSetThreadName(ThreadName.c_str());
     671  
     672      //
     673      // Store feature flags for future use.
     674      //
     675      // N.B. This is also stored in an environment variable so that mount.drvfs, when launched
     676      //      through fstab mounting below, can use that. This is needed because mount.drvfs won't
     677      //      be able to connect to init during this call. This environment variable is not present
     678      //      for user-launched processes.
     679      //
     680  
     681      Config.FeatureFlags = Message->FeatureFlags;
     682      UtilSetFeatureFlags(Config.FeatureFlags.value());
     683  
     684      //
     685      // Determine the default UID which can be specified in /etc/wsl.conf.
     686      //
     687  
     688      uid_t DefaultUid = Message->DrvFsDefaultOwner;
     689      if (Config.DefaultUser.has_value())
     690      {
     691          passwd* PasswordEntry = getpwnam(Config.DefaultUser->c_str());
     692          if (PasswordEntry == nullptr)
     693          {
     694              LOG_ERROR("getpwnam({}) failed {}", Config.DefaultUser->c_str(), errno);
     695          }
     696          else
     697          {
     698              DefaultUid = PasswordEntry->pw_uid;
     699          }
     700      }
     701  
     702      //
     703      // Process the /etc/fstab file.
     704      //
     705      // N.B. This must happen before mounting DrvFs volumes because the user may
     706      //      have specified DrvFs mounts in /etc/fstab and they should overwrite defaults.
     707      //
     708  
     709      if (Config.MountFsTab)
     710      {
     711          ConfigMountFsTab(Elevated);
     712      }
     713  
     714      //
     715      // Perform additional WSL2-specific mounts.
     716      //
     717  
     718      if (UtilIsUtilityVm())
     719      {
     720          if (ConfigInitializeVmMode(Elevated, Config) < 0)
     721          {
     722              FATAL_ERROR("ConfigInitializeVmMode");
     723          }
     724      }
     725  
     726      if (Config.AutoMount && (Message->DrvfsMount != LxInitDrvfsMountNone))
     727      {
     728          ConfigMountDrvFsVolumes(Message->DrvFsVolumesBitmap, DefaultUid, Elevated, Config);
     729      }
     730  
     731      //
     732      // If a hostname was specified in /etc/wsl.conf, use it.
     733      //
     734  
     735      if (Config.HostName.has_value())
     736      {
     737          Hostname = Config.HostName.value();
     738          LOG_WARNING("hostname set to {} in {}", Hostname.c_str(), CONFIG_FILE);
     739      }
     740  
     741      //
     742      // Sanitize the hostname.
     743      //
     744      // N.B. If systemd is enabled, systemd-hostnamed will cleanup the
     745      // hostname, which can lead to a disconnect if that doesn't match
     746      // what we write in /etc/hostname & /etc/hosts, so to hostname needs
     747      // to be cleaned up before being passed to systemd.
     748      //
     749      // N.B. While the Windows UI doesn't let the user set an invalid hostname
     750      // (from systemd-hostnamed's perspective), it's possible to override that
     751      // via Rename-Computer.
     752  
     753      Hostname = wsl::shared::string::CleanHostname(Hostname);
     754  
     755      //
     756      // Update the host and domain name.
     757      //
     758  
     759      if (sethostname(Hostname.c_str(), Hostname.size()) < 0)
     760      {
     761          LOG_ERROR("sethostname({}) failed {}", Hostname.c_str(), errno);
     762          Hostname = wsl::shared::string::c_defaultHostName;
     763          if (sethostname(Hostname.c_str(), Hostname.size()) < 0)
     764          {
     765              LOG_ERROR("sethostname({}) failed {}", Hostname.c_str(), errno);
     766          }
     767      }
     768  
     769      if (setenv(NAME_ENV, Hostname.c_str(), 1) < 0)
     770      {
     771          LOG_ERROR("setenv({}, {}) failed {}", NAME_ENV, Hostname.c_str(), errno);
     772      }
     773  
     774      //
     775      // Update the domain name.
     776      //
     777  
     778      if (setdomainname(Domainname, strlen(Domainname)) < 0)
     779      {
     780          LOG_ERROR("setdomainname({}) failed {}", Domainname, errno);
     781      }
     782  
     783      //
     784      // Generate and write /etc/hostname.
     785      //
     786  
     787      wil::unique_fd HostnameFd{TEMP_FAILURE_RETRY(creat(HOSTNAME_FILE_PATH, HOSTNAME_FILE_MODE))};
     788      if (!HostnameFd)
     789      {
     790          LOG_ERROR("creat {} failed: {}", HOSTNAME_FILE_PATH, errno);
     791      }
     792      else
     793      {
     794          try
     795          {
     796              auto FileContents = std::format("{}\n", Hostname);
     797              if (UtilWriteStringView(HostnameFd.get(), FileContents) < 0)
     798              {
     799                  LOG_ERROR("write failed {}", errno);
     800              }
     801          }
     802          CATCH_LOG()
     803      }
     804  
     805      HostnameFd.reset();
     806  
     807      //
     808      // Generate and write /etc/hosts.
     809      //
     810  
     811      if (Config.GenerateHosts)
     812      {
     813          wil::unique_fd HostsFd{TEMP_FAILURE_RETRY(creat(HOSTS_FILE_PATH, HOSTS_FILE_MODE))};
     814          if (!HostsFd)
     815          {
     816              LOG_ERROR("creat {} failed {}", HOSTS_FILE_PATH, errno);
     817          }
     818          else
     819          {
     820              try
     821              {
     822                  auto FileContents = std::format(HostsFileFormatString, Hostname.c_str(), Domainname, Hostname.c_str(), WindowsHosts);
     823                  if (UtilWriteStringView(HostsFd.get(), FileContents) < 0)
     824                  {
     825                      LOG_ERROR("write failed {}", errno);
     826                  }
     827              }
     828              CATCH_LOG()
     829          }
     830      }
     831      else
     832      {
     833          LOG_WARNING("{} updating disabled in {}", HOSTS_FILE_PATH, CONFIG_FILE);
     834      }
     835  
     836      //
     837      // Store the distribution name.
     838      //
     839  
     840      if (setenv(WSL_DISTRO_NAME_ENV, DistributionName, 1) < 0)
     841      {
     842          LOG_ERROR("setenv({}, {}, 1) failed {}", WSL_DISTRO_NAME_ENV, DistributionName, errno);
     843      }
     844  
     845      //
     846      // Run the Plan 9 server. This requires a DrvFs mount for the socket file,
     847      // so either fstab or automount must be enabled to have a chance for the
     848      // mount to be available.
     849      //
     850      // N.B. Failure to start the server is non-fatal.
     851      //
     852  
     853      unsigned int Plan9Port = LX_INIT_UTILITY_VM_INVALID_PORT;
     854      if ((WI_IsFlagClear(Config.FeatureFlags.value(), LxInitFeatureDisable9pServer)) && (Config.Plan9Enabled) &&
     855          (Config.AutoMount || Config.MountFsTab))
     856      {
     857          std::tie(Plan9Port, Config.Plan9ControlChannel) = StartPlan9Server(Plan9SocketPath, Config);
     858      }
     859  
     860      //
     861      // If the root filesystem is compressed, log a warning.
     862      //
     863  
     864      if (WI_IsFlagSet(Config.FeatureFlags.value(), LxInitFeatureRootfsCompressed))
     865      {
     866          LOG_WARNING("{} root file system is compressed, performance may be severely impacted.", DistributionName);
     867      }
     868  
     869      //
     870      // Update the timezone.
     871      //
     872  
     873      UpdateTimezone(Timezone, Config);
     874  
     875      if (Config.BootInit)
     876      {
     877          try
     878          {
     879              // Create the /run/user bind mount.
     880              // This mount is required because systemd will mount a tmpfs on each /run/user/<uid> folder
     881              // so /run/user need to be in the global mount namespace so both elevated and non elevated processes see it.
     882              const auto UserMountTarget = Config.DrvFsPrefix + WSLG_SHARED_FOLDER "/run/user";
     883              THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(UtilMkdirPath(UserMountTarget.c_str(), 0755) < 0);
     884              THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(UtilMount(UserMountTarget.c_str(), RUN_FOLDER "/" USER_MOUNT_FOLDER, nullptr, MS_BIND, nullptr) < 0)
     885          }
     886          CATCH_LOG();
     887      }
     888  
     889      //
     890      // Create a listening hvsocket for interop if the feature is enabled.
     891      //
     892  
     893      wil::unique_fd ListenSocket{};
     894      sockaddr_vm SocketAddress{};
     895      if (UtilIsUtilityVm() && Config.InteropEnabled)
     896      {
     897          ListenSocket = UtilListenVsockAnyPort(&SocketAddress, 1);
     898      }
     899  
     900      //
     901      // Send the config response to the service.
     902      //
     903  
     904      wsl::shared::MessageWriter<LX_INIT_CONFIGURATION_INFORMATION_RESPONSE> Response(LxInitMessageInitializeResponse);
     905      Response->Plan9Port = Plan9Port;
     906      Response->DefaultUid = DefaultUid;
     907      Response->InteropPort = ListenSocket ? SocketAddress.svm_port : LX_INIT_UTILITY_VM_INVALID_PORT;
     908      Response->SystemdEnabled = Config.BootInit;
     909  
     910      struct stat PidNamespaceInfo = {};
     911      THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(stat("/proc/self/ns/pid", &PidNamespaceInfo));
     912      Response->PidNamespace = PidNamespaceInfo.st_ino;
     913      static_assert(sizeof(Response->PidNamespace) == sizeof(PidNamespaceInfo.st_ino));
     914  
     915      auto [Flavor, Version] = UtilReadFlavorAndVersion("/etc/os-release");
     916      if (Flavor.has_value())
     917      {
     918          Response.WriteString(Response->FlavorIndex, Flavor->c_str());
     919      }
     920  
     921      if (Version.has_value())
     922      {
     923          Response.WriteString(Response->VersionIndex, Version->c_str());
     924      }
     925  
     926      Channel.SendMessage<LX_INIT_CONFIGURATION_INFORMATION_RESPONSE>(Response.Span());
     927  
     928      //
     929      // Accept the interop connection.
     930      //
     931  
     932      wsl::shared::SocketChannel InteropChannel;
     933      if (ListenSocket)
     934      {
     935          InteropChannel = {UtilAcceptVsock(ListenSocket.get(), SocketAddress, INTEROP_TIMEOUT_MS), "Interop"};
     936      }
     937  
     938      //
     939      // Create a thread to handle interop requests.
     940      //
     941  
     942      InteropServer InteropServer;
     943      if (InteropServer.Create() < 0)
     944      {
     945          FATAL_ERROR("Could not create init interop server");
     946      }
     947  
     948      //
     949      // If init is not running as pid 1, create a symlink to the interop server that was created.
     950      //
     951  
     952      if (Config.InitPid.has_value())
     953      {
     954          try
     955          {
     956              std::string LinkPath = std::format(WSL_INTEROP_SOCKET_FORMAT, WSL_TEMP_FOLDER, 1, WSL_INTEROP_SOCKET);
     957              if (symlink(InteropServer.Path(), LinkPath.c_str()) < 0)
     958              {
     959                  LOG_ERROR("symlink({}, {}) failed {}", InteropServer.Path(), LinkPath.c_str(), errno);
     960              }
     961          }
     962          CATCH_LOG()
     963      }
     964  
     965      UtilCreateWorkerThread(
     966          "Interop", [InteropChannel = std::move(InteropChannel), InteropServer = std::move(InteropServer), Elevated, &Config]() mutable {
     967              std::vector<gsl::byte> Buffer;
     968              for (;;)
     969              {
     970                  wsl::shared::SocketChannel ClientChannel{InteropServer.Accept(), "InteropServer"};
     971                  if (ClientChannel.Socket() < 0)
     972                  {
     973                      continue;
     974                  }
     975  
     976                  auto [Message, Span] = ClientChannel.ReceiveMessageOrClosed<MESSAGE_HEADER>();
     977                  if (Message == nullptr)
     978                  {
     979                      continue;
     980                  }
     981  
     982                  ConfigHandleInteropMessage(ClientChannel, InteropChannel, Elevated, Span, Message, Config);
     983              }
     984          });
     985  
     986      //
     987      // If there was a command specified in /etc/wsl.conf, run it in a child process.
     988      //
     989  
     990      if (Config.BootCommand.has_value())
     991      {
     992          UtilCreateChildProcess("BootCommand", [Command = Config.BootCommand.value(), SavedSignals = g_SavedSignalActions]() {
     993              //
     994              // Restore default signal dispositions for the child process.
     995              //
     996  
     997              THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(UtilSetSignalHandlers(SavedSignals, false) < 0);
     998              THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(UtilRestoreBlockedSignals() < 0);
     999  
    1000              execl("/bin/sh", "sh", "-c", Command.c_str(), nullptr);
    1001              LOG_ERROR("execl() failed, {}", errno);
    1002          });
    1003      }
    1004  
    1005      return 0;
    1006  }
    1007  CATCH_RETURN_ERRNO()
    1008  
    1009  int ConfigInitializeVmMode(bool Elevated, wsl::linux::WslDistributionConfig& Config)
    1010  
    1011  /*++
    1012  
    1013  Routine Description:
    1014  
    1015      This routine sets up VM Mode specific devices and mounts.
    1016  
    1017  Arguments:
    1018  
    1019      None.
    1020  
    1021  Return Value:
    1022  
    1023      0 on success, -1 on failure.
    1024  
    1025  --*/
    1026  
    1027  {
    1028      //
    1029      // Move temporary mounts created by mini_init to their final locations.
    1030      //
    1031      // N.B. Failure to mount these is not fatal.
    1032      //
    1033  
    1034      for (auto& share : g_gpuShares)
    1035      {
    1036          try
    1037          {
    1038              auto variable = LX_WSL2_GPU_SHARE_ENV + std::string{share.Name};
    1039              auto tempMount = RemoveMountAndEnvironmentOnScopeExit(variable.c_str());
    1040              if (tempMount && Config.GpuEnabled)
    1041              {
    1042                  tempMount.MoveMount(share.MountPoint);
    1043              }
    1044          }
    1045          CATCH_LOG()
    1046      }
    1047  
    1048      if (Config.GpuEnabled)
    1049      {
    1050          ConfigApplyWindowsLibPath(Config);
    1051      }
    1052  
    1053      try
    1054      {
    1055          auto tempMount = RemoveMountAndEnvironmentOnScopeExit(LX_WSL2_CROSS_DISTRO_ENV);
    1056          if (tempMount)
    1057          {
    1058              const auto target = Config.DrvFsPrefix + SHARED_MOUNT_FOLDER;
    1059              if (tempMount.MoveMount(target.c_str()))
    1060              {
    1061                  ConfigCreateResolvConfSymlink(Config);
    1062              }
    1063          }
    1064      }
    1065      CATCH_LOG()
    1066  
    1067      try
    1068      {
    1069          auto tempMount = RemoveMountAndEnvironmentOnScopeExit(LX_WSL2_SYSTEM_DISTRO_SHARE_ENV);
    1070          if (tempMount)
    1071          {
    1072              const auto target = Config.DrvFsPrefix + WSLG_SHARED_FOLDER;
    1073              if (!tempMount.MoveMount(target.c_str()))
    1074              {
    1075                  Config.GuiAppsEnabled = false;
    1076              }
    1077              else
    1078              {
    1079                  Config.GuiAppsEnabled = true;
    1080  
    1081                  //
    1082                  // Create a bind mount of the shared WSLg path at the expected location for x11 clients.
    1083                  //
    1084                  // N.B. If using distro init, this is done after waiting for the distro init to finish booting
    1085                  // since that will typically clear the /tmp directory.
    1086                  //
    1087  
    1088                  ConfigInitializeX11(Config);
    1089  
    1090                  //
    1091                  // Add environment variables to support GUI applications.
    1092                  //
    1093  
    1094                  for (const auto& var : ConfigGetWslgEnvironmentVariables(Config))
    1095                  {
    1096                      if (setenv(var.first.c_str(), var.second.c_str(), 1) < 0)
    1097                      {
    1098                          LOG_ERROR("setenv({}, {}) failed {}", var.first.c_str(), var.second.c_str(), errno);
    1099                      }
    1100                  }
    1101              }
    1102          }
    1103      }
    1104      CATCH_LOG()
    1105  
    1106      try
    1107      {
    1108          auto tempMount = RemoveMountAndEnvironmentOnScopeExit(LX_WSL2_KERNEL_MODULES_MOUNT_ENV);
    1109          if (tempMount)
    1110          {
    1111              auto target = getenv(LX_WSL2_KERNEL_MODULES_PATH_ENV);
    1112              if (target)
    1113              {
    1114                  unsetenv(LX_WSL2_KERNEL_MODULES_PATH_ENV);
    1115                  tempMount.MoveMount(target);
    1116              }
    1117          }
    1118      }
    1119      CATCH_LOG()
    1120  
    1121      //
    1122      // Change the permission of some devtmpfs devices to be more permissive.
    1123      //
    1124      // N.B. These devices may not be present with a custom kernel config.
    1125      //
    1126  
    1127      for (const auto* Device : {"/dev/fuse", "/dev/net/tun"})
    1128      {
    1129          if ((chmod(Device, 0666) < 0) && (errno != ENOENT))
    1130          {
    1131              LOG_ERROR("chmod({}, 0666) failed {}", Device, errno);
    1132              return -1;
    1133          }
    1134      }
    1135  
    1136      //
    1137      // Open a file descriptor to the current mount namespace.
    1138      //
    1139  
    1140      wil::unique_fd Namespace{UtilOpenMountNamespace()};
    1141      if (!Namespace)
    1142      {
    1143          return -1;
    1144      }
    1145  
    1146      if (Elevated)
    1147      {
    1148          g_ElevatedMountNamespace = Namespace.release();
    1149      }
    1150      else
    1151      {
    1152          g_NonElevatedMountNamespace = Namespace.release();
    1153      }
    1154  
    1155      return 0;
    1156  }
    1157  
    1158  int ConfigInitializeWsl(void)
    1159  
    1160  /*++
    1161  
    1162  Routine Description:
    1163  
    1164      This routine sets up WSL-specific devices and mounts.
    1165  
    1166  Arguments:
    1167  
    1168      None.
    1169  
    1170  Return Value:
    1171  
    1172      0 on success, -1 on failure.
    1173  
    1174  --*/
    1175  
    1176  {
    1177      unsigned int Index;
    1178      int Result;
    1179  
    1180      for (Index = 0; Index < COUNT_OF(LxssStartupWsl); Index += 1)
    1181      {
    1182          Result = ConfigInitializeEntry(&LxssStartupWsl[Index]);
    1183          if (Result < 0)
    1184          {
    1185              goto InitializeWslExit;
    1186          }
    1187      }
    1188  
    1189      //
    1190      // Initialize the serial device entries.
    1191      //
    1192  
    1193      for (Index = INIT_DEV_TTY_MINOR_NUMBER_FIRST_SERIAL; Index < INIT_DEV_TTY_MINOR_NUMBER_MAX_SERIAL; Index += 1)
    1194      {
    1195          auto TtySPath = std::format(INIT_DEV_TTY_SERIAL_FORMAT, (Index - INIT_DEV_TTY_MINOR_NUMBER_FIRST_SERIAL));
    1196  
    1197          Result = mknod(TtySPath.c_str(), INIT_DEV_TTY_SERIAL_MODE, makedev(INIT_DEV_TTY_MAJOR_NUMBER, Index));
    1198          if (Result < 0)
    1199          {
    1200              FATAL_ERROR("mknod({}) failed {}", TtySPath, errno);
    1201          }
    1202  
    1203          Result = chown(TtySPath.c_str(), INIT_DEV_TTY_SERIAL_UID, INIT_DEV_TTY_SERIAL_GID);
    1204          if (Result < 0)
    1205          {
    1206              FATAL_ERROR("chown({}) failed {}", TtySPath, errno);
    1207          }
    1208      }
    1209  
    1210      Result = 0;
    1211  
    1212  InitializeWslExit:
    1213      return Result;
    1214  }
    1215  
    1216  int ConfigInitializeEntry(PCINIT_STARTUP_ANY AnyEntry)
    1217  
    1218  /*++
    1219  
    1220  Routine Description:
    1221  
    1222      This routine creates an init startup entry.
    1223  
    1224  Arguments:
    1225  
    1226      AnyEntry - Supplies the startup entry to create.
    1227  
    1228  Return Value:
    1229  
    1230      0 on success, -1 on failure.
    1231  
    1232  --*/
    1233  
    1234  {
    1235      PCINIT_STARTUP_DIRECTORY Directory;
    1236      PCINIT_STARTUP_FILE File;
    1237      PCINIT_STARTUP_MOUNT Mount;
    1238      PCINIT_STARTUP_NODE Node;
    1239      int Result;
    1240      PCINIT_STARTUP_SYMBOLIC_LINK Symlink;
    1241  
    1242      switch (AnyEntry->Type)
    1243      {
    1244      case InitStartupTypeDirectory:
    1245          Directory = &AnyEntry->u.Directory;
    1246          Result = UtilMkdir(Directory->Path, Directory->Security.Mode);
    1247          if (Result < 0)
    1248          {
    1249              FATAL_ERROR("Failed to create {} {}", Directory->Path, errno);
    1250          }
    1251  
    1252          if (errno != EEXIST)
    1253          {
    1254              Result = chown(Directory->Path, Directory->Security.Uid, Directory->Security.Gid);
    1255              if (Result < 0)
    1256              {
    1257                  FATAL_ERROR("Failed to chown {} {}", Directory->Path, errno);
    1258              }
    1259          }
    1260  
    1261          break;
    1262  
    1263      case InitStartupTypeMount:
    1264          Mount = &AnyEntry->u.Mount;
    1265          Result = mount(Mount->DeviceName, Mount->MountLocation, Mount->FileSystemType, Mount->Flags & ~MS_SHARED, Mount->MountOptions);
    1266          if (Result < 0 && !Mount->IgnoreFailure)
    1267          {
    1268              FATAL_ERROR("Failed to mount {} at {} as {} {}", Mount->DeviceName, Mount->MountLocation, Mount->FileSystemType, errno);
    1269          }
    1270  
    1271          // N.B. The shared flag must be done in a followup mount() call
    1272          if (WI_IsFlagSet(Mount->Flags, MS_SHARED))
    1273          {
    1274              Result = mount(nullptr, Mount->MountLocation, nullptr, MS_SHARED, nullptr);
    1275              if (Result < 0 && !Mount->IgnoreFailure)
    1276              {
    1277                  FATAL_ERROR("Failed to make shared mount {} {}", Mount->MountLocation, errno);
    1278              }
    1279          }
    1280  
    1281          break;
    1282  
    1283      case InitStartupTypeNode:
    1284          Node = &AnyEntry->u.Node;
    1285          Result = mknod(Node->Path, Node->Security.Mode, makedev(Node->MajorNumber, Node->MinorNumber));
    1286          if (Result < 0)
    1287          {
    1288              FATAL_ERROR("Failed to create {} {}", Node->Path, errno);
    1289          }
    1290  
    1291          Result = chown(Node->Path, Node->Security.Uid, Node->Security.Gid);
    1292          if (Result < 0)
    1293          {
    1294              FATAL_ERROR("Failed to chown {} {}", Node->Path, errno);
    1295          }
    1296  
    1297          break;
    1298  
    1299      case InitStartupTypeSymlink:
    1300          Symlink = &AnyEntry->u.Symlink;
    1301          Result = symlink(Symlink->Target, Symlink->Source);
    1302          if ((Result < 0) && (errno != EEXIST))
    1303          {
    1304              FATAL_ERROR("Failed to create {} -> {} {}", Symlink->Source, Symlink->Target, errno);
    1305          }
    1306  
    1307          break;
    1308  
    1309      case InitStartupTypeFile:
    1310          File = &AnyEntry->u.File;
    1311          Result = TEMP_FAILURE_RETRY(creat(File->FileName, File->Mode));
    1312          if ((Result < 0) && (errno != EEXIST))
    1313          {
    1314              FATAL_ERROR("Failed to create {} {}", File->FileName, errno);
    1315              goto InitializeEntryExit;
    1316          }
    1317  
    1318          break;
    1319  
    1320      default:
    1321          FATAL_ERROR("Unsupported Type {}", AnyEntry->Type);
    1322      }
    1323  
    1324      Result = 0;
    1325  
    1326  InitializeEntryExit:
    1327      return Result;
    1328  }
    1329  
    1330  void ConfigCreateResolvConfSymlink(const wsl::linux::WslDistributionConfig& Config)
    1331  
    1332  /*++
    1333  
    1334  Routine Description:
    1335  
    1336      This routine ensures the /etc/resolv.conf symlink exists for WSL2.
    1337  
    1338  Arguments:
    1339  
    1340      Config - Supplies the distribution configuration.
    1341  
    1342  Return Value:
    1343  
    1344      0 on success, -1 on failure.
    1345  
    1346  --*/
    1347  
    1348  {
    1349      if (!UtilIsUtilityVm())
    1350      {
    1351          return;
    1352      }
    1353  
    1354      if (!Config.GenerateResolvConf)
    1355      {
    1356          LOG_WARNING("{} updating disabled in {}", RESOLV_CONF_FILE_PATH, CONFIG_FILE);
    1357  
    1358          //
    1359          // Ensure that the symlink between /etc/resolv.conf -> /mnt/wsl/resolv.conf is removed
    1360          //
    1361  
    1362          ConfigReconfigureResolvConfSymlink(Config);
    1363  
    1364          return;
    1365      }
    1366  
    1367      //
    1368      // Create a /etc/resolv.conf symlink to the file that is automatically
    1369      // generated by WSL Core.
    1370      //
    1371  
    1372      try
    1373      {
    1374          std::string Target = std::format("{}{}/{}", Config.DrvFsPrefix, SHARED_MOUNT_FOLDER, RESOLV_CONF_FILE_NAME);
    1375  
    1376          remove(RESOLV_CONF_FILE_PATH);
    1377          if (symlink(Target.c_str(), RESOLV_CONF_FILE_PATH) < 0)
    1378          {
    1379              LOG_ERROR("symlink({}, {}) failed {}", Target, RESOLV_CONF_FILE_PATH, errno);
    1380          }
    1381      }
    1382      CATCH_LOG()
    1383  }
    1384  
    1385  int ConfigCreateResolvConfSymlinkTarget(void)
    1386  
    1387  /*++
    1388  
    1389  Routine Description:
    1390  
    1391      If the /etc/resolv.conf file is a symlink, this routine will recursively
    1392      create the directory structure and target of the symlink.
    1393  
    1394  Arguments:
    1395  
    1396      None.
    1397  
    1398  Return Value:
    1399  
    1400      0 on success, -1 on failure.
    1401  
    1402  --*/
    1403  
    1404  {
    1405      bool RestoreCwd = false;
    1406      int Result;
    1407      char SymlinkBuffer[PATH_MAX + 1];
    1408      int SymlinkFd = -1;
    1409  
    1410      //
    1411      // If /etc/resolv.conf is a symlink, recursively create the directory
    1412      // structure.  If the file is not a symlink, return success. If the symlink
    1413      // does not exist, recreate it.
    1414      // TODO: move to std::filesystem
    1415      //
    1416  
    1417      Result = readlink(RESOLV_CONF_FILE_PATH, SymlinkBuffer, (sizeof(SymlinkBuffer) - 1));
    1418  
    1419      if (Result < 0)
    1420      {
    1421          if (errno == EINVAL)
    1422          {
    1423              Result = 0;
    1424              goto CreateResolvConfSymlinkTargetExit;
    1425          }
    1426          else if (errno == ENOENT)
    1427          {
    1428              Result = symlink(RESOLV_CONF_SYMLINK_TARGET, RESOLV_CONF_FILE_PATH);
    1429              if (Result < 0)
    1430              {
    1431                  LOG_ERROR("symlink({}, {}) failed {}", RESOLV_CONF_SYMLINK_TARGET, RESOLV_CONF_FILE_PATH, errno);
    1432  
    1433                  goto CreateResolvConfSymlinkTargetExit;
    1434              }
    1435  
    1436              Result = readlink(RESOLV_CONF_FILE_PATH, SymlinkBuffer, (sizeof(SymlinkBuffer) - 1));
    1437          }
    1438  
    1439          if (Result < 0)
    1440          {
    1441              LOG_ERROR("readlink({}) failed {}", RESOLV_CONF_FILE_PATH, errno);
    1442              goto CreateResolvConfSymlinkTargetExit;
    1443          }
    1444      }
    1445  
    1446      //
    1447      // Null-terminate the symlink buffer string.
    1448      //
    1449  
    1450      SymlinkBuffer[Result] = '\0';
    1451  
    1452      //
    1453      // Set current working directory to the folder that contains the resolv.conf
    1454      // symlink.
    1455      //
    1456      // N.B. This is so creating the target of the symlinks will work since they
    1457      //      may use relative symlinks.
    1458      //
    1459  
    1460      Result = chdir(ETC_FOLDER);
    1461      if (Result < 0)
    1462      {
    1463          LOG_ERROR("chdir {} failed {}", ETC_FOLDER, errno);
    1464          goto CreateResolvConfSymlinkTargetExit;
    1465      }
    1466  
    1467      RestoreCwd = true;
    1468  
    1469      //
    1470      // Check if the symlink target exists, if the file exists return success. If
    1471      // it does not exist, recursively create the directory structure.
    1472      //
    1473  
    1474      Result = access(SymlinkBuffer, W_OK);
    1475      if (Result == 0)
    1476      {
    1477          goto CreateResolvConfSymlinkTargetExit;
    1478      }
    1479      else if (errno != ENOENT)
    1480      {
    1481          Result = -1;
    1482          LOG_ERROR("access {} W_OK failed {}", SymlinkBuffer, errno);
    1483          goto CreateResolvConfSymlinkTargetExit;
    1484      }
    1485  
    1486      //
    1487      // Recursively create the directory structure.
    1488      //
    1489  
    1490      Result = UtilMkdirPath(SymlinkBuffer, RESOLV_CONF_DIRECTORY_MODE, true);
    1491  
    1492      //
    1493      // The symlink target itself does not need to be created here, as it will
    1494      // be created when the symlink is opened later.
    1495      //
    1496  
    1497      Result = 0;
    1498  
    1499  CreateResolvConfSymlinkTargetExit:
    1500      if (RestoreCwd != false)
    1501      {
    1502          if (chdir(DEFAULT_CWD) < 0)
    1503          {
    1504              LOG_ERROR("chdir({}) failed {}", DEFAULT_CWD, errno);
    1505          }
    1506      }
    1507  
    1508      if (SymlinkFd != -1)
    1509      {
    1510          CLOSE(SymlinkFd);
    1511      }
    1512  
    1513      return Result;
    1514  }
    1515  
    1516  int ConfigReconfigureResolvConfSymlink(const wsl::linux::WslDistributionConfig& Config)
    1517  
    1518  /*++
    1519  
    1520  Routine Description:
    1521  
    1522      Checks the value of the Config.GenerateResolvConf and removes the symlink (if one has been set previously)
    1523  
    1524  Arguments:
    1525  
    1526      Config - Supplies the Distribution Configuration.
    1527  
    1528  Return Value:
    1529  
    1530      0 on success, -1 on failure.
    1531  
    1532  --*/
    1533  
    1534  {
    1535      int Result;
    1536      char SymLinkBuffer[PATH_MAX + 1];
    1537  
    1538      // check if /etc/resolv.conf is symlink
    1539      // TODO: move to std::filesystem.
    1540      Result = readlink(RESOLV_CONF_FILE_PATH, SymLinkBuffer, (sizeof(SymLinkBuffer) - 1));
    1541      if (Result < 0)
    1542      {
    1543          if (errno == EINVAL || errno == ENOENT)
    1544          {
    1545              Result = 0;
    1546          }
    1547          else
    1548          {
    1549              LOG_ERROR("readlink({}) failed {}", RESOLV_CONF_FILE_PATH, errno);
    1550          }
    1551  
    1552          return Result;
    1553      }
    1554  
    1555      // null-terminate the symlink buffer string
    1556      SymLinkBuffer[Result] = '\0';
    1557  
    1558      // recreate the location of [automount root]/wsl/resolv.conf
    1559      auto target = Config.DrvFsPrefix + std::string{RESOLV_CONF_SYMLINK_WSL_MOUNT_SUFFIX};
    1560  
    1561      // check if the symlink is pointing to /mnt/wsl/resolv.conf created by wslcore
    1562      // do not interfere with symlinks set by other networking management processes (ie. resolvconf, NetworkManager, etc.)
    1563      if (std::string_view{SymLinkBuffer} == target)
    1564      {
    1565          // generateResolveConf setting has changed, remove symlink and restore if specified
    1566          Result = remove(RESOLV_CONF_FILE_PATH);
    1567          if (Result < 0)
    1568          {
    1569              LOG_ERROR("remove({}) failed {}", RESOLV_CONF_FILE_PATH, errno);
    1570          }
    1571      }
    1572  
    1573      return Result;
    1574  }
    1575  
    1576  EnvironmentBlock ConfigCreateEnvironmentBlock(const PLX_INIT_CREATE_PROCESS_COMMON Common, const wsl::linux::WslDistributionConfig& Config)
    1577  
    1578  /*++
    1579  
    1580  Routine Description:
    1581  
    1582      This routine creates the environment block to be used when launching a new
    1583      process.
    1584  
    1585  Arguments:
    1586  
    1587      Common - Supplies a pointer to the common create process message data.
    1588  
    1589  Return Value:
    1590  
    1591      An environment block.
    1592  
    1593  --*/
    1594  
    1595  {
    1596      //
    1597      // Initialize the environment block.
    1598      //
    1599  
    1600      auto Buffer = (char*)Common + Common->EnvironmentOffset;
    1601      EnvironmentBlock Environment(Buffer, Common->EnvironmentCount);
    1602  
    1603      //
    1604      // Add environment variables to support GUI applications.
    1605      //
    1606      // N.B. This must be done before processing WSLENV so the user can override
    1607      //      these values if desired.
    1608      //
    1609  
    1610      if (Config.GuiAppsEnabled)
    1611      {
    1612          for (const auto& Var : ConfigGetWslgEnvironmentVariables(Config))
    1613          {
    1614              Environment.AddVariable(Var.first, Var.second);
    1615          }
    1616      }
    1617  
    1618      //
    1619      // Add each Windows environment variable from WSLENV to the environment block.
    1620      //
    1621      // N.B. Failure to parse WSLENV is non-fatal.
    1622      //
    1623  
    1624      Buffer = (char*)Common + Common->NtEnvironmentOffset;
    1625      auto NtEnvironment = UtilParseWslEnv(Buffer);
    1626      if (!NtEnvironment.empty())
    1627      {
    1628          for (size_t Index = 0;;)
    1629          {
    1630              Buffer = NtEnvironment.data() + Index;
    1631              auto Length = strnlen(Buffer, NtEnvironment.size() - Index);
    1632              if (Length == 0)
    1633              {
    1634                  break;
    1635              }
    1636  
    1637              auto Value = strchr(Buffer, '=');
    1638              if (Value != NULL)
    1639              {
    1640                  *Value = '\0';
    1641                  Value += 1;
    1642                  Environment.AddVariable(Buffer, Value);
    1643              }
    1644  
    1645              Index += Length + 1;
    1646          }
    1647      }
    1648  
    1649      //
    1650      // Add the GPU library to the $PATH variable. This is done because some GPU
    1651      // vendors ship small utilities along with their usermode drivers.
    1652      //
    1653  
    1654      if (UtilIsUtilityVm())
    1655      {
    1656          if (Config.AppendGpuLibPath && Config.GpuEnabled)
    1657          {
    1658              ConfigAppendToPath(Environment, LXSS_LIB_PATH);
    1659          }
    1660      }
    1661  
    1662      //
    1663      // Translate the NT path into a list of Linux paths and add it to the PATH
    1664      // environment variable. Individual path elements that fail to translate
    1665      // are skipped.
    1666      //
    1667      // N.B. Failure to append the NT path is non-fatal.
    1668      //
    1669  
    1670      Buffer = reinterpret_cast<char*>(Common) + Common->NtPathOffset;
    1671      if ((Config.InteropAppendWindowsPath) && (*Buffer != '\0'))
    1672      {
    1673          ConfigAppendNtPath(Environment, Buffer);
    1674      }
    1675  
    1676      return Environment;
    1677  }
    1678  
    1679  std::set<std::pair<unsigned int, std::string>> ConfigGetMountedDrvFsVolumes(void)
    1680  
    1681  /*++
    1682  
    1683  Routine Description:
    1684  
    1685      This routine returns a bitmap indicating which Windows drive letters are
    1686      already mounted.
    1687  
    1688      N.B. If this function fails, it just returns 0, since failure is not
    1689           considered fatal here.
    1690  
    1691  Arguments:
    1692  
    1693      None.
    1694  
    1695  Return Value:
    1696  
    1697      The bitmap of mounted drives.
    1698  
    1699  --*/
    1700  
    1701  {
    1702      std::set<std::pair<unsigned int, std::string>> MountPoints;
    1703      mountutil::MountEnum MountEnum;
    1704      while (MountEnum.Next())
    1705      {
    1706          //
    1707          // Do not consider bind mounts.
    1708          //
    1709  
    1710          if (strcmp(MountEnum.Current().Root, "/") != 0)
    1711          {
    1712              continue;
    1713          }
    1714  
    1715          //
    1716          // Extract the correct mount source depending on whether this is 9p
    1717          // (WSL2) or DrvFs (WSL1). For virtio-9p, the entry's mount source
    1718          // will just be "drvfs" or "drvfsa", so it must be extracted from the
    1719          // aname (this works for hvsocket-9p too).
    1720          // N.B. UtilParsePlan9MountSource always returns a canonicalized path.
    1721          //
    1722  
    1723          std::string MountSource;
    1724          if (strcmp(MountEnum.Current().FileSystemType, PLAN9_FS_TYPE) == 0)
    1725          {
    1726              MountSource = UtilParsePlan9MountSource(MountEnum.Current().SuperOptions);
    1727          }
    1728          else if (strcmp(MountEnum.Current().FileSystemType, DRVFS_FS_TYPE) == 0)
    1729          {
    1730              MountSource = MountEnum.Current().Source;
    1731              UtilCanonicalisePathSeparator(MountSource, PATH_SEP_NT);
    1732          }
    1733          else if (strcmp(MountEnum.Current().FileSystemType, VIRTIO_FS_TYPE) == 0)
    1734          {
    1735              MountSource = QueryVirtiofsMountSource(MountEnum.Current().Source);
    1736          }
    1737          else
    1738          {
    1739              continue;
    1740          }
    1741  
    1742          if (MountSource.empty())
    1743          {
    1744              continue;
    1745          }
    1746  
    1747          auto letter = ConfigGetDriveLetter(MountSource);
    1748          if (letter.has_value())
    1749          {
    1750              MountPoints.emplace(letter.value(), MountEnum.Current().MountPoint);
    1751          }
    1752      }
    1753  
    1754      return MountPoints;
    1755  }
    1756  
    1757  std::vector<std::pair<std::string, std::string>> ConfigGetWslgEnvironmentVariables(const wsl::linux::WslDistributionConfig& Config)
    1758  
    1759  /*++
    1760  
    1761  Routine Description:
    1762  
    1763      This routine returns the environment variables needed by WSLg.
    1764  
    1765  Arguments:
    1766  
    1767      None.
    1768  
    1769  Return Value:
    1770  
    1771      A list of environment variables.
    1772  
    1773  --*/
    1774  
    1775  {
    1776      std::string WaylandPath = std::format("{}{}/{}", Config.DrvFsPrefix, WSLG_SHARED_FOLDER, WAYLAND_RUNTIME_DIR);
    1777      std::string PulsePath = std::format("unix:{}{}/{}", Config.DrvFsPrefix, WSLG_SHARED_FOLDER, PULSE_SERVER_NAME);
    1778      return std::vector<std::pair<std::string, std::string>>{
    1779          {XDG_RUNTIME_DIR_ENV, std::move(WaylandPath)},
    1780          {X11_DISPLAY_ENV, X11_DISPLAY_VALUE},
    1781          {WAYLAND_DISPLAY_ENV, WAYLAND_DISPLAY_VALUE},
    1782          {PULSE_SERVER_ENV, std::move(PulsePath)},
    1783          {LX_WSL2_GUI_APP_SUPPORT_ENV, "1"}};
    1784  }
    1785  
    1786  void ConfigInitializeCgroups(wsl::linux::WslDistributionConfig& Config)
    1787  
    1788  /*++
    1789  
    1790  Routine Description:
    1791  
    1792      This parses the /proc/cgroups file and mounts enabled cgroups.
    1793  
    1794      N.B. This routine was modeled after the cgroupfs-mount script.
    1795  
    1796  Arguments:
    1797  
    1798      Config - Supplies the distribution configuration.
    1799  
    1800  Return Value:
    1801  
    1802      None.
    1803  
    1804  --*/
    1805  
    1806  try
    1807  {
    1808      std::vector<std::string> DisabledControllers;
    1809  
    1810      if (UtilIsUtilityVm())
    1811      {
    1812          if (Config.CGroup == WslDistributionConfig::CGroupVersion::v1)
    1813          {
    1814              auto commandLine = UtilReadFileContent("/proc/cmdline");
    1815              auto position = commandLine.find(CGROUPS_NO_V1);
    1816              if (position != std::string::npos)
    1817              {
    1818                  auto list = commandLine.substr(position + sizeof(CGROUPS_NO_V1) - 1);
    1819                  auto end = list.find_first_of(" \n");
    1820                  if (end != std::string::npos)
    1821                  {
    1822                      list = list.substr(0, end);
    1823                  }
    1824  
    1825                  if (list == "all")
    1826                  {
    1827                      LOG_WARNING("Distribution has cgroupv1 enabled, but kernel command line has {}all. Falling back to cgroupv2", CGROUPS_NO_V1);
    1828                      Config.CGroup = WslDistributionConfig::CGroupVersion::v2;
    1829                  }
    1830                  else
    1831                  {
    1832                      DisabledControllers = wsl::shared::string::Split(list, ',');
    1833                  }
    1834              }
    1835          }
    1836  
    1837          if (Config.CGroup == WslDistributionConfig::CGroupVersion::v1)
    1838          {
    1839              THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(mount("tmpfs", CGROUP_MOUNTPOINT, "tmpfs", (MS_NOSUID | MS_NODEV | MS_NOEXEC), "mode=755") < 0);
    1840          }
    1841  
    1842          const auto Target = Config.CGroup == WslDistributionConfig::CGroupVersion::v1 ? CGROUP_MOUNTPOINT "/unified" : CGROUP_MOUNTPOINT;
    1843          THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(
    1844              UtilMount(CGROUP2_DEVICE, Target, CGROUP2_DEVICE, (MS_NOSUID | MS_NODEV | MS_NOEXEC | MS_RELATIME), "nsdelegate") < 0);
    1845  
    1846          if (Config.CGroup == WslDistributionConfig::CGroupVersion::v2)
    1847          {
    1848              return;
    1849          }
    1850      }
    1851      else
    1852      {
    1853          THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(mount("tmpfs", CGROUP_MOUNTPOINT, "tmpfs", (MS_NOSUID | MS_NODEV | MS_NOEXEC), "mode=755") < 0);
    1854      }
    1855  
    1856      //
    1857      // Mount cgroup v1 when running in WSL1 mode or when a WSL2 distro has automount.cgroups=v1 specified.
    1858      //
    1859      // Open the /proc/cgroups file and parse each line, ignoring malformed
    1860      // lines and disabled controllers.
    1861      //
    1862  
    1863      wil::unique_file Cgroups{fopen(CGROUPS_FILE, "r")};
    1864      THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(!Cgroups);
    1865  
    1866      ssize_t BytesRead;
    1867      char* Line = nullptr;
    1868      auto LineCleanup = wil::scope_exit([&]() { free(Line); });
    1869      size_t LineLength = 0;
    1870      while ((BytesRead = getline(&Line, &LineLength, Cgroups.get())) != -1)
    1871      {
    1872          char* Subsystem = nullptr;
    1873          bool Enabled = false;
    1874          if ((UtilParseCgroupsLine(Line, &Subsystem, &Enabled) < 0) || (Enabled == false) ||
    1875              std::find(DisabledControllers.begin(), DisabledControllers.end(), Subsystem) != DisabledControllers.end())
    1876  
    1877          {
    1878              continue;
    1879          }
    1880  
    1881          auto Target = std::format("{}/{}", CGROUP_MOUNTPOINT, Subsystem);
    1882          THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(
    1883              UtilMount(CGROUP_DEVICE, Target.c_str(), CGROUP_DEVICE, (MS_NOSUID | MS_NODEV | MS_NOEXEC | MS_RELATIME), Subsystem) < 0);
    1884      }
    1885  }
    1886  CATCH_LOG()
    1887  
    1888  std::optional<unsigned int> ConfigGetDriveLetter(std::string_view MountSource)
    1889  
    1890  /*++
    1891  
    1892  Routine Description:
    1893  
    1894      This routine extracts the drive letter from a mount source.
    1895  
    1896      N.B. Recognized formats are "X:", "X:\134" (the escape sequence for a
    1897           backslash used in /proc/self/mounts) and "X:/", where X may be
    1898           lowercase or uppercase.
    1899  
    1900  Arguments:
    1901  
    1902      MountSource - Supplies the mount source.
    1903  
    1904  Return Value:
    1905  
    1906      The drive letter index as an integer (0 is 'A', 1 is 'B' and so on).
    1907  
    1908  --*/
    1909  
    1910  {
    1911      //
    1912      // The length must be 2 or 3 and the second character must always be ':'.
    1913      //
    1914  
    1915      if ((MountSource.length() < 2) || (MountSource.length() > 3) || (MountSource[1] != ':'))
    1916      {
    1917          return {};
    1918      }
    1919  
    1920      //
    1921      // If there are three characters, the third one must be a path separator.
    1922      //
    1923  
    1924      if (MountSource.length() == 3 && MountSource[2] != '/' && MountSource[2] != '\\')
    1925      {
    1926          return {};
    1927      }
    1928  
    1929      //
    1930      // Extract the drive letter from the first character.
    1931      //
    1932  
    1933      if ((MountSource[0] >= 'a') && (MountSource[0] <= 'z'))
    1934      {
    1935          return MountSource[0] - 'a';
    1936      }
    1937      else if ((MountSource[0] >= 'A') && (MountSource[0] <= 'Z'))
    1938      {
    1939          return MountSource[0] - 'A';
    1940      }
    1941  
    1942      return {};
    1943  }
    1944  
    1945  void ConfigMountDrvFsVolumes(unsigned int DrvFsVolumes, uid_t OwnerUid, std::optional<bool> Admin, const wsl::linux::WslDistributionConfig& Config)
    1946  
    1947  /*++
    1948  
    1949  Routine Description:
    1950  
    1951      This routine mounts the specified DrvFs volumes.
    1952  
    1953  Arguments:
    1954  
    1955      DrvFsVolumes - Supplies a bitmap that contains the indices of DrvFs volumes
    1956          to mount.
    1957  
    1958      OwnerUid - Supplies the owner uid to use.
    1959  
    1960      Admin - Supplies an optional boolean to specify if the admin or non-admin
    1961          server should be used.
    1962  
    1963  Return Value:
    1964  
    1965      None.
    1966  
    1967  --*/
    1968  
    1969  try
    1970  {
    1971      if (DrvFsVolumes == 0)
    1972      {
    1973          return;
    1974      }
    1975  
    1976      //
    1977      // If fstab was processed, exclude already mounted volumes.
    1978      //
    1979  
    1980      std::set<std::pair<unsigned int, std::string>> MountedVolumes;
    1981      if (Config.MountFsTab)
    1982      {
    1983          MountedVolumes = ConfigGetMountedDrvFsVolumes();
    1984      }
    1985  
    1986      //
    1987      // Attempt to determine the owner gid to use.
    1988      //
    1989      // N.B. If no entry is found, root is used as the owner gid.
    1990      //
    1991  
    1992      auto OwnerGid = ROOT_GID;
    1993      auto Password = getpwuid(OwnerUid);
    1994      if (Password != nullptr)
    1995      {
    1996          OwnerGid = Password->pw_gid;
    1997      }
    1998  
    1999      //
    2000      // Initialize the mount options.
    2001      //
    2002      // N.B. If the options weren't specified, ConfigDrvFsOptions will be an
    2003      //      empty string. Since DrvFs ignores empty mount options, the extra
    2004      //      comma on the end in that case is not a problem.
    2005      //
    2006  
    2007      std::string Options =
    2008          std::format("noatime,uid={},gid={},{}", OwnerUid, OwnerGid, Config.DrvFsOptions.has_value() ? Config.DrvFsOptions->c_str() : "");
    2009  
    2010      //
    2011      // Iterate over the bitmap and attempt to create a DrvFs mount for each
    2012      // drive letter.
    2013      //
    2014      // N.B. __builtin_ffsll returns a one-based index.
    2015      //
    2016  
    2017      char Source[] = DRVFS_SOURCE;
    2018      for (int Index = __builtin_ffsll(DrvFsVolumes); Index != 0; Index = __builtin_ffsll(DrvFsVolumes))
    2019      {
    2020          //
    2021          // Mask out the current Index.
    2022          //
    2023  
    2024          Index -= 1;
    2025          DrvFsVolumes ^= (1 << Index);
    2026  
    2027          //
    2028          // If this drive is already mounted on the same mountpoint, skip.
    2029          //
    2030  
    2031          auto Target = std::format("{}{:c}", Config.DrvFsPrefix, 'a' + Index);
    2032          if (MountedVolumes.contains(std::make_pair(Index, Target.c_str())))
    2033          {
    2034              LOG_WARNING("{} already mounted, skipping...", Target);
    2035              continue;
    2036          }
    2037  
    2038          //
    2039          // Create the target directory and attempt the mount.
    2040          //
    2041  
    2042          if (UtilMkdir(Target.c_str(), DRVFS_TARGET_MODE) < 0)
    2043          {
    2044              continue;
    2045          }
    2046  
    2047          Source[0] = 'A' + Index;
    2048          if (MountDrvfs(Source, Target.c_str(), Options.c_str(), Admin, Config) < 0)
    2049          {
    2050              EMIT_USER_WARNING(wsl::shared::Localization::MessageDrvfsMountFailed(Source));
    2051          }
    2052      }
    2053  }
    2054  CATCH_LOG()
    2055  
    2056  static void ConfigApplyWindowsLibPath(const wsl::linux::WslDistributionConfig& Config)
    2057  
    2058  /*++
    2059  
    2060  Routine Description:
    2061  
    2062      This routine creates a file for the GNU loader to include in its
    2063      library search paths, located under /etc/ld.so.conf.d/.
    2064  
    2065      After writing this file, /sbin/ldconfig will be invoked to update the cache.
    2066  
    2067      N.B. Failures during this function are not fatal to instance start.
    2068  
    2069  Arguments:
    2070  
    2071      Config - Supplies the distribution configuration.
    2072  
    2073  Return Value:
    2074  
    2075      None.
    2076  
    2077  --*/
    2078  
    2079  {
    2080      const char* const LdConfigArgv[] = {LDCONFIG_COMMAND, nullptr};
    2081  
    2082      if (!Config.LinkOsLibs)
    2083      {
    2084          return;
    2085      }
    2086  
    2087      wil::unique_fd Fd{TEMP_FAILURE_RETRY(open(WINDOWS_LD_CONF_FILE, (O_CREAT | O_RDWR | O_TRUNC), WINDOWS_LD_CONF_FILE_MODE))};
    2088      if (!Fd)
    2089      {
    2090          LOG_ERROR("open {} failed {}", WINDOWS_LD_CONF_FILE, errno);
    2091          return;
    2092      }
    2093  
    2094      std::string_view Buffer{WindowsLibSearchFileHeaderString};
    2095      if (UtilWriteStringView(Fd.get(), Buffer) < 0)
    2096      {
    2097          LOG_ERROR("write failed {}", errno);
    2098          return;
    2099      }
    2100  
    2101      Buffer = LXSS_LIB_PATH;
    2102      if (UtilWriteStringView(Fd.get(), Buffer) < 0)
    2103      {
    2104          LOG_ERROR("write failed {}", errno);
    2105          return;
    2106      }
    2107  
    2108      if (UtilCreateProcessAndWait(LdConfigArgv[0], LdConfigArgv) < 0)
    2109      {
    2110          LOG_ERROR("Processing ldconfig failed");
    2111      }
    2112  }
    2113  
    2114  void ConfigMountFsTab(bool Elevated)
    2115  
    2116  /*++
    2117  
    2118  Routine Description:
    2119  
    2120      This routine runs mount -a to process the /etc/fstab file.
    2121  
    2122      N.B. Failures during this function are not fatal to instance start.
    2123  
    2124  Arguments:
    2125  
    2126      Elevated - True if the plan9 drvfs entries should use the elevated plan9 server.
    2127  
    2128  Return Value:
    2129  
    2130      None.
    2131

    2300          return -1;
    2301      }

    2373      std::string NewMountOptions;

    2375      {
    2376          if (strcmp(MountEntry.FileSystemType, PLAN9_FS_TYPE) == 0)
    2377          {
    2378              const char* NewSource = MountEntry.Source;
    2379              auto Plan9Source = UtilParsePlan9MountSource(MountEntry.SuperOptions);
    2380              if (Plan9Source.empty())

    2509  void ConfigUpdateLanguage(EnvironmentBlock& Environment)
    2510  
    2511  /*++
    2512  
    2513  Routine Description:
    2514  
    2515      This routine queries the contents of the /etc/default/locale text file and
    2516      if present updates the $LANG environment variable in the environment block.
    2517  
    2518  Arguments:
    2519  
    2520      Environment - Supplies the environment block pointer to update.
    2521  
    2522  Return Value:
    2523  
    2524      None.
    2525  
    2526  --*/
    2527  
    2528  try
    2529  {
    2530      //
    2531      // Attempt to open the /etc/default/locale file. If the file does not exist
    2532      // then the $LANG environment variable will not be updated.
    2533      //
    2534      // N.B. This file is being opened by root. The only user-visible content
    2535      //      will be the contents of the last line of the file that contains
    2536      //      "LANG=".
    2537      //
    2538  
    2539      wil::unique_file LocaleFile{fopen(LOCALE_FILE_PATH, "r")};
    2540      if (!LocaleFile)
    2541      {
    2542          if (errno != ENOENT)
    2543          {
    2544              LOG_ERROR("fopen({}) failed {}", LOCALE_FILE_PATH, errno);
    2545          }
    2546  
    2547          return;
    2548      }
    2549  
    2550      // TODO: Move to std::regex
    2551  
    2552      //
    2553      // Parse the file line-by-line looking for the "LANG=" string.
    2554      //
    2555  
    2556      char* Line = nullptr;
    2557      auto freeLine = wil::scope_exit([&Line]() { free(Line); });
    2558  
    2559      size_t LineLength = 0;
    2560      while (getline(&Line, &LineLength, LocaleFile.get()) != -1)
    2561      {
    2562          //
    2563          // Handle comments by replacing the first comment character with a null
    2564          // terminator, thus ending the string.
    2565          //
    2566  
    2567          auto SpecialCharacter = strchr(Line, '#');
    2568          if (SpecialCharacter != nullptr)
    2569          {
    2570              *SpecialCharacter = '\0';
    2571          }
    2572  
    2573          //
    2574          // If the current line contains the "LANG=" string, update the
    2575          // environment block with the remainder of the line.
    2576          //
    2577          // N.B. No validation is done on the contents of the string. If the
    2578          //      file contains multiple lines containing "LANG=" the last will
    2579          //      be used.
    2580          //
    2581  
    2582          auto Content = strstr(Line, LANG_ENV "=");
    2583          if (Content != nullptr)
    2584          {
    2585              Content += sizeof(LANG_ENV);
    2586  
    2587              //
    2588              // Replace newline character with a null terminator.
    2589              //
    2590  
    2591              SpecialCharacter = strchr(Content, '\n');
    2592              if (SpecialCharacter != nullptr)
    2593              {
    2594                  *SpecialCharacter = '\0';
    2595              }
    2596  
    2597              Environment.AddVariable(LANG_ENV, Content);
    2598          }
    2599      }
    2600  
    2601      return;
    2602  }

    2606  
    2607  /*++
    2608  
    2609  Routine Description:
    2610

    2677  bool CreateLoginSession(const wsl::linux::WslDistributionConfig& Config, const char* Username, uid_t Uid)
    2678  /*++
    2679  
    2680  Routine Description:
    2681  
    2682      Create a systemd login session for the given user.
    2683  
    2684  Arguments:
    2685  
    2686      Config - Supplies the WSL distribution configuration.
    2687  
    2688      Username - Supplies session username.
    2689  
    2690      Uid - Supplies the session UID.
    2691  
    2692  Return Value:
    2693  
    2694      true on success, false on failure.
    2695  
    2696  --*/
    2697  try
    2698  {
    2699      static std::mutex LoginSessionsLock;
    2700      static std::map<uid_t, int> LoginSessions;
    2701  
    2702      // Keep track of login sessions that have been created.
    2703      LoginSessionsLock.lock();
    2704      auto Unlock = wil::scope_exit([&]() { LoginSessionsLock.unlock(); });
    2705      if (LoginSessions.contains(Uid))
    2706      {
    2707          return true;
    2708      }
    2709  
    2710      int LoginLeader;
    2711      const int Result = forkpty(&LoginLeader, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr);
    2712      if (Result < 0)
    2713      {
    2714          LOG_ERROR("forkpty failed {}", errno);
    2715          return false;
    2716      }
    2717      else if (Result == 0)
    2718      {
    2719          Unlock.reset();
    2720          _exit(execl("/bin/login", "/bin/login", "-f", Username, nullptr));
    2721      }
    2722  
    2723      LoginSessions.emplace(Uid, LoginLeader);
    2724  
    2725      //
    2726      // N.B. Init needs to not ignore SIGCHLD so it can wait for the child process.
    2727      //
    2728      signal(SIGCHLD, SIG_DFL);
    2729      auto restoreDisposition = wil::scope_exit([]() { signal(SIGCHLD, SIG_IGN); });
    2730  
    2731      if (Config.BootInitTimeout > 0)
    2732      {
    2733          auto cmd = std::format("systemctl is-active user@{}.service", Uid);
    2734          try
    2735          {
    2736              return wsl::shared::retry::RetryWithTimeout<bool>(
    2737                  [&]() {
    2738                      std::string Output;
    2739                      auto exitCode = UtilExecCommandLine(cmd.c_str(), &Output, 0, false);
    2740                      if (exitCode == 0) // is-active returns 0 if the unit is active.
    2741                      {
    2742                          return true;
    2743                      }
    2744                      else if (Output == "failed\n")
    2745                      {
    2746                          LOG_ERROR("{} returned: {}", cmd, Output);
    2747                          return false;
    2748                      }
    2749  
    2750                      THROW_ERRNO(EAGAIN);
    2751                  },
    2752                  std::chrono::milliseconds{250},
    2753                  std::chrono::milliseconds{Config.BootInitTimeout});
    2754          }
    2755          catch (...)
    2756          {
    2757              LOG_ERROR("Timed out waiting for user session for uid={}", Uid);
    2758              return false;
    2759          }
    2760      }
    2761  
    2762      return true;
    2763  }
    2764  catch (...)
    2765  {
    2766      LOG_CAUGHT_EXCEPTION();
    2767      return false;
    2768  }

      27  
      28  #define PLAN9_CASE_OPTION "case="
      29  #define PLAN9_CASE_OPTION_DIR PLAN9_CASE_OPTION "dir"
      30  #define PLAN9_CASE_OPTION_FORCE PLAN9_CASE_OPTION "force"
      31  #define PLAN9_CASE_OPTION_OFF PLAN9_CASE_OPTION "off"
      32  #define PLAN9_SYMLINK_ROOT_OPTION "symlinkroot="
      33  #define PLAN9_UNC_PREFIX_LENGTH (2)
      34  
      35  #define LOG_STDERR(_errno) fprintf(stderr, "mount: %s\n", strerror(_errno))
      36

      38  constexpr int c_exitCodeMountFail = 32;

      44  std::pair<std::string, std::string> ConvertDrvfsMountOptionsToPlan9(std::string_view Options, const wsl::linux::WslDistributionConfig& Config)
      45  
      46  /*++
      47  
      48  Routine Description:
      49  
      50      This routine converts each applicable DrvFs mount option into a 9p mount option and splits
      51      non-DrvFs options to a different list.
      52  
      53  Arguments:
      54  
      55      Options - Supplies the DrvFs mount options.
      56  
      57  Return Value:
      58  
      59      A pair representing the 9p mount options, and standard mount options.
      60  
      61  --*/
      62  
      63  {
      64      using wsl::shared::string::StartsWith;
      65  
      66      std::string Plan9Options{};
      67      std::string StandardOptions{};
      68      while (!Options.empty())
      69      {
      70          auto Option = UtilStringNextToken(Options, ",");
      71          if ((Option == "metadata") || (StartsWith(Option, PLAN9_CASE_OPTION)) || (StartsWith(Option, "uid=")) ||
      72              (StartsWith(Option, "gid=")) || (StartsWith(Option, "umask=")) || (StartsWith(Option, "dmask=")) ||
      73              (StartsWith(Option, "fmask=")) || (StartsWith(Option, PLAN9_SYMLINK_ROOT_OPTION)))
      74          {
      75              if (Option == PLAN9_CASE_OPTION_FORCE)
      76              {
      77                  LOG_WARNING("{} not supported, using {}", PLAN9_CASE_OPTION_FORCE, PLAN9_CASE_OPTION_DIR);
      78                  Option = PLAN9_CASE_OPTION_DIR;
      79              }
      80  
      81              Plan9Options += ';';
      82              Plan9Options += Option;
      83          }
      84          else if (StartsWith(Option, "fallback="))
      85          {
      86              LOG_WARNING("{} not supported, ignoring...", Option);
      87          }
      88          else
      89          {
      90              StandardOptions += Option;
      91              StandardOptions += ',';
      92          }
      93      }
      94  
      95      Plan9Options += ";" PLAN9_SYMLINK_ROOT_OPTION;
      96      Plan9Options += Config.DrvFsPrefix;
      97      return {std::move(Plan9Options), std::move(StandardOptions)};
      98  }
