    1799              BytesRead = UtilReadBuffer(Sockets[0].get(), Buffer);
    1800              if (BytesRead < 0)
    1801              {
    1802                  LOG_ERROR("read failed {}", errno);
    1803                  break;
    1804              }
    1805  
    1806              //
    1807              // A zero-byte read means that the stdin socket has closed. Close
    1808              // the corresponding stdin file descriptor and remove the stdin
    1809              // socket from the poll descriptors list.
    1810              //
    1811  
    1812              if (BytesRead == 0)
    1813              {
    1814                  CLOSE(StdIn);
    1815                  StdIn = -1;
    1816                  PollDescriptors[0].fd = -1;
    1817  
    1818                  //
    1819                  // If stdin is a console, close the pseudoterminal master.
    1820                  //
    1821  
    1822                  if ((WI_IsFlagSet(CreateProcess.Common.Flags, LxInitCreateProcessFlagsStdInConsole)) && (Master != -1))
    1823                  {
    1824                      CLOSE(Master);
    1825                      Master = -1;
    1826                      PollDescriptors[3].fd = -1;
    1827                  }
    1828              }
    1829              else
    1830              {
    1831                  BytesWritten = write(StdIn, Buffer.data(), BytesRead);
    1832                  if (BytesWritten < 0)
    1833                  {
    1834                      //
    1835                      // If writing on stdin's pipe would block, mark the write as pending and continue.
    1836                      // This is required blocking on the write() could lead to a deadlock if the child process
    1837                      // is blocking trying to write on stderr / stdout while the relay tries to write stdin.
    1838                      //
    1839  
    1840                      if (errno == EWOULDBLOCK || errno == EAGAIN)
    1841                      {
    1842                          assert(PendingStdin.empty());
    1843                          PendingStdin.assign(Buffer.begin(), Buffer.begin() + BytesRead);
    1844                      }
    1845                      else
    1846                      {
    1847                          LOG_ERROR("write failed {}", errno);
    1848                          break;
    1849                      }
    1850                  }
    1851              }
    1852          }
    1853  
    1854          //
    1855          // Relay output from the stdout and stderr pipes.
    1856          //
    1857  
    1858          for (Index = 1; Index < 3; Index += 1)
    1859          {
    1860              if (PollDescriptors[Index].revents & (POLLIN | POLLHUP | POLLERR))
    1861              {
    1862                  BytesRead = UtilReadBuffer(PollDescriptors[Index].fd, Buffer);
    1863                  if (BytesRead <= 0)
    1864                  {
    1865                      if (BytesRead < 0)
    1866                      {
    1867                          LOG_ERROR("read failed {} {}", BytesRead, errno);
    1868                      }
    1869  
    1870                      PollDescriptors[Index].fd = -1;
    1871                      UtilSocketShutdown(Sockets[Index].get(), SHUT_WR);
    1872                      continue;
    1873                  }
    1874  
    1875                  BytesWritten = UtilWriteBuffer(Sockets[Index].get(), Buffer.data(), BytesRead);
    1876                  if (BytesWritten < 0)
    1877                  {
    1878                      if (errno == EPIPE)
    1879                      {
    1880                          CLOSE(PollDescriptors[Index].fd);
    1881                          PollDescriptors[Index].fd = -1;
    1882  
    1883                          if (Index == 1)
    1884                          {
    1885                              StdOutPipe.read().reset();
    1886                          }
    1887                          else if (Index == 2)
    1888                          {
    1889                              StdErrPipe.read().reset();
    1890                          }
    1891                      }
    1892                      else
    1893                      {
    1894                          LOG_ERROR("write failed {}, index={}, ChildPid={}, fd={}", errno, Index, ChildPid, Sockets[Index].get());
    1895                      }
    1896                  }
    1897              }
    1898          }
    1899  
    1900          //
    1901          // Relay output from the PTY master to the stdout or stderr socket.
    1902          //
    1903  
    1904          if (PollDescriptors[3].revents & (POLLIN | POLLHUP | POLLERR))
    1905          {
    1906              BytesRead = UtilReadBuffer(Master, Buffer);
    1907  
    1908              //
    1909              // N.B. The pty will fail with EIO on read on hangup instead of
    1910              //      indicating EOF.
    1911              //
    1912  
    1913              if (BytesRead == 0 || (BytesRead < 0 && errno == EIO))
    1914              {
    1915                  PollDescriptors[3].fd = -1;
    1916                  if (WI_IsFlagSet(CreateProcess.Common.Flags, LxInitCreateProcessFlagsStdOutConsole))
    1917                  {
    1918                      UtilSocketShutdown(Sockets[1].get(), SHUT_WR);
    1919                  }
    1920  
    1921                  if (WI_IsFlagSet(CreateProcess.Common.Flags, LxInitCreateProcessFlagsStdErrConsole))
    1922                  {
    1923                      UtilSocketShutdown(Sockets[2].get(), SHUT_WR);
    1924                  }
    1925              }
    1926              else if (BytesRead < 0)
    1927              {
    1928                  LOG_ERROR("read failed {} {}", BytesRead, errno);
    1929                  break;
    1930              }
    1931              else
    1932              {
    1933                  if (WI_IsFlagSet(CreateProcess.Common.Flags, LxInitCreateProcessFlagsStdOutConsole))
    1934                  {
    1935                      BytesWritten = UtilWriteBuffer(Sockets[1].get(), Buffer.data(), BytesRead);
    1936                  }
    1937                  else if (WI_IsFlagSet(CreateProcess.Common.Flags, LxInitCreateProcessFlagsStdErrConsole))
    1938                  {
    1939                      BytesWritten = UtilWriteBuffer(Sockets[2].get(), Buffer.data(), BytesRead);
    1940                  }
    1941                  else
    1942                  {
    1943                      LOG_ERROR("Unexpected output from PTY master");
    1944                  }
    1945  
    1946                  if (BytesWritten < 0)
    1947                  {
    1948                      LOG_ERROR("write failed {}", errno);
    1949                      break;
    1950                  }
    1951              }
    1952          }
    1953  
    1954          //
    1955          // Ensure all data has been written.
    1956          //
    1957  
    1958          if (BytesWritten > 0)
    1959          {
    1960              continue;
    1961          }
    1962  
    1963          //
    1964          // Handle interop requests by relaying create process messages from
    1965          // children over the control channel.
    1966          //
    1967  
    1968          if (PollDescriptors[4].revents & POLLIN)
    1969          {
    1970  
    1971              wsl::shared::SocketChannel channel(InteropServer.Accept(), "InteropRelay");
    1972              if (channel.Socket() < 0)
    1973              {
    1974                  continue;
    1975              }
    1976  
    1977              auto [Header, Span] = channel.ReceiveMessageOrClosed<MESSAGE_HEADER>();
    1978              if (Header != nullptr)
    1979              {
    1980                  try
    1981                  {
    1982                      ConfigHandleInteropMessage(
    1983                          channel, ControlChannel, WI_IsFlagSet(CreateProcess.Common.Flags, LxInitCreateProcessFlagsElevated), Span, Header, Config);
    1984                  }
    1985                  CATCH_LOG();
    1986              }
    1987          }
    1988  
    1989          //
    1990          // Handle signalfd.
    1991          //
    1992  
    1993          if (PollDescriptors[5].revents & POLLIN)
    1994          {
    1995              BytesRead = TEMP_FAILURE_RETRY(read(PollDescriptors[5].fd, &SignalInfo, sizeof(SignalInfo)));
    1996              if (BytesRead != sizeof(SignalInfo))
    1997              {
    1998                  LOG_ERROR("read failed {} {}", BytesRead, errno);
    1999                  break;
    2000              }
    2001  
    2002              if (SignalInfo.ssi_signo != SIGCHLD)
    2003              {
    2004                  LOG_ERROR("Unexpected signal {}", SignalInfo.ssi_signo);
    2005                  break;
    2006              }
    2007  
    2008              //
    2009              // Reap any zombie child processes.
    2010              //
    2011  
    2012              for (;;)
    2013              {
    2014                  Result = waitpid(-1, &Status, WNOHANG);
    2015                  if (Result <= 0)
    2016                  {
    2017                      break;
    2018                  }
    2019  
    2020                  //
    2021                  // If the child process exits, write the exit status message
    2022                  // via the control channel and shut down the stdin / stdout /
    2023                  // stderr sockets.
    2024                  //
    2025  
    2026                  if (ChildPid == Result)
    2027                  {
    2028                      if (WIFEXITED(Status))
    2029                      {
    2030                          Status = WEXITSTATUS(Status);
    2031                      }
    2032  
    2033                      try
    2034                      {
    2035  
    2036                          ExitStatus.Header.MessageType = LxInitMessageExitStatus;
    2037                          ExitStatus.Header.MessageSize = sizeof(ExitStatus);
    2038                          ExitStatus.ExitCode = Status;
    2039                          ControlChannel.SendMessage(ExitStatus);
    2040  
    2041                          // The result is purposefully ignored here.
    2042                          ControlChannel.ReceiveMessage<LX_INIT_PROCESS_EXIT_STATUS>();
    2043                      }
    2044                      catch (...)
    2045                      {
    2046                          Result = -1;
    2047                          LOG_ERROR("Failed to write exit status {}", errno);
    2048                          break;
    2049                      }
    2050  
    2051                      ChildPid = -1;
    2052                      UtilSocketShutdown(Sockets[0].get(), SHUT_RD);
    2053                      UtilSocketShutdown(Sockets[1].get(), SHUT_WR);
    2054                      UtilSocketShutdown(Sockets[2].get(), SHUT_WR);
    2055                      PollDescriptors[6].fd = -1;
    2056                  }
    2057              }
    2058  
    2059              //
    2060              // Exit the relay if no more children exist.
    2061              //
    2062  
    2063              if (Result < 0)
    2064              {
    2065                  if (errno != ECHILD)
    2066                  {
    2067                      LOG_ERROR("waitpid failed {}", errno);
    2068                  }
    2069  
    2070                  break;
    2071              }
    2072          }
    2073  
    2074          //
    2075          // Process messages from wsl.exe / wslhost.exe.
    2076          //
    2077  
    2078          if (PollDescriptors[6].revents & POLLIN)
    2079          {
    2080              auto [Message, _] = TerminalControlChannel.ReceiveMessageOrClosed<LX_INIT_WINDOW_SIZE_CHANGED>();
    2081  
    2082              //
    2083              // A zero-byte read means that the control channel has been closed
    2084              // and that the relay process should exit.
    2085              //
    2086  
    2087              if (Message == nullptr)
    2088              {
    2089                  break;
    2090              }
    2091  
    2092              memset(&WindowSize, 0, sizeof(WindowSize));
    2093              WindowSize.ws_col = Message->Columns;
    2094              WindowSize.ws_row = Message->Rows;
    2095              Result = ioctl(Master, TIOCSWINSZ, &WindowSize);
    2096              if (Result < 0)
    2097              {
    2098                  LOG_ERROR("ioctl(TIOCSWINSZ) failed {}", errno);
    2099              }
    2100          }
    2101      }
    2102  
    2103      //
    2104      // Cleanly shut down the sockets.
    2105      //
    2106      // N.B. If the socket has already been shut down, this is a no-op.
    2107      //
    2108  
    2109      UtilSocketShutdown(Sockets[0].get(), SHUT_RD);
    2110      UtilSocketShutdown(Sockets[1].get(), SHUT_WR);
    2111      UtilSocketShutdown(Sockets[2].get(), SHUT_WR);
    2112      UtilSocketShutdown(Sockets[3].get(), SHUT_RD);
    2113      UtilSocketShutdown(Sockets[4].get(), SHUT_WR);
    2114      Result = 0;
    2115  
    2116  CreateProcessUtilityVmEnd:
    2117      if (ListenSocket != -1)
    2118      {
    2119          CLOSE(ListenSocket);
    2120      }
    2121  
    2122      if (Master != -1)
    2123      {
    2124          CLOSE(Master);
    2125      }
    2126  
    2127      if (SignalFd != -1)
    2128      {
    2129          CLOSE(SignalFd);
    2130      }
    2131  
    2132      if (StdIn != -1)
    2133      {
    2134          CLOSE(StdIn);
    2135      }
    2136  
    2137      if (TtyFd != -1)
    2138      {
    2139          CLOSE(TtyFd);
    2140      }
    2141  
    2142      //
    2143      // The interop server needs to be manually reset so it deletes
    2144      // its interop socket. See https://github.com/microsoft/WSL/issues/7506.
    2145      //
    2146  
    2147      InteropServer.Reset();
    2148  
    2149      //
    2150      // The relay process should always exit.
    2151      //
    2152  
    2153      if (RelayPid == 0)
    2154      {
    2155          _exit(Result);
    2156      }
    2157  
    2158      return Result;
    2159  }
    2160  
    2161  void InitEntry(int Argc, char* Argv[])
    2162  
    2163  /*++
    2164  
    2165  Routine Description:
    2166  
    2167      This routine is the entry point for the init process.
    2168  
    2169  Arguments:
    2170  
    2171      Argc - Supplies command line argument count.
    2172  
    2173      Argv - Supplies command line arguments.
    2174  
    2175  Return Value:
    2176  
    2177      None.
    2178  
    2179  --*/
    2180  
    2181  {
    2182      //
    2183      // Initialize the startup environment.
    2184      //
    2185  
    2186      try
    2187      {
    2188          wil::ScopedWarningsCollector collector;
    2189  
    2190          auto config = ConfigInitializeCommon(g_SavedSignalActions);
    2191  
    2192          //
    2193          // Check if the binary is being run on WSL or in a Utility VM.
    2194          //
    2195  
    2196          if (!UtilIsUtilityVm())
    2197          {
    2198              InitEntryWsl(config);
    2199          }
    2200          else
    2201          {
    2202              InitEntryUtilityVm(config);
    2203          }
    2204      }
    2205      catch (...)
    2206      {
    2207          LOG_CAUGHT_EXCEPTION();
    2208      }
    2209  
    2210      FATAL_ERROR("Init not expected to exit");
    2211      return;
    2212  }
    2213  
    2214  void InitEntryUtilityVm(wsl::linux::WslDistributionConfig& Config)
    2215  
    2216  /*++
    2217  
    2218  Routine Description:
    2219  
    2220      This routine is the entry point for the init process when running inside
    2221      a utility VM.
    2222  
    2223  Arguments:
    2224  
    2225      Config - Supplies the distribution configuration.
    2226  
    2227  Return Value:
    2228  
    2229      None.
    2230  
    2231  --*/
    2232  
    2233  {
    2234      UtilSetThreadName("init-distro");
    2235  
    2236      //
    2237      // Set the close-on-exec flag on the socket file descriptor inherited from mini_init.
    2238      //
    2239  
    2240      wsl::shared::SocketChannel channel{wil::unique_fd{LX_INIT_UTILITY_VM_INIT_SOCKET_FD}, "init"};
    2241      if (fcntl(channel.Socket(), F_SETFD, FD_CLOEXEC) < 0)
    2242      {
    2243          FATAL_ERROR("fcntl failed {}", errno);
    2244          return;
    2245      }
    2246  
    2247      if (getenv(LX_WSL2_DISTRO_READ_ONLY_ENV) != nullptr)
    2248      {
    2249          EMIT_USER_WARNING(wsl::shared::Localization::MessageReadOnlyDistro());
    2250          unsetenv(LX_WSL2_DISTRO_READ_ONLY_ENV);
    2251      }
    2252  
    2253      auto Value = getenv(LX_WSL2_NETWORKING_MODE_ENV);
    2254      if (Value != nullptr)
    2255      {
    2256          Config.NetworkingMode = static_cast<LX_MINI_INIT_NETWORKING_MODE>(std::atoi(Value));
    2257          unsetenv(LX_WSL2_NETWORKING_MODE_ENV);
    2258      }
    2259  
    2260      Value = getenv(LX_WSL2_VM_ID_ENV);
    2261      if (Value != nullptr)
    2262      {
    2263          Config.VmId = Value;
    2264  
    2265          //
    2266          // Unset the environment variable for user distros.
    2267          //
    2268  
    2269          Value = getenv(LX_WSL2_SHARED_MEMORY_OB_DIRECTORY);
    2270          if (!Value)
    2271          {
    2272              unsetenv(LX_WSL2_VM_ID_ENV);
    2273          }
    2274      }
    2275  
    2276      //
    2277      // If the boot.systemd option is specified in /etc/wsl.conf, launch the distro init process as pid 1.
    2278      // WSL init and session leaders continue as children of the distro init process.
    2279      //
    2280  
    2281      const auto pid = getenv(LX_WSL_PID_ENV);
    2282      assert(pid != nullptr);
    2283      unsetenv(LX_WSL_PID_ENV);
    2284  
    2285      //
    2286      // Send the create instance result to the service.
    2287      //
    2288  
    2289      wsl::shared::MessageWriter<LX_MINI_INIT_CREATE_INSTANCE_RESULT> message;
    2290      message->Pid = std::stoul(pid);
    2291      message->Result = 0;
    2292  
    2293      auto Warnings = wil::ScopedWarningsCollector::ConsumeWarnings();
    2294      if (!Warnings.empty())
    2295      {
    2296          message.WriteString(message->WarningsOffset, Warnings);
    2297      }
    2298  
    2299      channel.SendMessage<LX_MINI_INIT_CREATE_INSTANCE_RESULT>(message.Span());
    2300  
    2301      std::optional<pid_t> distroInitPid;
    2302      const auto distroInitPidString = getenv(LX_WSL2_DISTRO_INIT_PID);
    2303      if (distroInitPidString != nullptr)
    2304      {
    2305          distroInitPid = std::stoul(distroInitPidString);
    2306          unsetenv(LX_WSL2_DISTRO_INIT_PID);
    2307      }
    2308  
    2309      std::vector<gsl::byte> Buffer;
    2310      if (Config.BootInit)
    2311      {
    2312          int SocketPair[2];
    2313          if (socketpair(AF_UNIX, (SOCK_STREAM | SOCK_CLOEXEC), 0, SocketPair) < 0)
    2314          {
    2315              FATAL_ERROR("socketpair failed {}", errno);
    2316          }
    2317  
    2318          wil::unique_fd BootStartReadSocket{SocketPair[0]};
    2319          Config.BootStartWriteSocket = SocketPair[1];
    2320  
    2321          const int ChildPid = fork();
    2322          if (ChildPid < 0)
    2323          {
    2324              FATAL_ERROR("fork failed {}", errno);
    2325          }
    2326          else if (ChildPid != 0)
    2327          {
    2328              UtilSetThreadName("init-systemd");
    2329  
    2330              //
    2331              // Wait to boot the distro init process until the first session leader has been created.
    2332              // This ensures that the entire boot is not done when a distro is trigger-started by accessing \\wsl.localhost.
    2333              //
    2334  
    2335              auto Message = wsl::shared::socket::RecvMessage(BootStartReadSocket.get(), Buffer);
    2336              if (Message.empty())
    2337              {
    2338                  FATAL_ERROR("recv failed {}", errno);
    2339              }
    2340  
    2341              auto* StartMessage = gslhelpers::get_struct<MESSAGE_HEADER>(Message);
    2342              if (StartMessage->MessageType != LxInitMessageStartDistroInit)
    2343              {
    2344                  FATAL_ERROR("unexpected Messagetype {}", StartMessage->MessageType);
    2345              }
    2346  
    2347              //
    2348              // Initialize distro init arguments and environment.
    2349              //
    2350  
    2351              auto InitializeStringVector = [&](std::vector<const char*>& PointerVector,
    2352                                                std::vector<std::string>& StringVector,
    2353                                                const std::optional<std::string>& String) {
    2354                  if (String.has_value())
    2355                  {
    2356                      std::string_view StringView{String.value()};
    2357                      while (!StringView.empty())
    2358                      {
    2359                          StringVector.emplace_back(UtilStringNextToken(StringView, " "));
    2360                      }
    2361  
    2362                      for (const auto& TokenString : StringVector)
    2363                      {
    2364                          PointerVector.push_back(TokenString.c_str());
    2365                      }
    2366                  }
    2367  
    2368                  PointerVector.push_back(nullptr);
    2369              };
    2370  
    2371              CreateWslSystemdUnits(Config);
    2372  
    2373              const char* Argv[] = {INIT_PATH, nullptr};
    2374              std::vector<const char*> Env;
    2375              std::vector<std::string> Environment;
    2376              InitializeStringVector(
    2377                  Env, Environment, "container=wsl container_host_id=windows container_host_version_id=" WSL_PACKAGE_VERSION);
    2378  
    2379              execvpe(INIT_PATH, const_cast<char**>(Argv), const_cast<char**>(Env.data()));
    2380              LOG_ERROR("execvpe({}) failed {}", INIT_PATH, errno);
    2381              _exit(1);
    2382          }
    2383  
    2384          //
    2385          // Keep track of the new pid for WSL init.
    2386          //
    2387  
    2388          Config.InitPid = getpid();
    2389      }
    2390  
    2391      //
    2392      // Loop waiting on the socket for requests from the Windows server.
    2393      // A zero-byte read means that the connection to the wsl has been closed and the init daemon should shut down.
    2394      //
    2395  
    2396      wil::unique_fd SignalFd;
    2397      std::vector<pollfd> PollDescriptors(1);
    2398      PollDescriptors[0].fd = channel.Socket();
    2399      PollDescriptors[0].events = POLLIN;
    2400  
    2401      //
    2402      // If a distro init pid was passed, set up a signalfd to watch it so the distribution can be terminated
    2403      // when that process exits.
    2404      //
    2405  
    2406      if (distroInitPid.has_value())
    2407      {
    2408          // Reset sigchld so we get notified when children exit.
    2409          signal(SIGCHLD, SIG_DFL);
    2410  
    2411          sigset_t SignalMask;
    2412          sigemptyset(&SignalMask);
    2413          sigaddset(&SignalMask, SIGCHLD);
    2414          if (UtilSaveBlockedSignals(SignalMask) < 0)
    2415          {
    2416              FATAL_ERROR("sigprocmask failed {}", errno);
    2417          }
    2418  
    2419          SignalFd = {signalfd(-1, &SignalMask, SFD_CLOEXEC)};
    2420          if (!SignalFd)
    2421          {
    2422              FATAL_ERROR("signalfd failed {}", errno);
    2423          }
    2424  
    2425          PollDescriptors.resize(2);
    2426          PollDescriptors[1].fd = SignalFd.get();
    2427          PollDescriptors[1].events = POLLIN;
    2428      }
    2429  
    2430      for (;;)
    2431      {
    2432          auto Result = poll(PollDescriptors.data(), PollDescriptors.size(), -1);
    2433          if (Result < 0)
    2434          {
    2435              FATAL_ERROR("poll failed {}", errno);
    2436          }
    2437  
    2438          if (PollDescriptors[0].revents & (POLLHUP | POLLERR))
    2439          {
    2440              break;
    2441          }
    2442          else if (PollDescriptors[0].revents & POLLIN)
    2443          {
    2444              auto [Header, Span] = channel.ReceiveMessageOrClosed<MESSAGE_HEADER>();
    2445              if (Header == nullptr)
    2446              {
    2447                  break;
    2448              }
    2449  
    2450              switch (Header->MessageType)
    2451              {
    2452              case LxInitMessageCreateSession:
    2453                  if (InitCreateSessionLeader(Span, channel, -1, Config) < 0)
    2454                  {
    2455                      FATAL_ERROR("InitCreateSessionLeader failed");
    2456                  }
    2457  
    2458                  break;
    2459  
    2460              case LxInitMessageInitialize:
    2461                  ConfigInitializeInstance(channel, Span, Config);
    2462                  break;
    2463  
    2464              case LxInitMessageTimezoneInformation:
    2465                  UpdateTimezone(Span, Config);
    2466                  break;
    2467  
    2468              case LxInitMessageRemountDrvfs:
    2469  
    2470                  //
    2471                  // If systemd is enabled, some units (like snapd) might be in the process
    2472                  // of creating mountpoints.
    2473                  // Because these mountpoints should be available in both namespaces, the elevated
    2474                  // and non-elevated namespaces shouldn't fork until systemd is done initializing.
    2475                  //
    2476  
    2477                  WaitForBootProcess(Config);
    2478                  ConfigRemountDrvFs(Span, channel, Config);
    2479                  break;
    2480  
    2481              case LxInitMessageTerminateInstance:
    2482                  InitTerminateInstance(Span, channel, Config);
    2483                  break;
    2484  
    2485              case LxInitCreateProcess:
    2486                  ProcessCreateProcessMessage(channel, Span);
    2487                  break;
    2488  
    2489              default:
    2490                  FATAL_ERROR("Unexpected message {}", Header->MessageType);
    2491              }
    2492          }
    2493  
    2494          if (distroInitPid.has_value() && PollDescriptors[1].revents & POLLIN)
    2495          {
    2496              signalfd_siginfo SignalInfo{};
    2497              auto BytesRead = TEMP_FAILURE_RETRY(read(PollDescriptors[1].fd, &SignalInfo, sizeof(SignalInfo)));
    2498              if (BytesRead != sizeof(SignalInfo))
    2499              {
    2500                  FATAL_ERROR("read failed {} {}", BytesRead, errno);
    2501              }
    2502  
    2503              if (SignalInfo.ssi_signo != SIGCHLD)
    2504              {
    2505                  LOG_ERROR("Unexpected signal {}", SignalInfo.ssi_signo);
    2506                  continue;
    2507              }
    2508  
    2509              int Status{};
    2510              auto Pid = waitpid(-1, &Status, WNOHANG);
    2511              if (Result == 0)
    2512              {
    2513                  continue;
    2514              }
    2515              else if (Result > 0)
    2516              {
    2517                  if (Pid == distroInitPid.value())
    2518                  {
    2519                      LOG_ERROR("Init has exited. Terminating distribution");
    2520                      break;
    2521                  }
    2522              }
    2523              else if (errno != ECHILD)
    2524              {
    2525                  FATAL_ERROR("waitpid failed {}", errno);
    2526              }
    2527          }
    2528      }
    2529  
    2530      InitTerminateInstanceInternal(Config);
    2531      return;
    2532  }
    2533  
    2534  void InitEntryWsl(wsl::linux::WslDistributionConfig& Config)
    2535  
    2536  /*++
    2537  
    2538  Routine Description:
    2539  
    2540      This routine is the entry point for the init process when running inside
    2541      WSL.
    2542  
    2543  Arguments:
    2544  
    2545      Config - Supplies the distribution configuration.
    2546  
    2547  Return Value:
    2548  
    2549      None.
    2550  
    2551  --*/
    2552  
    2553  {
    2554      auto Warnings = wil::ScopedWarningsCollector::ConsumeWarnings();
    2555      if (!Warnings.empty())
    2556      {
    2557          LOG_ERROR("{}", Warnings.c_str());
    2558      }
    2559  
    2560      //
    2561      // Connect to the windows server.
    2562      //
    2563  
    2564      wil::unique_fd LxBusFd = TEMP_FAILURE_RETRY(open(LXBUS_DEVICE_NAME, O_RDWR | O_CLOEXEC));
    2565      if (!LxBusFd)
    2566      {
    2567          FATAL_ERROR("open({}) failed {}", LXBUS_DEVICE_NAME, errno);
    2568          return;
    2569      }
    2570  
    2571      wsl::shared::SocketChannel Channel{wil::unique_fd{InitConnectToServer(LxBusFd.get(), true)}, "init"};
    2572      if (Channel.Socket() < 0)
    2573      {
    2574          return;
    2575      }
    2576  
    2577      //
    2578      // Loop waiting on the message port for requests from the Windows server.
    2579      //
    2580  
    2581      std::vector<gsl::byte> Buffer;
    2582      ssize_t BytesRead;
    2583      for (;;)
    2584      {
    2585          BytesRead = UtilReadMessageLxBus(Channel.Socket(), Buffer, true);
    2586          if (BytesRead < 0)
    2587          {
    2588              return;
    2589          }
    2590  
    2591          auto Message = gsl::make_span(Buffer.data(), BytesRead);
    2592          auto* Header = gslhelpers::try_get_struct<MESSAGE_HEADER>(Message);
    2593          if (!Header)
    2594          {
    2595              FATAL_ERROR("Invalid message size {}", Message.size());
    2596          }
    2597  
    2598          switch (Header->MessageType)
    2599          {
    2600          case LxInitMessageCreateSession:
    2601              if (InitCreateSessionLeader(Message, Channel, LxBusFd.get(), Config) < 0)
    2602              {
    2603                  //
    2604                  // If this distro has no children, exit on failure.
    2605                  //
    2606  
    2607                  int status;
    2608                  if (waitpid(-1, &status, WNOHANG) == -1 && (errno == ECHILD))
    2609                  {
    2610                      FATAL_ERROR("InitCreateSessionLeader failed");
    2611                  }
    2612  
    2613                  LOG_ERROR("InitCreateSessionLeader failed");
    2614              }
    2615  
    2616              break;
    2617  
    2618          case LxInitMessageNetworkInformation:
    2619              ConfigUpdateNetworkInformation(Message, Config);
    2620              break;
    2621  
    2622          case LxInitMessageInitialize:
    2623              ConfigInitializeInstance(Channel, Message, Config);
    2624              break;
    2625  
    2626          case LxInitMessageTimezoneInformation:
    2627              UpdateTimezone(Message, Config);
    2628              break;
    2629  
    2630          case LxInitMessageTerminateInstance:
    2631              InitTerminateInstance(Message, Channel, Config);
    2632              break;
    2633  
    2634          default:
    2635              FATAL_ERROR("Unexpected message {}", Header->MessageType);
    2636          }
    2637      }
    2638  
    2639      return;
    2640  }
    2641  
    2642  void InitTerminateInstance(gsl::span<gsl::byte> Buffer, wsl::shared::SocketChannel& Channel, wsl::linux::WslDistributionConfig& Config)
    2643  
    2644  /*++
    2645  
    2646  Routine Description:
    2647  
    2648      This routine processes a terminate instance request from the service.
    2649  
    2650  Arguments:
    2651  
    2652      Buffer - Supplies the message buffer.
    2653  
    2654      Channel - Supplies a channel to send the response.
    2655  
    2656      Config - Supplies the distribution config.
    2657  
    2658  Return Value:
    2659  
    2660      None.
    2661  
    2662  --*/
    2663  try
    2664  {
    2665  
    2666      auto* Message = gslhelpers::try_get_struct<LX_INIT_TERMINATE_INSTANCE>(Buffer);
    2667      if (!Message)
    2668      {
    2669          FATAL_ERROR("Invalid message size {}", Buffer.size());
    2670      }
    2671  
    2672      //
    2673      // Attempt to stop the plan9 server, if it is not able to be stopped because of an
    2674      // in-use file, reply to the service that the instance could not be terminated.
    2675      //
    2676  
    2677      if (!StopPlan9Server(Message->Force, Config))
    2678      {
    2679          Channel.SendResultMessage<bool>(false);
    2680          return;
    2681      }
    2682  
    2683      InitTerminateInstanceInternal(Config);
    2684  }
    2685  CATCH_LOG();
    2686  
    2687  void InitTerminateInstanceInternal(const wsl::linux::WslDistributionConfig& Config)
    2688  
    2689  /*++
    2690  
    2691  Routine Description:
    2692  
    2693      This routine attempts to cleanly terminate the instance.
    2694  
    2695  Arguments:
    2696  
    2697      Config - Supplies the distribution config.
    2698  
    2699  Return Value:
    2700  
    2701      None.
    2702  
    2703  --*/
    2704  try
    2705  {
    2706      //
    2707      // If systemd is enabled, attempt to poweroff the instance via systemctl.
    2708      //
    2709  
    2710      if (Config.BootInit && !Config.BootStartWriteSocket)
    2711      {
    2712          THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(UtilSetSignalHandlers(g_SavedSignalActions, false) < 0);
    2713  
    2714          if (UtilExecCommandLine("systemctl poweroff", nullptr) == 0)
    2715          {
    2716              std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(Config.BootInitTimeout));
    2717              LOG_ERROR("systemctl poweroff did not terminate the instance in {} ms, calling reboot(RB_POWER_OFF)", Config.BootInitTimeout);
    2718          }
    2719      }
    2720  
    2721      reboot(RB_POWER_OFF);
    2722      FATAL_ERROR("reboot(RB_POWER_OFF) failed {}", errno);
    2723  }
    2724  CATCH_LOG();
    2725  
    2726  void InstallSystemdUnit(const char* Path, const std::string& Name, const char* Content)
    2727  try
    2728  {
    2729      std::string target = std::format("{}/{}.service", Path, Name);
    2730      std::string defaultTarget = std::format("{}/default.target.wants", Path);
    2731      THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(UtilMkdirPath(Path, 0755) < 0);
    2732      THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(WriteToFile(target.c_str(), Content) < 0);
    2733      THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(UtilMkdirPath(defaultTarget.c_str(), 0755) < 0);
    2734  
    2735      std::string symlinkPath = std::format("{}/{}.service", defaultTarget, Name);
    2736      THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(symlink(target.c_str(), symlinkPath.c_str()) < 0);
    2737  }
    2738  CATCH_LOG();
    2739  
    2740  void CreateWslSystemdUnits(const wsl::linux::WslDistributionConfig& Config)
    2741  
    2742  /*++
    2743  
    2744  Routine Description:
    2745  
    2746      This method creates systemd unit files to protect WSL functionality from being disabled by systemd.
    2747  
    2748  Arguments:
    2749  
    2750      Config - Supplies the distribution configuration.
    2751  
    2752  Return Value:
    2753  
    2754      None.
    2755  
    2756  --*/
    2757  
    2758  try
    2759  {
    2760      if (Config.NetworkingMode == LxMiniInitNetworkingModeMirrored)
    2761      {
    2762          HardenMirroredNetworkingSettingsAgainstSystemd();
    2763      }
    2764  
    2765      constexpr auto folder = "/run/systemd/system-generators";
    2766  
    2767      THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(UtilMkdirPath(folder, 0755) < 0);
    2768      THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(symlink("/init", std::format("{}/{}", folder, LX_INIT_WSL_GENERATOR).c_str()));
    2769  
    2770      if (Config.GuiAppsEnabled)
    2771      {
    2772          constexpr auto folder = "/run/systemd/user-generators";
    2773  
    2774          THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(UtilMkdirPath(folder, 0755) < 0);
    2775          THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(symlink("/init", std::format("{}/{}", folder, LX_INIT_WSL_USER_GENERATOR).c_str()));
    2776      }
    2777  }
    2778  CATCH_LOG();
    2779  
    2780  void HardenMirroredNetworkingSettingsAgainstSystemd()
    2781  
    2782  /*++
    2783  
    2784  Routine Description:
    2785  
    2786      This routine writes configuration required for the mirrored networking mode loopback datapath to
    2787      a .conf file applied by systemd. Some distros come with default .conf files only applied when
    2788      systemd is enabled, and some of these contain network configurations that conflict with mirrored
    2789      networking mode. By writing to a .conf file that has higher precedence, we can prevent these
    2790      conflicting settings from being applied.
    2791  
    2792  Arguments:
    2793  
    2794      None.
    2795  
    2796  Return Value:
    2797  
    2798      None.
    2799  
    2800  --*/
    2801  
    2802  try
    2803  {
    2804      const char* NetworkingConfigFileDirectory = "/run/sysctl.d";
    2805      const char* NetworkingConfigFileName = "wsl-networking.conf";
    2806      const std::string NetworkingConfigFilePath = std::format("{}/{}", NetworkingConfigFileDirectory, NetworkingConfigFileName);
    2807      constexpr auto NetworkingConfig =
    2808          "# Note: This file is generated by WSL to prevent default .conf files applied by systemd from overwriting critical "
    2809          "networking settings\n"
    2810          "net.ipv4.conf.all.rp_filter=0\n"
    2811          "net.ipv4.conf." LX_INIT_LOOPBACK_DEVICE_NAME ".rp_filter=0\n";
    2812  
    2813      THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(UtilMkdirPath(NetworkingConfigFileDirectory, 0755) < 0);
    2814      THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(WriteToFile(NetworkingConfigFilePath.c_str(), NetworkingConfig) < 0);
    2815  }
    2816  CATCH_LOG();
    2817  
    2818  void SessionLeaderCreateProcess(gsl::span<gsl::byte> Buffer, int MessageFd, int TtyFd, const wsl::linux::WslDistributionConfig& Config)
    2819  
    2820  /*++
    2821  
    2822  Routine Description:
    2823  
    2824      This routine creates a process from a session leader.
    2825  
    2826  Arguments:
    2827  
    2828      Buffer - Supplies the message buffer.
    2829  
    2830      MessageFd - Supplies a message port file descriptor.
    2831  
    2832      TtyFd - Supplies a Tty file descriptor.
    2833  
    2834      Config - Supplies the distribution configuration.
    2835  
    2836  Return Value:
    2837  
    2838      None.
    2839  
    2840  --*/
    2841  
    2842  {
    2843      //
    2844      // Parse the create process message buffer and create the new child process.
    2845      //
    2846  
    2847      CREATE_PROCESS_PARSED Parsed = CreateProcessParse(Buffer, MessageFd, Config);
    2848      auto CreateProcessPid = fork();
    2849      THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(CreateProcessPid < 0);
    2850  
    2851      if (CreateProcessPid > 0)
    2852      {
    2853          //
    2854          // Remember the current process group.
    2855          //
    2856  
    2857          if (g_SessionGroup == -1)
    2858          {
    2859              g_SessionGroup = CreateProcessPid;
    2860          }
    2861  
    2862          //
    2863          // Reply with pid of the child process.
    2864          //
    2865  
    2866          THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(CreateProcessReplyToServer(&Parsed, CreateProcessPid, MessageFd) < 0);
    2867  
    2868          return;
    2869      }
    2870  
    2871      //
    2872      // Child...
    2873      //
    2874      // The child process should be part of a separate foreground process group.
    2875      // If a separate foreground process group does not exist, create one here.
    2876      //
    2877  
    2878      int Result = 0;
    2879      if (g_SessionGroup != -1)
    2880      {
    2881          //
    2882          // Attempt to join an existing foreground process group.
    2883          //
    2884  
    2885          Result = setpgid(0, g_SessionGroup);
    2886      }
    2887  
    2888      if ((g_SessionGroup == -1) || (Result < 0))
    2889      {
    2890          //
    2891          // Create a new process group.
    2892          //
    2893  
    2894          THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(setpgid(0, 0) < 0);
    2895      }
    2896  
    2897      //
    2898      // Always bring the process group to the foreground. This will give
    2899      // the newly launched process access to the terminal. In cases where
    2900      // multiple processes are being launched in the same session due to
    2901      // piping commands together (e.g. bash.exe -c ls | bash.exe -c less)
    2902      // or calling bash.exe from within a running WSL instance (inception),
    2903      // there may be issues when this process terminates, as restoring the
    2904      // foreground group does not happen by default. If the launcher is a
    2905      // shell program like /bin/bash, then it typically assumes that the
    2906      // foreground needs to be restored and all will work well.
    2907      //
    2908  
    2909      //
    2910      // N.B. SIGTTOU along with most other signals are blocked. Otherwise,
    2911      //      this could generate a signal with the default behavior of
    2912      //      stopping the process (waiting for SIGCONT to continue).
    2913      //
    2914  
    2915      if (tcsetpgrp(TtyFd, getpgid(0)) < 0)
    2916      {
    2917          LOG_ERROR("tcsetpgrp failed {}", errno);
    2918      }
    2919  
    2920      //
    2921      // Exec the new process.
    2922      //
    2923  
    2924      //
    2925      // Resources are not released for the child process because it will call execv.
    2926      //
    2927      // N.B. CreateProcess does not return.
    2928      //
    2929  
    2930      CreateProcess(&Parsed, TtyFd, Config);
    2931      FATAL_ERROR("CreateProcess not expected to return");
    2932  }
    2933  
    2934  void SessionLeaderSigchldHandler(__attribute__((unused)) int Signal, __attribute__((unused)) siginfo_t* SigInfo, __attribute__((unused)) void* UContext)
    2935  
    2936  /*++
    2937  
    2938  Routine Description:
    2939  
    2940      This routine determines if the process group assigned to processes launched
    2941      by the session leader has terminated.
    2942  
    2943  Arguments:
    2944  
    2945      Signal - Supplies the signal that was received.
    2946  
    2947      SigInfo - Supplies additional information about the signal.
    2948  
    2949      UContext - Supplies the scheduling context from the process before the
    2950          signal handler was invoked.
    2951  
    2952  Return Value:
    2953  
    2954      None.
    2955  
    2956  --*/
    2957  
    2958  {
    2959      pid_t child;
    2960      int status;
    2961  
    2962      while ((child = waitpid(-1, &status, WNOHANG)) > 0)
    2963      {
    2964          if (child == g_SessionGroup)
    2965          {
    2966              g_SessionGroup = -1;
    2967          }
    2968      }
    2969  
    2970      return;
    2971  }
    2972  
    2973  void SessionLeaderEntryUtilityVm(wsl::shared::SocketChannel& channel, const wsl::linux::WslDistributionConfig& Config)
    2974  
    2975  /*++
    2976  
    2977  Routine Description:
    2978  
    2979      This routine is the entry point for the session leader process.
    2980  
    2981  Arguments:
    2982  
    2983      channel - Supplies a message channel
    2984  
    2985  Return Value:
    2986  
    2987      None.
    2988  
    2989  --*/
    2990  
    2991  {
    2992      std::vector<gsl::byte> Buffer;
    2993      MESSAGE_HEADER* Header{};
    2994      struct sigaction SignalAction;
    2995  
    2996      //
    2997      // Create a new session.
    2998      //
    2999  
    3000      if (setsid() < 0)
    3001      {
    3002          FATAL_ERROR("setsid failed {}", errno);
    3003      }
    3004  
    3005      //
    3006      // Set up a signal handler to reap child processes and track session
    3007      // leader.
    3008      //
    3009  
    3010      memset(&SignalAction, 0, sizeof(SignalAction));
    3011      SignalAction.sa_flags = SA_SIGINFO;
    3012      SignalAction.sa_sigaction = SessionLeaderSigchldHandler;
    3013      if (sigaction(SIGCHLD, &SignalAction, NULL) < 0)
    3014      {
    3015          FATAL_ERROR("sigaction SIGCHLD failed {}", errno);
    3016      }
    3017  
    3018      //
    3019      // Loop waiting on the socket for requests from the Windows server. A zero-byte read means that there is no
    3020      // longer any active console applications for this session and that the session leader should exit.
    3021      //
    3022  
    3023      for (;;)
    3024      {
    3025          auto [Message, Span] = channel.ReceiveMessageOrClosed<LX_INIT_CREATE_PROCESS_UTILITY_VM>();
    3026          if (Message == nullptr)
    3027          {
    3028              _exit(0);
    3029          }
    3030  
    3031          switch (Message->Header.MessageType)
    3032          {
    3033          case LxInitMessageCreateProcessUtilityVm:
    3034              if (InitCreateProcessUtilityVm(Span, *Message, channel, Config) < 0)
    3035              {
    3036                  FATAL_ERROR("InitCreateProcessUtilityVm failed");
    3037              }
    3038  
    3039              break;
    3040  
    3041          default:
    3042              FATAL_ERROR("Unexpected message {}", Header->MessageType);
    3043          }
    3044      }
    3045  
    3046      FATAL_ERROR("Session leader not expected to exit");
    3047      return;
    3048  }
    3049  
    3050  void SessionLeaderEntry(int MessageFd, int TtyFd, const wsl::linux::WslDistributionConfig& Config)
    3051  
    3052  /*++
    3053  
    3054  Routine Description:
    3055  
    3056      This routine is the entry point for the session leader process.
    3057  
    3058  Arguments:
    3059  
    3060      MessageFd - Supplies a message port file descriptor.
    3061  
    3062      TtyFd - Supplies a Tty file descriptor.
    3063  
    3064      Config - Supplies the distribution configuration.
    3065  
    3066  Return Value:
    3067  
    3068      None.
    3069  
    3070  --*/
    3071  
    3072  {
    3073      std::vector<gsl::byte> Buffer;
    3074      ssize_t BytesRead;
    3075      struct sigaction SignalAction;
    3076  
    3077      //
    3078      // Create a new session and set the controlling session on the Tty device.
    3079      //
    3080  
    3081      if (setsid() < 0)
    3082      {
    3083          FATAL_ERROR("setsid failed {}", errno);
    3084      }
    3085  
    3086      if (TEMP_FAILURE_RETRY(ioctl(TtyFd, TIOCSCTTY, NULL)) < 0)
    3087      {
    3088          FATAL_ERROR("ioctl failed for TIOCSCTTY {}", errno);
    3089      }
    3090  
    3091      //
    3092      // Set up a signal handler to reap child processes and track session
    3093      // leader.
    3094      //
    3095  
    3096      memset(&SignalAction, 0, sizeof(SignalAction));
    3097      SignalAction.sa_flags = SA_SIGINFO;
    3098      SignalAction.sa_sigaction = SessionLeaderSigchldHandler;
    3099      if (sigaction(SIGCHLD, &SignalAction, NULL) < 0)
    3100      {
    3101          FATAL_ERROR("sigaction SIGCHLD failed {}", errno);
    3102      }
    3103  
    3104      //
    3105      // Loop waiting on the message port for requests from the Windows server.
    3106      //
    3107  
    3108      for (;;)
    3109      {
    3110          BytesRead = UtilReadMessageLxBus(MessageFd, Buffer, false);
    3111          if (BytesRead < 0)
    3112          {
    3113              FATAL_ERROR("read failed {}", errno);
    3114          }
    3115  
    3116          auto Message = gsl::make_span(Buffer.data(), BytesRead);
    3117          auto* Header = gslhelpers::try_get_struct<MESSAGE_HEADER>(Message);
    3118          if (!Header)
    3119          {
    3120              FATAL_ERROR("Invalid message size {}", Message.size());
    3121          }
    3122  
    3123          if (Header->MessageType == LxInitMessageCreateProcess)
    3124          {
    3125              SessionLeaderCreateProcess(Message, MessageFd, TtyFd, Config);
    3126          }
    3127          else
    3128          {
    3129              FATAL_ERROR("Unexpected message {}", Header->MessageType);
    3130          }
    3131      }
    3132  
    3133      FATAL_ERROR("Session leader not expected to exit");
    3134      return;
    3135  }
    3136  
    3137  bool StopPlan9Server(bool Force, wsl::linux::WslDistributionConfig& Config)
    3138  {
    3139      if (Config.Plan9ControlChannel.Socket() < 0)
    3140      {
    3141          return true;
    3142      }
    3143  
    3144      LX_INIT_STOP_PLAN9_SERVER Message{};
    3145      Message.Header.MessageType = LxInitMessageStopPlan9Server;
    3146      Message.Header.MessageSize = sizeof(Message);
    3147      Message.Force = Message.Force;
    3148  
    3149      const auto& Response = Config.Plan9ControlChannel.Transaction(Message);
    3150  
    3151      if (Response.Result)
    3152      {
    3153          // The plan9 server is terminated, release the socket.
    3154          Config.Plan9ControlChannel.Close();
    3155      }
    3156  
    3157      return Response.Result;
    3158  }
    3159  
    3160  wil::unique_fd UnmarshalConsoleFromServer(int MessageFd, LXBUS_IPC_CONSOLE_ID ConsoleId)
    3161  
    3162  /*++
    3163  
    3164  Routine Description:
    3165  
    3166      This routine unmarshals a console.
    3167  
    3168  Arguments:
    3169  
    3170      MessageFd - Supplies a message port file descriptor.
    3171  
    3172      ConsoleId - Supplies a console ID.
    3173  
    3174      TtyFd - Supplies a buffer to store a Tty file descriptor.
    3175  
    3176  Return Value:
    3177  
    3178      0 on success, -1 on failure.
    3179  
    3180  --*/
    3181  
    3182  {
    3183      LXBUS_IPC_MESSAGE_UNMARSHAL_CONSOLE_PARAMETERS UnmarshalConsole{};
    3184  
    3185      //
    3186      // N.B. Failures to unmarshall the console are non-fatal.
    3187      //
    3188  
    3189      UnmarshalConsole.Input.ConsoleId = ConsoleId;
    3190  
    3191      if (TEMP_FAILURE_RETRY(ioctl(MessageFd, LXBUS_IPC_MESSAGE_IOCTL_UNMARSHAL_CONSOLE, &UnmarshalConsole)))
    3192      {
    3193          LOG_ERROR("Failed to unmarshal console {}", errno);
    3194          return {};
    3195      }
    3196  
    3197      return UnmarshalConsole.Output.FileDescriptor;
    3198  }
    3199  
    3200  unsigned int StartPlan9(int Argc, char** Argv)
    3201  {
    3202      constexpr auto* Usage = "Usage: plan9 " LX_INIT_PLAN9_CONTROL_SOCKET_ARG " fd " LX_INIT_PLAN9_SOCKET_PATH_ARG
    3203                              " path " LX_INIT_PLAN9_SERVER_FD_ARG " fd " LX_INIT_PLAN9_LOG_FILE_ARG
    3204                              " log-file " LX_INIT_PLAN9_LOG_LEVEL_ARG " level " LX_INIT_PLAN9_PIPE_FD_ARG " fd [--log-truncate]\n";
    3205  
    3206      bool LogTruncate = false;
    3207      int LogLevel = TRACE_LEVEL_INFORMATION;
    3208      wil::unique_fd PipeFd;
    3209      const char* SocketPath{};
    3210      const char* LogFile{};
    3211      wil::unique_fd ControlSocket;
    3212      wil::unique_fd ServerFd;
    3213  
    3214      ArgumentParser parser(Argc, Argv);
    3215      parser.AddArgument(UniqueFd{ControlSocket}, LX_INIT_PLAN9_CONTROL_SOCKET_ARG);
    3216      parser.AddArgument(SocketPath, LX_INIT_PLAN9_SOCKET_PATH_ARG);
    3217      parser.AddArgument(UniqueFd{ServerFd}, LX_INIT_PLAN9_SERVER_FD_ARG);
    3218      parser.AddArgument(LogFile, LX_INIT_PLAN9_LOG_FILE_ARG);
    3219      parser.AddArgument(Integer{LogLevel}, LX_INIT_PLAN9_LOG_LEVEL_ARG);
    3220      parser.AddArgument(UniqueFd{PipeFd}, LX_INIT_PLAN9_PIPE_FD_ARG);
    3221      parser.AddArgument(LogTruncate, LX_INIT_PLAN9_TRUNCATE_LOG_ARG);
    3222  
    3223      try
    3224      {
    3225          parser.Parse();
    3226      }
    3227      catch (const wil::ExceptionWithUserMessage& e)
    3228      {
    3229          std::cerr << e.what() << "\n" << Usage;
    3230          return 1;
    3231      }
    3232

    3275      GnsEngine::NotificationRoutine readNotification;

    3284              std::string content{std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(std::cin), std::istreambuf_iterator<char>()};

    3295          };

    3297          returnStatus = [&](int Result, const std::string& Error) {

    3305          };

    3309          readNotification = [&]() -> std::optional<GnsEngine::Message> {
    3310              std::vector<gsl::byte> Buffer;
    3311              auto [Message, Span] = channel.ReceiveMessageOrClosed<MESSAGE_HEADER>();
    3312              if (Message == nullptr)
    3313              {
    3314                  return {};
    3315              }
    3316  
    3317              auto type = Message->MessageType;
    3318              GNS_LOG_INFO("Processing LX_MESSAGE_TYPE {}", ToString(type));
    3319              switch (type)
    3320              {
    3321              case LxGnsMessageNoOp:
    3322              case LxGnsMessageGlobalNetFilter:
    3323              {
    3324                  return {{type, {}, {}}};
    3325              }
    3326              case LxGnsMessageInterfaceConfiguration:
    3327              {
    3328                  auto size = Span.size() - offsetof(LX_GNS_INTERFACE_CONFIGURATION, Content) - 1;
    3329                  assert(size > 0);
    3330  
    3331                  std::string Content{reinterpret_cast<PLX_GNS_INTERFACE_CONFIGURATION>(Span.data())->Content, size};
    3332  
    3333                  return {{type, Content, {}}};
    3334              }
    3335  
    3336              case LxGnsMessageNotification:
    3337              {
    3338                  auto size = Span.size() - offsetof(LX_GNS_NOTIFICATION, Content) - 1;
    3339                  assert(size > 0);
    3340  
    3341                  const auto* NotificationMessage = reinterpret_cast<PLX_GNS_NOTIFICATION>(Span.data());
    3342                  std::string Content{NotificationMessage->Content, size};
    3343                  return {{type, Content, {NotificationMessage->AdapterId}}};
    3344              }
    3345  
    3346              case LxGnsMessageVmNicCreatedNotification:
    3347              case LxGnsMessageCreateDeviceRequest:
    3348              case LxGnsMessageModifyGuestDeviceSettingRequest:
    3349              case LxGnsMessageLoopbackRoutesRequest:
    3350              case LxGnsMessageInitialIpConfigurationNotification:
    3351              case LxGnsMessageInterfaceNetFilter:
    3352              case LxGnsMessageDeviceSettingRequest:
    3353              case LxGnsMessageSetupIpv6:
    3354              case LxGnsMessageConnectTestRequest:

    3357                  if (size == 0)
    3358                  {
    3359                      throw RuntimeErrorWithSourceLocation(
    3360                          std::format("Failed to find content for LX_MESSAGE_TYPE : {}", static_cast<int>(type)));
    3361                  }
    3362  
    3363                  std::string Content{reinterpret_cast<PLX_GNS_JSON_MESSAGE>(Span.data())->Content, size};
    3364                  return {{type, Content, {}}};
    3365              }
    3366  
    3367              default:
    3368              {
    3369                  throw RuntimeErrorWithSourceLocation(std::format("Unexpected LX_MESSAGE_TYPE : {}", static_cast<int>(type)));
    3370              }
    3371              }
    3372          };
    3373  
    3374          returnStatus = [&](int Result, const std::string& Error) {
    3375              std::vector<gsl::byte> Buffer(sizeof(LX_GNS_RESULT) + Error.size() + 1);
    3376  
    3377              GNS_LOG_INFO("Returning LxGnsMessageResult [{} - {}]", Result, Error.c_str());
    3378  
    3379              wsl::shared::MessageWriter<LX_GNS_RESULT> response(LX_GNS_RESULT::Type);
    3380              response->Result = Result;
    3381              if (!Error.empty())
    3382              {
    3383                  response.WriteString(Error);
    3384              }
    3385  
    3386              return channel.SendMessage<LX_GNS_RESULT>(response.Span());
    3387          };
    3388      }
    3389  
    3390      RoutingTable routingTable(RT_TABLE_MAIN);
    3391      NetworkManager manager(routingTable);
    3392      GnsEngine engine(readNotification, returnStatus, manager, DnsFd, DnsTunnelingIp);
    3393  
    3394      engine.run();
    3395  
    3396      GNS_LOG_INFO("StartGns returning {} (GNS Socket {}, MessageType {})", exitCode, channel.Socket(), MessageType.value_or(LxMiniInitMessageAny));
    3397      return exitCode;
    3398  }

    3400  void WaitForBootProcess(wsl::linux::WslDistributionConfig& Config)
    3401  {
    3402      if (!Config.BootStartWriteSocket)
    3403      {
    3404          return;
    3405      }
    3406  
    3407      //
    3408      // Launch the boot process wait for it to finish booting.
    3409      //
    3410  
    3411      MESSAGE_HEADER Message{};
    3412      Message.MessageType = LxInitMessageStartDistroInit;
    3413      Message.MessageSize = sizeof(Message);
    3414      if (UtilWriteBuffer(Config.BootStartWriteSocket.get(), gslhelpers::struct_as_bytes(Message)) < 0)
    3415      {
    3416          LOG_ERROR("write failed {}", errno);
    3417      }
    3418  
    3419      Config.BootStartWriteSocket.reset();
    3420      if (Config.BootInitTimeout > 0)
    3421      {
    3422          try
    3423          {
    3424              //
    3425              // N.B. Init needs to not ignore SIGCHLD so it can wait for the child process.
    3426              //
    3427  
    3428              signal(SIGCHLD, SIG_DFL);
    3429              auto restoreDisposition = wil::scope_exit([]() { signal(SIGCHLD, SIG_IGN); });
    3430              wsl::shared::retry::RetryWithTimeout<void>(
    3431                  [&]() {
    3432                      std::string Output;
    3433                      THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(
    3434                          UtilExecCommandLine("systemctl is-system-running | grep -E \"running|degraded\"", &Output, 0, false) < 0);
    3435                  },
    3436                  std::chrono::milliseconds{250},
    3437                  std::chrono::milliseconds{Config.BootInitTimeout});
    3438          }
    3439          catch (...)
    3440          {
    3441              LOG_ERROR("{} failed to start within {}ms", INIT_PATH, Config.BootInitTimeout);
    3442          }
    3443      }
    3444  }

     158  int WslEntryPoint(int Argc, char* Argv[])
     159  {
     160      //
     161      // Determine if the binary is being launched in init daemon mode by
     162      // checking the pid and Argc.
     163      //
     164      // N.B. Using the pid is not enough because this process might be running
     165      // in a docker container. See: https://github.com/microsoft/WSL/issues/10883.
     166      //
     167      // If not in init daemon mode, differentiate between various functionality by checking Argv[0].
     168      //
     169  
     170      char* BaseName = basename(Argv[0]);
     171      int ExitCode = -1;
     172      pid_t Pid = getpid();
     173  
     174      if (Pid == 1 && strcmp(BaseName, "init") == 0 && Argc <= 1)
     175      {
     176          InitEntry(Argc, Argv);
     177      }
     178      else
     179      {
     180          if (strcmp(BaseName, WSLPATH_NAME) == 0)
     181          {
     182              ExitCode = WslPathEntry(Argc, Argv);
     183          }
     184          else if (strcmp(BaseName, MOUNT_DRVFS_NAME) == 0)
     185          {
     186              ExitCode = MountDrvfsEntry(Argc, Argv);
     187          }
     188          else if (strcmp(BaseName, LX_INIT_LOCALHOST_RELAY) == 0)
     189          {
     190              ExitCode = RunPortTracker(Argc, Argv);
     191          }
     192          else if (strcmp(BaseName, LX_INIT_TELEMETRY_AGENT) == 0)
     193          {
     194              ExitCode = StartTelemetryAgent();
     195          }
     196          else if (strcmp(BaseName, LX_INIT_GNS) == 0)
     197          {
     198              ExitCode = StartGns(Argc, Argv);
     199          }
     200          else if (strcmp(BaseName, LX_INIT_PLAN9) == 0)
     201          {
     202              ExitCode = StartPlan9(Argc, Argv);
     203          }
     204          else if (strcmp(BaseName, WSLINFO_NAME) == 0)
     205          {
     206              ExitCode = WslInfoEntry(Argc, Argv);
     207          }
     208          else if (strcmp(BaseName, LX_INIT_WSL_CAPTURE_CRASH) == 0)
     209          {
     210              ExitCode = CaptureCrash(Argc, Argv);
     211          }
     212          else if (strcmp(BaseName, LX_INIT_WSL_GENERATOR) == 0)
     213          {
     214              ExitCode = GenerateSystemdUnits(Argc, Argv);
     215          }
     216          else if (strcmp(BaseName, LX_INIT_WSL_USER_GENERATOR) == 0)
     217          {
     218              ExitCode = GenerateUserSystemdUnits(Argc, Argv);
     219          }
     220          else
     221          {

     232                      exit(0);
     233                  }
     234                  CATCH_RETURN_ERRNO()
     235              }
     236  
     237              ExitCode = CreateNtProcess(Argc - 1, &Argv[1]);
     238          }
     239      }
     240  
     241      return ExitCode;
     242  }

     299  int GenerateSystemdUnits(int Argc, char** Argv)

     311          LOG_INFO("Generating WSL systemd units in {}", installPath);

     313          bool enableGuiApps = true;
     314          bool protectBinfmt = true;
     315          bool interopEnabled = true;

     317  
     318          wil::unique_file File{fopen("/etc/wsl.conf", "r")};

     322                  ConfigKey(wsl::linux::c_ConfigEnableGuiAppsOption, enableGuiApps),
     323                  ConfigKey(wsl::linux::c_ConfigBootProtectBinfmtOption, protectBinfmt),
     324                  ConfigKey(wsl::linux::c_ConfigInteropEnabledOption, interopEnabled),
     325                  ConfigKey(wsl::linux::c_ConfigAutoMountRoot, automountRoot),

     327              };

     332          // Mask systemd-networkd-wait-online.service since WSL always ensures that networking is configured during boot.
     333          // That unit can cause systemd boot timeouts since WSL's network interface is unmanaged by systemd.
     334          THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(symlink("/dev/null", std::format("{}/systemd-networkd-wait-online.service", installPath).c_str()) < 0);
     335  
     336          // Mask NetworkManager-wait-online.service for the same reason, as it causes timeouts on distros using NetworkManager.
     337          THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(symlink("/dev/null", std::format("{}/NetworkManager-wait-online.service", installPath).c_str()) < 0);
     338  
     339          // Only create the wslg unit if both enabled in wsl.conf, and if the wslg folder actually exists.
     340          if (enableGuiApps && access("/mnt/wslg/runtime-dir", F_OK) == 0)
     341          {
     342              THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(UtilMkdirPath("/run/tmpfiles.d", 0755) < 0);
     343              const std::string tmpFilesConfig =
     344                  "# Note: This file is generated by WSL to prevent systemd-tmpfiles from removing /tmp/.X11-unix during boot.\n";
     345  
     346              THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(WriteToFile("/run/tmpfiles.d/x11.conf", tmpFilesConfig.c_str()) < 0);
     347  
     348              // Note: It's not possible to use a mount unit because systemd will not mount /tmp/.X11-unix
     349              // if /proc/mount says it's already mounted.
     350  
     351              constexpr auto* x11UnitContent = R"(# Note: This file is generated by WSL to prevent tmp.mount from hiding /tmp/.X11-unix
     352  
     353  [Unit]
     354  Description=WSLg Remount Service
     355  DefaultDependencies=no
     356  After=systemd-tmpfiles-setup.service tmp.mount
     357  ConditionPathExists=/mnt/wslg/.X11-unix
     358  ConditionPathExists=!/tmp/.X11-unix/X0
     359  
     360  [Service]
     361  Type=oneshot
     362  ExecStart=/bin/mount -o bind,ro,X-mount.mkdir -t none /mnt/wslg/.X11-unix /tmp/.X11-unix)";
     363              InstallSystemdUnit(installPath, "wslg", x11UnitContent);
     364          }
     365  
     366          if (interopEnabled && protectBinfmt)
     367          {
     368              // N.B. ExecStop is required to prevent distributions from removing the WSL binfmt entry on shutdown.
     369              auto systemdBinfmtContent = std::format(
     370                  R"(# Note: This file is generated by WSL to prevent binfmt.d from overriding WSL's binfmt interpreter.
     371  # To disable this unit, add the following to /etc/wsl.conf:
     372  # [boot]
     373  # protectBinfmt=false
     374  
     375  [Service]
     376  ExecStop=
     377  ExecStart=/bin/sh -c '(echo -1 > {}/{}) ; (echo "{}" > {})' )",
     378                  BINFMT_MISC_MOUNT_TARGET,
     379                  LX_INIT_BINFMT_NAME,
     380                  BINFMT_INTEROP_REGISTRATION_STRING(LX_INIT_BINFMT_NAME),
     381                  BINFMT_MISC_REGISTER_FILE);
     382  
     383              // Install the override for systemd-binfmt.service.
     384              {
     385                  auto overrideFolder = std::format("{}/systemd-binfmt.service.d", installPath);
     386                  THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(UtilMkdirPath(overrideFolder.c_str(), 0755) < 0);
     387                  THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(WriteToFile(std::format("{}/override.conf", overrideFolder).c_str(), systemdBinfmtContent.c_str()) < 0);
     388              }
     389  
     390              // Install the override for binfmt-support.service.
     391              {
     392                  auto overrideFolder = std::format("{}/binfmt-support.service.d", installPath);
     393                  THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(UtilMkdirPath(overrideFolder.c_str(), 0755) < 0);
     394                  THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(WriteToFile(std::format("{}/override.conf", overrideFolder).c_str(), systemdBinfmtContent.c_str()) < 0);
     395              }
     396          }
     397  
     398          return 0;
     399      }
     400      CATCH_LOG()
     401  
     402      return 1;
     403  }
     404  
     405  int CaptureCrash(int Argc, char** Argv)
     406  try
     407  {
     408      UtilSetThreadName("CaptureCrash");
     409  
     410      if (Argc < 5)
     411      {
     412          std::cerr << "Usage: " << Argv[0] << "<time> <executable> <pid> <signal>" << std::endl;
     413          return 1;
     414      }
     415  
     416      InitializeLogging(false);
     417  
     418      LOG_INFO("Capturing crash for pid: {}, executable: {}, signal: {}, port: {}", Argv[3], Argv[2], Argv[4], LX_INIT_UTILITY_VM_CRASH_DUMP_PORT);
     419  
     420      wsl::shared::SocketChannel channel(UtilConnectVsock(LX_INIT_UTILITY_VM_CRASH_DUMP_PORT, true), "crash-dump");
     421  
     422      wsl::shared::MessageWriter<LX_PROCESS_CRASH> message(LxProcessCrash);
     423      message.WriteString(Argv[2]);
     424      message->Timestamp = std::strtoull(Argv[1], nullptr, 10);
     425      message->Signal = std::strtoul(Argv[4], nullptr, 10);
     426      message->Pid = std::strtoull(Argv[3], nullptr, 10);
     427  
     428      auto result = channel.Transaction<LX_PROCESS_CRASH>(message.Span()).Result;
     429      if (result != 0)
     430      {
     431          LOG_ERROR("Received error while trying to capture crash dump: {}", result);
     432      }
     433  
     434      std::vector<char> buffer(LX_RELAY_BUFFER_SIZE);
     435  
     436      int bytes = -1;
     437      while ((bytes = TEMP_FAILURE_RETRY(read(STDIN_FILENO, buffer.data(), buffer.size()))) > 0)
     438      {
     439          if (UtilWriteBuffer(channel.Socket(), buffer.data(), bytes) < 0)
     440          {
     441              LOG_ERROR("Error while trying read write dump, {}", errno);
     442              return 1;
     443          }
     444      }
     445  
     446      if (bytes != 0)
     447      {
     448          LOG_ERROR("Error while trying read crash dump from stdin, {}", errno);
     449          return 1;
     450      }
     451  
     452      return 0;
     453  }
     454  CATCH_RETURN_ERRNO()
     455  
     456  void CreateProcess(PCREATE_PROCESS_PARSED Parsed, int TtyFd, const wsl::linux::WslDistributionConfig& Config)
     457  
     458  /*++
     459  
     460  Routine Description:
     461  
     462      This routine is the entry point for the create process.
     463  
     464  Arguments:
     465  
     466      Parsed - Supplies a pointer to a create process parsed structure.
     467  
     468      Config - Supplies the distribution configuration.
     469  
     470  Return Value:
     471  
     472      None.
     473  
     474  --*/
     475  
     476  {
     477      ssize_t BytesRead;
     478      uint64_t EventFdData;
     479      int StdFdIndex;
     480  
     481      //
     482      // Initialize the new process and wait until the session leader signals
     483      // to execvpe.
     484      //
     485  
     486      for (StdFdIndex = 0; StdFdIndex < LX_INIT_STD_FD_COUNT; StdFdIndex += 1)
     487      {
     488          //
     489          // If a standard file descriptor is not set, use the TTY file descriptor.
     490          //
     491  
     492          if (dup2(Parsed->StdFd[StdFdIndex] ? Parsed->StdFd[StdFdIndex].get() : TtyFd, StdFdIndex) < 0)
     493          {
     494              FATAL_ERROR("dup2 failed {}", errno);
     495          }
     496  
     497          Parsed->StdFd[StdFdIndex].reset();
     498      }
     499  
     500      //
     501      // Read the eventfd data from the wsl service.
     502      //
     503  
     504      BytesRead = TEMP_FAILURE_RETRY(read(Parsed->EventFd.get(), &EventFdData, sizeof(EventFdData)));
     505      if (BytesRead != sizeof(EventFdData))
     506      {
     507          FATAL_ERROR("Failed to read (size {}) EventFd {}", BytesRead, errno);
     508      }
     509  
     510      //
     511      // Launch the process.
     512      //
     513  
     514      CreateProcessCommon(&Parsed->Common, TtyFd, Parsed->ServiceFd.get(), Config);
     515      return;
     516  }
     517  
     518  void CreateProcessCommon(PCREATE_PROCESS_PARSED_COMMON Common, int TtyFd, int ServiceSocket, const wsl::linux::WslDistributionConfig& Config)
     519  
     520  /*++
     521  
     522  Routine Description:
     523  
     524      This routine is entry point for the common create process functionality.
     525  
     526  Arguments:
     527  
     528      Common - Supplies a pointer to the common create process parsed data.
     529  
     530      TtyFd - Supplies the file descriptor representing the process's terminal.
     531          This method takes ownership of this file descriptor.
     532  
     533      ServiceSocket - Supplies the file descriptor to a socket connected to the Service.
     534  
     535      Config - Supplies the distribution configuration
     536  
     537  Return Value:
     538  
     539      None.
     540  
     541  --*/
     542  
     543  try
     544  {
     545      //
     546      // Print any errors that occurred.
     547      //
     548  
     549      for (const auto& e : wsl::shared::string::Split<char>(wil::ScopedWarningsCollector::ConsumeWarnings(), '\n'))
     550      {
     551          if (!e.empty())
     552          {
     553              fprintf(stderr, "wsl: %s\n", e.c_str());
     554          }
     555      }
     556  
     557      //
     558      // Restore default signal dispositions and clear the signal mask for the child process.
     559      //
     560  
     561      THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(UtilSetSignalHandlers(g_SavedSignalActions, false) < 0);
     562  
     563      sigset_t SignalMask;
     564      sigemptyset(&SignalMask);
     565      THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(sigprocmask(SIG_SETMASK, &SignalMask, NULL) < 0);
     566  
     567      auto AddEnvironmentVariable = [&](const char* Name) {
     568          const auto Value = UtilGetEnvironmentVariable(Name);
     569          if (!Value.empty())
     570          {
     571              Common->Environment.AddVariable(Name, Value.c_str());
     572          }
     573      };
     574  
     575      AddEnvironmentVariable(NAME_ENV);
     576      AddEnvironmentVariable(WSL_DISTRO_NAME_ENV);
     577  
     578      //
     579      // Get the password entry for the user. (root if the distribution is being installed)
     580      //
     581  
     582      const passwd* PasswordEntry{};
     583  
     584      auto ConfigureUid = [&](uint32_t Uid) {
     585          PasswordEntry = getpwuid(Uid);
     586          if (PasswordEntry == nullptr)
     587          {
     588              LOG_ERROR("getpwuid({}) failed {}", Uid, errno);
     589              PasswordEntry = const_cast<passwd*>(&c_defaultPasswordEntry);
     590          }
     591  
     592          //
     593          // Add environment variables to the environment block.
     594          //
     595  
     596          Common->Environment.AddVariable(HOME_ENV, PasswordEntry->pw_dir);
     597          Common->Environment.AddVariable(USER_ENV, PasswordEntry->pw_name);
     598          Common->Environment.AddVariable(LOGNAME_ENV, PasswordEntry->pw_name);
     599          Common->Environment.AddVariable(SHELL_ENV, PasswordEntry->pw_shell);
     600      };
     601  
     602      //
     603      // Set the $LANG environment variable.
     604      //
     605      // N.B. Failure to update $LANG environment variable is non-fatal.
     606      //
     607  
     608      ConfigUpdateLanguage(Common->Environment);
     609  
     610      //
     611      // Launch the OOBE command, if any
     612      //
     613  
     614      if (Common->AllowOOBE)
     615      {
     616          assert(ServiceSocket != -1);
     617  
     618          wsl::shared::SocketChannel channel(wil::unique_fd{ServiceSocket}, "OOBE");
     619  
     620          std::string OobeCommand{};
     621          int defaultUid = 0;
     622          ConfigKeyPresence defaultUidPresent{};
     623          std::vector<ConfigKey> keys = {ConfigKey("oobe.command", OobeCommand), ConfigKey("oobe.defaultUid", defaultUid, &defaultUidPresent)};
     624  
     625          {
     626              wil::unique_file File{fopen(WSL_DISTRIBUTION_CONF, "r")};
     627              ParseConfigFile(keys, File.get(), CFG_SKIP_UNKNOWN_VALUES, STRING_TO_WSTRING(CONFIG_FILE));
     628          }
     629  
     630          int32_t OobeResult = 0;
     631          if (!OobeCommand.empty())
     632          {
     633              auto Pid = UtilCreateChildProcess("OOBE", [&OobeCommand, &Common, &ConfigureUid]() {
     634                  ConfigureUid(0);
     635                  execle("/bin/sh", "sh", "-c", OobeCommand.c_str(), nullptr, const_cast<char**>(Common->Environment.Variables().data()));
     636                  LOG_ERROR("execle() failed, {}", errno);
     637              });
     638  
     639              int Status = -1;
     640              if (TEMP_FAILURE_RETRY(waitpid(Pid, &Status, 0)) < 0)
     641              {
     642                  LOG_ERROR("Waiting for child '{}' failed, waitpid failed {}", OobeCommand.c_str(), errno);
     643                  _exit(1);
     644              }
     645  
     646              if (UtilProcessChildExitCode(Status, OobeCommand.c_str(), 0, false) < 0)
     647              {
     648                  OobeResult = -1;
     649                  fprintf(stderr, "OOBE command \"%s\" failed, exiting\n", OobeCommand.c_str());
     650              }
     651          }
     652  
     653          LX_INIT_OOBE_RESULT result{};
     654          result.Header.MessageType = LxInitOobeResult;
     655          result.Header.MessageSize = sizeof(result);
     656          result.Result = OobeResult;
     657          result.DefaultUid = defaultUidPresent == ConfigKeyPresence::Present ? defaultUid : -1;
     658  
     659          channel.SendMessage(result);
     660  
     661          if (OobeResult != 0)
     662          {
     663              _exit(1);
     664          }
     665  
     666          ConfigureUid(defaultUidPresent == ConfigKeyPresence::Present ? defaultUid : Common->Uid);
     667      }
     668      else
     669      {
     670          ConfigureUid(Common->Uid);
     671      }
     672  
     673      //
     674      // Ensure that a login session has been created for the user and set expected
     675      // environment variables.
     676      //
     677  
     678      if (Config.InitPid.has_value())
     679      {
     680          wsl::shared::SocketChannel InteropChannel{UtilConnectToInteropServer(Config.InitPid.value()), "InteropClient"};
     681          THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(InteropChannel.Socket() < 0);
     682  
     683          wsl::shared::MessageWriter<LX_INIT_CREATE_LOGIN_SESSION> CreateSession(LxInitMessageCreateLoginSession);
     684          CreateSession->Uid = PasswordEntry->pw_uid;
     685          CreateSession->Gid = PasswordEntry->pw_gid;
     686          CreateSession.WriteString(PasswordEntry->pw_name);
     687  
     688          auto result = InteropChannel.Transaction<LX_INIT_CREATE_LOGIN_SESSION>(CreateSession.Span());
     689  
     690          if (!result.Result)
     691          {
     692              fprintf(stderr, "wsl: %s\n", wsl::shared::Localization::MessageSystemdUserSessionFailed(PasswordEntry->pw_name).c_str());
     693          }
     694  
     695          Common->Environment.AddVariable("DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS", std::format("unix:path=/run/user/{}/bus", PasswordEntry->pw_uid));
     696          Common->Environment.AddVariable(XDG_RUNTIME_DIR_ENV, std::format("/run/user/{}", PasswordEntry->pw_uid));
     697      }
     698  
     699      //
     700      // If a filename was provided, use the filename and command line as-is.
