     701      // Otherwise, use the user's default shell. If the user's default shell is
     702      // is empty, fall back to using /bin/sh.
     703      //
     704  
     705      std::string Argv0;
     706      std::vector<const char*> CommandLine = Common->CommandLine;
     707      char* Filename = const_cast<char*>(Common->Filename);
     708      if (strlen(Filename) == 0)
     709      {
     710          Filename = const_cast<char*>(SHELL_PATH);
     711          auto Size = sizeof(SHELL_PATH) - 1;
     712          if (PasswordEntry->pw_shell != NULL)
     713          {
     714              Size = strlen(PasswordEntry->pw_shell);
     715              if (Size != 0)
     716              {
     717                  Filename = PasswordEntry->pw_shell;
     718              }
     719          }
     720  
     721          if ((Common->ShellOptions & ShellOptionsLogin) != 0)
     722          {
     723              //
     724              // Construct the name of the shell as the last path element
     725              // prepended with a '-' and use this as Argv[0].
     726              //
     727              // N.B. This is the same behavior as the login binary.
     728              //
     729  
     730              auto Shell = strrchr(Filename, '/');
     731              if (Shell != nullptr)
     732              {
     733                  Shell = Shell + 1;
     734              }
     735              else
     736              {
     737                  Shell = Filename;
     738              }
     739  
     740              Argv0 = "-";
     741              Argv0 += Shell;
     742          }
     743          else
     744          {
     745              Argv0 = Filename;
     746          }
     747  
     748          CommandLine.insert(CommandLine.begin(), Argv0.c_str());
     749      }
     750  
     751      //
     752      // Set the owner of the tty device.
     753      //
     754  
     755      if (TtyFd != -1)
     756      {
     757          if (fchown(TtyFd, PasswordEntry->pw_uid, TTY_GID) < 0)
     758          {
     759              LOG_ERROR("fchown failed {}", errno);
     760          }
     761  
     762          CLOSE(TtyFd);
     763          TtyFd = -1;
     764      }
     765  
     766      //
     767      // Set the supplemental groups, gid, uid, and current working directory.
     768      //
     769  
     770      UtilInitGroups(PasswordEntry->pw_name, PasswordEntry->pw_gid);
     771      THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(setgid(PasswordEntry->pw_gid) < 0);
     772      THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(setuid(PasswordEntry->pw_uid) < 0);
     773  
     774      //
     775      // If the provided current working directory is empty, use the user's home
     776      // path as the current working directory.
     777      //
     778      // N.B. Failures to set the current working directory are non-fatal.
     779      //
     780  
     781      std::string Directory;
     782      if (Common->CurrentWorkingDirectory.empty())
     783      {
     784          Directory = PasswordEntry->pw_dir;
     785      }
     786      else
     787      {
     788          Directory = Common->CurrentWorkingDirectory;
     789          if (Directory[0] == '~')
     790          {
     791              Directory = PasswordEntry->pw_dir;
     792              if (Common->CurrentWorkingDirectory.size() > 1)
     793              {
     794                  Directory += &Common->CurrentWorkingDirectory[1];
     795              }
     796          }
     797      }
     798  
     799      if (chdir(Directory.c_str()) < 0)
     800      {
     801          LOG_ERROR("chdir({}) failed {}", Directory, errno);
     802      }
     803  
     804      //
     805      // Launch the process.
     806      //
     807  
     808      execvpe(Filename, const_cast<char**>(CommandLine.data()), const_cast<char**>(Common->Environment.Variables().data()));
     809      FATAL_ERROR("execvpe({}) failed: {}", Filename, strerror(errno));
     810  
     811      return;
     812  }
     813  catch (...)
     814  {
     815      LOG_CAUGHT_EXCEPTION();
     816      FATAL_ERROR("Create process failed");
     817  }
     818  
     819  CREATE_PROCESS_PARSED CreateProcessParse(gsl::span<gsl::byte> Buffer, int MessageFd, const wsl::linux::WslDistributionConfig& Config)
     820  
     821  /*++
     822  
     823  Routine Description:
     824  
     825      This routine parses a create process message.
     826  
     827  Arguments:
     828  
     829      Buffer - Supplies the create process message.
     830  
     831      MessageFd - Supplies a message port file descriptor.
     832  
     833      Config - Supplies the distribution configuration.
     834  
     835  Return Value:
     836  
     837      The create process parameters.
     838  
     839  --*/
     840  
     841  {
     842      //
     843      // Validate the message size.
     844      //
     845  
     846      auto* Message = gslhelpers::try_get_struct<LX_INIT_CREATE_PROCESS>(Buffer);
     847      THROW_ERRNO_IF(EINVAL, !Message);
     848  
     849      //
     850      // Parse common create process information.
     851      //
     852  
     853      CREATE_PROCESS_PARSED Parsed{};
     854      int Result = CreateProcessParseCommon(&Parsed.Common, Buffer.subspan(offsetof(LX_INIT_CREATE_PROCESS, Common)), Config);
     855      THROW_ERRNO_IF(EINVAL, Result < 0);
     856  
     857      //
     858      // Create the eventfd.
     859      //
     860  
     861      Parsed.EventFd = eventfd(0, EFD_CLOEXEC);
     862      THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(!Parsed.EventFd);
     863  
     864      //
     865      // Set up the standard handles for the process.
     866      //
     867      //
     868  
     869      for (unsigned short Index = 0; Index < LX_INIT_STD_FD_COUNT; Index += 1)
     870      {
     871          if (Message->StdFdIds[Index] != LX_INIT_CREATE_PROCESS_USE_CONSOLE)
     872          {
     873              LXBUS_IPC_MESSAGE_UNMARSHAL_HANDLE_PARAMETERS UnmarshalHandle{};
     874              UnmarshalHandle.Input.HandleId = Message->StdFdIds[Index];
     875              Result = TEMP_FAILURE_RETRY(ioctl(MessageFd, LXBUS_IPC_MESSAGE_IOCTL_UNMARSHAL_HANDLE, &UnmarshalHandle));
     876              THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(Result < 0);
     877  
     878              Parsed.StdFd[Index] = UnmarshalHandle.Output.FileDescriptor;
     879          }
     880      }
     881  
     882      //
     883      // Unmarshal the fork token.
     884      //
     885  
     886      LXBUS_IPC_MESSAGE_UNMARSHAL_FORK_TOKEN_PARAMETERS UnmarshalForkToken{};
     887      UnmarshalForkToken.Input.ForkTokenId = Message->ForkTokenId;
     888      Result = TEMP_FAILURE_RETRY(ioctl(MessageFd, LXBUS_IPC_MESSAGE_IOCTL_UNMARSHAL_FORK_TOKEN, &UnmarshalForkToken));
     889      THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(Result < 0);
     890  
     891      //
     892      // Unmarshal the ipc server.
     893      //
     894  
     895      if (Message->IpcServerId != LXBUS_IPC_SERVER_ID_INVALID)
     896      {
     897          LXBUS_IPC_MESSAGE_UNMARSHAL_SERVER_PARAMETERS UnmarshalServer{};
     898          UnmarshalServer.Input.ServerId = Message->IpcServerId;
     899          Result = TEMP_FAILURE_RETRY(ioctl(MessageFd, LXBUS_IPC_MESSAGE_IOCTL_UNMARSHAL_SERVER, &UnmarshalServer));
     900          THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(Result < 0);
     901  
     902          if (Parsed.Common.AllowOOBE)
     903          {
     904              wil::unique_fd LxBusFd{TEMP_FAILURE_RETRY(open(LXBUS_DEVICE_NAME, O_RDWR))};
     905              THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(!LxBusFd);
     906  
     907              LXBUS_CONNECT_SERVER_PARAMETERS ConnectParams{};
     908              ConnectParams.Input.Flags = LXBUS_IPC_CONNECT_FLAG_UNNAMED_SERVER;
     909              ConnectParams.Input.TimeoutMs = LXBUS_IPC_INFINITE_TIMEOUT;
     910              Result = TEMP_FAILURE_RETRY(ioctl(LxBusFd.get(), LXBUS_IOCTL_CONNECT_SERVER, &ConnectParams));
     911              THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(Result < 0);
     912  
     913              Parsed.ServiceFd = ConnectParams.Output.MessagePort;
     914          }
     915      }
     916  
     917      return Parsed;
     918  }
     919  
     920  int CreateProcessParseCommon(PCREATE_PROCESS_PARSED_COMMON Parsed, gsl::span<gsl::byte> Buffer, const wsl::linux::WslDistributionConfig& Config)
     921  
     922  /*++
     923  
     924  Routine Description:
     925  
     926      This routine parses a create process message.
     927  
     928  Arguments:
     929  
     930      Parsed - Supplies a buffer to store the common create process parameters.
     931  
     932      Buffer - Supplies the common create process message data.
     933  
     934      Config - Supplies the distribution configuration.
     935  
     936  Return Value:
     937  
     938      0 on success, -1 on failure.
     939  
     940  --*/
     941  
     942  try
     943  {
     944      auto* Common = gslhelpers::try_get_struct<LX_INIT_CREATE_PROCESS_COMMON>(Buffer);
     945      if (!Common)
     946      {
     947          LOG_ERROR("Invalid message size {}", Buffer.size());
     948          return -1;
     949      }
     950  
     951      //
     952      // Populate the current working directory. If the path does not begin with a
     953      // UNIX path separator or `~`, it is translated.
     954      //
     955      // N.B. Failure to translate the current working directory is non-fatal.
     956      //
     957  
     958      auto* Path = wsl::shared::string::FromSpan(Buffer, Common->CurrentWorkingDirectoryOffset);
     959      if ((*Path == '/') || (*Path == '~'))
     960      {
     961          Parsed->CurrentWorkingDirectory = Path;
     962      }
     963      else if (*Path != '\0')
     964      {
     965          Parsed->CurrentWorkingDirectory = WslPathTranslate(const_cast<char*>(Path), TRANSLATE_FLAG_ABSOLUTE, TRANSLATE_MODE_UNIX);
     966          if (Parsed->CurrentWorkingDirectory.empty() && Config.AutoMount)
     967          {
     968              EMIT_USER_WARNING(wsl::shared::Localization::MessageFailedToTranslate(Path));
     969          }
     970      }
     971  
     972      //
     973      // Initialize the command line will a null-terminator.
     974      //
     975  
     976      auto CommandLine = Buffer.subspan(Common->CommandLineOffset);
     977      for (unsigned short Index = 0; Index < Common->CommandLineCount; Index += 1)
     978      {
     979          std::string_view Argument{wsl::shared::string::FromSpan(CommandLine)};
     980          Parsed->CommandLine.emplace_back(Argument.data());
     981          CommandLine = CommandLine.subspan(Argument.size() + 1);
     982      }
     983  
     984      //
     985      // If a username was provided, get the password entry for the specified username.
     986      // If no username was provided use the one specified in /etc/wsl.conf.
     987      // Otherwise, use the default UID from the registry.
     988      //
     989  
     990      struct passwd* PasswordEntry = nullptr;
     991      auto Username = wsl::shared::string::FromSpan(Buffer, Common->UsernameOffset);
     992      if (strlen(Username) != 0)
     993      {
     994          PasswordEntry = getpwnam(Username);
     995          if (PasswordEntry == nullptr)
     996          {
     997              FATAL_ERROR_EX(EX_NOUSER, "getpwnam({}) failed {}", Username, errno);
     998          }
     999      }
    1000      else if (Config.DefaultUser.has_value())
    1001      {
    1002          PasswordEntry = getpwnam(Config.DefaultUser->c_str());
    1003          if (PasswordEntry == nullptr)
    1004          {
    1005              LOG_ERROR("getpwnam({}) failed {}", Config.DefaultUser->c_str(), errno);
    1006          }
    1007      }
    1008  
    1009      if (PasswordEntry == nullptr)
    1010      {
    1011          PasswordEntry = getpwuid(Common->DefaultUid);
    1012          if (PasswordEntry == nullptr)
    1013          {
    1014              LOG_ERROR("getpwuid({}) failed {}", Common->DefaultUid, errno);
    1015          }
    1016      }
    1017  
    1018      Parsed->CommandLine.emplace_back(nullptr);
    1019      Parsed->Environment = ConfigCreateEnvironmentBlock(Common, Config);
    1020      Parsed->Filename = wsl::shared::string::FromSpan(Buffer, Common->FilenameOffset);
    1021      Parsed->ShellOptions = static_cast<CREATE_PROCESS_SHELL_OPTIONS>(Common->ShellOptions);
    1022      Parsed->Uid = PasswordEntry ? PasswordEntry->pw_uid : ROOT_UID; // If the default user was not found, fall back to root.
    1023      Parsed->AllowOOBE = WI_IsFlagSet(Common->Flags, LxInitCreateProcessFlagAllowOOBE);
    1024      return 0;
    1025  }
    1026  CATCH_RETURN_ERRNO()
    1027  
    1028  int CreateProcessReplyToServer(PCREATE_PROCESS_PARSED Parsed, pid_t CreateProcessPid, int MessageFd)
    1029  
    1030  /*++
    1031  
    1032  Routine Description:
    1033  
    1034      This routine replies to the server for a create process message.
    1035  
    1036  Arguments:
    1037  
    1038      Parsed - Supplies a pointer to a create process parsed structure.
    1039  
    1040      CreateProcessPid - Supplies the pid of a newly created child process.
    1041  
    1042      MessageFd - Supplies a message port file descriptor.
    1043  
    1044  Return Value:
    1045  
    1046      0 on success, -1 on failure.
    1047  
    1048      N.B. On failure, this routine will terminate the child process.
    1049  
    1050  --*/
    1051  
    1052  {
    1053      auto terminateChild = wil::scope_exit([CreateProcessPid]() {
    1054          if (kill(CreateProcessPid, SIGKILL) < 0)
    1055          {
    1056              FATAL_ERROR("Failed to kill child process {}", errno);
    1057          }
    1058      });
    1059  
    1060      //
    1061      // Marshal the pid of the new child process and send a message
    1062      // indicating that the child was created.
    1063      //
    1064  
    1065      LXBUS_IPC_MESSAGE_MARSHAL_PROCESS_PARAMETERS MarshalProcess{};
    1066      MarshalProcess.Input.Process = CreateProcessPid;
    1067      if (TEMP_FAILURE_RETRY(ioctl(MessageFd, LXBUS_IPC_MESSAGE_IOCTL_MARSHAL_PROCESS, &MarshalProcess)) < 0)
    1068      {
    1069          LOG_ERROR("Failed to marshal pid {}", errno);
    1070          return -1;
    1071      }
    1072  
    1073      auto Bytes = UtilWriteBuffer(MessageFd, &MarshalProcess.Output.ProcessId, sizeof(MarshalProcess.Output.ProcessId));
    1074      if (Bytes < 0)
    1075      {
    1076          LOG_ERROR("Failed to write ProcessId {}", errno);
    1077          return -1;
    1078      }
    1079  
    1080      //
    1081      // Wait for the server to indicate that the process can be continued or
    1082      // it needs to be terminated.
    1083      //
    1084  
    1085      Bytes = TEMP_FAILURE_RETRY(read(MessageFd, &MarshalProcess.Output.ProcessId, sizeof(MarshalProcess.Output.ProcessId)));
    1086      if (Bytes != sizeof(MarshalProcess.Output.ProcessId))
    1087      {
    1088          LOG_ERROR("Failed to read (size {}) ProcessId {}", Bytes, errno);
    1089          return -1;
    1090      }
    1091  
    1092      if (MarshalProcess.Output.ProcessId == 0)
    1093      {
    1094          LOG_ERROR("Server replied with failure");
    1095          return -1;
    1096      }
    1097  
    1098      uint64_t EventFdData = 1;
    1099      Bytes = UtilWriteBuffer(Parsed->EventFd.get(), &EventFdData, sizeof(EventFdData));
    1100      if (Bytes < 0)
    1101      {
    1102          LOG_ERROR("Failed to write EventFd {}", errno);
    1103          return -1;
    1104      }
    1105  
    1106      terminateChild.release();
    1107      return 0;
    1108  }
    1109  
    1110  int InitCreateSessionLeader(gsl::span<gsl::byte> Buffer, wsl::shared::SocketChannel& Channel, int LxBusFd, wsl::linux::WslDistributionConfig& Config)
    1111  
    1112  /*++
    1113  
    1114  Routine Description:
    1115  
    1116      This routine creates a session leader from the init process.
    1117  
    1118  Arguments:
    1119  
    1120      Buffer - Supplies the message buffer.
    1121  
    1122      Channel - Supplies a message channel
    1123  
    1124      LxBusFd - Supplies an LxBus file descriptor (WSL1 only).
    1125  
    1126      Config - Supplies the distribution configuration.
    1127  
    1128  Return Value:
    1129  
    1130      0 on success, -1 on failure.
    1131  
    1132  --*/
    1133  try
    1134  {
    1135      int Result = -1;
    1136      pid_t SessionLeader = -1;
    1137      wil::unique_fd SessionLeaderFd;
    1138      struct sockaddr_vm SocketAddress;
    1139  
    1140      //
    1141      // N.B. FATAL_ERROR will exit the init process, which will also terminate
    1142      //      any previously created sessions that are still running. On failure,
    1143      //      the calling function may choose to continue, in order to preserve
    1144      //      these previous sessions. The FATAL_ERROR macro should be used with
    1145      //      care here.
    1146      //
    1147  
    1148      //
    1149      // Validate input parameters.
    1150      //
    1151  
    1152      auto* CreateSession = gslhelpers::try_get_struct<LX_INIT_CREATE_SESSION>(Buffer);
    1153      if (!CreateSession)
    1154      {
    1155          FATAL_ERROR("Unexpected create session size {}", Buffer.size());
    1156      }
    1157  
    1158      //
    1159      // Connect to the Windows server for the new session leader and create the
    1160      // new session leader process.
    1161      //
    1162  
    1163      if (LxBusFd >= 0)
    1164      {
    1165          //
    1166          // Unmarshal the console for the session leader.
    1167          //
    1168  
    1169          if (CreateSession->ConsoleId == LX_INIT_NO_CONSOLE)
    1170          {
    1171              FATAL_ERROR("Console required for session leader");
    1172          }
    1173  
    1174          auto TtyFd = UnmarshalConsoleFromServer(Channel.Socket(), CreateSession->ConsoleId);
    1175          if (!TtyFd)
    1176          {
    1177              Result = -1;
    1178              LOG_ERROR("UnmarshalConsoleFromServer failed");
    1179              goto InitCreateSessionLeaderExit;
    1180          }
    1181  
    1182          SessionLeaderFd = InitConnectToServer(LxBusFd, false);
    1183          if (!SessionLeaderFd)
    1184          {
    1185              Result = -1;
    1186              goto InitCreateSessionLeaderExit;
    1187          }
    1188  
    1189          SessionLeader = UtilCreateChildProcess(
    1190              "SessionLeader", [SessionLeaderFd = std::move(SessionLeaderFd), TtyFd = std::move(TtyFd), &Channel, &Config]() mutable {
    1191                  umask(Config.Umask);
    1192                  Channel.Close();
    1193  
    1194                  THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(UtilRestoreBlockedSignals() < 0);
    1195  
    1196                  SessionLeaderEntry(SessionLeaderFd.get(), TtyFd.get(), Config);
    1197              });
    1198      }
    1199      else
    1200      {
    1201          WaitForBootProcess(Config);
    1202  
    1203          //
    1204          // Ensure the /etc/resolv.conf symlink is present.
    1205          //
    1206  
    1207          ConfigCreateResolvConfSymlink(Config);
    1208  
    1209          //
    1210          // Create a listening socket for the service to connect to and tell the
    1211          // service which port to use.
    1212          //
    1213          // N.B. If creating the socket fails, a message with invalid port number
    1214          //      should be sent to unblock the wsl service.
    1215          //
    1216  
    1217          wil::unique_fd ListenSocket{UtilListenVsockAnyPort(&SocketAddress, 1)};
    1218          if (!ListenSocket)
    1219          {
    1220              SocketAddress.svm_port = -1;
    1221          }
    1222  
    1223          LX_INIT_CREATE_SESSION_RESPONSE Response;
    1224          Response.Header.MessageType = LxInitMessageCreateSessionResponse;
    1225          Response.Header.MessageSize = sizeof(Response);
    1226          Response.Port = SocketAddress.svm_port;
    1227          Channel.SendMessage(Response);
    1228  
    1229          if (!ListenSocket)
    1230          {
    1231              Result = -1;
    1232              goto InitCreateSessionLeaderExit;
    1233          }
    1234  
    1235          // Note: The call to accept() must be done in the child because if accept() takes a long time, it can block the creation
    1236          // of other session leaders. See https://github.com/microsoft/WSL/issues/9114.
    1237  
    1238          SessionLeader = UtilCreateChildProcess(
    1239              "SessionLeader", [ListenSocket = std::move(ListenSocket), &Channel, &Config, Mask = Config.Umask, SocketAddress]() {
    1240                  umask(Mask);
    1241                  Channel.Close();
    1242  
    1243                  THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(UtilRestoreBlockedSignals() < 0);
    1244  
    1245                  wsl::shared::SocketChannel channel{
    1246                      {UtilAcceptVsock(ListenSocket.get(), SocketAddress, SESSION_LEADER_ACCEPT_TIMEOUT_MS)}, "SessionLeader"};
    1247                  if (channel.Socket() < 0)
    1248                  {
    1249                      LOG_ERROR("UtilAcceptVsock() failed for session leader {}", errno);
    1250                      _exit(1);
    1251                  }
    1252  
    1253                  SessionLeaderEntryUtilityVm(channel, Config);
    1254              });
    1255      }
    1256  
    1257      if (SessionLeader < 0)
    1258      {
    1259          Result = -1;
    1260          goto InitCreateSessionLeaderExit;
    1261      }
    1262  
    1263      Result = 0;
    1264  
    1265  InitCreateSessionLeaderExit:
    1266      return Result;
    1267  }
    1268  CATCH_RETURN_ERRNO();
    1269  
    1270  int InitConnectToServer(int LxBusFd, bool WaitForServer)
    1271  
    1272  /*++
    1273  
    1274  Routine Description:
    1275  
    1276      This routine connects the init process to the lxbus server.
    1277  
    1278  Arguments:
    1279  
    1280      LxBusFd - Supplies an LxBus file descriptor.
    1281  
    1282      WaitForServer - Supplies true to wait for the server, false otherwise.
    1283  
    1284  Return Value:
    1285  
    1286      A message port file descriptor on success, -1 on failure.
    1287  
    1288  --*/
    1289  
    1290  {
    1291      LXBUS_CONNECT_SERVER_PARAMETERS Connection;
    1292      int MessageFd;
    1293      int Result;
    1294  
    1295      MessageFd = -1;
    1296      memset(&Connection, 0, sizeof(Connection));
    1297  
    1298      //
    1299      // Connect to the server and set the CLOEXEC flag.
    1300      //
    1301  
    1302      Connection.Input.ServerName = LX_INIT_SERVER_NAME;
    1303      Connection.Input.TimeoutMs = LXBUS_IPC_INFINITE_TIMEOUT;
    1304      if (WaitForServer != false)
    1305      {
    1306          Connection.Input.Flags = LXBUS_IPC_CONNECT_FLAG_WAIT_FOR_SERVER_REGISTRATION;
    1307      }
    1308  
    1309      Result = TEMP_FAILURE_RETRY(ioctl(LxBusFd, LXBUS_IOCTL_CONNECT_SERVER, &Connection));
    1310      if (Result < 0)
    1311      {
    1312          FATAL_ERROR("Failed to connect to server {}", errno);
    1313      }
    1314  
    1315      MessageFd = Connection.Output.MessagePort;
    1316      Result = fcntl(MessageFd, F_SETFD, FD_CLOEXEC);
    1317      if (Result < 0)
    1318      {
    1319          FATAL_ERROR("fcntl failed {}", errno);
    1320      }
    1321  
    1322      return MessageFd;
    1323  }
    1324  
    1325  int InitCreateProcessUtilityVm(
    1326      gsl::span<gsl::byte> Span,
    1327      const LX_INIT_CREATE_PROCESS_UTILITY_VM& CreateProcess,
    1328      wsl::shared::SocketChannel& Channel,
    1329      const wsl::linux::WslDistributionConfig& Config)
    1330  
    1331  /*++
    1332  
    1333  Routine Description:
    1334  
    1335      This routine creates a process from init.
    1336  
    1337  Arguments:
    1338  
    1339      Span - Supplies the message buffer.
    1340  
    1341      CreateProcess - Supplies the message
    1342  
    1343      Channel - Supplies the channel.
    1344  
    1345      Config - Supplies the distribution configuration.
    1346  
    1347  Return Value:
    1348  
    1349      0 on success, -1 on failure.
    1350  
    1351  --*/
    1352  
    1353  {
    1354      std::vector<gsl::byte> Buffer;
    1355      ssize_t BytesRead;
    1356      ssize_t BytesWritten;
    1357      pid_t ChildPid;
    1358      wsl::shared::SocketChannel ControlChannel;
    1359  
    1360      LX_INIT_PROCESS_EXIT_STATUS ExitStatus;
    1361      unsigned int Index;
    1362      bool InteropEnabled;
    1363      InteropServer InteropServer;
    1364      int ListenSocket = -1;
    1365      int Master = -1;
    1366      CREATE_PROCESS_PARSED_COMMON Parsed = {nullptr};
    1367      std::vector<gsl::byte> PendingStdin;
    1368      struct pollfd PollDescriptors[7];
    1369      pid_t RelayPid = -1;
    1370      int Result;
    1371      int SignalFd = -1;
    1372      struct signalfd_siginfo SignalInfo;
    1373      sigset_t SignalMask;
    1374      struct sockaddr_vm SocketAddress;
    1375      std::vector<wil::unique_fd> Sockets(LX_INIT_UTILITY_VM_CREATE_PROCESS_SOCKET_COUNT);
    1376      int Status;
    1377      wil::unique_pipe StdErrPipe;
    1378      int StdIn = -1;
    1379      wil::unique_pipe StdInPipe;
    1380      wil::unique_pipe StdOutPipe;
    1381      wsl::shared::SocketChannel TerminalControlChannel;
    1382  
    1383      int TtyFd = -1;
    1384      struct winsize WindowSize;
    1385  
    1386      //
    1387      // Connect an extra socket for OOBE, if requested.
    1388      //
    1389  
    1390      if (WI_IsFlagSet(CreateProcess.Common.Flags, LxInitCreateProcessFlagAllowOOBE))
    1391      {
    1392          Sockets.push_back(wil::unique_fd{});
    1393      }
    1394  
    1395      //
    1396      // Create a listening socket to accept connections for stdin, stdout,
    1397      // stderr, and the control channel.
    1398      //
    1399      // N.B. If creating the socket fails, a message with invalid port number
    1400      //      should be sent to unblock the wsl service.
    1401      //
    1402  
    1403      ListenSocket = UtilListenVsockAnyPort(&SocketAddress, Sockets.size());
    1404      if (ListenSocket < 0)
    1405      {
    1406          SocketAddress.svm_port = -1;
    1407      }
    1408  
    1409      //
    1410      // Tell the service which sockets ports to connect to.
    1411      //
    1412  
    1413      Channel.SendResultMessage<uint32_t>(SocketAddress.svm_port);
    1414  
    1415      //
    1416      // Exit if creating the listening socket failed.
    1417      //
    1418  
    1419      if (ListenSocket < 0)
    1420      {
    1421          Result = -1;
    1422          goto CreateProcessUtilityVmEnd;
    1423      }
    1424  
    1425      //
    1426      // Create a process to relay input and output via sockets. The parent
    1427      // returns to continue processing messages.
    1428      //
    1429  
    1430      RelayPid = fork();
    1431      if (RelayPid < 0)
    1432      {
    1433          FATAL_ERROR("fork failed for child process {}", errno);
    1434      }
    1435  
    1436      if (RelayPid > 0)
    1437      {
    1438          Result = 0;
    1439          goto CreateProcessUtilityVmEnd;
    1440      }
    1441  
    1442      UtilSetThreadName("Relay");
    1443  
    1444      //
    1445      // Move to the correct mount namespace to create the child in.
    1446      //
    1447  
    1448      if (ConfigSetMountNamespace(WI_IsFlagSet(CreateProcess.Common.Flags, LxInitCreateProcessFlagsElevated)) < 0)
    1449      {
    1450          Result = -1;
    1451          goto CreateProcessUtilityVmEnd;
    1452      }
    1453  
    1454      //
    1455      // Accept connections from the wsl service.
    1456      //
    1457  
    1458      for (auto& Socket : Sockets)
    1459      {
    1460          Socket.reset(UtilAcceptVsock(ListenSocket, SocketAddress));
    1461          if (Socket.get() < 0)
    1462          {
    1463              Result = -1;
    1464              goto CreateProcessUtilityVmEnd;
    1465          }
    1466      }
    1467  
    1468      //
    1469      // Close the listening socket.
    1470      //
    1471  
    1472      CLOSE(ListenSocket);
    1473      ListenSocket = -1;
    1474  
    1475      //
    1476      // Initialize interop.
    1477      //
    1478  
    1479      InteropEnabled = WI_IsFlagSet(CreateProcess.Common.Flags, LxInitCreateProcessFlagsInteropEnabled) && Config.InteropEnabled;
    1480      if (InteropEnabled)
    1481      {
    1482          Result = InteropServer.Create();
    1483          if (Result < 0)
    1484          {
    1485              goto CreateProcessUtilityVmEnd;
    1486          }
    1487      }
    1488  
    1489      //
    1490      // For any of the standard handles that are not consoles, create pipes.
    1491      //
    1492  
    1493      if (WI_IsFlagClear(CreateProcess.Common.Flags, LxInitCreateProcessFlagsStdInConsole))
    1494      {
    1495          try
    1496          {
    1497              StdInPipe = wil::unique_pipe::create(O_CLOEXEC);
    1498          }
    1499          catch (...)
    1500          {
    1501              LOG_CAUGHT_EXCEPTION_MSG("pipe failed");
    1502              Result = -1;
    1503              goto CreateProcessUtilityVmEnd;
    1504          }
    1505      }
    1506  
    1507      if (WI_IsFlagClear(CreateProcess.Common.Flags, LxInitCreateProcessFlagsStdOutConsole))
    1508      {
    1509          try
    1510          {
    1511              StdOutPipe = wil::unique_pipe::create(O_CLOEXEC);
    1512          }
    1513          catch (...)
    1514          {
    1515              LOG_CAUGHT_EXCEPTION_MSG("pipe failed");
    1516              Result = -1;
    1517              goto CreateProcessUtilityVmEnd;
    1518          }
    1519      }
    1520  
    1521      if (WI_IsFlagClear(CreateProcess.Common.Flags, LxInitCreateProcessFlagsStdErrConsole))
    1522      {
    1523          try
    1524          {
    1525              StdErrPipe = wil::unique_pipe::create(O_CLOEXEC);
    1526          }
    1527          catch (...)
    1528          {
    1529              LOG_CAUGHT_EXCEPTION_MSG("pipe failed");
    1530              Result = -1;
    1531              goto CreateProcessUtilityVmEnd;
    1532          }
    1533      }
    1534  
    1535      //
    1536      // Mark the relay process as a subreaper.
    1537      //
    1538  
    1539      Result = prctl(PR_SET_CHILD_SUBREAPER, 1);
    1540      if (Result < 0)
    1541      {
    1542          LOG_ERROR("prctl failed {}", errno);
    1543          goto CreateProcessUtilityVmEnd;
    1544      }
    1545  
    1546      //
    1547      // Block SIGCHLD.
    1548      // N.B. This needs to be done before forking so SIGCHILD isn't missed
    1549      // in case the child exits before the relay masks the signal.
    1550      //
    1551  
    1552      sigemptyset(&SignalMask);
    1553      sigaddset(&SignalMask, SIGCHLD);
    1554      Result = sigprocmask(SIG_BLOCK, &SignalMask, nullptr);
    1555      if (Result < 0)
    1556      {
    1557          LOG_ERROR("sigprocmask failed {}", errno);
    1558          goto CreateProcessUtilityVmEnd;
    1559      }
    1560  
    1561      //
    1562      // Create a pseudoterminal and child process.
    1563      //
    1564  
    1565      memset(&WindowSize, 0, sizeof(WindowSize));
    1566      WindowSize.ws_col = CreateProcess.Columns;
    1567      WindowSize.ws_row = CreateProcess.Rows;
    1568      Result = forkpty(&Master, NULL, NULL, &WindowSize);
    1569      if (Result < 0)
    1570      {
    1571          LOG_ERROR("forkpty failed {}", errno);
    1572          goto CreateProcessUtilityVmEnd;
    1573      }
    1574  
    1575      if (Result == 0)
    1576      {
    1577          //
    1578          // Reset the signal masks.
    1579          //
    1580  
    1581          sigemptyset(&SignalMask);
    1582          Result = sigprocmask(SIG_SETMASK, &SignalMask, nullptr);
    1583          if (Result < 0)
    1584          {
    1585              LOG_ERROR("sigprocmask failed {}", errno);
    1586              goto CreateProcessUtilityVmEnd;
    1587          }
    1588  
    1589          //
    1590          // Duplicate stdin to get a file descriptor representing the controlling
    1591          // terminal.
    1592          //
    1593  
    1594          TtyFd = dup(STDIN_FILENO);
    1595          if (TtyFd < 0)
    1596          {
    1597              LOG_ERROR("dup failed {}", errno);
    1598              goto CreateProcessUtilityVmEnd;
    1599          }
    1600  
    1601          //
    1602          // Replace any standard file descriptor that is not a console with a
    1603          // pipe.
    1604          //
    1605  
    1606          if (WI_IsFlagClear(CreateProcess.Common.Flags, LxInitCreateProcessFlagsStdInConsole))
    1607          {
    1608              Result = dup2(StdInPipe.read().get(), STDIN_FILENO);
    1609              if (Result < 0)
    1610              {
    1611                  LOG_ERROR("dup2 failed {}", errno);
    1612                  goto CreateProcessUtilityVmEnd;
    1613              }
    1614          }
    1615  
    1616          if (WI_IsFlagClear(CreateProcess.Common.Flags, LxInitCreateProcessFlagsStdOutConsole))
    1617          {
    1618              Result = dup2(StdOutPipe.write().get(), STDOUT_FILENO);
    1619              if (Result < 0)
    1620              {
    1621                  LOG_ERROR("dup2 failed {}", errno);
    1622                  goto CreateProcessUtilityVmEnd;
    1623              }
    1624          }
    1625  
    1626          if (WI_IsFlagClear(CreateProcess.Common.Flags, LxInitCreateProcessFlagsStdErrConsole))
    1627          {
    1628              Result = dup2(StdErrPipe.write().get(), STDERR_FILENO);
    1629              if (Result < 0)
    1630              {
    1631                  LOG_ERROR("dup2 failed {}", errno);
    1632                  goto CreateProcessUtilityVmEnd;
    1633              }
    1634          }
    1635  
    1636          //
    1637          // Parse common create process information and create the process in
    1638          // the child.
    1639          //
    1640  
    1641          Result = CreateProcessParseCommon(&Parsed, Span.subspan(offsetof(LX_INIT_CREATE_PROCESS_UTILITY_VM, Common)), Config);
    1642          if (Result < 0)
    1643          {
    1644              goto CreateProcessUtilityVmEnd;
    1645          }
    1646  
    1647          //
    1648          // Set the unique interop socket name as an environment variable.
    1649          //
    1650  
    1651          if (InteropEnabled)
    1652          {
    1653              Result = Parsed.Environment.AddVariableNoThrow(WSL_INTEROP_ENV, InteropServer.Path());
    1654              if (Result < 0)
    1655              {
    1656                  goto CreateProcessUtilityVmEnd;
    1657              }
    1658          }
    1659  
    1660          CreateProcessCommon(&Parsed, TtyFd, Sockets.size() >= 6 ? Sockets[5].get() : -1, Config);
    1661          TtyFd = -1;
    1662          goto CreateProcessUtilityVmEnd;
    1663      }
    1664  
    1665      //
    1666      // Parent...
    1667      //
    1668  
    1669      ChildPid = Result;
    1670  
    1671      if (Sockets.size() >= 6)
    1672      {
    1673          Sockets[5].reset();
    1674      }
    1675  
    1676      //
    1677      // Add the child pid to the thread name for convenience.
    1678      //
    1679  
    1680      UtilSetThreadName(std::format("Relay({})", ChildPid).c_str());
    1681  
    1682      //
    1683      // Close the unneeded ends of the std pipes.
    1684      //
    1685  
    1686      StdInPipe.read().reset();
    1687      StdOutPipe.write().reset();
    1688      StdErrPipe.write().reset();
    1689  
    1690      //
    1691      // Create a signalfd to detect when the child process exits.
    1692      //
    1693  
    1694      SignalFd = signalfd(-1, &SignalMask, 0);
    1695      if (SignalFd < 0)
    1696      {
    1697          Result = -1;
    1698          LOG_ERROR("signalfd failed {}", errno);
    1699          goto CreateProcessUtilityVmEnd;
    1700      }
    1701  
    1702      //
    1703      // Duplicate the stdin file descriptor.
    1704      //
    1705  
    1706      if (WI_IsFlagSet(CreateProcess.Common.Flags, LxInitCreateProcessFlagsStdInConsole))
    1707      {
    1708          StdIn = dup(Master);
    1709      }
    1710      else
    1711      {
    1712          StdIn = dup(StdInPipe.write().get());
    1713          StdInPipe.write().reset();
    1714      }
    1715  
    1716      if (StdIn < 0)
    1717      {
    1718          Result = -1;
    1719          LOG_ERROR("dup failed {}", errno);
    1720          goto CreateProcessUtilityVmEnd;
    1721      }
    1722  
    1723      THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(fcntl(StdIn, F_SETFL, O_NONBLOCK) < 0);
    1724  
    1725      //
    1726      // Fill the poll descriptors.
    1727      //
    1728      // N.B. Any files descriptors that are -1 are ignored by poll.
    1729      //
    1730  
    1731      PollDescriptors[0].fd = Sockets[0].get();
    1732      PollDescriptors[0].events = POLLIN;
    1733      PollDescriptors[1].fd = StdOutPipe.read().get();
    1734      PollDescriptors[1].events = POLLIN;
    1735      PollDescriptors[2].fd = StdErrPipe.read().get();
    1736      PollDescriptors[2].events = POLLIN;
    1737      PollDescriptors[3].fd = Master;
    1738      PollDescriptors[3].events = POLLIN;
    1739      PollDescriptors[4].fd = InteropServer.Socket();
    1740      PollDescriptors[4].events = POLLIN;
    1741      PollDescriptors[5].fd = SignalFd;
    1742      PollDescriptors[5].events = POLLIN;
    1743      PollDescriptors[6].fd = Sockets[3].get();
    1744      PollDescriptors[6].events = POLLIN;
    1745  
    1746      TerminalControlChannel = {{Sockets[3].get()}, "TerminalControl"};
    1747  
    1748      //
    1749      // This is required because sequence numbers can be reset during handover from wsl.exe to wslhost.exe.
    1750      //
    1751  
    1752      TerminalControlChannel.IgnoreSequenceNumbers();
    1753  
    1754      ControlChannel = {{Sockets[4].get()}, "Control"};
    1755  
    1756      //
    1757      // Begin relaying data from the stdin socket to stdin file descriptor and
    1758      // from the master PTY endpoint and output pipes to the stdout and stderr
    1759      // sockets.
    1760      //
    1761  
    1762      for (;;)
    1763      {
    1764          BytesWritten = 0;
    1765  
    1766          Result = poll(PollDescriptors, COUNT_OF(PollDescriptors), PendingStdin.empty() ? -1 : 100);
    1767          if (!PendingStdin.empty())
    1768          {
    1769              BytesWritten = write(StdIn, PendingStdin.data(), PendingStdin.size());
    1770              if (BytesWritten < 0)
    1771              {
    1772                  if (errno != EAGAIN && errno != EWOULDBLOCK)
    1773                  {
    1774                      LOG_ERROR("delayed stdin write failed {}, ChildPid={}", errno, ChildPid);
    1775                  }
    1776              }
    1777              else if (BytesWritten <= PendingStdin.size()) // Partial or complete write
    1778              {
    1779                  PendingStdin.erase(PendingStdin.begin(), PendingStdin.begin() + BytesWritten);
    1780              }
    1781              else
    1782              {
    1783                  LOG_ERROR("Unexpected write result {}, pending={}", BytesWritten, PendingStdin.size());
    1784              }
    1785          }
    1786  
    1787          if (Result < 0)
    1788          {
    1789              LOG_ERROR("poll failed {}", errno);
    1790              break;
    1791          }
    1792  
    1793          //
    1794          // Relay input from the stdin socket to the stdin file descriptor.
    1795          //
    1796  
    1797          if (PollDescriptors[0].revents & (POLLIN | POLLHUP | POLLERR) && PendingStdin.empty())
    1798          {
    1799              BytesRead = UtilReadBuffer(Sockets[0].get(), Buffer);
    1800              if (BytesRead < 0)
    1801              {
    1802                  LOG_ERROR("read failed {}", errno);
    1803                  break;
    1804              }
    1805  
    1806              //
    1807              // A zero-byte read means that the stdin socket has closed. Close
    1808              // the corresponding stdin file descriptor and remove the stdin
    1809              // socket from the poll descriptors list.
    1810              //
    1811  
    1812              if (BytesRead == 0)
    1813              {
    1814                  CLOSE(StdIn);
    1815                  StdIn = -1;
    1816                  PollDescriptors[0].fd = -1;
    1817  
    1818                  //
    1819                  // If stdin is a console, close the pseudoterminal master.
    1820                  //
    1821  
    1822                  if ((WI_IsFlagSet(CreateProcess.Common.Flags, LxInitCreateProcessFlagsStdInConsole)) && (Master != -1))
    1823                  {
    1824                      CLOSE(Master);
    1825                      Master = -1;
    1826                      PollDescriptors[3].fd = -1;
    1827                  }
    1828              }
    1829              else
    1830              {
    1831                  BytesWritten = write(StdIn, Buffer.data(), BytesRead);
    1832                  if (BytesWritten < 0)
    1833                  {
    1834                      //
    1835                      // If writing on stdin's pipe would block, mark the write as pending and continue.
    1836                      // This is required blocking on the write() could lead to a deadlock if the child process
    1837                      // is blocking trying to write on stderr / stdout while the relay tries to write stdin.
    1838                      //
    1839  
    1840                      if (errno == EWOULDBLOCK || errno == EAGAIN)
    1841                      {
    1842                          assert(PendingStdin.empty());
    1843                          PendingStdin.assign(Buffer.begin(), Buffer.begin() + BytesRead);
    1844                      }
    1845                      else
    1846                      {
    1847                          LOG_ERROR("write failed {}", errno);
    1848                          break;
    1849                      }
    1850                  }
    1851              }
    1852          }
    1853  
    1854          //
    1855          // Relay output from the stdout and stderr pipes.
    1856          //
    1857  
    1858          for (Index = 1; Index < 3; Index += 1)
    1859          {
    1860              if (PollDescriptors[Index].revents & (POLLIN | POLLHUP | POLLERR))
    1861              {
    1862                  BytesRead = UtilReadBuffer(PollDescriptors[Index].fd, Buffer);
    1863                  if (BytesRead <= 0)
    1864                  {
    1865                      if (BytesRead < 0)
    1866                      {
    1867                          LOG_ERROR("read failed {} {}", BytesRead, errno);
    1868                      }
    1869  
    1870                      PollDescriptors[Index].fd = -1;
    1871                      UtilSocketShutdown(Sockets[Index].get(), SHUT_WR);
    1872                      continue;
    1873                  }
    1874  
    1875                  BytesWritten = UtilWriteBuffer(Sockets[Index].get(), Buffer.data(), BytesRead);
    1876                  if (BytesWritten < 0)
    1877                  {
    1878                      if (errno == EPIPE)
    1879                      {
    1880                          CLOSE(PollDescriptors[Index].fd);
    1881                          PollDescriptors[Index].fd = -1;
    1882  
    1883                          if (Index == 1)
    1884                          {
    1885                              StdOutPipe.read().reset();
    1886                          }
    1887                          else if (Index == 2)
    1888                          {
    1889                              StdErrPipe.read().reset();
    1890                          }
    1891                      }
    1892                      else
    1893                      {
    1894                          LOG_ERROR("write failed {}, index={}, ChildPid={}, fd={}", errno, Index, ChildPid, Sockets[Index].get());
    1895                      }
    1896                  }
    1897              }
    1898          }
    1899  
    1900          //
    1901          // Relay output from the PTY master to the stdout or stderr socket.
    1902          //
    1903  
    1904          if (PollDescriptors[3].revents & (POLLIN | POLLHUP | POLLERR))
    1905          {
    1906              BytesRead = UtilReadBuffer(Master, Buffer);
    1907  
    1908              //
    1909              // N.B. The pty will fail with EIO on read on hangup instead of
    1910              //      indicating EOF.
    1911              //
    1912  
    1913              if (BytesRead == 0 || (BytesRead < 0 && errno == EIO))
    1914              {
    1915                  PollDescriptors[3].fd = -1;
    1916                  if (WI_IsFlagSet(CreateProcess.Common.Flags, LxInitCreateProcessFlagsStdOutConsole))
    1917                  {
    1918                      UtilSocketShutdown(Sockets[1].get(), SHUT_WR);
    1919                  }
    1920  
    1921                  if (WI_IsFlagSet(CreateProcess.Common.Flags, LxInitCreateProcessFlagsStdErrConsole))
    1922                  {
    1923                      UtilSocketShutdown(Sockets[2].get(), SHUT_WR);
    1924                  }
    1925              }
    1926              else if (BytesRead < 0)
    1927              {
    1928                  LOG_ERROR("read failed {} {}", BytesRead, errno);
    1929                  break;
    1930              }
    1931              else
    1932              {
    1933                  if (WI_IsFlagSet(CreateProcess.Common.Flags, LxInitCreateProcessFlagsStdOutConsole))
    1934                  {
    1935                      BytesWritten = UtilWriteBuffer(Sockets[1].get(), Buffer.data(), BytesRead);
    1936                  }
    1937                  else if (WI_IsFlagSet(CreateProcess.Common.Flags, LxInitCreateProcessFlagsStdErrConsole))
    1938                  {
    1939                      BytesWritten = UtilWriteBuffer(Sockets[2].get(), Buffer.data(), BytesRead);
    1940                  }
    1941                  else
    1942                  {
    1943                      LOG_ERROR("Unexpected output from PTY master");
    1944                  }
    1945  
    1946                  if (BytesWritten < 0)
    1947                  {
    1948                      LOG_ERROR("write failed {}", errno);
    1949                      break;
    1950                  }
    1951              }
    1952          }
    1953  
    1954          //
    1955          // Ensure all data has been written.
    1956          //
    1957  
    1958          if (BytesWritten > 0)
    1959          {
    1960              continue;
    1961          }
    1962  
    1963          //
    1964          // Handle interop requests by relaying create process messages from
    1965          // children over the control channel.
    1966          //
    1967  
    1968          if (PollDescriptors[4].revents & POLLIN)
    1969          {
    1970  
    1971              wsl::shared::SocketChannel channel(InteropServer.Accept(), "InteropRelay");
    1972              if (channel.Socket() < 0)
    1973              {
    1974                  continue;
    1975              }
    1976  
    1977              auto [Header, Span] = channel.ReceiveMessageOrClosed<MESSAGE_HEADER>();
    1978              if (Header != nullptr)
    1979              {
    1980                  try
    1981                  {
    1982                      ConfigHandleInteropMessage(
    1983                          channel, ControlChannel, WI_IsFlagSet(CreateProcess.Common.Flags, LxInitCreateProcessFlagsElevated), Span, Header, Config);
    1984                  }
    1985                  CATCH_LOG();
    1986              }
    1987          }
    1988  
    1989          //
    1990          // Handle signalfd.
    1991          //
    1992  
    1993          if (PollDescriptors[5].revents & POLLIN)
    1994          {
    1995              BytesRead = TEMP_FAILURE_RETRY(read(PollDescriptors[5].fd, &SignalInfo, sizeof(SignalInfo)));
    1996              if (BytesRead != sizeof(SignalInfo))
    1997              {
    1998                  LOG_ERROR("read failed {} {}", BytesRead, errno);
    1999                  break;
    2000              }
    2001  
    2002              if (SignalInfo.ssi_signo != SIGCHLD)
    2003              {
    2004                  LOG_ERROR("Unexpected signal {}", SignalInfo.ssi_signo);
    2005                  break;
    2006              }
    2007  
    2008              //
    2009              // Reap any zombie child processes.
    2010              //
    2011  
    2012              for (;;)
    2013              {
    2014                  Result = waitpid(-1, &Status, WNOHANG);
    2015                  if (Result <= 0)
    2016                  {
    2017                      break;
    2018                  }
    2019  
    2020                  //
    2021                  // If the child process exits, write the exit status message
    2022                  // via the control channel and shut down the stdin / stdout /
    2023                  // stderr sockets.
    2024                  //
    2025  
    2026                  if (ChildPid == Result)
    2027                  {
    2028                      if (WIFEXITED(Status))
    2029                      {
    2030                          Status = WEXITSTATUS(Status);
    2031                      }
    2032  
    2033                      try
    2034                      {
    2035  
    2036                          ExitStatus.Header.MessageType = LxInitMessageExitStatus;
    2037                          ExitStatus.Header.MessageSize = sizeof(ExitStatus);
    2038                          ExitStatus.ExitCode = Status;
    2039                          ControlChannel.SendMessage(ExitStatus);
    2040  
    2041                          // The result is purposefully ignored here.
    2042                          ControlChannel.ReceiveMessage<LX_INIT_PROCESS_EXIT_STATUS>();
    2043                      }
    2044                      catch (...)
    2045                      {
    2046                          Result = -1;
    2047                          LOG_ERROR("Failed to write exit status {}", errno);
    2048                          break;
    2049                      }
    2050  
    2051                      ChildPid = -1;
    2052                      UtilSocketShutdown(Sockets[0].get(), SHUT_RD);
    2053                      UtilSocketShutdown(Sockets[1].get(), SHUT_WR);
    2054                      UtilSocketShutdown(Sockets[2].get(), SHUT_WR);
    2055                      PollDescriptors[6].fd = -1;
    2056                  }
    2057              }
    2058  
    2059              //
    2060              // Exit the relay if no more children exist.
    2061              //
    2062  
    2063              if (Result < 0)
    2064              {
    2065                  if (errno != ECHILD)
    2066                  {
    2067                      LOG_ERROR("waitpid failed {}", errno);
    2068                  }
    2069  
    2070                  break;
    2071              }
    2072          }
    2073  
    2074          //
    2075          // Process messages from wsl.exe / wslhost.exe.
    2076          //
    2077  
    2078          if (PollDescriptors[6].revents & POLLIN)
    2079          {
    2080              auto [Message, _] = TerminalControlChannel.ReceiveMessageOrClosed<LX_INIT_WINDOW_SIZE_CHANGED>();
    2081  
    2082              //
    2083              // A zero-byte read means that the control channel has been closed
    2084              // and that the relay process should exit.
    2085              //
    2086  
    2087              if (Message == nullptr)
    2088              {
    2089                  break;
    2090              }
    2091  
    2092              memset(&WindowSize, 0, sizeof(WindowSize));
    2093              WindowSize.ws_col = Message->Columns;
    2094              WindowSize.ws_row = Message->Rows;
    2095              Result = ioctl(Master, TIOCSWINSZ, &WindowSize);
    2096              if (Result < 0)
    2097              {
    2098                  LOG_ERROR("ioctl(TIOCSWINSZ) failed {}", errno);
    2099              }
    2100          }
    2101      }
    2102  
    2103      //
    2104      // Cleanly shut down the sockets.
    2105      //
    2106      // N.B. If the socket has already been shut down, this is a no-op.
    2107      //
    2108  
    2109      UtilSocketShutdown(Sockets[0].get(), SHUT_RD);
    2110      UtilSocketShutdown(Sockets[1].get(), SHUT_WR);
    2111      UtilSocketShutdown(Sockets[2].get(), SHUT_WR);
    2112      UtilSocketShutdown(Sockets[3].get(), SHUT_RD);
    2113      UtilSocketShutdown(Sockets[4].get(), SHUT_WR);
    2114      Result = 0;
    2115  
    2116  CreateProcessUtilityVmEnd:
    2117      if (ListenSocket != -1)
    2118      {
    2119          CLOSE(ListenSocket);
    2120      }
    2121  
    2122      if (Master != -1)
    2123      {
    2124          CLOSE(Master);
    2125      }
    2126  
    2127      if (SignalFd != -1)
    2128      {
    2129          CLOSE(SignalFd);
    2130      }
    2131  
    2132      if (StdIn != -1)
    2133      {
    2134          CLOSE(StdIn);
    2135      }
    2136  
    2137      if (TtyFd != -1)
    2138      {
    2139          CLOSE(TtyFd);
    2140      }
    2141  
    2142      //
    2143      // The interop server needs to be manually reset so it deletes
    2144      // its interop socket. See https://github.com/microsoft/WSL/issues/7506.
    2145      //
    2146  
    2147      InteropServer.Reset();
    2148  
    2149      //
    2150      // The relay process should always exit.
    2151      //
    2152  
    2153      if (RelayPid == 0)
    2154      {
    2155          _exit(Result);
    2156      }
    2157  
    2158      return Result;
    2159  }
    2160  
    2161  void InitEntry(int Argc, char* Argv[])
    2162  
    2163  /*++
    2164  
    2165  Routine Description:
    2166  
    2167      This routine is the entry point for the init process.
    2168  
    2169  Arguments:
    2170  
    2171      Argc - Supplies command line argument count.
    2172  
    2173      Argv - Supplies command line arguments.
    2174  
    2175  Return Value:
    2176  
    2177      None.
    2178  
    2179  --*/
    2180  
    2181  {
    2182      //
    2183      // Initialize the startup environment.
    2184      //
    2185  
    2186      try
    2187      {
    2188          wil::ScopedWarningsCollector collector;
    2189  
    2190          auto config = ConfigInitializeCommon(g_SavedSignalActions);
    2191  
    2192          //
    2193          // Check if the binary is being run on WSL or in a Utility VM.
    2194          //
    2195  
    2196          if (!UtilIsUtilityVm())
    2197          {
    2198              InitEntryWsl(config);
    2199          }
    2200          else
    2201          {
    2202              InitEntryUtilityVm(config);
    2203          }
    2204      }
    2205      catch (...)
    2206      {
    2207          LOG_CAUGHT_EXCEPTION();
    2208      }
    2209  
    2210      FATAL_ERROR("Init not expected to exit");
    2211      return;
    2212  }
    2213  
    2214  void InitEntryUtilityVm(wsl::linux::WslDistributionConfig& Config)
    2215  
    2216  /*++
    2217  
    2218  Routine Description:
    2219  
    2220      This routine is the entry point for the init process when running inside
    2221      a utility VM.
    2222  
    2223  Arguments:
    2224  
    2225      Config - Supplies the distribution configuration.
    2226  
    2227  Return Value:
    2228  
    2229      None.
    2230  
    2231  --*/
    2232  
    2233  {
    2234      UtilSetThreadName("init-distro");
    2235  
    2236      //
    2237      // Set the close-on-exec flag on the socket file descriptor inherited from mini_init.
    2238      //
    2239  
    2240      wsl::shared::SocketChannel channel{wil::unique_fd{LX_INIT_UTILITY_VM_INIT_SOCKET_FD}, "init"};
    2241      if (fcntl(channel.Socket(), F_SETFD, FD_CLOEXEC) < 0)
    2242      {
    2243          FATAL_ERROR("fcntl failed {}", errno);
    2244          return;
    2245      }
    2246  
    2247      if (getenv(LX_WSL2_DISTRO_READ_ONLY_ENV) != nullptr)
    2248      {
    2249          EMIT_USER_WARNING(wsl::shared::Localization::MessageReadOnlyDistro());
    2250          unsetenv(LX_WSL2_DISTRO_READ_ONLY_ENV);
    2251      }
    2252  
    2253      auto Value = getenv(LX_WSL2_NETWORKING_MODE_ENV);
    2254      if (Value != nullptr)
    2255      {
    2256          Config.NetworkingMode = static_cast<LX_MINI_INIT_NETWORKING_MODE>(std::atoi(Value));
    2257          unsetenv(LX_WSL2_NETWORKING_MODE_ENV);
    2258      }
    2259  
    2260      Value = getenv(LX_WSL2_VM_ID_ENV);
    2261      if (Value != nullptr)
    2262      {
    2263          Config.VmId = Value;
    2264  
    2265          //
    2266          // Unset the environment variable for user distros.
    2267          //
    2268  
    2269          Value = getenv(LX_WSL2_SHARED_MEMORY_OB_DIRECTORY);
    2270          if (!Value)
    2271          {
    2272              unsetenv(LX_WSL2_VM_ID_ENV);
    2273          }
    2274      }
    2275  
    2276      //
    2277      // If the boot.systemd option is specified in /etc/wsl.conf, launch the distro init process as pid 1.
    2278      // WSL init and session leaders continue as children of the distro init process.
    2279      //
    2280  
    2281      const auto pid = getenv(LX_WSL_PID_ENV);
    2282      assert(pid != nullptr);
    2283      unsetenv(LX_WSL_PID_ENV);
    2284  
    2285      //
    2286      // Send the create instance result to the service.
    2287      //
    2288  
    2289      wsl::shared::MessageWriter<LX_MINI_INIT_CREATE_INSTANCE_RESULT> message;
    2290      message->Pid = std::stoul(pid);
    2291      message->Result = 0;
    2292  
    2293      auto Warnings = wil::ScopedWarningsCollector::ConsumeWarnings();
    2294      if (!Warnings.empty())
    2295      {
    2296          message.WriteString(message->WarningsOffset, Warnings);
    2297      }
    2298  
    2299      channel.SendMessage<LX_MINI_INIT_CREATE_INSTANCE_RESULT>(message.Span());
    2300  
    2301      std::optional<pid_t> distroInitPid;
    2302      const auto distroInitPidString = getenv(LX_WSL2_DISTRO_INIT_PID);
    2303      if (distroInitPidString != nullptr)
    2304      {
    2305          distroInitPid = std::stoul(distroInitPidString);
    2306          unsetenv(LX_WSL2_DISTRO_INIT_PID);
    2307      }
    2308  
    2309      std::vector<gsl::byte> Buffer;
    2310      if (Config.BootInit)
    2311      {
    2312          int SocketPair[2];
    2313          if (socketpair(AF_UNIX, (SOCK_STREAM | SOCK_CLOEXEC), 0, SocketPair) < 0)
    2314          {
    2315              FATAL_ERROR("socketpair failed {}", errno);
    2316          }
    2317  
    2318          wil::unique_fd BootStartReadSocket{SocketPair[0]};
    2319          Config.BootStartWriteSocket = SocketPair[1];
    2320  
    2321          const int ChildPid = fork();
    2322          if (ChildPid < 0)
    2323          {
    2324              FATAL_ERROR("fork failed {}", errno);
    2325          }
    2326          else if (ChildPid != 0)
    2327          {
    2328              UtilSetThreadName("init-systemd");
    2329  
    2330              //
    2331              // Wait to boot the distro init process until the first session leader has been created.
    2332              // This ensures that the entire boot is not done when a distro is trigger-started by accessing \\wsl.localhost.
    2333              //
    2334  
    2335              auto Message = wsl::shared::socket::RecvMessage(BootStartReadSocket.get(), Buffer);
    2336              if (Message.empty())
    2337              {
    2338                  FATAL_ERROR("recv failed {}", errno);
    2339              }
    2340  
    2341              auto* StartMessage = gslhelpers::get_struct<MESSAGE_HEADER>(Message);
    2342              if (StartMessage->MessageType != LxInitMessageStartDistroInit)
    2343              {
    2344                  FATAL_ERROR("unexpected Messagetype {}", StartMessage->MessageType);
    2345              }
    2346  
    2347              //
    2348              // Initialize distro init arguments and environment.
    2349              //
    2350  
    2351              auto InitializeStringVector = [&](std::vector<const char*>& PointerVector,
    2352                                                std::vector<std::string>& StringVector,
    2353                                                const std::optional<std::string>& String) {
    2354                  if (String.has_value())
    2355                  {
    2356                      std::string_view StringView{String.value()};
    2357                      while (!StringView.empty())
    2358                      {
    2359                          StringVector.emplace_back(UtilStringNextToken(StringView, " "));
    2360                      }
    2361  
    2362                      for (const auto& TokenString : StringVector)
    2363                      {
    2364                          PointerVector.push_back(TokenString.c_str());
    2365                      }
    2366                  }
    2367  
    2368                  PointerVector.push_back(nullptr);
    2369              };
    2370  
    2371              CreateWslSystemdUnits(Config);
    2372  
    2373              const char* Argv[] = {INIT_PATH, nullptr};
    2374              std::vector<const char*> Env;
    2375              std::vector<std::string> Environment;
    2376              InitializeStringVector(
    2377                  Env, Environment, "container=wsl container_host_id=windows container_host_version_id=" WSL_PACKAGE_VERSION);
    2378  
    2379              execvpe(INIT_PATH, const_cast<char**>(Argv), const_cast<char**>(Env.data()));
    2380              LOG_ERROR("execvpe({}) failed {}", INIT_PATH, errno);
    2381              _exit(1);
    2382          }
    2383  
    2384          //
    2385          // Keep track of the new pid for WSL init.
    2386          //
    2387  
    2388          Config.InitPid = getpid();
    2389      }
    2390  
    2391      //
    2392      // Loop waiting on the socket for requests from the Windows server.
    2393      // A zero-byte read means that the connection to the wsl has been closed and the init daemon should shut down.
    2394      //
    2395  
    2396      wil::unique_fd SignalFd;
    2397      std::vector<pollfd> PollDescriptors(1);
    2398      PollDescriptors[0].fd = channel.Socket();
    2399      PollDescriptors[0].events = POLLIN;
    2400  
    2401      //
    2402      // If a distro init pid was passed, set up a signalfd to watch it so the distribution can be terminated
    2403      // when that process exits.
    2404      //
    2405  
    2406      if (distroInitPid.has_value())
    2407      {
    2408          // Reset sigchld so we get notified when children exit.
    2409          signal(SIGCHLD, SIG_DFL);
    2410  
    2411          sigset_t SignalMask;
    2412          sigemptyset(&SignalMask);
    2413          sigaddset(&SignalMask, SIGCHLD);
    2414          if (UtilSaveBlockedSignals(SignalMask) < 0)
    2415          {
    2416              FATAL_ERROR("sigprocmask failed {}", errno);
    2417          }
    2418  
    2419          SignalFd = {signalfd(-1, &SignalMask, SFD_CLOEXEC)};
    2420          if (!SignalFd)
    2421          {
    2422              FATAL_ERROR("signalfd failed {}", errno);
    2423          }
    2424  
    2425          PollDescriptors.resize(2);
    2426          PollDescriptors[1].fd = SignalFd.get();
    2427          PollDescriptors[1].events = POLLIN;
    2428      }
    2429  
    2430      for (;;)
    2431      {
    2432          auto Result = poll(PollDescriptors.data(), PollDescriptors.size(), -1);
    2433          if (Result < 0)
    2434          {
    2435              FATAL_ERROR("poll failed {}", errno);
    2436          }
    2437  
    2438          if (PollDescriptors[0].revents & (POLLHUP | POLLERR))
    2439          {
    2440              break;
    2441          }
    2442          else if (PollDescriptors[0].revents & POLLIN)
    2443          {
    2444              auto [Header, Span] = channel.ReceiveMessageOrClosed<MESSAGE_HEADER>();
    2445              if (Header == nullptr)
    2446              {
    2447                  break;
    2448              }
    2449  
    2450              switch (Header->MessageType)
    2451              {
    2452              case LxInitMessageCreateSession:
    2453                  if (InitCreateSessionLeader(Span, channel, -1, Config) < 0)
    2454                  {
    2455                      FATAL_ERROR("InitCreateSessionLeader failed");
    2456                  }
    2457  
    2458                  break;
    2459  
    2460              case LxInitMessageInitialize:
    2461                  ConfigInitializeInstance(channel, Span, Config);
    2462                  break;
    2463  
    2464              case LxInitMessageTimezoneInformation:
    2465                  UpdateTimezone(Span, Config);
    2466                  break;
    2467  
    2468              case LxInitMessageRemountDrvfs:
    2469  
    2470                  //
    2471                  // If systemd is enabled, some units (like snapd) might be in the process
    2472                  // of creating mountpoints.
    2473                  // Because these mountpoints should be available in both namespaces, the elevated
    2474                  // and non-elevated namespaces shouldn't fork until systemd is done initializing.
    2475                  //
    2476  
    2477                  WaitForBootProcess(Config);
    2478                  ConfigRemountDrvFs(Span, channel, Config);
    2479                  break;
    2480  
    2481              case LxInitMessageTerminateInstance:
    2482                  InitTerminateInstance(Span, channel, Config);
    2483                  break;
    2484  
    2485              case LxInitCreateProcess:
    2486                  ProcessCreateProcessMessage(channel, Span);
    2487                  break;
    2488  
    2489              default:
    2490                  FATAL_ERROR("Unexpected message {}", Header->MessageType);
    2491              }
    2492          }
    2493  
    2494          if (distroInitPid.has_value() && PollDescriptors[1].revents & POLLIN)
    2495          {
    2496              signalfd_siginfo SignalInfo{};
    2497              auto BytesRead = TEMP_FAILURE_RETRY(read(PollDescriptors[1].fd, &SignalInfo, sizeof(SignalInfo)));
    2498              if (BytesRead != sizeof(SignalInfo))
    2499              {
    2500                  FATAL_ERROR("read failed {} {}", BytesRead, errno);
    2501              }
    2502  
    2503              if (SignalInfo.ssi_signo != SIGCHLD)
    2504              {
    2505                  LOG_ERROR("Unexpected signal {}", SignalInfo.ssi_signo);
    2506                  continue;
    2507              }
    2508  
    2509              int Status{};
    2510              auto Pid = waitpid(-1, &Status, WNOHANG);
    2511              if (Result == 0)
    2512              {
    2513                  continue;
    2514              }
    2515              else if (Result > 0)
    2516              {
    2517                  if (Pid == distroInitPid.value())
    2518                  {
    2519                      LOG_ERROR("Init has exited. Terminating distribution");
    2520                      break;
    2521                  }
    2522              }
    2523              else if (errno != ECHILD)
    2524              {
    2525                  FATAL_ERROR("waitpid failed {}", errno);
    2526              }
    2527          }
    2528      }
    2529  
    2530      InitTerminateInstanceInternal(Config);
    2531      return;
    2532  }
    2533  
    2534  void InitEntryWsl(wsl::linux::WslDistributionConfig& Config)
    2535  
    2536  /*++
    2537  
    2538  Routine Description:
    2539  
    2540      This routine is the entry point for the init process when running inside
    2541      WSL.
    2542  
    2543  Arguments:
    2544  
    2545      Config - Supplies the distribution configuration.
    2546  
    2547  Return Value:
    2548  
    2549      None.
    2550  
    2551  --*/
    2552  
    2553  {
    2554      auto Warnings = wil::ScopedWarningsCollector::ConsumeWarnings();
    2555      if (!Warnings.empty())
    2556      {
    2557          LOG_ERROR("{}", Warnings.c_str());
    2558      }
    2559  
    2560      //
    2561      // Connect to the windows server.
    2562      //
    2563  
    2564      wil::unique_fd LxBusFd = TEMP_FAILURE_RETRY(open(LXBUS_DEVICE_NAME, O_RDWR | O_CLOEXEC));
    2565      if (!LxBusFd)
    2566      {
    2567          FATAL_ERROR("open({}) failed {}", LXBUS_DEVICE_NAME, errno);
    2568          return;
    2569      }
    2570  
    2571      wsl::shared::SocketChannel Channel{wil::unique_fd{InitConnectToServer(LxBusFd.get(), true)}, "init"};
    2572      if (Channel.Socket() < 0)
    2573      {
    2574          return;
    2575      }
    2576  
    2577      //
    2578      // Loop waiting on the message port for requests from the Windows server.
    2579      //
    2580  
    2581      std::vector<gsl::byte> Buffer;
    2582      ssize_t BytesRead;
    2583      for (;;)
    2584      {
    2585          BytesRead = UtilReadMessageLxBus(Channel.Socket(), Buffer, true);
    2586          if (BytesRead < 0)
    2587          {
    2588              return;
    2589          }
    2590  
    2591          auto Message = gsl::make_span(Buffer.data(), BytesRead);
    2592          auto* Header = gslhelpers::try_get_struct<MESSAGE_HEADER>(Message);
    2593          if (!Header)
    2594          {
    2595              FATAL_ERROR("Invalid message size {}", Message.size());
    2596          }
    2597  
    2598          switch (Header->MessageType)
    2599          {
    2600          case LxInitMessageCreateSession:
    2601              if (InitCreateSessionLeader(Message, Channel, LxBusFd.get(), Config) < 0)
    2602              {
    2603                  //
    2604                  // If this distro has no children, exit on failure.
    2605                  //
    2606  
    2607                  int status;
    2608                  if (waitpid(-1, &status, WNOHANG) == -1 && (errno == ECHILD))
    2609                  {
    2610                      FATAL_ERROR("InitCreateSessionLeader failed");
    2611                  }
    2612  
    2613                  LOG_ERROR("InitCreateSessionLeader failed");
    2614              }
    2615  
    2616              break;
    2617  
    2618          case LxInitMessageNetworkInformation:
    2619              ConfigUpdateNetworkInformation(Message, Config);
    2620              break;
    2621  
    2622          case LxInitMessageInitialize:
    2623              ConfigInitializeInstance(Channel, Message, Config);
    2624              break;
    2625  
    2626          case LxInitMessageTimezoneInformation:
    2627              UpdateTimezone(Message, Config);
    2628              break;
    2629  
    2630          case LxInitMessageTerminateInstance:
    2631              InitTerminateInstance(Message, Channel, Config);
    2632              break;
    2633  
    2634          default:
    2635              FATAL_ERROR("Unexpected message {}", Header->MessageType);
    2636          }
    2637      }
    2638  
    2639      return;
    2640  }
    2641  
    2642  void InitTerminateInstance(gsl::span<gsl::byte> Buffer, wsl::shared::SocketChannel& Channel, wsl::linux::WslDistributionConfig& Config)
    2643  
    2644  /*++
    2645  
    2646  Routine Description:
    2647  
    2648      This routine processes a terminate instance request from the service.
    2649  
    2650  Arguments:
    2651  
    2652      Buffer - Supplies the message buffer.
    2653  
    2654      Channel - Supplies a channel to send the response.
    2655  
    2656      Config - Supplies the distribution config.
    2657  
    2658  Return Value:
    2659  
    2660      None.
    2661  
    2662  --*/
    2663  try
    2664  {
    2665  
    2666      auto* Message = gslhelpers::try_get_struct<LX_INIT_TERMINATE_INSTANCE>(Buffer);
    2667      if (!Message)
    2668      {
    2669          FATAL_ERROR("Invalid message size {}", Buffer.size());
    2670      }
    2671  
    2672      //
    2673      // Attempt to stop the plan9 server, if it is not able to be stopped because of an
    2674      // in-use file, reply to the service that the instance could not be terminated.
    2675      //
    2676  
    2677      if (!StopPlan9Server(Message->Force, Config))
    2678      {
    2679          Channel.SendResultMessage<bool>(false);
    2680          return;
    2681      }
    2682  
    2683      InitTerminateInstanceInternal(Config);
    2684  }
    2685  CATCH_LOG();
    2686  
    2687  void InitTerminateInstanceInternal(const wsl::linux::WslDistributionConfig& Config)
    2688  
    2689  /*++
    2690  
    2691  Routine Description:
    2692  
    2693      This routine attempts to cleanly terminate the instance.
    2694  
    2695  Arguments:
    2696  
    2697      Config - Supplies the distribution config.
    2698  
    2699  Return Value:
    2700  
    2701      None.
    2702  
    2703  --*/
    2704  try
    2705  {
    2706      //
    2707      // If systemd is enabled, attempt to poweroff the instance via systemctl.
    2708      //
    2709  
    2710      if (Config.BootInit && !Config.BootStartWriteSocket)
    2711      {
    2712          THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(UtilSetSignalHandlers(g_SavedSignalActions, false) < 0);
    2713  
    2714          if (UtilExecCommandLine("systemctl poweroff", nullptr) == 0)
    2715          {
    2716              std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(Config.BootInitTimeout));
    2717              LOG_ERROR("systemctl poweroff did not terminate the instance in {} ms, calling reboot(RB_POWER_OFF)", Config.BootInitTimeout);
    2718          }
    2719      }
    2720  
    2721      reboot(RB_POWER_OFF);
    2722      FATAL_ERROR("reboot(RB_POWER_OFF) failed {}", errno);
    2723  }
    2724  CATCH_LOG();
    2725  
    2726  void InstallSystemdUnit(const char* Path, const std::string& Name, const char* Content)
    2727  try
    2728  {
    2729      std::string target = std::format("{}/{}.service", Path, Name);
    2730      std::string defaultTarget = std::format("{}/default.target.wants", Path);
    2731      THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(UtilMkdirPath(Path, 0755) < 0);
    2732      THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(WriteToFile(target.c_str(), Content) < 0);
    2733      THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(UtilMkdirPath(defaultTarget.c_str(), 0755) < 0);
    2734  
    2735      std::string symlinkPath = std::format("{}/{}.service", defaultTarget, Name);
    2736      THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(symlink(target.c_str(), symlinkPath.c_str()) < 0);
    2737  }
    2738  CATCH_LOG();
    2739  
    2740  void CreateWslSystemdUnits(const wsl::linux::WslDistributionConfig& Config)
    2741  
    2742  /*++
    2743  
    2744  Routine Description:
    2745  
    2746      This method creates systemd unit files to protect WSL functionality from being disabled by systemd.
    2747  
    2748  Arguments:
    2749  
    2750      Config - Supplies the distribution configuration.
    2751  
    2752  Return Value:
    2753  
    2754      None.
    2755  
    2756  --*/
    2757  
    2758  try
    2759  {
    2760      if (Config.NetworkingMode == LxMiniInitNetworkingModeMirrored)
    2761      {
    2762          HardenMirroredNetworkingSettingsAgainstSystemd();
    2763      }
    2764  
    2765      constexpr auto folder = "/run/systemd/system-generators";
    2766  
    2767      THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(UtilMkdirPath(folder, 0755) < 0);
    2768      THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(symlink("/init", std::format("{}/{}", folder, LX_INIT_WSL_GENERATOR).c_str()));
    2769  
    2770      if (Config.GuiAppsEnabled)
    2771      {
    2772          constexpr auto folder = "/run/systemd/user-generators";
    2773  
    2774          THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(UtilMkdirPath(folder, 0755) < 0);
    2775          THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(symlink("/init", std::format("{}/{}", folder, LX_INIT_WSL_USER_GENERATOR).c_str()));
    2776      }
    2777  }
    2778  CATCH_LOG();
    2779  
    2780  void HardenMirroredNetworkingSettingsAgainstSystemd()
    2781  
    2782  /*++
    2783  
    2784  Routine Description:
    2785  
    2786      This routine writes configuration required for the mirrored networking mode loopback datapath to
    2787      a .conf file applied by systemd. Some distros come with default .conf files only applied when
    2788      systemd is enabled, and some of these contain network configurations that conflict with mirrored
    2789      networking mode. By writing to a .conf file that has higher precedence, we can prevent these
    2790      conflicting settings from being applied.
    2791  
    2792  Arguments:
    2793  
    2794      None.
    2795  
    2796  Return Value:
    2797  
    2798      None.
    2799  
    2800  --*/
    2801  
    2802  try
    2803  {
    2804      const char* NetworkingConfigFileDirectory = "/run/sysctl.d";
    2805      const char* NetworkingConfigFileName = "wsl-networking.conf";
    2806      const std::string NetworkingConfigFilePath = std::format("{}/{}", NetworkingConfigFileDirectory, NetworkingConfigFileName);
    2807      constexpr auto NetworkingConfig =
    2808          "# Note: This file is generated by WSL to prevent default .conf files applied by systemd from overwriting critical "
    2809          "networking settings\n"
    2810          "net.ipv4.conf.all.rp_filter=0\n"
