    2811          "net.ipv4.conf." LX_INIT_LOOPBACK_DEVICE_NAME ".rp_filter=0\n";
    2812  
    2813      THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(UtilMkdirPath(NetworkingConfigFileDirectory, 0755) < 0);
    2814      THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(WriteToFile(NetworkingConfigFilePath.c_str(), NetworkingConfig) < 0);
    2815  }
    2816  CATCH_LOG();
    2817  
    2818  void SessionLeaderCreateProcess(gsl::span<gsl::byte> Buffer, int MessageFd, int TtyFd, const wsl::linux::WslDistributionConfig& Config)
    2819  
    2820  /*++
    2821  
    2822  Routine Description:
    2823  
    2824      This routine creates a process from a session leader.
    2825  
    2826  Arguments:
    2827  
    2828      Buffer - Supplies the message buffer.
    2829  
    2830      MessageFd - Supplies a message port file descriptor.
    2831  
    2832      TtyFd - Supplies a Tty file descriptor.
    2833  
    2834      Config - Supplies the distribution configuration.
    2835  
    2836  Return Value:
    2837  
    2838      None.
    2839  
    2840  --*/
    2841  
    2842  {
    2843      //
    2844      // Parse the create process message buffer and create the new child process.
    2845      //
    2846  
    2847      CREATE_PROCESS_PARSED Parsed = CreateProcessParse(Buffer, MessageFd, Config);
    2848      auto CreateProcessPid = fork();
    2849      THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(CreateProcessPid < 0);
    2850  
    2851      if (CreateProcessPid > 0)
    2852      {
    2853          //
    2854          // Remember the current process group.
    2855          //
    2856  
    2857          if (g_SessionGroup == -1)
    2858          {
    2859              g_SessionGroup = CreateProcessPid;
    2860          }
    2861  
    2862          //
    2863          // Reply with pid of the child process.
    2864          //
    2865  
    2866          THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(CreateProcessReplyToServer(&Parsed, CreateProcessPid, MessageFd) < 0);
    2867  
    2868          return;
    2869      }
    2870  
    2871      //
    2872      // Child...
    2873      //
    2874      // The child process should be part of a separate foreground process group.
    2875      // If a separate foreground process group does not exist, create one here.
    2876      //
    2877  
    2878      int Result = 0;
    2879      if (g_SessionGroup != -1)
    2880      {
    2881          //
    2882          // Attempt to join an existing foreground process group.
    2883          //
    2884  
    2885          Result = setpgid(0, g_SessionGroup);
    2886      }
    2887  
    2888      if ((g_SessionGroup == -1) || (Result < 0))
    2889      {
    2890          //
    2891          // Create a new process group.
    2892          //
    2893  
    2894          THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(setpgid(0, 0) < 0);
    2895      }
    2896  
    2897      //
    2898      // Always bring the process group to the foreground. This will give
    2899      // the newly launched process access to the terminal. In cases where
    2900      // multiple processes are being launched in the same session due to
    2901      // piping commands together (e.g. bash.exe -c ls | bash.exe -c less)
    2902      // or calling bash.exe from within a running WSL instance (inception),
    2903      // there may be issues when this process terminates, as restoring the
    2904      // foreground group does not happen by default. If the launcher is a
    2905      // shell program like /bin/bash, then it typically assumes that the
    2906      // foreground needs to be restored and all will work well.
    2907      //
    2908  
    2909      //
    2910      // N.B. SIGTTOU along with most other signals are blocked. Otherwise,
    2911      //      this could generate a signal with the default behavior of
    2912      //      stopping the process (waiting for SIGCONT to continue).
    2913      //
    2914  
    2915      if (tcsetpgrp(TtyFd, getpgid(0)) < 0)
    2916      {
    2917          LOG_ERROR("tcsetpgrp failed {}", errno);
    2918      }
    2919  
    2920      //
    2921      // Exec the new process.
    2922      //
    2923  
    2924      //
    2925      // Resources are not released for the child process because it will call execv.
    2926      //
    2927      // N.B. CreateProcess does not return.
    2928      //
    2929  
    2930      CreateProcess(&Parsed, TtyFd, Config);
    2931      FATAL_ERROR("CreateProcess not expected to return");
    2932  }
    2933  
    2934  void SessionLeaderSigchldHandler(__attribute__((unused)) int Signal, __attribute__((unused)) siginfo_t* SigInfo, __attribute__((unused)) void* UContext)
    2935  
    2936  /*++
    2937  
    2938  Routine Description:
    2939  
    2940      This routine determines if the process group assigned to processes launched
    2941      by the session leader has terminated.
    2942  
    2943  Arguments:

    2973  void SessionLeaderEntryUtilityVm(wsl::shared::SocketChannel& channel, const wsl::linux::WslDistributionConfig& Config)
    2974  
    2975  /*++
    2976  
    2977  Routine Description:
    2978  
    2979      This routine is the entry point for the session leader process.
    2980  
    2981  Arguments:
    2982

    2999  
    3000      if (setsid() < 0)

    3050  void SessionLeaderEntry(int MessageFd, int TtyFd, const wsl::linux::WslDistributionConfig& Config)
    3051  
    3052  /*++
    3053  
    3054  Routine Description:
    3055  
    3056      This routine is the entry point for the session leader process.
    3057  
    3058  Arguments:
    3059  
    3060      MessageFd - Supplies a message port file descriptor.
    3061  
    3062      TtyFd - Supplies a Tty file descriptor.
    3063  
    3064      Config - Supplies the distribution configuration.
    3065  
    3066  Return Value:
    3067  
    3068      None.
    3069  
    3070  --*/
    3071  
    3072  {
    3073      std::vector<gsl::byte> Buffer;
    3074      ssize_t BytesRead;
    3075      struct sigaction SignalAction;
    3076  
    3077      //
    3078      // Create a new session and set the controlling session on the Tty device.
    3079      //
    3080  
    3081      if (setsid() < 0)
    3082      {
    3083          FATAL_ERROR("setsid failed {}", errno);
    3084      }
    3085  
    3086      if (TEMP_FAILURE_RETRY(ioctl(TtyFd, TIOCSCTTY, NULL)) < 0)
    3087      {
    3088          FATAL_ERROR("ioctl failed for TIOCSCTTY {}", errno);
    3089      }
    3090  
    3091      //
    3092      // Set up a signal handler to reap child processes and track session
    3093      // leader.
    3094      //
    3095  
    3096      memset(&SignalAction, 0, sizeof(SignalAction));
    3097      SignalAction.sa_flags = SA_SIGINFO;
    3098      SignalAction.sa_sigaction = SessionLeaderSigchldHandler;
    3099      if (sigaction(SIGCHLD, &SignalAction, NULL) < 0)
    3100      {
    3101          FATAL_ERROR("sigaction SIGCHLD failed {}", errno);
    3102      }
    3103  
    3104      //
    3105      // Loop waiting on the message port for requests from the Windows server.
    3106      //
    3107  
    3108      for (;;)
    3109      {
    3110          BytesRead = UtilReadMessageLxBus(MessageFd, Buffer, false);
    3111          if (BytesRead < 0)
    3112          {
    3113              FATAL_ERROR("read failed {}", errno);
    3114          }
    3115  
    3116          auto Message = gsl::make_span(Buffer.data(), BytesRead);
    3117          auto* Header = gslhelpers::try_get_struct<MESSAGE_HEADER>(Message);
    3118          if (!Header)
    3119          {
    3120              FATAL_ERROR("Invalid message size {}", Message.size());
    3121          }
    3122  
    3123          if (Header->MessageType == LxInitMessageCreateProcess)
    3124          {
    3125              SessionLeaderCreateProcess(Message, MessageFd, TtyFd, Config);
    3126          }
    3127          else
    3128          {
    3129              FATAL_ERROR("Unexpected message {}", Header->MessageType);
    3130          }
    3131      }
    3132  
    3133      FATAL_ERROR("Session leader not expected to exit");
    3134      return;
    3135  }

    3238  unsigned int StartGns(int Argc, char** Argv)
    3239  {
    3240      constexpr auto* Usage =
    3241          "Usage: gns [" LX_INIT_GNS_SOCKET_ARG " fd] [" LX_INIT_GNS_DNS_SOCKET_ARG " fd] [" LX_INIT_GNS_ADAPTER_ARG
    3242          " guid] [" LX_INIT_GNS_MESSAGE_TYPE_ARG " int] [" LX_INIT_GNS_DNS_TUNNELING_IP " ip]\n";
    3243  
    3244      UtilSetThreadName("GNS");
    3245  
    3246      // Initialize error and telemetry logging.
    3247      InitializeLogging(false);
    3248  
    3249      // hvsocket file descriptor used for DNS tunneling
    3250      std::optional<int> DnsFd;
    3251      std::optional<GUID> AdapterId;
    3252      std::optional<LX_MESSAGE_TYPE> MessageType;
    3253      std::string DnsTunnelingIp;
    3254      wil::unique_fd Socket;
    3255  
    3256      ArgumentParser parser(Argc, Argv);
    3257      parser.AddArgument(UniqueFd{Socket}, LX_INIT_GNS_SOCKET_ARG);
    3258      parser.AddArgument(Integer{DnsFd}, LX_INIT_GNS_DNS_SOCKET_ARG);
    3259      parser.AddArgument(AdapterId, LX_INIT_GNS_ADAPTER_ARG);
    3260      parser.AddArgument(Integer{MessageType}, LX_INIT_GNS_MESSAGE_TYPE_ARG);
    3261      parser.AddArgument(DnsTunnelingIp, LX_INIT_GNS_DNS_TUNNELING_IP);
    3262  
    3263      try
    3264      {
    3265          parser.Parse();
    3266      }
    3267      catch (const wil::ExceptionWithUserMessage& e)
    3268      {
    3269          std::cerr << e.what() << "\n" << Usage;
    3270          return 1;
    3271      }
    3272  
    3273      wsl::shared::SocketChannel channel{std::move(Socket), "GNS"};
    3274  
    3275      GnsEngine::NotificationRoutine readNotification;
    3276      GnsEngine::StatusRoutine returnStatus;
    3277  
    3278      // returns the most recent error when init is created for unit tests (i.e. Fd == -1)
    3279      int exitCode = 0;
    3280  
    3281      if (channel.Socket() == -1)
    3282      {
    3283          readNotification = [&]() -> std::optional<GnsEngine::Message> {
    3284              std::string content{std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(std::cin), std::istreambuf_iterator<char>()};
    3285              if (content.empty())
    3286              {
    3287                  return {};
    3288              }
    3289              if (MessageType.has_value())
    3290              {
    3291                  return {{MessageType.value(), content, AdapterId}};
    3292              }
    3293  
    3294              return {{AdapterId.has_value() ? LxGnsMessageNotification : LxGnsMessageInterfaceConfiguration, content, AdapterId}};
    3295          };
    3296  
    3297          returnStatus = [&](int Result, const std::string& Error) {
    3298              GNS_LOG_INFO("Returning LxGnsMessageResult (no output fd) [{} - {}]", Result, Error.c_str());
    3299              // exitCode keeps the most recent error in the test path
    3300              if (Result != 0)
    3301              {
    3302                  exitCode = Result;
    3303              }
    3304              return true;
    3305          };
    3306      }
    3307      else
    3308      {
    3309          readNotification = [&]() -> std::optional<GnsEngine::Message> {
    3310              std::vector<gsl::byte> Buffer;
    3311              auto [Message, Span] = channel.ReceiveMessageOrClosed<MESSAGE_HEADER>();
    3312              if (Message == nullptr)
    3313              {
    3314                  return {};
    3315              }
    3316  
    3317              auto type = Message->MessageType;
    3318              GNS_LOG_INFO("Processing LX_MESSAGE_TYPE {}", ToString(type));
    3319              switch (type)
    3320              {
    3321              case LxGnsMessageNoOp:
    3322              case LxGnsMessageGlobalNetFilter:
    3323              {
    3324                  return {{type, {}, {}}};
    3325              }
    3326              case LxGnsMessageInterfaceConfiguration:
    3327              {
    3328                  auto size = Span.size() - offsetof(LX_GNS_INTERFACE_CONFIGURATION, Content) - 1;
    3329                  assert(size > 0);
    3330  
    3331                  std::string Content{reinterpret_cast<PLX_GNS_INTERFACE_CONFIGURATION>(Span.data())->Content, size};
    3332  
    3333                  return {{type, Content, {}}};
    3334              }
    3335  
    3336              case LxGnsMessageNotification:
    3337              {
    3338                  auto size = Span.size() - offsetof(LX_GNS_NOTIFICATION, Content) - 1;
    3339                  assert(size > 0);
    3340  
    3341                  const auto* NotificationMessage = reinterpret_cast<PLX_GNS_NOTIFICATION>(Span.data());
    3342                  std::string Content{NotificationMessage->Content, size};
    3343                  return {{type, Content, {NotificationMessage->AdapterId}}};
    3344              }
    3345  
    3346              case LxGnsMessageVmNicCreatedNotification:
    3347              case LxGnsMessageCreateDeviceRequest:
    3348              case LxGnsMessageModifyGuestDeviceSettingRequest:
    3349              case LxGnsMessageLoopbackRoutesRequest:
    3350              case LxGnsMessageInitialIpConfigurationNotification:
    3351              case LxGnsMessageInterfaceNetFilter:
    3352              case LxGnsMessageDeviceSettingRequest:
    3353              case LxGnsMessageSetupIpv6:
    3354              case LxGnsMessageConnectTestRequest:
    3355              {
    3356                  auto size = Span.size() - offsetof(LX_GNS_JSON_MESSAGE, Content) - 1;
    3357                  if (size == 0)
    3358                  {
    3359                      throw RuntimeErrorWithSourceLocation(
    3360                          std::format("Failed to find content for LX_MESSAGE_TYPE : {}", static_cast<int>(type)));
    3361                  }
    3362  
    3363                  std::string Content{reinterpret_cast<PLX_GNS_JSON_MESSAGE>(Span.data())->Content, size};
    3364                  return {{type, Content, {}}};
    3365              }
    3366  
    3367              default:
    3368              {
    3369                  throw RuntimeErrorWithSourceLocation(std::format("Unexpected LX_MESSAGE_TYPE : {}", static_cast<int>(type)));
    3370              }
    3371              }
    3372          };
    3373  
    3374          returnStatus = [&](int Result, const std::string& Error) {
    3375              std::vector<gsl::byte> Buffer(sizeof(LX_GNS_RESULT) + Error.size() + 1);
    3376  
    3377              GNS_LOG_INFO("Returning LxGnsMessageResult [{} - {}]", Result, Error.c_str());
    3378  
    3379              wsl::shared::MessageWriter<LX_GNS_RESULT> response(LX_GNS_RESULT::Type);
    3380              response->Result = Result;
    3381              if (!Error.empty())
    3382              {
    3383                  response.WriteString(Error);
    3384              }
    3385  
    3386              return channel.SendMessage<LX_GNS_RESULT>(response.Span());
    3387          };
    3388      }
    3389  
    3390      RoutingTable routingTable(RT_TABLE_MAIN);
    3391      NetworkManager manager(routingTable);
    3392      GnsEngine engine(readNotification, returnStatus, manager, DnsFd, DnsTunnelingIp);
    3393  
    3394      engine.run();
    3395  
    3396      GNS_LOG_INFO("StartGns returning {} (GNS Socket {}, MessageType {})", exitCode, channel.Socket(), MessageType.value_or(LxMiniInitMessageAny));
    3397      return exitCode;
    3398  }

    3400  void WaitForBootProcess(wsl::linux::WslDistributionConfig& Config)
    3401  {
    3402      if (!Config.BootStartWriteSocket)
    3403      {
    3404          return;
    3405      }
    3406  
    3407      //
    3408      // Launch the boot process wait for it to finish booting.
    3409      //
    3410

    3412      Message.MessageType = LxInitMessageStartDistroInit;

    3415      {

    3418  
    3419      Config.BootStartWriteSocket.reset();

    3422          try
    3423          {

    3428              signal(SIGCHLD, SIG_DFL);
    3429              auto restoreDisposition = wil::scope_exit([]() { signal(SIGCHLD, SIG_IGN); });
    3430              wsl::shared::retry::RetryWithTimeout<void>(
    3431                  [&]() {
    3432                      std::string Output;
    3433                      THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(
    3434                          UtilExecCommandLine("systemctl is-system-running | grep -E \"running|degraded\"", &Output, 0, false) < 0);
    3435                  },
    3436                  std::chrono::milliseconds{250},
    3437                  std::chrono::milliseconds{Config.BootInitTimeout});
    3438          }
    3439          catch (...)
    3440          {
    3441              LOG_ERROR("{} failed to start within {}ms", INIT_PATH, Config.BootInitTimeout);
    3442          }
    3443      }
    3444  }

      93  // Fallback passwd struct to use in case the /etc/passwd file is missing or
      94  // corrupt.
      95  //
      96  
      97  constexpr passwd c_defaultPasswordEntry = {
      98      const_cast<char*>("root"), NULL, ROOT_UID, ROOT_GID, NULL, const_cast<char*>("/"), const_cast<char*>(DEFAULT_SHELL)};

     158  int WslEntryPoint(int Argc, char* Argv[])
     159  {
     160      //
     161      // Determine if the binary is being launched in init daemon mode by
     162      // checking the pid and Argc.
     163      //
     164      // N.B. Using the pid is not enough because this process might be running
     165      // in a docker container. See: https://github.com/microsoft/WSL/issues/10883.
     166      //
     167      // If not in init daemon mode, differentiate between various functionality by checking Argv[0].
     168      //
     169  
     170      char* BaseName = basename(Argv[0]);
     171      int ExitCode = -1;
     172      pid_t Pid = getpid();
     173  
     174      if (Pid == 1 && strcmp(BaseName, "init") == 0 && Argc <= 1)
     175      {
     176          InitEntry(Argc, Argv);
     177      }
     178      else
     179      {
     180          if (strcmp(BaseName, WSLPATH_NAME) == 0)
     181          {
     182              ExitCode = WslPathEntry(Argc, Argv);
     183          }
     184          else if (strcmp(BaseName, MOUNT_DRVFS_NAME) == 0)
     185          {
     186              ExitCode = MountDrvfsEntry(Argc, Argv);
     187          }
     188          else if (strcmp(BaseName, LX_INIT_LOCALHOST_RELAY) == 0)
     189          {
     190              ExitCode = RunPortTracker(Argc, Argv);
     191          }
     192          else if (strcmp(BaseName, LX_INIT_TELEMETRY_AGENT) == 0)
     193          {
     194              ExitCode = StartTelemetryAgent();
     195          }
     196          else if (strcmp(BaseName, LX_INIT_GNS) == 0)
     197          {
     198              ExitCode = StartGns(Argc, Argv);
     199          }
     200          else if (strcmp(BaseName, LX_INIT_PLAN9) == 0)
     201          {
     202              ExitCode = StartPlan9(Argc, Argv);
     203          }
     204          else if (strcmp(BaseName, WSLINFO_NAME) == 0)
     205          {
     206              ExitCode = WslInfoEntry(Argc, Argv);
     207          }
     208          else if (strcmp(BaseName, LX_INIT_WSL_CAPTURE_CRASH) == 0)
     209          {
     210              ExitCode = CaptureCrash(Argc, Argv);
     211          }
     212          else if (strcmp(BaseName, LX_INIT_WSL_GENERATOR) == 0)
     213          {
     214              ExitCode = GenerateSystemdUnits(Argc, Argv);
     215          }
     216          else if (strcmp(BaseName, LX_INIT_WSL_USER_GENERATOR) == 0)
     217          {
     218              ExitCode = GenerateUserSystemdUnits(Argc, Argv);
     219          }
     220          else
     221          {
     222              // Handle the special case for import result messages, everything else is sent to the binfmt interpreter.
     223              if (Pid == 1 && strcmp(BaseName, "init") == 0 && Argc == 3 && strcmp(Argv[1], LX_INIT_IMPORT_MESSAGE_ARG) == 0)
     224              {
     225                  try
     226                  {
     227                      wsl::shared::MessageWriter<LX_MINI_INIT_IMPORT_RESULT> message;
     228                      PostProcessImportedDistribution(message, Argv[2]);
     229                      UtilWriteBuffer(STDOUT_FILENO, message.Span());
     230                      char buffer[1];
     231                      read(STDIN_FILENO, buffer, sizeof(buffer));
     232                      exit(0);
     233                  }
     234                  CATCH_RETURN_ERRNO()
     235              }
     236  
     237              ExitCode = CreateNtProcess(Argc - 1, &Argv[1]);
     238          }
     239      }
     240  
     241      return ExitCode;
     242  }
     243  
     244  int GenerateUserSystemdUnits(int Argc, char** Argv)
     245  {
     246      if (Argc < 2)
     247      {
     248          LOG_ERROR("Unit folder missing");
     249          return 1;
     250      }
     251  
     252      const auto* installPath = Argv[1];
     253  
     254      try
     255      {
     256          std::string automountRoot = "/mnt";
     257          wil::unique_file File{fopen("/etc/wsl.conf", "r")};
     258          if (File)
     259          {
     260              std::vector<ConfigKey> ConfigKeys = {
     261                  ConfigKey(wsl::linux::c_ConfigAutoMountRoot, automountRoot),
     262  
     263              };
     264              ParseConfigFile(ConfigKeys, File.get(), CFG_SKIP_UNKNOWN_VALUES, STRING_TO_WSTRING(CONFIG_FILE));
     265              File.reset();
     266          }
     267  
     268          // TODO: handle quotes in path
     269  
     270          auto unitContent = std::format(
     271              R"(# Note: This file is generated by WSL to configure wslg.
     272  
     273  [Unit]
     274  Description=WSLg user service
     275  DefaultDependencies=no
     276  
     277  [Service]
     278  Type=oneshot
     279  Environment=WSLG_RUNTIME_DIR={}/{}/{}
     280  ExecStart=/bin/sh -c 'mkdir -p -m 00755 "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/pulse"'
     281  ExecStart=/bin/sh -c 'ln -sf "$WSLG_RUNTIME_DIR/wayland-0" "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/wayland-0"'
     282  ExecStart=/bin/sh -c 'ln -sf "$WSLG_RUNTIME_DIR/wayland-0.lock" "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/wayland-0.lock"'
     283  ExecStart=/bin/sh -c 'ln -sf "$WSLG_RUNTIME_DIR/pulse/native" "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/pulse/native"'
     284  ExecStart=/bin/sh -c 'ln -sf "$WSLG_RUNTIME_DIR/pulse/pid" "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/pulse/pid"'
     285    )",
     286              automountRoot,
     287              WSLG_SHARED_FOLDER,
     288              WAYLAND_RUNTIME_DIR);
     289  
     290          InstallSystemdUnit(installPath, "wslg-session", unitContent.c_str());
     291  
     292          return 0;
     293      }
     294      CATCH_LOG()
     295  
     296      return 1;
     297  }
     298  
     299  int GenerateSystemdUnits(int Argc, char** Argv)
     300  {
     301      if (Argc < 2)
     302      {
     303          LOG_ERROR("Unit folder missing");
     304          return 1;
     305      }
     306  
     307      try
     308      {
     309          const auto* installPath = Argv[1];
     310  
     311          LOG_INFO("Generating WSL systemd units in {}", installPath);
     312  
     313          bool enableGuiApps = true;
     314          bool protectBinfmt = true;
     315          bool interopEnabled = true;
     316          std::string automountRoot = "/mnt";
     317  
     318          wil::unique_file File{fopen("/etc/wsl.conf", "r")};
     319          if (File)
     320          {
     321              std::vector<ConfigKey> ConfigKeys = {
     322                  ConfigKey(wsl::linux::c_ConfigEnableGuiAppsOption, enableGuiApps),
     323                  ConfigKey(wsl::linux::c_ConfigBootProtectBinfmtOption, protectBinfmt),
     324                  ConfigKey(wsl::linux::c_ConfigInteropEnabledOption, interopEnabled),
     325                  ConfigKey(wsl::linux::c_ConfigAutoMountRoot, automountRoot),
     326  
     327              };
     328              ParseConfigFile(ConfigKeys, File.get(), CFG_SKIP_UNKNOWN_VALUES, STRING_TO_WSTRING(CONFIG_FILE));
     329              File.reset();
     330          }
     331  
     332          // Mask systemd-networkd-wait-online.service since WSL always ensures that networking is configured during boot.
     333          // That unit can cause systemd boot timeouts since WSL's network interface is unmanaged by systemd.
     334          THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(symlink("/dev/null", std::format("{}/systemd-networkd-wait-online.service", installPath).c_str()) < 0);
     335  
     336          // Mask NetworkManager-wait-online.service for the same reason, as it causes timeouts on distros using NetworkManager.
     337          THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(symlink("/dev/null", std::format("{}/NetworkManager-wait-online.service", installPath).c_str()) < 0);
     338  
     339          // Only create the wslg unit if both enabled in wsl.conf, and if the wslg folder actually exists.
     340          if (enableGuiApps && access("/mnt/wslg/runtime-dir", F_OK) == 0)
     341          {
     342              THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(UtilMkdirPath("/run/tmpfiles.d", 0755) < 0);
     343              const std::string tmpFilesConfig =
     344                  "# Note: This file is generated by WSL to prevent systemd-tmpfiles from removing /tmp/.X11-unix during boot.\n";
     345  
     346              THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(WriteToFile("/run/tmpfiles.d/x11.conf", tmpFilesConfig.c_str()) < 0);
     347  
     348              // Note: It's not possible to use a mount unit because systemd will not mount /tmp/.X11-unix
     349              // if /proc/mount says it's already mounted.
     350  
     351              constexpr auto* x11UnitContent = R"(# Note: This file is generated by WSL to prevent tmp.mount from hiding /tmp/.X11-unix
     352  
     353  [Unit]
     354  Description=WSLg Remount Service
     355  DefaultDependencies=no
     356  After=systemd-tmpfiles-setup.service tmp.mount
     357  ConditionPathExists=/mnt/wslg/.X11-unix
     358  ConditionPathExists=!/tmp/.X11-unix/X0
     359  
     360  [Service]
     361  Type=oneshot
     362  ExecStart=/bin/mount -o bind,ro,X-mount.mkdir -t none /mnt/wslg/.X11-unix /tmp/.X11-unix)";
     363              InstallSystemdUnit(installPath, "wslg", x11UnitContent);
     364          }
     365  
     366          if (interopEnabled && protectBinfmt)
     367          {
     368              // N.B. ExecStop is required to prevent distributions from removing the WSL binfmt entry on shutdown.
     369              auto systemdBinfmtContent = std::format(
     370                  R"(# Note: This file is generated by WSL to prevent binfmt.d from overriding WSL's binfmt interpreter.
     371  # To disable this unit, add the following to /etc/wsl.conf:
     372  # [boot]
     373  # protectBinfmt=false
     374  
     375  [Service]
     376  ExecStop=
     377  ExecStart=/bin/sh -c '(echo -1 > {}/{}) ; (echo "{}" > {})' )",
     378                  BINFMT_MISC_MOUNT_TARGET,
     379                  LX_INIT_BINFMT_NAME,
     380                  BINFMT_INTEROP_REGISTRATION_STRING(LX_INIT_BINFMT_NAME),
     381                  BINFMT_MISC_REGISTER_FILE);
     382  
     383              // Install the override for systemd-binfmt.service.
     384              {
     385                  auto overrideFolder = std::format("{}/systemd-binfmt.service.d", installPath);
     386                  THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(UtilMkdirPath(overrideFolder.c_str(), 0755) < 0);
     387                  THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(WriteToFile(std::format("{}/override.conf", overrideFolder).c_str(), systemdBinfmtContent.c_str()) < 0);
     388              }
     389  
     390              // Install the override for binfmt-support.service.
     391              {
     392                  auto overrideFolder = std::format("{}/binfmt-support.service.d", installPath);
     393                  THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(UtilMkdirPath(overrideFolder.c_str(), 0755) < 0);
     394                  THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(WriteToFile(std::format("{}/override.conf", overrideFolder).c_str(), systemdBinfmtContent.c_str()) < 0);
     395              }
     396          }
     397  
     398          return 0;
     399      }
     400      CATCH_LOG()
     401  
     402      return 1;
     403  }
     404  
     405  int CaptureCrash(int Argc, char** Argv)
     406  try
     407  {
     408      UtilSetThreadName("CaptureCrash");
     409  
     410      if (Argc < 5)
     411      {
     412          std::cerr << "Usage: " << Argv[0] << "<time> <executable> <pid> <signal>" << std::endl;
     413          return 1;
     414      }
     415  
     416      InitializeLogging(false);
     417  
     418      LOG_INFO("Capturing crash for pid: {}, executable: {}, signal: {}, port: {}", Argv[3], Argv[2], Argv[4], LX_INIT_UTILITY_VM_CRASH_DUMP_PORT);
     419  
     420      wsl::shared::SocketChannel channel(UtilConnectVsock(LX_INIT_UTILITY_VM_CRASH_DUMP_PORT, true), "crash-dump");
     421  
     422      wsl::shared::MessageWriter<LX_PROCESS_CRASH> message(LxProcessCrash);
     423      message.WriteString(Argv[2]);
     424      message->Timestamp = std::strtoull(Argv[1], nullptr, 10);
     425      message->Signal = std::strtoul(Argv[4], nullptr, 10);
     426      message->Pid = std::strtoull(Argv[3], nullptr, 10);
     427  
     428      auto result = channel.Transaction<LX_PROCESS_CRASH>(message.Span()).Result;
     429      if (result != 0)
     430      {
     431          LOG_ERROR("Received error while trying to capture crash dump: {}", result);
     432      }
     433  
     434      std::vector<char> buffer(LX_RELAY_BUFFER_SIZE);
     435  
     436      int bytes = -1;
     437      while ((bytes = TEMP_FAILURE_RETRY(read(STDIN_FILENO, buffer.data(), buffer.size()))) > 0)
     438      {
     439          if (UtilWriteBuffer(channel.Socket(), buffer.data(), bytes) < 0)
     440          {
     441              LOG_ERROR("Error while trying read write dump, {}", errno);
     442              return 1;
     443          }
     444      }
     445  
     446      if (bytes != 0)
     447      {
     448          LOG_ERROR("Error while trying read crash dump from stdin, {}", errno);
     449          return 1;
     450      }
     451  
     452      return 0;
     453  }
     454  CATCH_RETURN_ERRNO()
     455  
     456  void CreateProcess(PCREATE_PROCESS_PARSED Parsed, int TtyFd, const wsl::linux::WslDistributionConfig& Config)
     457  
     458  /*++
     459  
     460  Routine Description:
     461  
     462      This routine is the entry point for the create process.
     463  
     464  Arguments:
     465  
     466      Parsed - Supplies a pointer to a create process parsed structure.
     467  
     468      Config - Supplies the distribution configuration.
     469  
     470  Return Value:
     471  
     472      None.
     473  
     474  --*/
     475  
     476  {
     477      ssize_t BytesRead;
     478      uint64_t EventFdData;
     479      int StdFdIndex;
     480  
     481      //
     482      // Initialize the new process and wait until the session leader signals
     483      // to execvpe.
     484      //
     485  
     486      for (StdFdIndex = 0; StdFdIndex < LX_INIT_STD_FD_COUNT; StdFdIndex += 1)
     487      {
     488          //
     489          // If a standard file descriptor is not set, use the TTY file descriptor.
     490          //
     491  
     492          if (dup2(Parsed->StdFd[StdFdIndex] ? Parsed->StdFd[StdFdIndex].get() : TtyFd, StdFdIndex) < 0)
     493          {
     494              FATAL_ERROR("dup2 failed {}", errno);
     495          }
     496  
     497          Parsed->StdFd[StdFdIndex].reset();
     498      }
     499  
     500      //
     501      // Read the eventfd data from the wsl service.
     502      //
     503  
     504      BytesRead = TEMP_FAILURE_RETRY(read(Parsed->EventFd.get(), &EventFdData, sizeof(EventFdData)));
     505      if (BytesRead != sizeof(EventFdData))
     506      {
     507          FATAL_ERROR("Failed to read (size {}) EventFd {}", BytesRead, errno);
     508      }
     509  
     510      //
     511      // Launch the process.
     512      //
     513  
     514      CreateProcessCommon(&Parsed->Common, TtyFd, Parsed->ServiceFd.get(), Config);
     515      return;
     516  }
     517  
     518  void CreateProcessCommon(PCREATE_PROCESS_PARSED_COMMON Common, int TtyFd, int ServiceSocket, const wsl::linux::WslDistributionConfig& Config)
     519  
     520  /*++
     521  
     522  Routine Description:
     523  
     524      This routine is entry point for the common create process functionality.
     525  
     526  Arguments:
     527  
     528      Common - Supplies a pointer to the common create process parsed data.
     529  
     530      TtyFd - Supplies the file descriptor representing the process's terminal.
     531          This method takes ownership of this file descriptor.
     532  
     533      ServiceSocket - Supplies the file descriptor to a socket connected to the Service.
     534  
     535      Config - Supplies the distribution configuration
     536  
     537  Return Value:
     538  
     539      None.
     540  
     541  --*/
     542  
     543  try
     544  {
     545      //
     546      // Print any errors that occurred.
     547      //
     548  
     549      for (const auto& e : wsl::shared::string::Split<char>(wil::ScopedWarningsCollector::ConsumeWarnings(), '\n'))
     550      {
     551          if (!e.empty())
     552          {
     553              fprintf(stderr, "wsl: %s\n", e.c_str());
     554          }
     555      }
     556  
     557      //
     558      // Restore default signal dispositions and clear the signal mask for the child process.
     559      //
     560  
     561      THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(UtilSetSignalHandlers(g_SavedSignalActions, false) < 0);
     562  
     563      sigset_t SignalMask;
     564      sigemptyset(&SignalMask);
     565      THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(sigprocmask(SIG_SETMASK, &SignalMask, NULL) < 0);
     566  
     567      auto AddEnvironmentVariable = [&](const char* Name) {
     568          const auto Value = UtilGetEnvironmentVariable(Name);
     569          if (!Value.empty())
     570          {
     571              Common->Environment.AddVariable(Name, Value.c_str());
     572          }
     573      };
     574  
     575      AddEnvironmentVariable(NAME_ENV);
     576      AddEnvironmentVariable(WSL_DISTRO_NAME_ENV);
     577  
     578      //
     579      // Get the password entry for the user. (root if the distribution is being installed)
     580      //
     581  
     582      const passwd* PasswordEntry{};
     583  
     584      auto ConfigureUid = [&](uint32_t Uid) {
     585          PasswordEntry = getpwuid(Uid);
     586          if (PasswordEntry == nullptr)
     587          {
     588              LOG_ERROR("getpwuid({}) failed {}", Uid, errno);
     589              PasswordEntry = const_cast<passwd*>(&c_defaultPasswordEntry);
     590          }
     591  
     592          //
     593          // Add environment variables to the environment block.
     594          //
     595  
     596          Common->Environment.AddVariable(HOME_ENV, PasswordEntry->pw_dir);
     597          Common->Environment.AddVariable(USER_ENV, PasswordEntry->pw_name);
     598          Common->Environment.AddVariable(LOGNAME_ENV, PasswordEntry->pw_name);
     599          Common->Environment.AddVariable(SHELL_ENV, PasswordEntry->pw_shell);
     600      };
     601  
     602      //
     603      // Set the $LANG environment variable.
     604      //
     605      // N.B. Failure to update $LANG environment variable is non-fatal.
     606      //
     607  
     608      ConfigUpdateLanguage(Common->Environment);
     609  
     610      //
     611      // Launch the OOBE command, if any
     612      //
     613  
     614      if (Common->AllowOOBE)
     615      {
     616          assert(ServiceSocket != -1);
     617  
     618          wsl::shared::SocketChannel channel(wil::unique_fd{ServiceSocket}, "OOBE");
     619  
     620          std::string OobeCommand{};
     621          int defaultUid = 0;
     622          ConfigKeyPresence defaultUidPresent{};
     623          std::vector<ConfigKey> keys = {ConfigKey("oobe.command", OobeCommand), ConfigKey("oobe.defaultUid", defaultUid, &defaultUidPresent)};
     624  
     625          {
     626              wil::unique_file File{fopen(WSL_DISTRIBUTION_CONF, "r")};
     627              ParseConfigFile(keys, File.get(), CFG_SKIP_UNKNOWN_VALUES, STRING_TO_WSTRING(CONFIG_FILE));
     628          }
     629  
     630          int32_t OobeResult = 0;
     631          if (!OobeCommand.empty())
     632          {
     633              auto Pid = UtilCreateChildProcess("OOBE", [&OobeCommand, &Common, &ConfigureUid]() {
     634                  ConfigureUid(0);
     635                  execle("/bin/sh", "sh", "-c", OobeCommand.c_str(), nullptr, const_cast<char**>(Common->Environment.Variables().data()));
     636                  LOG_ERROR("execle() failed, {}", errno);
     637              });
     638  
     639              int Status = -1;
     640              if (TEMP_FAILURE_RETRY(waitpid(Pid, &Status, 0)) < 0)
     641              {
     642                  LOG_ERROR("Waiting for child '{}' failed, waitpid failed {}", OobeCommand.c_str(), errno);
     643                  _exit(1);
     644              }
     645  
     646              if (UtilProcessChildExitCode(Status, OobeCommand.c_str(), 0, false) < 0)
     647              {
     648                  OobeResult = -1;
     649                  fprintf(stderr, "OOBE command \"%s\" failed, exiting\n", OobeCommand.c_str());
     650              }
     651          }
     652  
     653          LX_INIT_OOBE_RESULT result{};
     654          result.Header.MessageType = LxInitOobeResult;
     655          result.Header.MessageSize = sizeof(result);
     656          result.Result = OobeResult;
     657          result.DefaultUid = defaultUidPresent == ConfigKeyPresence::Present ? defaultUid : -1;
     658  
     659          channel.SendMessage(result);
     660  
     661          if (OobeResult != 0)
     662          {
     663              _exit(1);
     664          }
     665  
     666          ConfigureUid(defaultUidPresent == ConfigKeyPresence::Present ? defaultUid : Common->Uid);
     667      }
     668      else
     669      {
     670          ConfigureUid(Common->Uid);
     671      }
     672  
     673      //
     674      // Ensure that a login session has been created for the user and set expected
     675      // environment variables.
     676      //
     677  
     678      if (Config.InitPid.has_value())
     679      {
     680          wsl::shared::SocketChannel InteropChannel{UtilConnectToInteropServer(Config.InitPid.value()), "InteropClient"};
     681          THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(InteropChannel.Socket() < 0);
     682  
     683          wsl::shared::MessageWriter<LX_INIT_CREATE_LOGIN_SESSION> CreateSession(LxInitMessageCreateLoginSession);
     684          CreateSession->Uid = PasswordEntry->pw_uid;
     685          CreateSession->Gid = PasswordEntry->pw_gid;
     686          CreateSession.WriteString(PasswordEntry->pw_name);
     687  
     688          auto result = InteropChannel.Transaction<LX_INIT_CREATE_LOGIN_SESSION>(CreateSession.Span());
     689  
     690          if (!result.Result)
     691          {
     692              fprintf(stderr, "wsl: %s\n", wsl::shared::Localization::MessageSystemdUserSessionFailed(PasswordEntry->pw_name).c_str());
     693          }
     694  
     695          Common->Environment.AddVariable("DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS", std::format("unix:path=/run/user/{}/bus", PasswordEntry->pw_uid));
     696          Common->Environment.AddVariable(XDG_RUNTIME_DIR_ENV, std::format("/run/user/{}", PasswordEntry->pw_uid));
     697      }
     698  
     699      //
     700      // If a filename was provided, use the filename and command line as-is.
     701      // Otherwise, use the user's default shell. If the user's default shell is
     702      // is empty, fall back to using /bin/sh.
     703      //
     704  
     705      std::string Argv0;
     706      std::vector<const char*> CommandLine = Common->CommandLine;
     707      char* Filename = const_cast<char*>(Common->Filename);
     708      if (strlen(Filename) == 0)
     709      {
     710          Filename = const_cast<char*>(SHELL_PATH);
     711          auto Size = sizeof(SHELL_PATH) - 1;
     712          if (PasswordEntry->pw_shell != NULL)
     713          {
     714              Size = strlen(PasswordEntry->pw_shell);
     715              if (Size != 0)
     716              {
     717                  Filename = PasswordEntry->pw_shell;
     718              }
     719          }
     720  
     721          if ((Common->ShellOptions & ShellOptionsLogin) != 0)
     722          {
     723              //
     724              // Construct the name of the shell as the last path element
     725              // prepended with a '-' and use this as Argv[0].
     726              //
     727              // N.B. This is the same behavior as the login binary.
     728              //
     729  
     730              auto Shell = strrchr(Filename, '/');
     731              if (Shell != nullptr)
     732              {
     733                  Shell = Shell + 1;
     734              }
     735              else
     736              {
     737                  Shell = Filename;
     738              }
     739  
     740              Argv0 = "-";
     741              Argv0 += Shell;
     742          }
     743          else
     744          {
     745              Argv0 = Filename;
     746          }
     747  
     748          CommandLine.insert(CommandLine.begin(), Argv0.c_str());
     749      }
     750  
     751      //
     752      // Set the owner of the tty device.
     753      //
     754  
     755      if (TtyFd != -1)
     756      {
     757          if (fchown(TtyFd, PasswordEntry->pw_uid, TTY_GID) < 0)
     758          {
     759              LOG_ERROR("fchown failed {}", errno);
     760          }
     761  
     762          CLOSE(TtyFd);
     763          TtyFd = -1;
     764      }
     765  
     766      //
     767      // Set the supplemental groups, gid, uid, and current working directory.
     768      //
     769  
     770      UtilInitGroups(PasswordEntry->pw_name, PasswordEntry->pw_gid);
     771      THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(setgid(PasswordEntry->pw_gid) < 0);
     772      THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(setuid(PasswordEntry->pw_uid) < 0);
     773  
     774      //
     775      // If the provided current working directory is empty, use the user's home
     776      // path as the current working directory.
     777      //
     778      // N.B. Failures to set the current working directory are non-fatal.
     779      //
     780  
     781      std::string Directory;
     782      if (Common->CurrentWorkingDirectory.empty())
     783      {
     784          Directory = PasswordEntry->pw_dir;
     785      }
     786      else
     787      {
     788          Directory = Common->CurrentWorkingDirectory;
     789          if (Directory[0] == '~')
     790          {
     791              Directory = PasswordEntry->pw_dir;
     792              if (Common->CurrentWorkingDirectory.size() > 1)
     793              {
     794                  Directory += &Common->CurrentWorkingDirectory[1];
     795              }
     796          }
     797      }
     798  
     799      if (chdir(Directory.c_str()) < 0)
     800      {
     801          LOG_ERROR("chdir({}) failed {}", Directory, errno);
     802      }
     803  
     804      //
     805      // Launch the process.
     806      //
     807  
     808      execvpe(Filename, const_cast<char**>(CommandLine.data()), const_cast<char**>(Common->Environment.Variables().data()));
     809      FATAL_ERROR("execvpe({}) failed: {}", Filename, strerror(errno));
     810  
     811      return;
     812  }
     813  catch (...)
     814  {
     815      LOG_CAUGHT_EXCEPTION();
     816      FATAL_ERROR("Create process failed");
     817  }
     818  
     819  CREATE_PROCESS_PARSED CreateProcessParse(gsl::span<gsl::byte> Buffer, int MessageFd, const wsl::linux::WslDistributionConfig& Config)
     820  
     821  /*++
     822  
     823  Routine Description:
     824  
     825      This routine parses a create process message.
     826  
     827  Arguments:
     828  
     829      Buffer - Supplies the create process message.
     830  
     831      MessageFd - Supplies a message port file descriptor.
     832  
     833      Config - Supplies the distribution configuration.
     834  
     835  Return Value:
     836  
     837      The create process parameters.
     838  
     839  --*/
     840  
     841  {
     842      //
     843      // Validate the message size.
     844      //
     845  
     846      auto* Message = gslhelpers::try_get_struct<LX_INIT_CREATE_PROCESS>(Buffer);
     847      THROW_ERRNO_IF(EINVAL, !Message);
     848  
     849      //
     850      // Parse common create process information.
     851      //
     852  
     853      CREATE_PROCESS_PARSED Parsed{};
     854      int Result = CreateProcessParseCommon(&Parsed.Common, Buffer.subspan(offsetof(LX_INIT_CREATE_PROCESS, Common)), Config);
     855      THROW_ERRNO_IF(EINVAL, Result < 0);
     856  
     857      //
     858      // Create the eventfd.
     859      //
     860  
     861      Parsed.EventFd = eventfd(0, EFD_CLOEXEC);
     862      THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(!Parsed.EventFd);
     863  
     864      //
     865      // Set up the standard handles for the process.
     866      //
     867      //
     868  
     869      for (unsigned short Index = 0; Index < LX_INIT_STD_FD_COUNT; Index += 1)
     870      {
     871          if (Message->StdFdIds[Index] != LX_INIT_CREATE_PROCESS_USE_CONSOLE)
     872          {
     873              LXBUS_IPC_MESSAGE_UNMARSHAL_HANDLE_PARAMETERS UnmarshalHandle{};
     874              UnmarshalHandle.Input.HandleId = Message->StdFdIds[Index];
     875              Result = TEMP_FAILURE_RETRY(ioctl(MessageFd, LXBUS_IPC_MESSAGE_IOCTL_UNMARSHAL_HANDLE, &UnmarshalHandle));
     876              THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(Result < 0);
     877  
     878              Parsed.StdFd[Index] = UnmarshalHandle.Output.FileDescriptor;
     879          }
     880      }
     881  
     882      //
     883      // Unmarshal the fork token.
     884      //
     885  
     886      LXBUS_IPC_MESSAGE_UNMARSHAL_FORK_TOKEN_PARAMETERS UnmarshalForkToken{};
     887      UnmarshalForkToken.Input.ForkTokenId = Message->ForkTokenId;
     888      Result = TEMP_FAILURE_RETRY(ioctl(MessageFd, LXBUS_IPC_MESSAGE_IOCTL_UNMARSHAL_FORK_TOKEN, &UnmarshalForkToken));
     889      THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(Result < 0);
     890  
     891      //
     892      // Unmarshal the ipc server.
     893      //
     894  
     895      if (Message->IpcServerId != LXBUS_IPC_SERVER_ID_INVALID)
     896      {
     897          LXBUS_IPC_MESSAGE_UNMARSHAL_SERVER_PARAMETERS UnmarshalServer{};
     898          UnmarshalServer.Input.ServerId = Message->IpcServerId;
     899          Result = TEMP_FAILURE_RETRY(ioctl(MessageFd, LXBUS_IPC_MESSAGE_IOCTL_UNMARSHAL_SERVER, &UnmarshalServer));
     900          THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(Result < 0);
     901  
     902          if (Parsed.Common.AllowOOBE)
     903          {
     904              wil::unique_fd LxBusFd{TEMP_FAILURE_RETRY(open(LXBUS_DEVICE_NAME, O_RDWR))};
     905              THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(!LxBusFd);
     906  
     907              LXBUS_CONNECT_SERVER_PARAMETERS ConnectParams{};
     908              ConnectParams.Input.Flags = LXBUS_IPC_CONNECT_FLAG_UNNAMED_SERVER;
     909              ConnectParams.Input.TimeoutMs = LXBUS_IPC_INFINITE_TIMEOUT;
     910              Result = TEMP_FAILURE_RETRY(ioctl(LxBusFd.get(), LXBUS_IOCTL_CONNECT_SERVER, &ConnectParams));
     911              THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(Result < 0);
     912  
     913              Parsed.ServiceFd = ConnectParams.Output.MessagePort;
     914          }
     915      }
     916  
     917      return Parsed;
     918  }
     919  
     920  int CreateProcessParseCommon(PCREATE_PROCESS_PARSED_COMMON Parsed, gsl::span<gsl::byte> Buffer, const wsl::linux::WslDistributionConfig& Config)
     921  
     922  /*++
     923  
     924  Routine Description:
     925  
     926      This routine parses a create process message.
     927  
     928  Arguments:
     929  
     930      Parsed - Supplies a buffer to store the common create process parameters.
     931  
     932      Buffer - Supplies the common create process message data.
     933  
     934      Config - Supplies the distribution configuration.
     935  
     936  Return Value:
     937  
     938      0 on success, -1 on failure.
     939  
     940  --*/
     941  
     942  try
     943  {
     944      auto* Common = gslhelpers::try_get_struct<LX_INIT_CREATE_PROCESS_COMMON>(Buffer);
     945      if (!Common)
     946      {
     947          LOG_ERROR("Invalid message size {}", Buffer.size());
     948          return -1;
     949      }
     950  
     951      //
     952      // Populate the current working directory. If the path does not begin with a
     953      // UNIX path separator or `~`, it is translated.
     954      //
     955      // N.B. Failure to translate the current working directory is non-fatal.
     956      //
     957  
     958      auto* Path = wsl::shared::string::FromSpan(Buffer, Common->CurrentWorkingDirectoryOffset);
     959      if ((*Path == '/') || (*Path == '~'))
     960      {
     961          Parsed->CurrentWorkingDirectory = Path;
     962      }
     963      else if (*Path != '\0')
     964      {
     965          Parsed->CurrentWorkingDirectory = WslPathTranslate(const_cast<char*>(Path), TRANSLATE_FLAG_ABSOLUTE, TRANSLATE_MODE_UNIX);
     966          if (Parsed->CurrentWorkingDirectory.empty() && Config.AutoMount)
     967          {
     968              EMIT_USER_WARNING(wsl::shared::Localization::MessageFailedToTranslate(Path));
     969          }
     970      }
     971  
     972      //
     973      // Initialize the command line will a null-terminator.
     974      //
     975  
     976      auto CommandLine = Buffer.subspan(Common->CommandLineOffset);
     977      for (unsigned short Index = 0; Index < Common->CommandLineCount; Index += 1)
     978      {
     979          std::string_view Argument{wsl::shared::string::FromSpan(CommandLine)};
     980          Parsed->CommandLine.emplace_back(Argument.data());
     981          CommandLine = CommandLine.subspan(Argument.size() + 1);
     982      }
     983  
     984      //
     985      // If a username was provided, get the password entry for the specified username.
     986      // If no username was provided use the one specified in /etc/wsl.conf.
     987      // Otherwise, use the default UID from the registry.
     988      //
     989  
     990      struct passwd* PasswordEntry = nullptr;
     991      auto Username = wsl::shared::string::FromSpan(Buffer, Common->UsernameOffset);
     992      if (strlen(Username) != 0)
     993      {
     994          PasswordEntry = getpwnam(Username);
     995          if (PasswordEntry == nullptr)
     996          {
     997              FATAL_ERROR_EX(EX_NOUSER, "getpwnam({}) failed {}", Username, errno);
     998          }
     999      }
    1000      else if (Config.DefaultUser.has_value())
    1001      {
    1002          PasswordEntry = getpwnam(Config.DefaultUser->c_str());
    1003          if (PasswordEntry == nullptr)
    1004          {
    1005              LOG_ERROR("getpwnam({}) failed {}", Config.DefaultUser->c_str(), errno);
    1006          }
    1007      }
    1008  
    1009      if (PasswordEntry == nullptr)
    1010      {
    1011          PasswordEntry = getpwuid(Common->DefaultUid);
    1012          if (PasswordEntry == nullptr)
    1013          {
    1014              LOG_ERROR("getpwuid({}) failed {}", Common->DefaultUid, errno);
    1015          }
    1016      }
    1017  
    1018      Parsed->CommandLine.emplace_back(nullptr);
    1019      Parsed->Environment = ConfigCreateEnvironmentBlock(Common, Config);
    1020      Parsed->Filename = wsl::shared::string::FromSpan(Buffer, Common->FilenameOffset);
    1021      Parsed->ShellOptions = static_cast<CREATE_PROCESS_SHELL_OPTIONS>(Common->ShellOptions);
    1022      Parsed->Uid = PasswordEntry ? PasswordEntry->pw_uid : ROOT_UID; // If the default user was not found, fall back to root.
    1023      Parsed->AllowOOBE = WI_IsFlagSet(Common->Flags, LxInitCreateProcessFlagAllowOOBE);
    1024      return 0;
    1025  }
    1026  CATCH_RETURN_ERRNO()
    1027  
    1028  int CreateProcessReplyToServer(PCREATE_PROCESS_PARSED Parsed, pid_t CreateProcessPid, int MessageFd)
    1029  
    1030  /*++
    1031  
    1032  Routine Description:
    1033  
    1034      This routine replies to the server for a create process message.
    1035  
    1036  Arguments:
    1037  
    1038      Parsed - Supplies a pointer to a create process parsed structure.
    1039  
    1040      CreateProcessPid - Supplies the pid of a newly created child process.
    1041  
    1042      MessageFd - Supplies a message port file descriptor.
    1043  
    1044  Return Value:
    1045  
    1046      0 on success, -1 on failure.
    1047  
    1048      N.B. On failure, this routine will terminate the child process.
    1049  
    1050  --*/
    1051  
    1052  {
    1053      auto terminateChild = wil::scope_exit([CreateProcessPid]() {
    1054          if (kill(CreateProcessPid, SIGKILL) < 0)
    1055          {
    1056              FATAL_ERROR("Failed to kill child process {}", errno);
    1057          }
    1058      });
    1059  
    1060      //
    1061      // Marshal the pid of the new child process and send a message
    1062      // indicating that the child was created.
    1063      //
    1064  
    1065      LXBUS_IPC_MESSAGE_MARSHAL_PROCESS_PARAMETERS MarshalProcess{};
    1066      MarshalProcess.Input.Process = CreateProcessPid;
    1067      if (TEMP_FAILURE_RETRY(ioctl(MessageFd, LXBUS_IPC_MESSAGE_IOCTL_MARSHAL_PROCESS, &MarshalProcess)) < 0)
    1068      {
    1069          LOG_ERROR("Failed to marshal pid {}", errno);
    1070          return -1;
    1071      }
    1072  
    1073      auto Bytes = UtilWriteBuffer(MessageFd, &MarshalProcess.Output.ProcessId, sizeof(MarshalProcess.Output.ProcessId));
    1074      if (Bytes < 0)
    1075      {
    1076          LOG_ERROR("Failed to write ProcessId {}", errno);
    1077          return -1;
    1078      }
    1079  
    1080      //
    1081      // Wait for the server to indicate that the process can be continued or
    1082      // it needs to be terminated.
    1083      //
    1084  
    1085      Bytes = TEMP_FAILURE_RETRY(read(MessageFd, &MarshalProcess.Output.ProcessId, sizeof(MarshalProcess.Output.ProcessId)));
    1086      if (Bytes != sizeof(MarshalProcess.Output.ProcessId))
    1087      {
    1088          LOG_ERROR("Failed to read (size {}) ProcessId {}", Bytes, errno);
    1089          return -1;
    1090      }
    1091  
    1092      if (MarshalProcess.Output.ProcessId == 0)
    1093      {
    1094          LOG_ERROR("Server replied with failure");
    1095          return -1;
    1096      }
    1097  
    1098      uint64_t EventFdData = 1;
    1099      Bytes = UtilWriteBuffer(Parsed->EventFd.get(), &EventFdData, sizeof(EventFdData));
    1100      if (Bytes < 0)
    1101      {
    1102          LOG_ERROR("Failed to write EventFd {}", errno);
    1103          return -1;
    1104      }
    1105  
    1106      terminateChild.release();
    1107      return 0;
    1108  }
    1109  
    1110  int InitCreateSessionLeader(gsl::span<gsl::byte> Buffer, wsl::shared::SocketChannel& Channel, int LxBusFd, wsl::linux::WslDistributionConfig& Config)
    1111  
    1112  /*++
    1113  
    1114  Routine Description:
    1115  
    1116      This routine creates a session leader from the init process.
    1117  
    1118  Arguments:
    1119  
    1120      Buffer - Supplies the message buffer.
    1121  
    1122      Channel - Supplies a message channel
    1123  
    1124      LxBusFd - Supplies an LxBus file descriptor (WSL1 only).
    1125  
    1126      Config - Supplies the distribution configuration.
    1127  
    1128  Return Value:
    1129  
    1130      0 on success, -1 on failure.
    1131  
    1132  --*/
    1133  try
    1134  {
    1135      int Result = -1;
    1136      pid_t SessionLeader = -1;
    1137      wil::unique_fd SessionLeaderFd;
    1138      struct sockaddr_vm SocketAddress;
    1139  
    1140      //
    1141      // N.B. FATAL_ERROR will exit the init process, which will also terminate
    1142      //      any previously created sessions that are still running. On failure,
    1143      //      the calling function may choose to continue, in order to preserve
    1144      //      these previous sessions. The FATAL_ERROR macro should be used with
    1145      //      care here.
    1146      //
    1147  
    1148      //
    1149      // Validate input parameters.
    1150      //
    1151  
    1152      auto* CreateSession = gslhelpers::try_get_struct<LX_INIT_CREATE_SESSION>(Buffer);
    1153      if (!CreateSession)
    1154      {
    1155          FATAL_ERROR("Unexpected create session size {}", Buffer.size());
    1156      }
    1157  
    1158      //
    1159      // Connect to the Windows server for the new session leader and create the
    1160      // new session leader process.
    1161      //
    1162  
    1163      if (LxBusFd >= 0)
    1164      {
    1165          //
    1166          // Unmarshal the console for the session leader.
    1167          //
    1168  
    1169          if (CreateSession->ConsoleId == LX_INIT_NO_CONSOLE)
    1170          {
    1171              FATAL_ERROR("Console required for session leader");
    1172          }
    1173  
    1174          auto TtyFd = UnmarshalConsoleFromServer(Channel.Socket(), CreateSession->ConsoleId);
    1175          if (!TtyFd)
    1176          {
    1177              Result = -1;
    1178              LOG_ERROR("UnmarshalConsoleFromServer failed");
    1179              goto InitCreateSessionLeaderExit;
    1180          }
    1181  
    1182          SessionLeaderFd = InitConnectToServer(LxBusFd, false);
    1183          if (!SessionLeaderFd)
    1184          {
    1185              Result = -1;
    1186              goto InitCreateSessionLeaderExit;
    1187          }
    1188  
    1189          SessionLeader = UtilCreateChildProcess(
    1190              "SessionLeader", [SessionLeaderFd = std::move(SessionLeaderFd), TtyFd = std::move(TtyFd), &Channel, &Config]() mutable {
    1191                  umask(Config.Umask);
    1192                  Channel.Close();
    1193  
    1194                  THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(UtilRestoreBlockedSignals() < 0);
    1195  
    1196                  SessionLeaderEntry(SessionLeaderFd.get(), TtyFd.get(), Config);
    1197              });
    1198      }
    1199      else
    1200      {
    1201          WaitForBootProcess(Config);
    1202  
    1203          //
    1204          // Ensure the /etc/resolv.conf symlink is present.
    1205          //
    1206  
    1207          ConfigCreateResolvConfSymlink(Config);
    1208  
    1209          //
    1210          // Create a listening socket for the service to connect to and tell the
    1211          // service which port to use.
    1212          //
    1213          // N.B. If creating the socket fails, a message with invalid port number
    1214          //      should be sent to unblock the wsl service.
    1215          //
    1216  
    1217          wil::unique_fd ListenSocket{UtilListenVsockAnyPort(&SocketAddress, 1)};
    1218          if (!ListenSocket)
    1219          {
    1220              SocketAddress.svm_port = -1;
    1221          }
    1222  
    1223          LX_INIT_CREATE_SESSION_RESPONSE Response;
    1224          Response.Header.MessageType = LxInitMessageCreateSessionResponse;
    1225          Response.Header.MessageSize = sizeof(Response);
    1226          Response.Port = SocketAddress.svm_port;
    1227          Channel.SendMessage(Response);
    1228  
    1229          if (!ListenSocket)
    1230          {
    1231              Result = -1;
    1232              goto InitCreateSessionLeaderExit;
    1233          }
    1234  
    1235          // Note: The call to accept() must be done in the child because if accept() takes a long time, it can block the creation
    1236          // of other session leaders. See https://github.com/microsoft/WSL/issues/9114.
    1237  
    1238          SessionLeader = UtilCreateChildProcess(
    1239              "SessionLeader", [ListenSocket = std::move(ListenSocket), &Channel, &Config, Mask = Config.Umask, SocketAddress]() {
    1240                  umask(Mask);
    1241                  Channel.Close();
    1242  
    1243                  THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(UtilRestoreBlockedSignals() < 0);
    1244  
    1245                  wsl::shared::SocketChannel channel{
    1246                      {UtilAcceptVsock(ListenSocket.get(), SocketAddress, SESSION_LEADER_ACCEPT_TIMEOUT_MS)}, "SessionLeader"};
    1247                  if (channel.Socket() < 0)
    1248                  {
    1249                      LOG_ERROR("UtilAcceptVsock() failed for session leader {}", errno);
    1250                      _exit(1);
    1251                  }
    1252  
    1253                  SessionLeaderEntryUtilityVm(channel, Config);
    1254              });
    1255      }
    1256  
    1257      if (SessionLeader < 0)
    1258      {
    1259          Result = -1;
    1260          goto InitCreateSessionLeaderExit;
    1261      }
    1262  
    1263      Result = 0;
    1264  
    1265  InitCreateSessionLeaderExit:
    1266      return Result;
    1267  }
    1268  CATCH_RETURN_ERRNO();
    1269  
    1270  int InitConnectToServer(int LxBusFd, bool WaitForServer)
    1271  
    1272  /*++
    1273  
    1274  Routine Description:
    1275  
    1276      This routine connects the init process to the lxbus server.
    1277  
    1278  Arguments:
    1279  
    1280      LxBusFd - Supplies an LxBus file descriptor.
    1281  
    1282      WaitForServer - Supplies true to wait for the server, false otherwise.
    1283  
    1284  Return Value:
    1285  
    1286      A message port file descriptor on success, -1 on failure.
    1287  
    1288  --*/
    1289  
    1290  {
    1291      LXBUS_CONNECT_SERVER_PARAMETERS Connection;
    1292      int MessageFd;
    1293      int Result;
    1294  
    1295      MessageFd = -1;
    1296      memset(&Connection, 0, sizeof(Connection));
    1297  
    1298      //
    1299      // Connect to the server and set the CLOEXEC flag.
    1300      //
    1301  
    1302      Connection.Input.ServerName = LX_INIT_SERVER_NAME;
    1303      Connection.Input.TimeoutMs = LXBUS_IPC_INFINITE_TIMEOUT;
    1304      if (WaitForServer != false)
    1305      {
    1306          Connection.Input.Flags = LXBUS_IPC_CONNECT_FLAG_WAIT_FOR_SERVER_REGISTRATION;
    1307      }
    1308  
    1309      Result = TEMP_FAILURE_RETRY(ioctl(LxBusFd, LXBUS_IOCTL_CONNECT_SERVER, &Connection));
    1310      if (Result < 0)
    1311      {
    1312          FATAL_ERROR("Failed to connect to server {}", errno);
    1313      }
    1314  
    1315      MessageFd = Connection.Output.MessagePort;
    1316      Result = fcntl(MessageFd, F_SETFD, FD_CLOEXEC);
    1317      if (Result < 0)
    1318      {
    1319          FATAL_ERROR("fcntl failed {}", errno);
    1320      }
    1321  
    1322      return MessageFd;
    1323  }
    1324  
    1325  int InitCreateProcessUtilityVm(
    1326      gsl::span<gsl::byte> Span,
    1327      const LX_INIT_CREATE_PROCESS_UTILITY_VM& CreateProcess,
    1328      wsl::shared::SocketChannel& Channel,
    1329      const wsl::linux::WslDistributionConfig& Config)
    1330  
    1331  /*++
    1332  
    1333  Routine Description:
    1334  
    1335      This routine creates a process from init.
    1336  
    1337  Arguments:
    1338  
    1339      Span - Supplies the message buffer.
    1340  
    1341      CreateProcess - Supplies the message
    1342  
    1343      Channel - Supplies the channel.
    1344  
    1345      Config - Supplies the distribution configuration.
    1346  
    1347  Return Value:
    1348  
    1349      0 on success, -1 on failure.
    1350  
    1351  --*/
    1352  
    1353  {
    1354      std::vector<gsl::byte> Buffer;
    1355      ssize_t BytesRead;
    1356      ssize_t BytesWritten;
    1357      pid_t ChildPid;
    1358      wsl::shared::SocketChannel ControlChannel;
    1359  
    1360      LX_INIT_PROCESS_EXIT_STATUS ExitStatus;
    1361      unsigned int Index;
    1362      bool InteropEnabled;
    1363      InteropServer InteropServer;
    1364      int ListenSocket = -1;
    1365      int Master = -1;
    1366      CREATE_PROCESS_PARSED_COMMON Parsed = {nullptr};
    1367      std::vector<gsl::byte> PendingStdin;
    1368      struct pollfd PollDescriptors[7];
    1369      pid_t RelayPid = -1;
    1370      int Result;
    1371      int SignalFd = -1;
    1372      struct signalfd_siginfo SignalInfo;
    1373      sigset_t SignalMask;
    1374      struct sockaddr_vm SocketAddress;
    1375      std::vector<wil::unique_fd> Sockets(LX_INIT_UTILITY_VM_CREATE_PROCESS_SOCKET_COUNT);
    1376      int Status;
    1377      wil::unique_pipe StdErrPipe;
    1378      int StdIn = -1;
    1379      wil::unique_pipe StdInPipe;
    1380      wil::unique_pipe StdOutPipe;
    1381      wsl::shared::SocketChannel TerminalControlChannel;
    1382  
    1383      int TtyFd = -1;
    1384      struct winsize WindowSize;
    1385  
    1386      //
    1387      // Connect an extra socket for OOBE, if requested.
    1388      //
    1389  
    1390      if (WI_IsFlagSet(CreateProcess.Common.Flags, LxInitCreateProcessFlagAllowOOBE))
    1391      {
    1392          Sockets.push_back(wil::unique_fd{});
    1393      }
    1394  
    1395      //
    1396      // Create a listening socket to accept connections for stdin, stdout,
    1397      // stderr, and the control channel.
    1398      //
    1399      // N.B. If creating the socket fails, a message with invalid port number
    1400      //      should be sent to unblock the wsl service.
    1401      //
    1402  
    1403      ListenSocket = UtilListenVsockAnyPort(&SocketAddress, Sockets.size());
    1404      if (ListenSocket < 0)
    1405      {
    1406          SocketAddress.svm_port = -1;
    1407      }
    1408  
    1409      //
    1410      // Tell the service which sockets ports to connect to.
    1411      //
    1412  
    1413      Channel.SendResultMessage<uint32_t>(SocketAddress.svm_port);
    1414  
    1415      //
    1416      // Exit if creating the listening socket failed.
    1417      //
    1418  
    1419      if (ListenSocket < 0)
    1420      {
    1421          Result = -1;
    1422          goto CreateProcessUtilityVmEnd;
    1423      }
    1424  
    1425      //
    1426      // Create a process to relay input and output via sockets. The parent
    1427      // returns to continue processing messages.
    1428      //
    1429  
    1430      RelayPid = fork();
    1431      if (RelayPid < 0)
    1432      {
    1433          FATAL_ERROR("fork failed for child process {}", errno);
    1434      }
    1435  
    1436      if (RelayPid > 0)
    1437      {
    1438          Result = 0;
    1439          goto CreateProcessUtilityVmEnd;
    1440      }
    1441  
    1442      UtilSetThreadName("Relay");
    1443  
    1444      //
    1445      // Move to the correct mount namespace to create the child in.
    1446      //
    1447  
    1448      if (ConfigSetMountNamespace(WI_IsFlagSet(CreateProcess.Common.Flags, LxInitCreateProcessFlagsElevated)) < 0)
    1449      {
    1450          Result = -1;
    1451          goto CreateProcessUtilityVmEnd;
    1452      }
    1453  
    1454      //
    1455      // Accept connections from the wsl service.
    1456      //
    1457  
    1458      for (auto& Socket : Sockets)
    1459      {
    1460          Socket.reset(UtilAcceptVsock(ListenSocket, SocketAddress));
    1461          if (Socket.get() < 0)
    1462          {
    1463              Result = -1;
    1464              goto CreateProcessUtilityVmEnd;
    1465          }
    1466      }
    1467  
    1468      //
    1469      // Close the listening socket.
    1470      //
    1471  
    1472      CLOSE(ListenSocket);
    1473      ListenSocket = -1;
    1474  
    1475      //
    1476      // Initialize interop.
    1477      //
    1478  
    1479      InteropEnabled = WI_IsFlagSet(CreateProcess.Common.Flags, LxInitCreateProcessFlagsInteropEnabled) && Config.InteropEnabled;
    1480      if (InteropEnabled)
    1481      {
    1482          Result = InteropServer.Create();
    1483          if (Result < 0)
    1484          {
    1485              goto CreateProcessUtilityVmEnd;
    1486          }
    1487      }
    1488  
    1489      //
    1490      // For any of the standard handles that are not consoles, create pipes.
    1491      //
    1492  
    1493      if (WI_IsFlagClear(CreateProcess.Common.Flags, LxInitCreateProcessFlagsStdInConsole))
    1494      {
    1495          try
    1496          {
    1497              StdInPipe = wil::unique_pipe::create(O_CLOEXEC);
    1498          }
    1499          catch (...)
    1500          {
    1501              LOG_CAUGHT_EXCEPTION_MSG("pipe failed");
    1502              Result = -1;
    1503              goto CreateProcessUtilityVmEnd;
    1504          }
    1505      }
    1506  
    1507      if (WI_IsFlagClear(CreateProcess.Common.Flags, LxInitCreateProcessFlagsStdOutConsole))
    1508      {
    1509          try
    1510          {
    1511              StdOutPipe = wil::unique_pipe::create(O_CLOEXEC);
    1512          }
    1513          catch (...)
    1514          {
    1515              LOG_CAUGHT_EXCEPTION_MSG("pipe failed");
    1516              Result = -1;
    1517              goto CreateProcessUtilityVmEnd;
    1518          }
    1519      }
    1520  
    1521      if (WI_IsFlagClear(CreateProcess.Common.Flags, LxInitCreateProcessFlagsStdErrConsole))
    1522      {
    1523          try
    1524          {
    1525              StdErrPipe = wil::unique_pipe::create(O_CLOEXEC);
    1526          }
    1527          catch (...)
    1528          {
    1529              LOG_CAUGHT_EXCEPTION_MSG("pipe failed");
    1530              Result = -1;
    1531              goto CreateProcessUtilityVmEnd;
    1532          }
    1533      }
    1534  
    1535      //
    1536      // Mark the relay process as a subreaper.
    1537      //
    1538  
    1539      Result = prctl(PR_SET_CHILD_SUBREAPER, 1);
    1540      if (Result < 0)
    1541      {
    1542          LOG_ERROR("prctl failed {}", errno);
    1543          goto CreateProcessUtilityVmEnd;
    1544      }
    1545  
    1546      //
    1547      // Block SIGCHLD.
    1548      // N.B. This needs to be done before forking so SIGCHILD isn't missed
    1549      // in case the child exits before the relay masks the signal.
    1550      //
    1551  
    1552      sigemptyset(&SignalMask);
    1553      sigaddset(&SignalMask, SIGCHLD);
    1554      Result = sigprocmask(SIG_BLOCK, &SignalMask, nullptr);
    1555      if (Result < 0)
    1556      {
    1557          LOG_ERROR("sigprocmask failed {}", errno);
    1558          goto CreateProcessUtilityVmEnd;
    1559      }
    1560  
    1561      //
    1562      // Create a pseudoterminal and child process.
    1563      //
    1564  
    1565      memset(&WindowSize, 0, sizeof(WindowSize));
    1566      WindowSize.ws_col = CreateProcess.Columns;
    1567      WindowSize.ws_row = CreateProcess.Rows;
    1568      Result = forkpty(&Master, NULL, NULL, &WindowSize);
    1569      if (Result < 0)
    1570      {
    1571          LOG_ERROR("forkpty failed {}", errno);
    1572          goto CreateProcessUtilityVmEnd;
    1573      }
    1574  
    1575      if (Result == 0)
    1576      {
    1577          //
    1578          // Reset the signal masks.
    1579          //
    1580  
    1581          sigemptyset(&SignalMask);
    1582          Result = sigprocmask(SIG_SETMASK, &SignalMask, nullptr);
    1583          if (Result < 0)
    1584          {
    1585              LOG_ERROR("sigprocmask failed {}", errno);
    1586              goto CreateProcessUtilityVmEnd;
    1587          }
    1588  
    1589          //
    1590          // Duplicate stdin to get a file descriptor representing the controlling
    1591          // terminal.
    1592          //
    1593  
    1594          TtyFd = dup(STDIN_FILENO);
    1595          if (TtyFd < 0)
    1596          {
    1597              LOG_ERROR("dup failed {}", errno);
    1598              goto CreateProcessUtilityVmEnd;
    1599          }
    1600  
    1601          //
    1602          // Replace any standard file descriptor that is not a console with a
    1603          // pipe.
    1604          //
    1605  
    1606          if (WI_IsFlagClear(CreateProcess.Common.Flags, LxInitCreateProcessFlagsStdInConsole))
    1607          {
    1608              Result = dup2(StdInPipe.read().get(), STDIN_FILENO);
    1609              if (Result < 0)
    1610              {
    1611                  LOG_ERROR("dup2 failed {}", errno);
    1612                  goto CreateProcessUtilityVmEnd;
    1613              }
    1614          }
    1615  
    1616          if (WI_IsFlagClear(CreateProcess.Common.Flags, LxInitCreateProcessFlagsStdOutConsole))
    1617          {
    1618              Result = dup2(StdOutPipe.write().get(), STDOUT_FILENO);
    1619              if (Result < 0)
    1620              {
    1621                  LOG_ERROR("dup2 failed {}", errno);
    1622                  goto CreateProcessUtilityVmEnd;
    1623              }
    1624          }
    1625  
    1626          if (WI_IsFlagClear(CreateProcess.Common.Flags, LxInitCreateProcessFlagsStdErrConsole))
    1627          {
    1628              Result = dup2(StdErrPipe.write().get(), STDERR_FILENO);
    1629              if (Result < 0)
    1630              {
    1631                  LOG_ERROR("dup2 failed {}", errno);
    1632                  goto CreateProcessUtilityVmEnd;
    1633              }
    1634          }
    1635  
    1636          //
    1637          // Parse common create process information and create the process in
    1638          // the child.
    1639          //
    1640  
    1641          Result = CreateProcessParseCommon(&Parsed, Span.subspan(offsetof(LX_INIT_CREATE_PROCESS_UTILITY_VM, Common)), Config);
    1642          if (Result < 0)
    1643          {
    1644              goto CreateProcessUtilityVmEnd;
    1645          }
    1646  
    1647          //
    1648          // Set the unique interop socket name as an environment variable.
    1649          //
    1650  
    1651          if (InteropEnabled)
    1652          {
    1653              Result = Parsed.Environment.AddVariableNoThrow(WSL_INTEROP_ENV, InteropServer.Path());
    1654              if (Result < 0)
    1655              {
    1656                  goto CreateProcessUtilityVmEnd;
    1657              }
    1658          }
    1659  
    1660          CreateProcessCommon(&Parsed, TtyFd, Sockets.size() >= 6 ? Sockets[5].get() : -1, Config);
    1661          TtyFd = -1;
    1662          goto CreateProcessUtilityVmEnd;
    1663      }
    1664  
    1665      //
    1666      // Parent...
    1667      //
    1668  
    1669      ChildPid = Result;
    1670  
    1671      if (Sockets.size() >= 6)
    1672      {
    1673          Sockets[5].reset();
    1674      }
    1675  
    1676      //
    1677      // Add the child pid to the thread name for convenience.
    1678      //
    1679  
    1680      UtilSetThreadName(std::format("Relay({})", ChildPid).c_str());
    1681  
    1682      //
    1683      // Close the unneeded ends of the std pipes.
    1684      //
    1685  
    1686      StdInPipe.read().reset();
    1687      StdOutPipe.write().reset();
    1688      StdErrPipe.write().reset();
    1689  
    1690      //
    1691      // Create a signalfd to detect when the child process exits.
    1692      //
    1693  
    1694      SignalFd = signalfd(-1, &SignalMask, 0);
    1695      if (SignalFd < 0)
    1696      {
    1697          Result = -1;
    1698          LOG_ERROR("signalfd failed {}", errno);
    1699          goto CreateProcessUtilityVmEnd;
    1700      }
    1701  
    1702      //
    1703      // Duplicate the stdin file descriptor.
    1704      //
    1705  
    1706      if (WI_IsFlagSet(CreateProcess.Common.Flags, LxInitCreateProcessFlagsStdInConsole))
    1707      {
    1708          StdIn = dup(Master);
    1709      }
    1710      else
    1711      {
    1712          StdIn = dup(StdInPipe.write().get());
    1713          StdInPipe.write().reset();
    1714      }
    1715  
    1716      if (StdIn < 0)
    1717      {
    1718          Result = -1;
    1719          LOG_ERROR("dup failed {}", errno);
    1720          goto CreateProcessUtilityVmEnd;
    1721      }
    1722  
    1723      THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(fcntl(StdIn, F_SETFL, O_NONBLOCK) < 0);
    1724  
    1725      //
    1726      // Fill the poll descriptors.
    1727      //
    1728      // N.B. Any files descriptors that are -1 are ignored by poll.
    1729      //
    1730  
    1731      PollDescriptors[0].fd = Sockets[0].get();
    1732      PollDescriptors[0].events = POLLIN;
    1733      PollDescriptors[1].fd = StdOutPipe.read().get();
    1734      PollDescriptors[1].events = POLLIN;
    1735      PollDescriptors[2].fd = StdErrPipe.read().get();
    1736      PollDescriptors[2].events = POLLIN;
    1737      PollDescriptors[3].fd = Master;
    1738      PollDescriptors[3].events = POLLIN;
    1739      PollDescriptors[4].fd = InteropServer.Socket();
    1740      PollDescriptors[4].events = POLLIN;
    1741      PollDescriptors[5].fd = SignalFd;
    1742      PollDescriptors[5].events = POLLIN;
    1743      PollDescriptors[6].fd = Sockets[3].get();
    1744      PollDescriptors[6].events = POLLIN;
    1745  
    1746      TerminalControlChannel = {{Sockets[3].get()}, "TerminalControl"};
    1747  
    1748      //
    1749      // This is required because sequence numbers can be reset during handover from wsl.exe to wslhost.exe.
    1750      //
    1751  
    1752      TerminalControlChannel.IgnoreSequenceNumbers();
    1753  
    1754      ControlChannel = {{Sockets[4].get()}, "Control"};
    1755  
    1756      //
