     462      ArgumentParser parser(std::wstring{commandLine}, WSL_BINARY_NAME);
     463      parser.AddPositionalArgument(distroArgument, 0);
     464      parser.AddArgument(distroArgument, WSL_INSTALL_ARG_DIST_OPTION_LONG, WSL_INSTALL_ARG_DIST_OPTION);
     465      parser.AddArgument(noLaunchAfterInstall, WSL_INSTALL_ARG_NO_LAUNCH_OPTION_LONG, WSL_INSTALL_ARG_NO_LAUNCH_OPTION);
     466      parser.AddArgument(webDownload, WSL_INSTALL_ARG_WEB_DOWNLOAD_LONG);
     467      parser.AddArgument(noDistribution, WSL_INSTALL_ARG_NO_DISTRIBUTION_OPTION);
     468      parser.AddArgument(installWslOptionalComponent, WSL_INSTALL_ARG_ENABLE_WSL1_LONG);
     469      parser.AddArgument(NoOp{}, WSL_INSTALL_ARG_PRERELEASE_LONG); // Unused but handled because argument may be present when invoked from inbox.
     470      parser.AddArgument(fromFile, WSL_INSTALL_ARG_FROM_FILE_LONG, WSL_INSTALL_ARG_FROM_FILE_OPTION);
     471      parser.AddArgument(name, WSL_INSTALL_ARG_NAME_LONG);
     472      parser.AddArgument(AbsolutePath(location), WSL_INSTALL_ARG_LOCATION_LONG, WSL_INSTALL_ARG_LOCATION_OPTION);
     473      parser.AddArgument(legacy, WSL_INSTALL_ARG_LEGACY_LONG);
     474      parser.AddArgument(WslVersion(version), WSL_INSTALL_ARG_VERSION);
     475      parser.AddArgument(g_promptBeforeExit, WSL_INSTALL_ARG_PROMPT_BEFORE_EXIT_OPTION);
     476      parser.AddArgument(SizeString(vhdSize), WSL_INSTALL_ARG_VHD_SIZE);
     477      parser.AddArgument(fixedVhd, WSL_INSTALL_ARG_FIXED_VHD);
     478  
     479      parser.Parse();
     480  
     481      if (noDistribution && distroArgument.has_value())
     482      {
     483          THROW_HR_WITH_USER_ERROR(
     484              E_INVALIDARG, Localization::MessageArgumentsNotValidTogether(WSL_INSTALL_ARG_NO_DISTRIBUTION_OPTION, WSL_INSTALL_ARG_DIST_OPTION_LONG));
     485      }
     486  
     487      if (fixedVhd && !vhdSize.has_value())
     488      {
     489          THROW_HR_WITH_USER_ERROR(E_INVALIDARG, Localization::MessageArgumentNotValidWithout(WSL_INSTALL_ARG_FIXED_VHD, WSL_INSTALL_ARG_VHD_SIZE));
     490      }
     491  
     492      // A distribution to be installed can be specified in three ways:
     493      // wsl.exe --install --distribution Ubuntu
     494      // wsl.exe --install Ubuntu
     495      // wsl.exe --install
     496      //
     497      // N.B. The legacy method (specifying --distribution) is no longer documented,
     498      // but is still supported to avoid breaking existing scripts.
     499      if (fromFile.has_value())
     500      {
     501          if (distroArgument.has_value())
     502          {
     503              THROW_HR_WITH_USER_ERROR(
     504                  E_INVALIDARG, Localization::MessageArgumentsNotValidTogether(WSL_INSTALL_ARG_FROM_FILE_LONG, WSL_INSTALL_ARG_DIST_OPTION_LONG));
     505          }
     506  
     507          wil::unique_hfile diskFile;
     508          HANDLE file{};
     509          if (fromFile.value() == WSL_IMPORT_ARG_STDIN)
     510          {
     511              file = GetStdHandle(STD_INPUT_HANDLE);
     512              fromFile = L"<stdin>";
     513          }
     514          else
     515          {
     516              diskFile.reset(CreateFileW(
     517                  fromFile->c_str(), GENERIC_READ, (FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_DELETE), nullptr, OPEN_EXISTING, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, nullptr));
     518  
     519              THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(!diskFile);
     520  
     521              file = diskFile.get();
     522          }
     523  
     524          wsl::windows::common::wslutil::PrintMessage(Localization::MessageInstalling(fromFile->c_str()));
     525          wsl::windows::common::HandleConsoleProgressBar progressBar(file, Localization::MessageImportProgress());
     526  
     527          SvcComm service;
     528          auto [id, installedName] = service.RegisterDistribution(
     529              name.has_value() ? name->c_str() : nullptr,
     530              version.value_or(LXSS_WSL_VERSION_DEFAULT),
     531              file,
     532              location.has_value() ? location->c_str() : nullptr,
     533              fixedVhd ? LXSS_IMPORT_DISTRO_FLAGS_FIXED_VHD : 0,
     534              vhdSize);
     535  
     536          wsl::windows::common::wslutil::PrintMessage(Localization::MessageDistributionInstalled(installedName.get()), stdout);
     537  
     538          if (!noLaunchAfterInstall)
     539          {
     540              wsl::windows::common::wslutil::PrintMessage(Localization::MessageLaunchingDistro(installedName.get()), stdout);
     541  
     542              LaunchProcessOptions options{};
     543              options.DistroGuid = id;
     544              return LaunchProcess(nullptr, 0, nullptr, options);
     545          }
     546  
     547          return 0;
     548      }
     549  
     550      bool rebootRequired = InstallPrerequisites(installWslOptionalComponent);
     551      noLaunchAfterInstall |= rebootRequired;
     552  
     553      // Install a distribution only if no reboot is required, or if we're on the --legacy path (to maintain old behavior).
     554      const Distribution* legacyDistro = nullptr;
     555  
     556      WslInstall::InstallResult installResult{};
     557      if (!noDistribution && (legacy || !rebootRequired))
     558      {
     559          auto result = WslInstall::InstallDistribution(
     560              installResult, distroArgument, version, !noLaunchAfterInstall, webDownload, legacy, fixedVhd, name, location, vhdSize);
     561  
     562          std::optional<std::wstring> flavor;
     563          if (installResult.Distribution.has_value())
     564          {
     565              if (const auto* distro = std::get_if<ModernDistributionVersion>(&*installResult.Distribution))
     566              {
     567                  flavor = distro->Name;
     568              }
     569              else
     570              {
     571                  legacyDistro = std::get_if<Distribution>(&*installResult.Distribution);
     572                  WI_ASSERT(legacyDistro != nullptr);
     573  
     574                  flavor = legacyDistro->Name;
     575              }
     576          }
     577  
     578          // Logs when a specific distribution is installed, and whether that was successful. Used to report distro usage to distro maintainers
     579          WSL_LOG_TELEMETRY(
     580              "InstallDistribution",
     581              PDT_ProductAndServiceUsage,
     582              TraceLoggingValue(result, "result"),
     583              TraceLoggingValue(legacyDistro == nullptr, "modern"),
     584              TraceLoggingValue(flavor.value_or(L"<none>").c_str(), "flavor"));
     585  
     586          THROW_IF_FAILED(result);
     587      }
     588  
     589      if (rebootRequired)
     590      {
     591          wsl::windows::common::wslutil::PrintSystemError(ERROR_SUCCESS_REBOOT_REQUIRED);
     592      }
     593      else if (noDistribution)
     594      {
     595          wsl::windows::common::wslutil::PrintSystemError(NO_ERROR);
     596      }
     597      else
     598      {
     599          if (!installResult.Alreadyinstalled)
     600          {
     601              wsl::windows::common::wslutil::PrintMessage(Localization::MessageDistributionInstalled(installResult.Name));
     602          }
     603  
     604          if (!noLaunchAfterInstall)
     605          {
     606              wsl::windows::common::wslutil::PrintMessage(Localization::MessageLaunchingDistro(installResult.Name), stdout);
     607  
     608              if (legacyDistro != nullptr)
     609              {
     610                  wsl::windows::common::distribution::Launch(*legacyDistro, installResult.InstalledViaGitHub, !installResult.Alreadyinstalled);
     611              }
     612              else
     613              {
     614                  LaunchProcessOptions options{};
     615                  options.DistroGuid = installResult.Id.value();
     616  
     617                  return LaunchProcess(nullptr, 0, nullptr, options);
     618              }
     619          }
     620      }
     621  
     622      return 0;
     623  }
     624  
     625  bool InstallPrerequisites(_In_ bool installWslOptionalComponent)
     626  {
     627      const auto [rebootRequired, missingComponents] = WslInstall::CheckForMissingOptionalComponents(installWslOptionalComponent);
     628      if (missingComponents.empty())
     629      {
     630          return rebootRequired;
     631      }
     632  
     633      // Install any optional components that have not yet been installed.
     634      const auto token = wil::open_current_access_token();
     635      if (!wsl::windows::common::security::IsTokenElevated(token.get()))
     636      {
     637          const auto elevatedCommand = std::format(
     638              L"{} {} {}", WSL_INSTALL_ARG, WSL_INSTALL_ARG_NO_DISTRIBUTION_OPTION, installWslOptionalComponent ? WSL_INSTALL_ARG_ENABLE_WSL1_LONG : L"");
     639  
     640          const auto exitCode = LaunchElevated(elevatedCommand.c_str());
     641          if (exitCode != 0)
     642          {
     643              return exitCode;
     644          }
     645      }
     646      else
     647      {
     648          WslInstall::InstallOptionalComponents(missingComponents);
     649      }
     650  
     651      return rebootRequired;
     652  }
     653  
     654  int LaunchProcess(_In_opt_ LPCWSTR filename, _In_ int argc, _In_reads_(argc) LPCWSTR argv[], _In_ const LaunchProcessOptions& options)
     655  {
     656      // Create an instance of the specified distribution.
     657      //
     658      // N.B. If creating the instance fails because the file system needs to
     659      //      be upgraded, the appropriate message is displayed before
     660      //      re-attempting the create while allowing the upgrade. This is
     661      //      only done if running in interactive mode.
     662      const LPCGUID distribution = options.DistroGuid.has_value() ? &options.DistroGuid.value() : nullptr;
     663      wsl::windows::common::SvcComm service;
     664      if (argc == 0)
     665      {
     666          ClientExecutionContext context;
     667          const auto result = service.CreateInstanceNoThrow(distribution, 0, context.OutError());
     668          if (FAILED(result))
     669          {
     670              if (result == WSL_E_FS_UPGRADE_NEEDED)
     671              {
     672                  wsl::windows::common::wslutil::PrintMessage(wsl::shared::Localization::MessageFsUpgradeNeeded(), stderr);
     673              }
     674              else
     675              {
     676                  THROW_HR(result);
     677              }
     678          }
     679      }
     680  
     681      const int exitCode = service.LaunchProcess(
     682          distribution,
     683          filename,
     684          argc,
     685          argv,
     686          options.LaunchFlags,
     687          options.Username.empty() ? nullptr : options.Username.c_str(),
     688          options.CurrentWorkingDirectory.empty() ? nullptr : options.CurrentWorkingDirectory.c_str());
     689  
     690      THROW_HR_IF(WSL_E_USER_NOT_FOUND, (exitCode == LX_INIT_USER_NOT_FOUND));
     691      THROW_HR_IF(WSL_E_TTY_LIMIT, (exitCode == LX_INIT_TTY_LIMIT));
     692  
     693      return exitCode;
     694  }
     695  
     696  int ListDistributions(_In_ std::wstring_view commandLine)
     697  {
     698      ListOptions options{};
     699      ArgumentParser parser(std::wstring{commandLine}, WSL_BINARY_NAME);
     700      parser.AddArgument(options.all, WSL_LIST_ARG_ALL_OPTION);
     701      parser.AddArgument(options.running, WSL_LIST_ARG_RUNNING_OPTION);
     702      parser.AddArgument(options.quiet, WSL_LIST_ARG_QUIET_OPTION_LONG, WSL_LIST_ARG_QUIET_OPTION);
     703      parser.AddArgument(options.verbose, WSL_LIST_ARG_VERBOSE_OPTION_LONG, WSL_LIST_ARG_VERBOSE_OPTION);
     704      parser.AddArgument(options.online, WSL_LIST_ARG_ONLINE_OPTION_LONG, WSL_LIST_ARG_ONLINE_OPTION);
     705  
     706      parser.Parse();
     707  
     708      return ListDistributionsHelper(options);
     709  }
     710  
     711  int ListDistributionsHelper(_In_ ListOptions options)
     712  {
     713      // Handle invalid options.
     714      THROW_HR_IF(
     715          WSL_E_INVALID_USAGE,
     716          ((options.quiet && options.verbose) || (options.all && options.running)) || ((options.verbose || options.all) && options.online));
     717  
     718      // Query all registered distributions and sort the list so the default
     719      // (if present) is first.
     720      wsl::windows::common::SvcComm service;
     721      auto distros = service.EnumerateDistributions();
     722      std::sort(distros.begin(), distros.end(), [](const auto& Left, const auto&) {
     723          return (WI_IsFlagSet(Left.Flags, LXSS_ENUMERATE_FLAGS_DEFAULT));
     724      });
     725  
     726      if (options.verbose)
     727      {
     728          THROW_HR_IF(WSL_E_DEFAULT_DISTRO_NOT_FOUND, distros.empty());
     729  
     730          // Determine max length of a distro name and construct the format string.
     731          size_t maxLength = wcslen(WSL_LIST_HEADER_NAME);
     732          std::for_each(distros.begin(), distros.end(), [&](const auto& entry) {
     733              const size_t length = wcslen(entry.DistroName);
     734              if (length > maxLength)
     735              {
     736                  maxLength = length;
     737              }
     738          });
     739  
     740          std::wstring formatString(L"%s %-");
     741          formatString += std::to_wstring(maxLength + 4);
     742          formatString += L"s%-16s%s\n";
     743  
     744          // Print distribution information.
     745          wprintf(formatString.c_str(), L" ", WSL_LIST_HEADER_NAME, WSL_LIST_HEADER_STATE, WSL_LIST_HEADER_VERSION);
     746          std::for_each(distros.begin(), distros.end(), [&](const auto& entry) {
     747              const LPCWSTR defaultDistro = WI_IsFlagSet(entry.Flags, LXSS_ENUMERATE_FLAGS_DEFAULT) ? L"*" : L" ";
     748              const std::wstring version(std::to_wstring(entry.Version));
     749              auto state = L"Stopped";
     750              switch (entry.State)
     751              {
     752              case LxssDistributionStateRunning:
     753                  state = L"Running";
     754                  break;
     755  
     756              case LxssDistributionStateInstalling:
     757                  state = L"Installing";
     758                  break;
     759  
     760              case LxssDistributionStateUninstalling:
     761                  state = L"Uninstalling";
     762                  break;
     763  
     764              case LxssDistributionStateConverting:
     765                  state = L"Converting";
     766                  break;
     767  
     768              case LxssDistributionStateExporting:
     769                  state = L"Exporting";
     770                  break;
     771  
     772              default:
     773                  break;
     774              }
     775  
     776              wprintf(formatString.c_str(), defaultDistro, entry.DistroName, state, version.c_str());
     777          });
     778      }
     779      else if (!options.online)
     780      {
     781          if (options.running)
     782          {
     783              std::erase_if(distros, [&](const auto& entry) { return (entry.State != LxssDistributionStateRunning); });
     784  
     785              if ((!options.quiet) && (distros.empty()))
     786              {
     787                  wsl::windows::common::wslutil::PrintMessage(wsl::shared::Localization::MessageNoRunningDistro());
     788                  return -1;
     789              }
     790          }
     791  
     792          if (!options.all)
     793          {
     794              std::erase_if(distros, [&](const auto& entry) {
     795                  return (
     796                      (entry.State == LxssDistributionStateInstalling) || (entry.State == LxssDistributionStateUninstalling) ||
     797                      (entry.State == LxssDistributionStateConverting) || (entry.State == LxssDistributionStateExporting));
     798              });
     799          }
     800  
     801          if (!options.quiet)
     802          {
     803              THROW_HR_IF(WSL_E_DEFAULT_DISTRO_NOT_FOUND, distros.empty());
     804  
     805              wsl::windows::common::wslutil::PrintMessage(wsl::shared::Localization::MessageRegisteredDistrosHeader());
     806          }
     807  
     808          std::for_each(distros.begin(), distros.end(), [&](const auto& entry) {
     809              if ((!options.quiet) && WI_IsFlagSet(entry.Flags, LXSS_ENUMERATE_FLAGS_DEFAULT))
     810              {
     811                  wsl::windows::common::wslutil::PrintMessage(Localization::MessagePrintDistroDefault(entry.DistroName), stdout);
     812              }
     813              else
     814              {
     815                  wprintf(L"%s\n", entry.DistroName);
     816              }
     817          });
     818      }
     819      else
     820      {
     821          std::vector<std::pair<std::wstring, std::wstring>> names;
     822  
     823          size_t maxLength = wcslen(WSL_LIST_HEADER_NAME);
     824  
     825          auto appendIfNotPresent = [&](const std::wstring& name, const std::wstring& friendlyName) {
     826              auto pred = [&name](const auto& e) { return e.first == name; };
     827  
     828              if (std::find_if(names.begin(), names.end(), pred) == names.end())
     829              {
     830                  names.emplace_back(name, friendlyName);
     831  
     832                  if (name.size() > maxLength)
     833                  {
     834                      maxLength = name.size();
     835                  }
     836              }
     837          };
     838  
     839          auto readNames = [&](const DistributionList& distributions) {
     840              if (distributions.ModernDistributions.has_value())
     841              {
     842                  for (const auto& [name, versions] : *distributions.ModernDistributions)
     843                  {
     844                      for (auto i = 0; i < versions.size(); i++)
     845                      {
     846                          if (!options.all && i > 3)
     847                          {
     848                              break; // Only show 3 entries per distro unless --all is passed.
     849                          }
     850  
     851                          appendIfNotPresent(versions[i].Name, versions[i].FriendlyName);
     852                      }
     853                  }
     854              }
     855  
     856              if (distributions.Distributions.has_value())
     857              {
     858                  for (const auto& e : *distributions.Distributions)
     859                  {
     860                      appendIfNotPresent(e.Name, e.FriendlyName);
     861                  }
     862              }
     863          };
     864  
     865          const auto manifest = wsl::windows::common::distribution::GetAvailable();
     866          if (manifest.OverrideManifest.has_value())
     867          {
     868              readNames(*manifest.OverrideManifest);
     869          }
     870  
     871          readNames(manifest.Manifest);
     872  
     873          std::wstring formatString(L"%-");
     874          formatString += std::to_wstring(maxLength + 4);
     875          formatString += L"s%s\n";
     876  
     877          wsl::windows::common::wslutil::PrintMessage(wsl::shared::Localization::MessageDistributionListOnline(WSL_INSTALL_ARG));
     878          wprintf(formatString.c_str(), WSL_LIST_HEADER_NAME, WSL_LIST_HEADER_FRIENDLY_NAME);
     879          std::for_each(names.begin(), names.end(), [&](const auto& entry) {
     880              wprintf(formatString.c_str(), entry.first.c_str(), entry.second.c_str());
     881          });
     882      }
     883  
     884      return 0;
     885  }
     886  
     887  int Manage(_In_ std::wstring_view commandLine)
     888  {
     889      LPCWSTR distribution{};
     890      std::optional<bool> sparse;
     891      std::optional<std::wstring> move;
     892      std::optional<std::wstring> defaultUser;
     893      std::optional<uint64_t> resize;
     894      bool allowUnsafe = false;
     895  
     896      ArgumentParser parser(std::wstring{commandLine}, WSL_BINARY_NAME, 0);
     897      parser.AddPositionalArgument(distribution, 0);
     898      parser.AddArgument(ParsedBool(sparse), WSL_MANAGE_ARG_SET_SPARSE_OPTION_LONG, WSL_MANAGE_ARG_SET_SPARSE_OPTION);
     899      parser.AddArgument(AbsolutePath(move), WSL_MANAGE_ARG_MOVE_OPTION_LONG, WSL_MANAGE_ARG_MOVE_OPTION);
     900      parser.AddArgument(defaultUser, WSL_MANAGE_ARG_SET_DEFAULT_USER_OPTION_LONG);
     901      parser.AddArgument(SizeString(resize), WSL_MANAGE_ARG_RESIZE_OPTION_LONG, WSL_MANAGE_ARG_RESIZE_OPTION);
     902      parser.AddArgument(allowUnsafe, WSL_MANAGE_ARG_ALLOW_UNSAFE);
     903      parser.Parse();
     904  
     905      THROW_HR_IF(WSL_E_INVALID_USAGE, distribution == nullptr);
     906  
     907      wsl::windows::common::SvcComm service;
     908      auto distroGuid = service.GetDistributionId(distribution);
     909  
     910      if (sparse.has_value() + move.has_value() + defaultUser.has_value() + resize.has_value() != 1)
     911      {
     912          THROW_HR(WSL_E_INVALID_USAGE);
     913      }
     914  
     915      if (sparse)
     916      {
     917          SetSparse(distroGuid, sparse.value(), allowUnsafe);
     918      }
     919      else if (move)
     920      {
     921          service.MoveDistribution(distroGuid, move->c_str());
     922      }
     923      else if (defaultUser)
     924      {
     925          auto wslExe = wil::GetModuleFileNameW<std::wstring>(wil::GetModuleInstanceHandle());
     926  
     927          auto commandLine = std::format(
     928              L"\"{}\" {} -u root /usr/bin/id -u -- '{}'",
     929              wslExe,
     930              wsl::shared::string::GuidToString<wchar_t>(distroGuid),
     931              defaultUser.value());
     932  
     933          wsl::windows::common::SubProcess process{wslExe.c_str(), commandLine.c_str()};
     934  
     935          auto result = process.RunAndCaptureOutput(INFINITE, GetStdHandle(STD_ERROR_HANDLE));
     936          if (result.ExitCode != 0)
     937          {
     938              return result.ExitCode;
     939          }
     940  
     941          while (!result.Stdout.empty() && (result.Stdout.back() == '\r' || result.Stdout.back() == '\n'))
     942          {
     943              result.Stdout.pop_back();
     944          }
     945  
     946          wchar_t* endPtr{};
     947          auto newUid = std::wcstoul(result.Stdout.c_str(), &endPtr, 10);
     948  
     949          THROW_HR_IF(HRESULT_FROM_WIN32(ERROR_INVALID_DATA), endPtr != result.Stdout.c_str() + result.Stdout.size());
     950  
     951          service.ConfigureDistribution(&distroGuid, newUid, LXSS_DISTRO_FLAGS_UNCHANGED);
     952      }
     953      else if (resize)
     954      {
     955          THROW_IF_FAILED(service.ResizeDistribution(&distroGuid, resize.value()));
     956      }
     957  
     958      wsl::windows::common::wslutil::PrintSystemError(ERROR_SUCCESS);
     959      return 0;
     960  }
     961  
     962  int Mount(_In_ std::wstring_view commandLine)
     963  {
     964      bool vhd = false;
     965      bool bare = false;
     966      std::optional<std::wstring> options;
     967      ULONG partition = 0;
     968      std::optional<std::wstring> type;
     969      std::optional<std::wstring> name;
     970      std::wstring disk;
     971  
     972      ArgumentParser parser(std::wstring{commandLine}, WSL_BINARY_NAME);
     973      parser.AddArgument(bare, WSL_MOUNT_ARG_BARE_OPTION_LONG);
     974      parser.AddArgument(vhd, WSL_MOUNT_ARG_VHD_OPTION_LONG);
     975      parser.AddArgument(options, WSL_MOUNT_ARG_OPTIONS_OPTION_LONG, WSL_MOUNT_ARG_OPTIONS_OPTION);
     976      parser.AddArgument(Integer(partition), WSL_MOUNT_ARG_PARTITION_OPTION_LONG, WSL_MOUNT_ARG_PARTITION_OPTION);
     977      parser.AddArgument(type, WSL_MOUNT_ARG_TYPE_OPTION_LONG, WSL_MOUNT_ARG_TYPE_OPTION);
     978      parser.AddArgument(name, WSL_MOUNT_ARG_NAME_OPTION_LONG, WSL_MOUNT_ARG_NAME_OPTION);
     979      parser.AddPositionalArgument(UnquotedPath(disk), 0);
     980      parser.Parse();
     981  
     982      THROW_HR_IF(WSL_E_INVALID_USAGE, disk.empty());
     983  
     984      ULONG flags = 0;
     985      if (vhd)
     986      {
     987          WI_SetFlag(flags, LXSS_ATTACH_MOUNT_FLAGS_VHD);
     988          disk = wsl::windows::common::filesystem::GetFullPath(disk.c_str()).wstring();
     989      }
     990      else
     991      {
     992          WI_SetFlag(flags, LXSS_ATTACH_MOUNT_FLAGS_PASS_THROUGH);
     993      }
     994  
     995      // First attach the disk to the vm
     996      wsl::windows::common::SvcComm service;
     997      const auto result = service.AttachDisk(disk.c_str(), flags);
     998      if (FAILED(result))
     999      {
    1000          THROW_HR_IF(result, bare);
    1001  
    1002          // In the case of a non-bare mount, WSL_E_DISK_ALREADY_ATTACHED and LXSS_E_USER_VHD_ALREADY_ATTACHED are
    1003          // ok to ignore because the user can mount more than one partition on the same disk
    1004          // (so that disk might be already attached).
    1005          THROW_HR_IF(result, result != WSL_E_DISK_ALREADY_ATTACHED && result != WSL_E_USER_VHD_ALREADY_ATTACHED);
    1006      }
    1007  
    1008      // Perform the mount
    1009      if (!bare)
    1010      {
    1011          const auto mountResult = service.MountDisk(
    1012              disk.c_str(),
    1013              flags,
    1014              partition,
    1015              name.has_value() ? name->c_str() : nullptr,
    1016              type.has_value() ? type->c_str() : nullptr,
    1017              options.has_value() ? options->c_str() : nullptr);
    1018  
    1019          if (mountResult.Result != 0)
    1020          {
    1021              wsl::windows::common::wslutil::PrintMessage(
    1022                  Localization::MessageDiskMountFailed(strerror(-mountResult.Result), WSL_UNMOUNT_ARG, disk), stdout);
    1023              return 1;
    1024          }
    1025          else
    1026          {
    1027              wsl::windows::common::wslutil::PrintMessage(
    1028                  Localization::MessageDiskMounted(mountResult.MountName.get(), WSL_UNMOUNT_ARG, disk), stdout);
    1029          }
    1030      }
    1031      else
    1032      {
    1033          wsl::windows::common::wslutil::PrintSystemError(ERROR_SUCCESS);
    1034      }
    1035  
    1036      return 0;
    1037  }
    1038  
    1039  LaunchProcessOptions ParseLegacyArguments(_Inout_ std::wstring_view& commandLine)
    1040  {
    1041      // Strip the executable name. Because this has to be a legal file name, quoted parts cannot contain escaped quotes.
    1042      BOOLEAN inQuotes = FALSE;
    1043      while ((!commandLine.empty()) && ((inQuotes != FALSE) || (!LXSS_IS_WHITESPACE(commandLine[0]))))
    1044      {
    1045          if (commandLine[0] == L'"')
    1046          {
    1047              inQuotes = !inQuotes;
    1048          }
    1049  
    1050          commandLine = commandLine.substr(1);
    1051      }
    1052  
    1053      // Strip any leading whitespace.
    1054      commandLine = wsl::windows::common::string::StripLeadingWhitespace(commandLine);
    1055  
    1056      // Check for a distribution GUID as the first parameter and strip it out if present.
    1057      auto argument = wsl::windows::common::helpers::ParseArgument(commandLine);
    1058      auto distroGuid = wsl::shared::string::ToGuid(argument);
    1059      if (distroGuid.has_value())
    1060      {
    1061          commandLine = wsl::windows::common::helpers::ConsumeArgument(commandLine, argument);
    1062      }
    1063  
    1064      // Check for the home directory parameter and strip it out if present.
    1065      std::wstring currentWorkingDirectory;
    1066      argument = wsl::windows::common::helpers::ParseArgument(commandLine);
    1067      if (argument == WSL_CWD_HOME)
    1068      {
    1069          currentWorkingDirectory = WSL_CWD_HOME;
    1070          commandLine = wsl::windows::common::helpers::ConsumeArgument(commandLine, argument);
    1071      }
    1072  
    1073      return {std::move(currentWorkingDirectory), std::move(distroGuid)};
    1074  }
    1075  
    1076  DWORD
    1077  ParseVersionString(_In_ const std::wstring_view& versionString)
    1078  {
    1079      DWORD version;
    1080      const auto result = wil::ResultFromException([&]() { version = std::stoi(std::wstring(versionString)); });
    1081      THROW_HR_IF(HRESULT_FROM_WIN32(ERROR_VERSION_PARSE_ERROR), (FAILED(result) || ((version != LXSS_WSL_VERSION_1) && (version != LXSS_WSL_VERSION_2))));
    1082  
    1083      return version;
    1084  }
    1085  
    1086  int SetDefaultDistribution(_In_ LPCWSTR distributionName)
    1087  {
    1088      wsl::windows::common::SvcComm service;
    1089      const GUID distroGuid = service.GetDistributionId(distributionName);
    1090      service.SetDefaultDistribution(&distroGuid);
    1091      wsl::windows::common::wslutil::PrintSystemError(ERROR_SUCCESS);
    1092      return 0;
    1093  }
    1094  
    1095  int SetDefaultVersion(_In_ std::wstring_view commandLine)
    1096  {
    1097      const auto argument = wsl::windows::common::helpers::ParseArgument(commandLine);
    1098      const auto version = ParseVersionString(argument);
    1099      if (version == LXSS_WSL_VERSION_1)
    1100      {
    1101          THROW_HR_IF(WSL_E_WSL1_NOT_SUPPORTED, !wsl::windows::common::helpers::IsWslOptionalComponentPresent());
    1102      }
    1103      else
    1104      {
    1105          WI_ASSERT(version == LXSS_WSL_VERSION_2);
    1106  
    1107          wsl::windows::common::wslutil::PrintMessage(wsl::shared::Localization::MessageVmModeConversionInfo());
    1108      }
    1109  
    1110      const wil::unique_hkey lxssKey = wsl::windows::common::registry::OpenLxssUserKey();
    1111      wsl::windows::common::registry::WriteDword(lxssKey.get(), nullptr, LXSS_WSL_DEFAULT_VERSION, version);
    1112      wsl::windows::common::wslutil::PrintSystemError(ERROR_SUCCESS);
    1113      return 0;
    1114  }
    1115  
    1116  int Shutdown(_In_ std::wstring_view commandLine)
    1117  {
    1118      bool force = false;
    1119      ArgumentParser parser(std::wstring{commandLine}, WSL_BINARY_NAME);
    1120      parser.AddArgument(force, WSL_SHUTDOWN_OPTION_FORCE);
    1121  
    1122      parser.Parse();
    1123  
    1124      wsl::windows::common::SvcComm service;
    1125      service.Shutdown(force);
    1126  
    1127      return 0;
    1128  }
    1129  
    1130  int SetSparse(GUID& distroGuid, bool sparse, bool allowUnsafe)
    1131  {
    1132      wsl::windows::common::SvcComm service;
    1133  
    1134      auto setProgress = wsl::windows::common::ConsoleProgressIndicator(wsl::shared::Localization::MessageConversionStart());
    1135      THROW_IF_FAILED(service.SetSparse(&distroGuid, sparse, allowUnsafe));
    1136  
    1137      return 0;
    1138  }
    1139  
    1140  int SetVersion(_In_ std::wstring_view commandLine)
    1141  {
    1142      auto argument = wsl::windows::common::helpers::ParseArgument(commandLine);
    1143      if (argument.empty())
    1144      {
    1145          wsl::windows::common::wslutil::PrintMessage(Localization::MessageRequiredParameterMissing(WSL_SET_VERSION_ARG), stdout);
    1146          return -1;
    1147      }
    1148  
    1149      const std::wstring distributionName(argument);
    1150      wsl::windows::common::SvcComm service;
    1151      const auto distroGuid = service.GetDistributionId(distributionName.c_str());
    1152  
    1153      commandLine = wsl::windows::common::helpers::ConsumeArgument(commandLine, argument);
    1154      argument = wsl::windows::common::helpers::ParseArgument(commandLine);
    1155      const auto version = ParseVersionString(argument);
    1156      if (version == LXSS_WSL_VERSION_2)
    1157      {
    1158          wsl::windows::common::wslutil::PrintMessage(wsl::shared::Localization::MessageVmModeConversionInfo());
    1159      }
    1160  
    1161      auto progress = wsl::windows::common::ConsoleProgressIndicator(wsl::shared::Localization::MessageConversionStart(), true);
    1162      const auto result = service.SetVersion(&distroGuid, version);
    1163      progress.End();
    1164      THROW_IF_FAILED(result);
    1165  
    1166      wsl::windows::common::wslutil::PrintSystemError(ERROR_SUCCESS);
    1167      return 0;
    1168  }
    1169  
    1170  int Status()
    1171  {
    1172      // Print the default distro.
    1173      wsl::windows::common::SvcComm service;
    1174      const auto distros = service.EnumerateDistributions();
    1175      for (const auto& entry : distros)
    1176      {
    1177          if (WI_IsFlagSet(entry.Flags, LXSS_ENUMERATE_FLAGS_DEFAULT))
    1178          {
    1179              wsl::windows::common::wslutil::PrintMessage(Localization::MessageStatusDefaultDistro(entry.DistroName), stdout);
    1180              break;
    1181          }
    1182      }
    1183  
    1184      // Print the default version.
    1185      const DWORD version = wsl::windows::common::wslutil::GetDefaultVersion();
    1186      wsl::windows::common::wslutil::PrintMessage(Localization::MessageStatusDefaultVersion(version), stdout);
    1187  
    1188      // Print a message if the WSL optional component is not present for WSL1 support.
    1189      if (!wsl::windows::common::helpers::IsWslOptionalComponentPresent())
    1190      {
    1191          wsl::windows::common::wslutil::PrintMessage(wsl::shared::Localization::MessageWsl1NotSupported());
    1192      }
    1193  
    1194      // Print a message if the vmcompute service is present for WSL2 support.
    1195      if (!wsl::windows::common::helpers::IsServicePresent(L"vmcompute"))
    1196      {
    1197          wsl::windows::common::wslutil::PrintMessage(wsl::shared::Localization::MessageEnableVirtualization());
    1198      }
    1199  
    1200      return 0;
    1201  }
    1202  
    1203  int TerminateDistribution(_In_ LPCWSTR distributionName)
    1204  {
    1205      wsl::windows::common::SvcComm service;
    1206      const GUID distroGuid = service.GetDistributionId(distributionName);
    1207      service.TerminateInstance(&distroGuid);
    1208      wsl::windows::common::wslutil::PrintSystemError(ERROR_SUCCESS);
    1209      return 0;
    1210  }
    1211  
    1212  int Unmount(_In_ const std::wstring& arg)
    1213  {
    1214      const auto* disk = arg.empty() ? nullptr : arg.c_str();
    1215  
    1216      std::pair<int, int> value;
    1217      wsl::windows::common::SvcComm service;
    1218      const HRESULT result = wil::ResultFromException([&] { value = service.DetachDisk(disk); });
    1219  
    1220      // support relative paths in unmount
    1221      // check is the result is the error code for "file not found" and the path is relative
    1222      if (result == HRESULT_FROM_WIN32(ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND) && PathIsRelative(disk))
    1223      {
    1224          // retry dismounting with the absolute path
    1225          const auto absoluteDisk = wsl::windows::common::filesystem::GetFullPath(filesystem::UnquotePath(disk).c_str());
    1226          value = service.DetachDisk(absoluteDisk.c_str());
    1227      }
    1228      else if (FAILED(result))
    1229      {
    1230          THROW_HR(result);
    1231      }
    1232  
    1233      if (value.first != 0)
    1234      {
    1235          wsl::windows::common::wslutil::PrintMessage(Localization::MessageDetachFailed(strerror(-value.first), WSL_SHUTDOWN_ARG), stdout);
    1236          return -1;
    1237      }
    1238  
    1239      wsl::windows::common::wslutil::PrintSystemError(ERROR_SUCCESS);
    1240      return 0;
    1241  }
    1242  
    1243  int UnregisterDistribution(_In_ LPCWSTR distributionName)
    1244  {
    1245      auto progress = wsl::windows::common::ConsoleProgressIndicator(wsl::shared::Localization::MessageStatusUnregistering(), true);
    1246      wsl::windows::common::SvcComm service;
    1247      const GUID distroGuid = service.GetDistributionId(distributionName, LXSS_GET_DISTRO_ID_LIST_ALL);
    1248      service.UnregisterDistribution(&distroGuid);
    1249      progress.End();
    1250      wsl::windows::common::wslutil::PrintSystemError(ERROR_SUCCESS);
    1251      return 0;
    1252  }
    1253  
    1254  int UpdatePackage(std::wstring_view commandLine)
    1255  {
    1256      ExecutionContext context(wsl::windows::common::UpdatePackage);
    1257  
    1258      bool preRelease{};
    1259      ArgumentParser parser(std::wstring{commandLine}, WSL_BINARY_NAME);
    1260      parser.AddArgument(preRelease, WSL_UPDATE_ARG_PRE_RELEASE_OPTION_LONG);
    1261  
    1262      // Options kept for compatibility with inbox WSL.
    1263      parser.AddArgument(NoOp(), WSL_UPDATE_ARG_WEB_DOWNLOAD_OPTION_LONG);
    1264      parser.AddArgument(NoOp(), WSL_UPDATE_ARG_CONFIRM_OPTION_LONG);
    1265      parser.AddArgument(NoOp(), WSL_UPDATE_ARG_PROMPT_OPTION_LONG);
    1266      parser.Parse();
    1267  
    1268      return wsl::windows::common::wslutil::UpdatePackage(preRelease, false);
    1269  }
    1270  
    1271  int Uninstall()
    1272  {
    1273      auto logFile = std::filesystem::temp_directory_path() / L"wsl-uninstall-logs.txt";
    1274      auto clearLogs =
    1275          wil::scope_exit_log(WI_DIAGNOSTICS_INFO, [&logFile]() { LOG_IF_WIN32_BOOL_FALSE(DeleteFile(logFile.c_str())); });
    1276  
    1277      const auto exitCode = wsl::windows::common::wslutil::UninstallViaMsi(logFile.c_str(), &wsl::windows::common::wslutil::MsiMessageCallback);
    1278  
    1279      if (exitCode != 0)
    1280      {
    1281          clearLogs.release();
    1282          THROW_HR_WITH_USER_ERROR(
    1283              HRESULT_FROM_WIN32(exitCode),
    1284              wsl::shared::Localization::MessageUninstallFailed(exitCode) + L"\r\n" +
    1285                  wsl::shared::Localization::MessageSeeLogFile(logFile.c_str()));
    1286      }
    1287  
    1288      return exitCode;
    1289  }
    1290  
    1291  int Version()
    1292  {
    1293      // Query the Windows version.
    1294      const auto windowsVersion = wsl::windows::common::helpers::GetWindowsVersionString();
    1295      wsl::windows::common::wslutil::PrintMessage(
    1296          Localization::MessagePackageVersions(
    1297              WSL_PACKAGE_VERSION, KERNEL_VERSION, WSLG_VERSION, MSRDC_VERSION, DIRECT3D_VERSION, DXCORE_VERSION, windowsVersion),
    1298          stdout);
    1299  
    1300      if constexpr (!wsl::shared::OfficialBuild)
    1301      {
    1302          // Print additional information if running a debug build.
    1303          wsl::windows::common::wslutil::PrintMessage(Localization::MessageBuildInfo(_MSC_VER, COMMIT_HASH, __TIME__ " " __DATE__), stdout);
    1304      }
    1305  
    1306      return 0;
    1307  }
    1308  
    1309  int WslconfigMain(_In_ int argc, _In_reads_(argc) LPWSTR* argv)
    1310  {
    1311      // Call the MSI package if we're in an MSIX context
    1312      if (wsl::windows::common::wslutil::IsRunningInMsix())
    1313      {
    1314          return wsl::windows::common::wslutil::CallMsiPackage();
    1315      }
    1316  
    1317      using wsl::shared::string::IsEqual;
    1318  
    1319      // Use exit code -1 on generic failures. This was the original exit code and shouldn't be changed, especially since wslconfig.exe is deprecated.
    1320      int exitCode = -1;
    1321      if ((argc >= 2) && ((IsEqual(argv[1], WSLCONFIG_COMMAND_LIST, true)) || (IsEqual(argv[1], WSLCONFIG_COMMAND_LIST_SHORT, true))))
    1322      {
    1323          ListOptions options{};
    1324          for (int index = 2; index < argc; index += 1)
    1325          {
    1326              std::wstring_view argument = argv[index];
    1327              if (argument.empty())
    1328              {
    1329                  break;
    1330              }
    1331              if (IsEqual(argument, WSLCONFIG_COMMAND_LIST_ALL, true))
    1332              {
    1333                  options.all = true;
    1334              }
    1335              else if (IsEqual(argument, WSLCONFIG_COMMAND_LIST_RUNNING, true))
    1336              {
    1337                  options.running = true;
    1338              }
    1339              else
    1340              {
    1341                  THROW_HR(WSL_E_INVALID_USAGE);
    1342              }
    1343          }
    1344  
    1345          exitCode = ListDistributionsHelper(options);
    1346      }
    1347      else if ((argc >= 3) && ((IsEqual(argv[1], WSLCONFIG_COMMAND_SET_DEFAULT, true)) || (IsEqual(argv[1], WSLCONFIG_COMMAND_SET_DEFAULT_SHORT, true))))
    1348      {
    1349          exitCode = SetDefaultDistribution(argv[2]);
    1350      }
    1351      else if ((argc >= 3) && ((IsEqual(argv[1], WSLCONFIG_COMMAND_TERMINATE, true)) || (IsEqual(argv[1], WSLCONFIG_COMMAND_TERMINATE_SHORT, true))))
    1352      {
    1353          exitCode = TerminateDistribution(argv[2]);
    1354      }
    1355      else if ((argc >= 3) && ((IsEqual(argv[1], WSLCONFIG_COMMAND_UNREGISTER_DISTRIBUTION, true)) || (IsEqual(argv[1], WSLCONFIG_COMMAND_UNREGISTER_DISTRIBUTION_SHORT, true))))
    1356      {
    1357          exitCode = UnregisterDistribution(argv[2]);
    1358      }
    1359      else
    1360      {
    1361          THROW_HR(WSL_E_INVALID_USAGE);
    1362      }
    1363  
    1364      return exitCode;
    1365  }
    1366  
    1367  int WslgMain(_In_ std::wstring_view commandLine)
    1368  {
    1369      // N.B. There is no app execution alias for wslg, so it cannot run in an MSIX context.
    1370      WI_ASSERT(!wsl::windows::common::wslutil::IsRunningInMsix());
    1371  
    1372      auto options = ParseLegacyArguments(commandLine);
    1373  
    1374      // Parse additional arguments.
    1375      std::wstring_view argument;
    1376      ShellExecOptions shellExecOptions{};
    1377      wsl::windows::common::SvcComm service;
    1378      for (;;)
    1379      {
    1380          argument = wsl::windows::common::helpers::ParseArgument(commandLine);
    1381          if (argument.empty())
    1382          {
    1383              break;
    1384          }
    1385  
    1386          if ((argument == WSL_DISTRO_ARG) || (argument == WSL_DISTRO_ARG_LONG))
    1387          {
    1388              THROW_HR_IF(WSL_E_INVALID_USAGE, options.DistroGuid.has_value());
    1389  
    1390              commandLine = wsl::windows::common::helpers::ConsumeArgument(commandLine, argument);
    1391              argument = wsl::windows::common::helpers::ParseArgument(commandLine);
    1392              THROW_HR_IF(WSL_E_INVALID_USAGE, argument.empty());
    1393  
    1394              // Query the service for the distribution id.
    1395              options.DistroGuid = service.GetDistributionId(std::wstring(argument).c_str());
    1396          }
    1397          else if (argument == WSL_SHELL_OPTION_ARG)
    1398          {
    1399              commandLine = wsl::windows::common::helpers::ConsumeArgument(commandLine, argument);
    1400              argument = wsl::windows::common::helpers::ParseArgument(commandLine);
    1401              THROW_HR_IF(E_INVALIDARG, argument.empty());
    1402  
    1403              shellExecOptions.ParseShellOptionArg(argument);
    1404          }
    1405          else if ((argument == WSL_USER_ARG) || (argument == WSL_USER_ARG_LONG))
    1406          {
    1407              commandLine = wsl::windows::common::helpers::ConsumeArgument(commandLine, argument);
    1408              argument = wsl::windows::common::helpers::ParseArgument(commandLine);
    1409              THROW_HR_IF(WSL_E_INVALID_USAGE, argument.empty());
    1410  
    1411              options.Username = argument;
    1412          }
    1413          else if (argument == WSL_CHANGE_DIRECTORY_ARG)
    1414          {
    1415              commandLine = wsl::windows::common::helpers::ConsumeArgument(commandLine, argument);
    1416              argument = wsl::windows::common::helpers::ParseArgument(commandLine, true);
    1417              ChangeDirectory(argument, options);
    1418          }
    1419          else if (argument == WSL_STOP_PARSING_ARG)
    1420          {
    1421              commandLine = wsl::windows::common::helpers::ConsumeArgument(commandLine, argument);
    1422              break;
    1423          }
    1424          else
    1425          {
    1426              THROW_HR_IF(WSL_E_INVALID_USAGE, ((argument.size() > 0) && (argument[0] == L'-')));
    1427  
    1428              break;
    1429          }
    1430  
    1431          commandLine = wsl::windows::common::helpers::ConsumeArgument(commandLine, argument);
    1432      }
    1433  
    1434      // Launching a graphical application requires a non-empty command line.
    1435      THROW_HR_IF(WSL_E_INVALID_USAGE, commandLine.empty());
    1436  
    1437      std::vector<const wchar_t*> arguments;
    1438      const std::wstring commandLineString{commandLine};
    1439      wil::unique_hlocal_ptr<LPWSTR[]> execArguments{};
    1440      LPCWSTR filename{};
    1441      if (!shellExecOptions.IsUseShell())
    1442      {
    1443          int argc;
    1444          execArguments.reset(CommandLineToArgvW(commandLineString.c_str(), &argc));
    1445          THROW_HR_IF(E_INVALIDARG, (!execArguments || (argc == 0)));
    1446  
    1447          arguments.reserve(argc);
    1448          arguments.insert(arguments.begin(), &execArguments.get()[0], &execArguments.get()[argc]);
    1449          filename = arguments[0];
    1450      }
    1451      else
    1452      {
    1453          arguments.push_back(commandLineString.c_str());
    1454      }
    1455  
    1456      // Graphical applications by default will use a login shell so that users can modify behavior.
    1457      shellExecOptions.DefaultUseShell = true;
    1458      shellExecOptions.DefaultLogin = shellExecOptions.IsUseShell();
    1459      if (shellExecOptions.IsLogin())
    1460      {
    1461          // Launch via the user's default shell in login mode to parse files like /etc/profile.
    1462          WI_SetFlag(options.LaunchFlags, LXSS_LAUNCH_FLAG_SHELL_LOGIN);
    1463      }
    1464  
    1465      return LaunchProcess(filename, gsl::narrow_cast<int>(arguments.size()), arguments.data(), options);
    1466  }
    1467  
    1468  int RunDebugShell()
    1469  {
    1470      ExecutionContext context(Context::DebugShell);
    1471  
    1472      auto token = wil::open_current_access_token();
    1473      auto tokenInfo = wil::get_token_information<TOKEN_USER>(token.get());
    1474      auto pipePath = wsl::windows::common::wslutil::GetDebugShellPipeName(tokenInfo->User.Sid);
    1475      wil::unique_hfile pipe{CreateFileW(pipePath.c_str(), GENERIC_READ | GENERIC_WRITE, 0, nullptr, OPEN_EXISTING, FILE_FLAG_OVERLAPPED, nullptr)};
    1476  
    1477      if (!pipe)
    1478      {
    1479          auto error = GetLastError();
    1480          if (error == ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED && !wsl::windows::common::security::IsTokenElevated(token.get()))
    1481          {
    1482              wsl::windows::common::wslutil::PrintMessage(wsl::shared::Localization::MessageAdministratorAccessRequiredForDebugShell());
    1483              return 1;
    1484          }
    1485          else if (
    1486              error == ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND &&
    1487              !wsl::windows::policies::IsFeatureAllowed(wsl::windows::policies::OpenPoliciesKey().get(), wsl::windows::policies::c_allowDebugShellUserSetting))
    1488          {
    1489              wsl::windows::common::wslutil::PrintMessage(wsl::shared::Localization::MessageDebugShellDisabled());
    1490              return 1;
    1491          }
    1492          else
    1493          {
    1494              THROW_WIN32(error);
    1495          }
    1496      }
    1497  
    1498      // agetty waits for a LF before printing the prompt, so write it immediately after the pipe is opened.
    1499      // This is needed because without the '-w' flag, agetty doesn't wait and prints the shell prompt before
    1500      // a pipe is connected, so it's lost.
    1501      THROW_IF_WIN32_BOOL_FALSE(WriteFile(pipe.get(), "\n", 1, nullptr, nullptr));
    1502  
    1503      // Create a thread to relay stdin to the pipe.
    1504      wsl::windows::common::ConsoleState Io;
    1505      auto exitEvent = wil::unique_event(wil::EventOptions::ManualReset);
    1506      std::thread inputThread(
    1507          [&]() { wsl::windows::common::RelayStandardInput(GetStdHandle(STD_INPUT_HANDLE), pipe.get(), {}, exitEvent.get(), &Io); });
    1508  
    1509      auto joinThread = wil::scope_exit_log(WI_DIAGNOSTICS_INFO, [&]() {
    1510          exitEvent.SetEvent();
    1511          inputThread.join();
    1512      });
    1513  
    1514      // Relay the contents of the pipe to stdout.
    1515      wsl::windows::common::relay::InterruptableRelay(pipe.get(), GetStdHandle(STD_OUTPUT_HANDLE));
    1516  
    1517      // Print a message that the VM has exited and signal the input thread to exit.
    1518      fputws(L"\n", stdout);
    1519      THROW_HR(HCS_E_CONNECTION_CLOSED);
    1520  }
    1521  
    1522  int WslMain(_In_ std::wstring_view commandLine)
    1523  {
    1524      // Call the MSI package if we're in an MSIX context
