     214  std::pair<bool, std::vector<std::wstring>> WslInstall::CheckForMissingOptionalComponents(_In_ bool requireWslOptionalComponent)
     215  {
     216      // Include the WSL optional component if it was requested, or if the OS is not Windows 11 or later.
     217      std::vector<std::wstring> missingComponents;
     218      requireWslOptionalComponent |= !wsl::windows::common::helpers::IsWindows11OrAbove();
     219      if (requireWslOptionalComponent && !wsl::windows::common::helpers::IsServicePresent(L"lxssmanager"))
     220      {
     221          missingComponents.emplace_back(c_optionalFeatureNameWsl);
     222      }
     223  
     224      if (!wsl::windows::common::wslutil::IsVirtualMachinePlatformInstalled())
     225      {
     226          missingComponents.emplace_back(c_optionalFeatureNameVmp);
     227      }
     228  
     229      // If any required components are not present, a reboot is required.
     230      bool rebootRequired = !missingComponents.empty();
     231  
     232      // Query the list of optional components that have already been installed.
     233      const auto installedComponents = GetInstalledOptionalComponents();
     234      for (const auto& component : installedComponents)
     235      {
     236          std::erase(missingComponents, component);
     237      }
     238  
     239      return {rebootRequired, std::move(missingComponents)};
     240  }
     241  
     242  void WslInstall::InstallOptionalComponents(const std::vector<std::wstring>& components)
     243  {
     244      std::wstring systemDirectory;
     245      THROW_IF_FAILED(wil::GetSystemDirectoryW(systemDirectory));
     246  
     247      const auto dismPath = std::filesystem::path(std::move(systemDirectory)) / L"dism.exe";
     248      for (const auto& component : components)
     249      {
     250          wsl::windows::common::wslutil::PrintMessage(Localization::MessageInstallingWindowsComponent(component));
     251  
     252          auto commandLine = std::format(L"{} /Online /NoRestart /enable-feature /featurename:{}", dismPath.wstring(), component);
     253          const auto exitCode = wsl::windows::common::helpers::RunProcess(commandLine);
     254          if (exitCode != 0 && exitCode != ERROR_SUCCESS_REBOOT_REQUIRED)
     255          {
     256              THROW_HR_WITH_USER_ERROR(WSL_E_INSTALL_COMPONENT_FAILED, Localization::MessageOptionalComponentInstallFailed(component, exitCode));
     257          }
     258      }
     259  
     260      // Update the list of optional components that have been installed.
     261      auto installedComponents = GetInstalledOptionalComponents();
     262      installedComponents.insert(installedComponents.end(), components.begin(), components.end());
     263      const auto lxssKey = wsl::windows::common::registry::OpenLxssUserKey();
     264      const auto key =
     265          wsl::windows::common::registry::CreateKey(lxssKey.get(), c_optionalFeatureInstallStatus, KEY_ALL_ACCESS, nullptr, REG_OPTION_VOLATILE);
     266      wsl::windows::common::registry::WriteString(key.get(), nullptr, nullptr, wsl::shared::string::Join(installedComponents, L',').c_str());
     267  }
     268  
     269  std::pair<std::wstring, GUID> WslInstall::InstallModernDistribution(
     270      const ModernDistributionVersion& distribution,
     271      const std::optional<ULONG>& version,
     272      const std::optional<std::wstring>& name,
     273      const std::optional<std::wstring>& location,
     274      const std::optional<uint64_t>& vhdSize,
     275      const bool fixedVhd)
     276  {
     277      wsl::windows::common::SvcComm service;
     278  
     279      // Fail early if the distributions name is already in use.
     280      auto result = wil::ResultFromException([&]() {
     281          service.GetDistributionId(name.has_value() ? name->c_str() : distribution.Name.c_str(), LXSS_GET_DISTRO_ID_LIST_ALL);
     282      });
     283  
     284      THROW_HR_IF(HRESULT_FROM_WIN32(ERROR_ALREADY_EXISTS), SUCCEEDED(result));
     285      LOG_HR_IF(result, result != WSL_E_DISTRO_NOT_FOUND);
     286  
     287      const auto downloadInfo = wsl::shared::Arm64 ? distribution.Arm64Url : distribution.Amd64Url;
     288      THROW_HR_IF(E_UNEXPECTED, !downloadInfo.has_value());
     289  
     290      std::wstring installPath;
     291      bool fileDownloaded{};
     292      auto deleteFile = wil::scope_exit_log(WI_DIAGNOSTICS_INFO, [&] {
     293          if (fileDownloaded)
     294          {
     295              THROW_IF_WIN32_BOOL_FALSE(DeleteFileW(installPath.c_str()));
     296          }
     297      });
     298  
     299      if (auto localFile = wsl::windows::common::filesystem::TryGetPathFromFileUrl(downloadInfo->Url))
     300      {
     301          installPath = std::move(localFile.value());
     302      }
     303      else
     304      {
     305          PrintMessage(Localization::MessageDownloading(distribution.FriendlyName.c_str()), stdout);
     306          installPath = DownloadFile(downloadInfo->Url, distribution.Name + L".wsl");
     307          fileDownloaded = true;
     308      }
     309  
     310      PrintMessage(Localization::MessageInstalling(distribution.FriendlyName.c_str()), stdout);
     311  
     312      wil::unique_handle file{CreateFile(installPath.c_str(), GENERIC_READ, FILE_SHARE_READ, nullptr, OPEN_EXISTING, 0, nullptr)};
     313      THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(!file);
     314  
     315      EnforceFileHash(file.get(), downloadInfo->Sha256);
     316  
     317      wsl::windows::common::HandleConsoleProgressBar progressBar(file.get(), Localization::MessageImportProgress());
     318  
     319      auto [id, installedName] = service.RegisterDistribution(
     320          name.has_value() ? name->c_str() : distribution.Name.c_str(),
     321          version.value_or(LXSS_WSL_VERSION_DEFAULT),
     322          file.get(),
     323          location.has_value() ? location->c_str() : nullptr,
     324          fixedVhd ? LXSS_IMPORT_DISTRO_FLAGS_FIXED_VHD : 0,
     325          vhdSize);
     326  
     327      return {installedName.get(), id};
     328  }

      39  DistributionRegistration DistributionRegistration::Open(HKEY LxssKey, const GUID& Id)
      40  {
      41      ExecutionContext context(Context::ReadDistroConfig);
      42  
      43      const auto distroGuidString = wsl::shared::string::GuidToString<wchar_t>(Id);
      44  
      45      wil::unique_hkey distroKey;
      46      try
      47      {
      48          distroKey = wsl::windows::common::registry::OpenKey(LxssKey, distroGuidString.c_str(), (KEY_READ | KEY_WRITE));
      49      }
      50      catch (...)
      51      {
      52          THROW_HR_IF(WSL_E_DISTRO_NOT_FOUND, wil::ResultFromCaughtException() == HRESULT_FROM_WIN32(ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND));
      53          throw;
      54      }
      55  
      56      return DistributionRegistration(Id, std::move(distroKey));
      57  }
      58  
      59  DistributionRegistration DistributionRegistration::Create(
      60      HKEY LxssKey, const std::optional<GUID>& Id, LPCWSTR Name, ULONG Version, LPCWSTR BasePath, ULONG Flags, ULONG DefaultUID, LPCWSTR PackageFamilyName, LPCWSTR VhdFileName, bool EnableOobe)
      61  {
      62      std::wstring distroGuidString;
      63      GUID distroId{};
      64      wil::unique_hkey distroKey{};
      65      if (Id.has_value())
      66      {
      67          distroId = Id.value();
      68          distroGuidString = wsl::shared::string::GuidToString<wchar_t>(distroId);
      69          distroKey = wsl::windows::common::registry::CreateKey(LxssKey, distroGuidString.c_str(), (KEY_READ | KEY_WRITE));
      70      }
      71      else
      72      {
      73          DWORD disposition = 0;
      74          do
      75          {
      76              THROW_IF_FAILED(CoCreateGuid(&distroId));
      77  
      78              distroGuidString = wsl::shared::string::GuidToString<wchar_t>(distroId);
      79              distroKey = wsl::windows::common::registry::CreateKey(LxssKey, distroGuidString.c_str(), (KEY_READ | KEY_WRITE), &disposition);
      80          } while (disposition != REG_CREATED_NEW_KEY);
      81      }
      82  
      83      WI_ASSERT(distroKey && !distroGuidString.empty());
      84  
      85      // Set up a scope exit member to delete the key if registration fails.
      86      auto cleanup = wil::scope_exit([&] { wsl::windows::common::registry::DeleteKey(LxssKey, distroGuidString.c_str()); });
      87  
      88      DistributionRegistration distribution(distroId, std::move(distroKey));
      89  
      90      distribution.Write(Property::State, LxssDistributionStateInstalling);
      91  
      92      if (Name != nullptr)
      93      {
      94          distribution.Write(Property::Name, Name);
      95      }
      96      distribution.Write(Property::Version, Version);
      97      distribution.Write(Property::BasePath, BasePath);
      98      distribution.Write(Property::Flags, Flags);
      99      distribution.Write(Property::Flags, Flags);
     100      distribution.Write(Property::DefaultUid, DefaultUID);
     101      distribution.Write(Property::RunOOBE, EnableOobe);
     102  
     103      if (ARGUMENT_PRESENT(PackageFamilyName))
     104      {
     105          WI_ASSERT(wcslen(PackageFamilyName) > 0);
     106  
     107          distribution.Write(Property::PackageFamilyName, PackageFamilyName);
     108      }
     109  
     110      if (ARGUMENT_PRESENT(VhdFileName))
     111      {
     112          distribution.Write(Property::VhdFileName, VhdFileName);
     113      }
     114  
     115      // Dismiss the scope exit member so the key is persisted.
     116      cleanup.release();
     117      return distribution;
     118  }
     119  
     120  std::optional<DistributionRegistration> DistributionRegistration::OpenDefault(HKEY LxssKey)
     121  {
     122      const auto defaultId = wsl::windows::common::registry::ReadOptionalString(LxssKey, nullptr, DefaultDistro);
     123      if (!defaultId.has_value())
     124      {
     125          return {};
     126      }
     127  
     128      const auto distroGuid = wsl::shared::string::ToGuid(defaultId.value());
     129      if (!distroGuid.has_value())
     130      {
     131          return {};
     132      }
     133  
     134      try
     135      {
     136          return Open(LxssKey, distroGuid.value());
     137      }
     138      catch (...)
     139      {
     140          // If we hit this block, it means that the default distribution value point to a distribution that doesn't exist.
     141          // Handle gracefully so this doesn't prevent the user from installing new distros.
     142  
     143          LOG_CAUGHT_EXCEPTION_MSG("Broken default distro. ID: %ls", defaultId->c_str());
     144          return {};
     145      }
     146  }

     148  DistributionRegistration DistributionRegistration::OpenOrDefault(HKEY LxssKey, const GUID* Id)
     149  {
     150      if (Id == nullptr)
     151      {
     152          auto defaultDistribution = OpenDefault(LxssKey);
     153          THROW_HR_IF(WSL_E_DEFAULT_DISTRO_NOT_FOUND, !defaultDistribution.has_value());
     154  
     155          return std::move(defaultDistribution.value());
     156      }
     157      else
     158      {
     159          return Open(LxssKey, *Id);
     160      }
     161  }

     232  DWORD
     233  DistributionRegistration::ApplyGlobalFlagsOverride(DWORD Flags)
     234  {
     235      WI_ASSERT(!WI_IsAnyFlagSet(Flags, ~LXSS_DISTRO_FLAGS_ALL));
     236  
     237      DWORD globalFlags =
     238          wsl::windows::common::registry::ReadDword(HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE, LXSS_SERVICE_REGISTRY_PATH, L"DistributionFlags", LXSS_DISTRO_FLAGS_ALL);
     239  
     240      // The VM Mode flag cannot be overridden by global flags.
     241      WI_SetFlag(globalFlags, LXSS_DISTRO_FLAGS_VM_MODE);
     242      Flags &= (globalFlags & LXSS_DISTRO_FLAGS_ALL);
     243      return Flags;
     244  }

     315  HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE LxssUserSession::ListDistributions(_Out_ ULONG* Count, _Out_ LPWSTR** Distributions)
     316  try
     317  {
     318  
     319      wil::unique_cotaskmem_array_ptr<LXSS_ENUMERATE_INFO> distributions;
     320      RETURN_IF_FAILED(EnumerateDistributions(distributions.size_address<ULONG>(), &distributions, nullptr));
     321  
     322      // Filter out distributions that are not in the installed or running state.
     323      std::vector<wil::unique_cotaskmem_string> installedDistros{};
     324      for (size_t index = 0; index < distributions.size(); index += 1)
     325      {
     326          if ((distributions[index].State == LxssDistributionStateInstalled) || (distributions[index].State == LxssDistributionStateRunning))
     327          {
     328              installedDistros.emplace_back(wil::make_unique_string<wil::unique_cotaskmem_string>(distributions[index].DistroName));
     329          }
     330      }
     331  
     332      auto userDistributions(wil::make_unique_cotaskmem<LPWSTR[]>(installedDistros.size()));
     333      for (size_t index = 0; index < installedDistros.size(); index += 1)
     334      {
     335          userDistributions.get()[index] = installedDistros[index].release();
     336      }
     337  
     338      *Count = gsl::narrow_cast<ULONG>(installedDistros.size());
     339      *Distributions = userDistributions.release();
     340      return S_OK;
     341  }
     342  CATCH_RETURN()

     558  LxssUserSessionImpl::LxssUserSessionImpl(_In_ PSID userSid, _In_ DWORD sessionId, _Inout_ wsl::windows::service::PluginManager& pluginManager) :
     559      m_sessionId(sessionId), m_pluginManager(pluginManager)
     560  {
     561      THROW_IF_WIN32_BOOL_FALSE(::CopySid(sizeof(m_userSid), &m_userSid.Sid, userSid));
     562  
     563      try
     564      {
     565          wil::unique_hkey lxssKey;
     566          wil::unique_handle userToken;
     567          {
     568              auto runAsUser = wil::CoImpersonateClient();
     569              userToken = wsl::windows::common::security::GetUserToken(TokenImpersonation);
     570              lxssKey = wsl::windows::common::registry::OpenLxssUserKey();
     571          }
     572  
     573          static std::atomic<DWORD> sessionCookie;
     574  
     575          m_session = {sessionCookie++, nullptr, &m_userSid.Sid};
     576  
     577          // Detect existing legacy installs and convert them to the new format.
     578          const DWORD state =
     579              wsl::windows::common::registry::ReadDword(lxssKey.get(), nullptr, LXSS_LEGACY_INSTALL_VALUE, LxssDistributionStateInvalid);
     580  
     581          if (state == LxssDistributionStateInstalled)
     582          {
     583              // Create a registration for legacy installs and delete legacy
     584              // installed state.
     585              std::lock_guard lock(m_instanceLock);
     586              _CreateLegacyRegistration(lxssKey.get(), userToken.get());
     587              wsl::windows::common::registry::DeleteKeyValue(lxssKey.get(), LXSS_LEGACY_INSTALL_VALUE);
     588          }
     589  
     590          // Create a threadpool timer to terminate a Linux utility VM that is idle.
     591          m_vmTerminationTimer.reset(CreateThreadpoolTimer(s_VmIdleTerminate, this, nullptr));
     592          THROW_IF_NULL_ALLOC(m_vmTerminationTimer);
     593  
     594          // Register for timezone update notifications.
     595  
     596          auto listenForTimeZoneChanges = [this] {
     597              try
     598              {
     599                  WNDCLASSEX windowClass{};
     600                  windowClass.cbSize = sizeof(windowClass);
     601                  windowClass.lpfnWndProc = s_TimezoneWindowProc;
     602                  windowClass.hInstance = nullptr;
     603                  windowClass.lpszClassName = L"wslservice-timezone-notifications";
     604                  THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(RegisterClassExW(&windowClass) == 0);
     605  
     606                  // Note: HWND_MESSAGE cannot be used here because such windows don't receive broadcast messages like WM_TIMECHANGE
     607                  const wil::unique_hwnd windowHandle{CreateWindowExW(
     608                      0,
     609                      windowClass.lpszClassName,
     610                      nullptr,
     611                      WS_OVERLAPPEDWINDOW,
     612                      CW_USEDEFAULT,
     613                      CW_USEDEFAULT,
     614                      CW_USEDEFAULT,
     615                      CW_USEDEFAULT,
     616                      nullptr,
     617                      nullptr,
     618                      windowClass.hInstance,
     619                      nullptr)};
     620  
     621                  THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(!windowHandle);
     622                  SetWindowLongPtr(windowHandle.get(), GWLP_USERDATA, reinterpret_cast<LONG_PTR>(this));
     623  
     624                  MSG windowMessage{};
     625                  while (GetMessageW(&windowMessage, nullptr, 0, 0))
     626                  {
     627                      TranslateMessage(&windowMessage);
     628                      DispatchMessage(&windowMessage);
     629                  }
     630              }
     631              CATCH_LOG();
     632          };
     633  
     634          m_timezoneThread = std::thread{listenForTimeZoneChanges};
     635  
     636          // Shutdown the inbox session for the current user if needed, this is only required once after the
     637          // lifted package is installed to ensure that the inbox service has released per-user resources.
     638          LOG_IF_FAILED(wil::ResultFromException(WI_DIAGNOSTICS_INFO, [&] {
     639              // Open a handle to the service control manager and check if the inbox service is registered.
     640              const wil::unique_schandle manager{OpenSCManager(nullptr, nullptr, SC_MANAGER_ENUMERATE_SERVICE)};
     641              THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(!manager);
     642  
     643              const wil::unique_schandle service{OpenServiceW(manager.get(), LXSS_INBOX_SERVICE_NAME, SERVICE_QUERY_STATUS)};
     644              if (!service)
     645              {
     646                  return;
     647              }
     648  
     649              // Check if the service is already stopped.
     650              SERVICE_STATUS status;
     651              THROW_IF_WIN32_BOOL_FALSE(QueryServiceStatus(service.get(), &status));
     652  
     653              if (status.dwCurrentState == SERVICE_STOPPED)
     654              {
     655                  return;
     656              }
     657  
     658              // Shutdown the user's session.
     659              auto runAsUser = wil::impersonate_token(userToken.get());
     660              const auto wslSupport = wil::CoCreateInstance<LxssUserSessionInBox, IWslSupport>(CLSCTX_LOCAL_SERVER | CLSCTX_ENABLE_CLOAKING);
     661              THROW_IF_FAILED(wslSupport->Shutdown());
     662          }));
     663      }
     664      CATCH_LOG()
     665  }
     666  
     667  LxssUserSessionImpl::~LxssUserSessionImpl()
     668  {
     669      if (m_timezoneThread.joinable())
     670      {
     671          LOG_IF_WIN32_BOOL_FALSE(PostThreadMessage(GetThreadId(m_timezoneThread.native_handle()), WM_QUIT, 0, 0));
     672          m_timezoneThread.join();
     673      }
     674  
     675      m_lifetimeManager.ClearCallbacks();
     676  
     677      // Ensure that if there are no running instances.
     678      WI_ASSERT(m_runningInstances.empty());
     679  }
     680  
     681  HRESULT LxssUserSessionImpl::AttachDisk(_In_ LPCWSTR Disk, _In_ ULONG Flags)
     682  {
     683      ExecutionContext context(Context::AttachDisk);
     684  
     685      std::lock_guard lock(m_instanceLock);
     686      const wil::unique_hkey lxssKey = s_OpenLxssUserKey();
     687  
     688      // Validate that at least one WSL2 distro is installed
     689      auto pred = [&](const auto& e) { return WI_IsFlagSet(e.Read(Property::Flags), LXSS_DISTRO_FLAGS_VM_MODE); };
     690  
     691      auto distributions = _EnumerateDistributions(lxssKey.get(), true);
     692      RETURN_HR_IF(WSL_E_WSL2_NEEDED, !std::any_of(distributions.begin(), distributions.end(), pred));
     693  
     694      return wil::ResultFromException([&]() {
     695          _CreateVm();
     696          const auto diskType = WI_IsFlagSet(Flags, LXSS_ATTACH_MOUNT_FLAGS_VHD) ? WslCoreVm::DiskType::VHD : WslCoreVm::DiskType::PassThrough;
     697          const auto userToken = wsl::windows::common::security::GetUserToken(TokenImpersonation);
     698          m_utilityVm->AttachDisk(Disk, diskType, {}, true, userToken.get());
     699      });
     700  }
     701  
     702  HRESULT LxssUserSessionImpl::ConfigureDistribution(_In_opt_ LPCGUID DistroGuid, _In_ ULONG DefaultUid, _In_ ULONG Flags)
     703  try
     704  {
     705      ExecutionContext context(Context::ConfigureDistro);
     706  
     707      WSL_LOG("ConfigureDistribution", TraceLoggingValue(DefaultUid, "DefaultUid"), TraceLoggingValue(Flags, "Flags"));
     708  
     709      const wil::unique_hkey lxssKey = s_OpenLxssUserKey();
     710      std::lock_guard lock(m_instanceLock);
     711  
     712      // Ensure the distribution exists.
     713      auto distribution = DistributionRegistration::OpenOrDefault(lxssKey.get(), DistroGuid);
     714  
     715      auto configuration = s_GetDistributionConfiguration(distribution);
     716  
     717      // Validate parameters.
     718      RETURN_HR_IF(
     719          E_INVALIDARG,
     720          ((DefaultUid == LX_UID_INVALID) || (Flags != LXSS_DISTRO_FLAGS_UNCHANGED && WI_IsAnyFlagSet(Flags, ~LXSS_DISTRO_FLAGS_ALL))));
     721  
     722      // If the configuration is changed, terminate the distribution so the new settings will take effect.
     723      bool modified = false;
     724      if (DefaultUid != distribution.Read(Property::DefaultUid))
     725      {
     726          distribution.Write(Property::DefaultUid, DefaultUid);
     727          modified = true;
     728      }
     729  
     730      if (Flags != LXSS_DISTRO_FLAGS_UNCHANGED)
     731      {
     732          // The VM Mode flag is not configurable via this API.
     733          if (WI_IsFlagSet(configuration.Flags, LXSS_DISTRO_FLAGS_VM_MODE))
     734          {
     735              WI_SetFlag(Flags, LXSS_DISTRO_FLAGS_VM_MODE);
     736          }
     737          else
     738          {
     739              WI_ClearFlag(Flags, LXSS_DISTRO_FLAGS_VM_MODE);
     740          }
     741  
     742          if (Flags != configuration.Flags)
     743          {
     744              distribution.Write(Property::Flags, Flags);
     745              modified = true;
     746          }
     747      }
     748  
     749      if (modified)
     750      {
     751          _TerminateInstanceInternal(&distribution.Id(), false);
     752      }
     753  
     754      return S_OK;
     755  }
     756  CATCH_RETURN()

     767  
     768  HRESULT LxssUserSessionImpl::CreateLxProcess(
     769      _In_opt_ LPCGUID DistroGuid,
     770      _In_opt_ LPCSTR Filename,
     771      _In_ ULONG CommandLineCount,
     772      _In_reads_opt_(CommandLineCount) LPCSTR* CommandLine,
     773      _In_opt_ LPCWSTR CurrentWorkingDirectory,
     774      _In_opt_ LPCWSTR NtPath,
     775      _In_reads_opt_(NtEnvironmentLength) PWCHAR NtEnvironment,
     776      _In_ ULONG NtEnvironmentLength,
     777      _In_opt_ LPCWSTR Username,
     778      _In_ SHORT Columns,
     779      _In_ SHORT Rows,
     780      _In_ HANDLE ConsoleHandle,
     781      _In_ PLXSS_STD_HANDLES StdHandles,
     782      _In_ ULONG Flags,
     783      _Out_ GUID* DistributionId,
     784      _Out_ GUID* InstanceId,
     785      _Out_ HANDLE* ProcessHandle,
     786      _Out_ HANDLE* ServerHandle,
     787      _Out_ HANDLE* StandardIn,
     788      _Out_ HANDLE* StandardOut,
     789      _Out_ HANDLE* StandardErr,
     790      _Out_ HANDLE* CommunicationChannel,
     791      _Out_ HANDLE* InteropSocket)
     792  try
     793  {
     794      // This API handles launching processes three ways:
     795      // 1. If Filename and CommandLine are both NULL, the user's default shell
     796      //    is launched. The default shell is stored in /etc/passwd.
     797      // 2. If Filename is NULL but CommandLine is not, the user's default shell
     798      //    is used to invoke the specified command. For example:
     799      //        /bin/bash -c "command"
     800      // 3. If Filename and CommandLine are both non-NULL, they are passed along
     801      //    as-is to the exec system call by the init daemon.
     802  
     803      // Create an instance to run the process.
     804      auto instance = _CreateInstance(DistroGuid, Flags);
     805  
     806      // Query process creation context.
     807      auto distributionId = instance->GetDistributionId();
     808      auto context = s_GetCreateProcessContext(distributionId, WI_IsFlagSet(Flags, LXSS_CREATE_INSTANCE_FLAGS_USE_SYSTEM_DISTRO));
     809  
     810      _SetHttpProxyInfo(context.DefaultEnvironment);
     811  
     812      // Parse the create process params.
     813      auto parsed = LxssCreateProcess::ParseArguments(
     814          Filename,
     815          CommandLineCount,
     816          CommandLine,
     817          CurrentWorkingDirectory,
     818          NtPath,
     819          NtEnvironment,
     820          NtEnvironmentLength,
     821          Username,
     822          context.DefaultEnvironment,
     823          context.Flags);
     824  
     825      if (WI_IsFlagSet(Flags, LXSS_CREATE_INSTANCE_FLAGS_SHELL_LOGIN))
     826      {
     827          THROW_HR_IF(E_INVALIDARG, ARGUMENT_PRESENT(Filename));
     828          parsed.ShellOptions = ShellOptionsLogin;
     829      }
     830  
     831      // Initialize console data and launch the process.
     832      CreateLxProcessConsoleData consoleData;
     833      if (ConsoleHandle)
     834      {
     835          consoleData.ConsoleHandle.reset(wsl::windows::common::wslutil::DuplicateHandleFromCallingProcess(ConsoleHandle));
     836      }
     837  
     838      consoleData.ClientProcess = wsl::windows::common::wslutil::OpenCallingProcess(PROCESS_VM_READ | GENERIC_READ | SYNCHRONIZE);
     839      instance->CreateLxProcess(
     840          parsed, context, consoleData, Columns, Rows, StdHandles, InstanceId, ProcessHandle, ServerHandle, StandardIn, StandardOut, StandardErr, CommunicationChannel, InteropSocket);
     841  
     842      *DistributionId = distributionId;
     843      return S_OK;
     844  }
     845  CATCH_RETURN()
     846  
     847  void LxssUserSessionImpl::ClearDiskStateInRegistry(_In_ const LPCWSTR Disk)
     848  {
     849      bool deleted = !ARGUMENT_PRESENT(Disk);
     850  
     851      const auto key = wsl::windows::common::registry::OpenOrCreateLxssDiskMountsKey(&m_userSid.Sid);
     852      for (const auto& e : wsl::windows::common::registry::EnumKeys(key.get(), KEY_READ))
     853      {
     854          if (Disk == nullptr || wsl::windows::common::registry::ReadString(e.second.get(), nullptr, c_diskValueName) == Disk)
     855          {
     856              wsl::windows::common::registry::DeleteKey(key.get(), e.first.c_str());
     857              deleted = true;
     858          }
     859      }
     860  
     861      THROW_HR_IF(HRESULT_FROM_WIN32(ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND), !deleted);
     862  }
     863  
     864  HRESULT LxssUserSessionImpl::DetachDisk(_In_ LPCWSTR Disk, _Out_ int* Result, _Out_ int* Step)
     865  {
     866      ExecutionContext context(Context::DetachDisk);
     867  
     868      std::lock_guard lock(m_instanceLock);
     869  
     870      // If the UVM isn't running, simply clear the disk state in the registry, if any
     871      if (!m_utilityVm)
     872      {
     873          return wil::ResultFromException([&]() {
     874              ClearDiskStateInRegistry(Disk);
     875              *Result = 0;
     876              *Step = LxMiniInitMountStepNone;
     877          });
     878      }
     879  
     880      return wil::ResultFromException([&]() { std::tie(*Result, *Step) = m_utilityVm->DetachDisk(Disk); });
     881  }
     882  
     883  HRESULT LxssUserSessionImpl::MountDisk(
     884      _In_ LPCWSTR Disk,
     885      _In_ ULONG Flags,
     886      _In_ ULONG PartitionIndex,
     887      _In_opt_ LPCWSTR Name,
     888      _In_opt_ LPCWSTR Type,
     889      _In_opt_ LPCWSTR Options,
     890      _Out_ int* Result,
     891      _Out_ int* Step,
     892      _Out_ LPWSTR* MountName)
     893  {
     894      ExecutionContext context(Context::DetachDisk);
     895  
     896      std::lock_guard lock(m_instanceLock);
     897      return wil::ResultFromException([&]() {
     898          _CreateVm();
     899          const auto MountDiskType = WI_IsFlagSet(Flags, LXSS_ATTACH_MOUNT_FLAGS_VHD) ? WslCoreVm::DiskType::VHD : WslCoreVm::DiskType::PassThrough;
     900          const auto MountResult = m_utilityVm->MountDisk(Disk, MountDiskType, PartitionIndex, Name, Type, Options);
     901          const auto MountNameWide = wsl::shared::string::MultiByteToWide(MountResult.MountPointName);
     902          *Result = MountResult.Result;
     903          *Step = MountResult.Step;
     904          *MountName = wil::make_unique_string<wil::unique_cotaskmem_string>(MountNameWide.c_str()).release();
     905      });
     906  }
     907  
     908  HRESULT LxssUserSessionImpl::MoveDistribution(_In_ LPCGUID DistroGuid, _In_ LPCWSTR Location)
     909  {
     910      ExecutionContext context(Context::MoveDistro);
     911  
     912      std::lock_guard lock(m_instanceLock);
     913  
     914      // Fail if the distribution is running.
     915      RETURN_HR_IF(WSL_E_DISTRO_NOT_STOPPED, m_runningInstances.contains(*DistroGuid));
     916  
     917      // Lookup the distribution configuration
     918      const auto lxssKey = s_OpenLxssUserKey();
     919      _ValidateDistributionNameAndPathNotInUse(lxssKey.get(), Location, nullptr);
     920  
     921      auto registration = DistributionRegistration::Open(lxssKey.get(), *DistroGuid);
     922      auto distro = s_GetDistributionConfiguration(registration);
     923  
     924      RETURN_HR_IF(E_NOTIMPL, WI_IsFlagClear(distro.Flags, LXSS_DISTRO_FLAGS_VM_MODE));
     925  
     926      // Build the final vhd path.
     927      std::filesystem::path newVhdPath = Location;
     928      RETURN_HR_IF(E_INVALIDARG, newVhdPath.empty());
     929  
     930      newVhdPath /= distro.VhdFilePath.filename();
     931  
     932      auto impersonate = wil::CoImpersonateClient();
     933  
     934      // Create the distribution base folder
     935      std::error_code error;
     936      std::filesystem::create_directories(Location, error);
     937      if (error.value())
     938      {
     939          THROW_WIN32(error.value());
     940      }
     941  
     942      // Move the VHD to the new location.
     943      THROW_IF_WIN32_BOOL_FALSE(MoveFileEx(distro.VhdFilePath.c_str(), newVhdPath.c_str(), MOVEFILE_COPY_ALLOWED | MOVEFILE_WRITE_THROUGH));
     944  
     945      auto revert = wil::scope_exit_log(WI_DIAGNOSTICS_INFO, [&]() {
     946          THROW_IF_WIN32_BOOL_FALSE(MoveFileEx(
     947              newVhdPath.c_str(), distro.VhdFilePath.c_str(), MOVEFILE_COPY_ALLOWED | MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING | MOVEFILE_WRITE_THROUGH));
     948  
     949          // Write the location back to the original path in case the second registry write failed. Otherwise, this is a no-op.
     950          registration.Write(Property::BasePath, distro.BasePath.c_str());
     951      });
     952  
     953      // Update the registry location
     954      registration.Write(Property::BasePath, Location);
     955      registration.Write(Property::VhdFileName, newVhdPath.filename().c_str());
     956  
     957      revert.release();
     958  
     959      return S_OK;
     960  }
     961  
     962  HRESULT LxssUserSessionImpl::EnumerateDistributions(_Out_ PULONG DistributionCount, _Out_ LXSS_ENUMERATE_INFO** Distributions)
     963  {
     964      // Get a list of all registered distributions.
     965      const wil::unique_hkey lxssKey = s_OpenLxssUserKey();
     966      std::lock_guard lock(m_instanceLock);
     967      const auto distributions = _EnumerateDistributions(lxssKey.get(), true);
     968  
     969      // Get the default distribution.
     970      //
     971      // N.B. It is possible the default to not exist, for example if there is
     972      //      a single distribution that is being installed.
     973      GUID defaultGuid = GUID_NULL;
     974      try
     975      {
     976          defaultGuid = _GetDefaultDistro(lxssKey.get());
     977      }
     978      CATCH_LOG()
     979  
     980      const ULONG numberOfDistributions = gsl::narrow_cast<ULONG>(distributions.size());
     981      auto userDistributions(wil::make_unique_cotaskmem<LXSS_ENUMERATE_INFO[]>(numberOfDistributions));
     982  
     983      // Fill in information about each distribution.
     984      for (ULONG index = 0; index < numberOfDistributions; index += 1)
     985      {
     986  
     987          auto configuration = s_GetDistributionConfiguration(distributions[index]);
     988          auto state = static_cast<LxssDistributionState>(configuration.State);
     989  
     990          if (m_runningInstances.contains(distributions[index].Id()))
     991          {
     992              state = LxssDistributionStateRunning;
     993          }
     994          else if (state == LxssDistributionStateInstalled)
     995          {
     996              auto distro = std::find_if(m_lockedDistributions.begin(), m_lockedDistributions.end(), [&](const auto& pair) {
     997                  return IsEqualGUID(distributions[index].Id(), pair.first);
     998              });
     999  
    1000              if (distro != m_lockedDistributions.end())
    1001              {
    1002                  state = distro->second;
    1003              }
    1004          }
    1005  
    1006          const auto current = &userDistributions.get()[index];
    1007          current->DistroGuid = distributions[index].Id();
    1008          current->State = state;
    1009          current->Version = WI_IsFlagSet(configuration.Flags, LXSS_DISTRO_FLAGS_VM_MODE) ? LXSS_WSL_VERSION_2 : LXSS_WSL_VERSION_1;
    1010          current->Flags = 0;
    1011          WI_SetFlagIf(current->Flags, LXSS_ENUMERATE_FLAGS_DEFAULT, IsEqualGUID(distributions[index].Id(), defaultGuid));
    1012  
    1013          static_assert((RTL_NUMBER_OF(current->DistroName) - 1) == LX_INIT_DISTRO_NAME_MAX);
    1014  
    1015          memset(current->DistroName, 0, sizeof(current->DistroName));
    1016          wcscpy_s(current->DistroName, RTL_NUMBER_OF(current->DistroName) - 1, configuration.Name.c_str());
    1017      }
    1018  
    1019      *DistributionCount = numberOfDistributions;
    1020      *Distributions = userDistributions.release();
    1021      return S_OK;
    1022  }
    1023  
    1024  HRESULT LxssUserSessionImpl::ExportDistribution(_In_opt_ LPCGUID DistroGuid, _In_ HANDLE FileHandle, _In_ HANDLE ErrorHandle, _In_ ULONG Flags)
    1025  {
    1026      RETURN_HR_IF(E_INVALIDARG, (WI_IsAnyFlagSet(Flags, ~LXSS_EXPORT_DISTRO_FLAGS_ALL)));
    1027  
    1028      LXSS_DISTRO_CONFIGURATION configuration;
    1029      wil::unique_hkey distroKey;
    1030      try
    1031      {
    1032          const wil::unique_hkey lxssKey = s_OpenLxssUserKey();
    1033          std::lock_guard lock(m_instanceLock);
    1034  
    1035          const auto registration = DistributionRegistration::OpenOrDefault(lxssKey.get(), DistroGuid);
    1036  
    1037          // Ensure the distribution is installed.
    1038          configuration = s_GetDistributionConfiguration(registration);
    1039          RETURN_HR_IF(E_ILLEGAL_STATE_CHANGE, (configuration.State != LxssDistributionStateInstalled));
    1040  
    1041          // Exporting a WSL1 distro is not possible if the VHD flag is specified.
    1042          RETURN_HR_IF(WSL_E_WSL2_NEEDED, WI_IsFlagSet(Flags, LXSS_EXPORT_DISTRO_FLAGS_VHD) && WI_IsFlagClear(configuration.Flags, LXSS_DISTRO_FLAGS_VM_MODE));
    1043  
    1044          // Exporting a WSL1 distro is not possible if the lxcore driver is not present.
    1045          RETURN_HR_IF(WSL_E_WSL1_NOT_SUPPORTED, WI_IsFlagClear(configuration.Flags, LXSS_DISTRO_FLAGS_VM_MODE) && !g_lxcoreInitialized);
    1046  
    1047          // Add the distribution to the list of converting distributions.
    1048          _ConversionBegin(configuration.DistroId, LxssDistributionStateExporting);
    1049      }
    1050      CATCH_RETURN()
    1051  
    1052      // Set up a scope exit member to remove the distribution from the converting list.
    1053      auto exportComplete = wil::scope_exit_log(WI_DIAGNOSTICS_INFO, [&] { _ConversionComplete(configuration.DistroId); });
    1054  
    1055      // Log telemetry to track how long exporting the distribution takes.
    1056      WSL_LOG_TELEMETRY(
    1057          "ExportDistributionBegin",
    1058          PDT_ProductAndServicePerformance,
    1059          TraceLoggingValue(configuration.Name.c_str(), "distroName"),
    1060          TraceLoggingValue(Flags, "flags"));
    1061  
    1062      HRESULT result;
    1063      auto enableExit = wil::scope_exit([&] {
    1064          WSL_LOG_TELEMETRY(
    1065              "ExportDistributionEnd",
    1066              PDT_ProductAndServicePerformance,
    1067              TraceLoggingValue(configuration.Name.c_str(), "distroName"),
    1068              TraceLoggingValue(result, "result"),
    1069              TraceLoggingValue(Flags, "flags"));
    1070      });
    1071  
    1072      // Export the distribution.
    1073      try
    1074      {
    1075          const wil::unique_handle clientProcess = wsl::windows::common::wslutil::OpenCallingProcess(GENERIC_READ | SYNCHRONIZE);
    1076          if (WI_IsFlagSet(configuration.Flags, LXSS_DISTRO_FLAGS_VM_MODE))
    1077          {
    1078              if (WI_IsFlagSet(Flags, LXSS_EXPORT_DISTRO_FLAGS_VHD))
    1079              {
    1080                  const wil::unique_handle userToken = wsl::windows::common::security::GetUserToken(TokenImpersonation);
    1081                  auto runAsUser = wil::impersonate_token(userToken.get());
    1082  
    1083                  // Ensure the target file has the correct file extension.
    1084                  if (GetFileType(FileHandle) == FILE_TYPE_DISK)
    1085                  {
    1086                      std::wstring exportPath;
    1087                      THROW_IF_FAILED(wil::GetFinalPathNameByHandleW(FileHandle, exportPath));
    1088  
    1089                      const auto sourceFileExtension = configuration.VhdFilePath.extension().native();
    1090                      const auto targetFileExtension = std::filesystem::path(exportPath).extension().native();
    1091                      if (!wsl::windows::common::string::IsPathComponentEqual(sourceFileExtension, targetFileExtension))
    1092                      {
    1093                          THROW_HR_WITH_USER_ERROR(
    1094                              WSL_E_EXPORT_FAILED, wsl::shared::Localization::MessageRequiresFileExtension(sourceFileExtension.c_str()));
    1095                      }
    1096                  }
    1097  
    1098                  const wil::unique_hfile vhdFile(CreateFileW(
    1099                      configuration.VhdFilePath.c_str(), GENERIC_READ, (FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_DELETE), nullptr, OPEN_EXISTING, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, nullptr));
    1100  
    1101                  RETURN_LAST_ERROR_IF(!vhdFile);
    1102  
    1103                  wsl::windows::common::relay::InterruptableRelay(vhdFile.get(), FileHandle, clientProcess.get(), LXSS_RELAY_BUFFER_SIZE);
    1104              }
    1105              else
    1106              {
    1107                  auto vmContext = _RunUtilityVmSetup(configuration, LxMiniInitMessageExport, Flags);
    1108  
    1109                  wsl::windows::common::relay::ScopedRelay stdErrRelay(
    1110                      wil::unique_handle{reinterpret_cast<HANDLE>(vmContext.errorSocket.release())}, ErrorHandle);
    1111  
    1112                  // Relay the filesystem file contents to the tar.gz handle.
    1113                  wsl::windows::common::relay::InterruptableRelay(
    1114                      reinterpret_cast<HANDLE>(vmContext.tarSocket.get()), FileHandle, clientProcess.get(), LXSS_RELAY_BUFFER_SIZE);
    1115  
    1116                  // Wait for the utility VM to finish expanding the tar and ensure that
    1117                  // the operation was successful.
    1118                  ULONG exitCode = 1;
    1119                  vmContext.instance->GetInitPort()->Receive(&exitCode, sizeof(exitCode), clientProcess.get());
    1120  
    1121                  // Flush any pending IO on the error relay before exiting.
    1122                  stdErrRelay.Sync();
    1123  
    1124                  THROW_HR_IF(WSL_E_EXPORT_FAILED, (exitCode != 0));
    1125              }
    1126          }
    1127          else
    1128          {
    1129              auto mounts = _CreateSetupMounts(configuration);
    1130  
    1131              const char* formatArgs = nullptr;
    1132  
    1133              if (WI_IsFlagSet(Flags, LXSS_EXPORT_DISTRO_FLAGS_GZIP))
    1134              {
    1135                  THROW_HR_IF(E_INVALIDARG, WI_IsFlagSet(Flags, LXSS_EXPORT_DISTRO_FLAGS_XZIP));
    1136  
    1137                  formatArgs = LXSS_BSDTAR_CREATE_ARGS_GZIP;
    1138              }
    1139              else if (WI_IsFlagSet(Flags, LXSS_EXPORT_DISTRO_FLAGS_XZIP))
    1140              {
    1141                  formatArgs = LXSS_BSDTAR_CREATE_ARGS_XZIP;
    1142              }
    1143              else
    1144              {
    1145                  formatArgs = LXSS_BSDTAR_CREATE_ARGS;
    1146              }
    1147  
    1148              const auto commandLine = std::format("{} -C {}{}", LXSS_BSDTAR_PATH, LXSS_ROOTFS_MOUNT, formatArgs);
    1149  
    1150              const auto elfContext = _RunElfBinary(
    1151                  commandLine.c_str(),
    1152                  configuration.BasePath.c_str(),
    1153                  clientProcess.get(),
    1154                  nullptr,
    1155                  FileHandle,
    1156                  ErrorHandle,
    1157                  mounts.data(),
    1158                  static_cast<ULONG>(mounts.size()));
    1159  
    1160              const auto exitStatus = _GetElfExitStatus(elfContext);
    1161              THROW_HR_IF(WSL_E_EXPORT_FAILED, exitStatus != 0);
    1162          }
    1163  
    1164          result = S_OK;
    1165      }
    1166      catch (...)
    1167      {
    1168          result = wil::ResultFromCaughtException();
    1169      }
    1170  
    1171      return result;
    1172  }

    1177      const wil::unique_hkey lxssKey = s_OpenLxssUserKey();

    1183  
    1184  HRESULT LxssUserSessionImpl::GetDistributionConfiguration(
    1185      _In_opt_ LPCGUID DistroGuid,
    1186      _Out_ LPWSTR* DistributionName,
    1187      _Out_ ULONG* Version,
    1188      _Out_ ULONG* DefaultUid,
    1189      _Out_ ULONG* DefaultEnvironmentCount,
    1190      _Out_ LPSTR** DefaultEnvironment,
    1191      _Out_ ULONG* Flags)
    1192  try
    1193  {
    1194      const wil::unique_hkey lxssKey = s_OpenLxssUserKey();
    1195      std::lock_guard lock(m_instanceLock);
    1196  
    1197      const auto registration = DistributionRegistration::OpenOrDefault(lxssKey.get(), DistroGuid);
    1198      const auto configuration = s_GetDistributionConfiguration(registration);
    1199  
    1200      // Write configuration information back to the calling process.
    1201      *DistributionName = wil::make_cotaskmem_string(configuration.Name.c_str()).release();
    1202      *Version = configuration.Version;
    1203      *DefaultUid = registration.Read(Property::DefaultUid);
    1204      *Flags = configuration.Flags;
    1205      const auto defaultEnvironment = registration.Read(Property::DefaultEnvironment);
    1206      *DefaultEnvironmentCount = gsl::narrow_cast<ULONG>(defaultEnvironment.size());
    1207      auto environment(wil::make_unique_cotaskmem<LPSTR[]>(defaultEnvironment.size()));
    1208      for (size_t index = 0; index < defaultEnvironment.size(); index += 1)
    1209      {
    1210          environment.get()[index] =
    1211              wil::make_unique_ansistring<wil::unique_cotaskmem_ansistring>(defaultEnvironment[index].c_str()).release();
    1212      }
    1213  
    1214      *DefaultEnvironment = environment.release();
    1215      return S_OK;
    1216  }
    1217  CATCH_RETURN()
    1218  
    1219  HRESULT LxssUserSessionImpl::GetDistributionId(_In_ LPCWSTR DistributionName, _In_ ULONG Flags, _Out_ GUID* pDistroGuid)
    1220  try
    1221  {
    1222      // The client must provide a non-empty string.
    1223      //
    1224      // N.B. COM insures that the name buffer is non-NULL.
    1225      RETURN_HR_IF(E_INVALIDARG, (wcslen(DistributionName) == 0));
    1226  
    1227      // Validate flags.
    1228      RETURN_HR_IF(E_INVALIDARG, (WI_IsAnyFlagSet(Flags, ~LXSS_GET_DISTRO_ID_LIST_ALL)));
    1229  
    1230      // Open the user's lxss registry key.
    1231      const wil::unique_hkey lxssKey = s_OpenLxssUserKey();
    1232      const bool listAll = WI_IsFlagSet(Flags, LXSS_GET_DISTRO_ID_LIST_ALL);
    1233      bool distroFound = false;
    1234  
    1235      // Lock the session and search for a distribution that has a matching name.
    1236      std::lock_guard lock(m_instanceLock);
    1237      const auto distros = _EnumerateDistributions(lxssKey.get(), listAll);
    1238      for (const auto& registration : distros)
    1239      {
    1240          if (wsl::shared::string::IsEqual(DistributionName, registration.Read(Property::Name), true))
    1241          {
    1242              distroFound = true;
    1243              *pDistroGuid = registration.Id();
    1244              break;
    1245          }
    1246      }
    1247  
    1248      // Return an error if no distribution was found with a matching name.
    1249      RETURN_HR_IF(WSL_E_DISTRO_NOT_FOUND, !distroFound);
    1250  
    1251      return S_OK;
    1252  }
    1253  CATCH_RETURN()

    1269  
    1270  HRESULT
    1271  LxssUserSessionImpl::ImportDistributionInplace(_In_ LPCWSTR DistributionName, _In_ LPCWSTR VhdPath, _Out_ GUID* pDistroGuid)
    1272  {
    1273      ExecutionContext context(Context::RegisterDistro);
    1274  
    1275      s_ValidateDistroName(DistributionName);
    1276  
    1277      // Return an error if the path is not absolute or does not have a valid VHD file extension.
    1278      const std::filesystem::path path{VhdPath};
    1279      RETURN_HR_IF(E_INVALIDARG, !path.is_absolute() || !wsl::windows::common::wslutil::IsVhdFile(path));
    1280  
    1281      const wil::unique_hkey lxssKey = s_OpenLxssUserKey();
    1282      std::lock_guard lock(m_instanceLock);
    1283  
    1284      // Create a registration for the distribution.
    1285      //
    1286      // N.B. Import inplace is always WSL2.
    1287      _ValidateDistributionNameAndPathNotInUse(lxssKey.get(), path.parent_path().c_str(), DistributionName);
    1288  
    1289      constexpr ULONG flags = LXSS_DISTRO_FLAGS_DEFAULT | LXSS_DISTRO_FLAGS_VM_MODE;
    1290      auto registration = DistributionRegistration::Create(
    1291          lxssKey.get(),
    1292          {},
    1293          DistributionName,
    1294          LXSS_DISTRO_VERSION_CURRENT,
    1295          path.parent_path().c_str(),
    1296          flags,
    1297          LX_UID_ROOT,
    1298          nullptr,
    1299          path.filename().c_str(),
    1300          false);
    1301  
    1302      auto configuration = s_GetDistributionConfiguration(registration);
    1303  
    1304      // Declare a scope exit variable to clean up on failure.
    1305      const wil::unique_handle userToken = wsl::windows::common::security::GetUserToken(TokenImpersonation);
    1306      auto cleanup = wil::scope_exit_log(WI_DIAGNOSTICS_INFO, [&] {
    1307          {
    1308              auto runAsUser = wil::impersonate_token(userToken.get());
    1309              _DeleteDistribution(configuration, LXSS_DELETE_DISTRO_FLAGS_UNMOUNT);
    1310          }
    1311  
    1312          registration.Delete(lxssKey.get());
    1313      });
    1314  
    1315      const auto vmContext = _RunUtilityVmSetup(configuration, LxMiniInitMessageImportInplace);
    1316      auto* channel = dynamic_cast<WslCoreInstance::WslCorePort*>(vmContext.instance->GetInitPort().get());
    1317  
    1318      gsl::span<gsl::byte> span;
    1319      const auto& message = channel->GetChannel().ReceiveMessage<LX_MINI_INIT_IMPORT_RESULT>(&span);
    1320  
    1321      // Process the import result message.
    1322      THROW_HR_IF(WSL_E_IMPORT_FAILED, (message.Result != 0));
    1323  
    1324      _ProcessImportResultMessage(message, span, lxssKey.get(), configuration, registration);
    1325  
    1326      // Set the distribution as installed.
    1327      _SetDistributionInstalled(lxssKey.get(), registration.Id());
    1328      cleanup.release();
    1329  
    1330      _SendDistributionRegisteredEvent(configuration);
    1331  
    1332      _LaunchOOBEIfNeeded();
    1333  
    1334      // Log when a distro is imported in place
    1335      WSL_LOG_TELEMETRY(
    1336          "ImportDistributionInplace",
    1337          PDT_ProductAndServiceUsage,
    1338          TraceLoggingValue(DistributionName, "distroName"),
    1339          TraceLoggingValue(path.filename().c_str(), "fileName"));
    1340  
    1341      *pDistroGuid = registration.Id();
    1342      return S_OK;
    1343  }
    1344  
    1345  HRESULT LxssUserSessionImpl::RegisterDistribution(
    1346      _In_ LPCWSTR DistributionName,
    1347      _In_ ULONG Version,
    1348      _In_ HANDLE FileHandle,
    1349      _In_ HANDLE ErrorHandle,
    1350      _In_ LPCWSTR TargetDirectory,
    1351      _In_ ULONG Flags,
    1352      _In_ ULONG64 VhdSize,
    1353      _In_opt_ LPCWSTR PackageFamilyName,
    1354      _Out_opt_ LPWSTR* InstalledDistributionName,
    1355      _Out_ GUID* pDistroGuid)
    1356  {
    1357      ExecutionContext context(Context::RegisterDistro);
    1358  
    1359      RETURN_HR_IF(E_INVALIDARG, (WI_IsAnyFlagSet(Flags, ~LXSS_IMPORT_DISTRO_FLAGS_ALL)));
    1360  
    1361      // Set up a scope exit member to log registration status.
    1362      HRESULT result = E_FAIL;
    1363      auto registerExit = wil::scope_exit([&] {
    1364          // Log when a distribution registration ends and its result
    1365          WSL_LOG_TELEMETRY(
    1366              "RegisterDistributionEnd",
    1367              PDT_ProductAndServiceUsage,
    1368              TraceLoggingValue(DistributionName, "name"),
    1369              TraceLoggingHexUInt32(result, "result"),
    1370              TraceLoggingValue(Version, "version"),
    1371              TraceLoggingValue(Flags, "flags"));
    1372      });
    1373  
    1374      try
    1375      {
    1376          // Log when a distribution is being registered in WSL
    1377          WSL_LOG_TELEMETRY(
    1378              "RegisterDistributionBegin",
    1379              PDT_ProductAndServiceUsage,
    1380              TraceLoggingValue(DistributionName, "name"),
    1381              TraceLoggingValue(Version, "version"),
    1382              TraceLoggingValue(Flags, "flags"));
    1383  
    1384          if (DistributionName != nullptr)
    1385          {
    1386              s_ValidateDistroName(DistributionName);
    1387          }
    1388  
    1389          // Impersonate the user and open their lxss registry key.
    1390          wil::unique_hkey lxssKey = s_OpenLxssUserKey();
    1391  
    1392          // Determine the filesystem version. If WslFs is not enabled, downgrade
    1393          // the version.
    1394          ULONG FilesystemVersion = LXSS_DISTRO_VERSION_CURRENT;
    1395          if (wsl::windows::common::registry::ReadDword(lxssKey.get(), nullptr, WSL_NEW_DISTRO_LXFS, 0) != 0)
    1396          {
    1397              if (LXSS_DISTRO_USES_WSL_FS(FilesystemVersion) != FALSE)
    1398              {
    1399                  FilesystemVersion = LXSS_DISTRO_VERSION_1;
    1400              }
    1401          }
    1402  
    1403          // Validate the version number.
    1404          if (Version == LXSS_WSL_VERSION_DEFAULT)
    1405          {
    1406              Version = wsl::windows::common::registry::ReadDword(lxssKey.get(), nullptr, LXSS_WSL_DEFAULT_VERSION, LXSS_WSL_VERSION_2);
    1407          }
    1408  
    1409          RETURN_HR_IF(E_INVALIDARG, ((Version != LXSS_WSL_VERSION_1) && (Version != LXSS_WSL_VERSION_2)));
    1410  
    1411          // Registering a WSL1 distro is not possible if any VHD flags are specified.
    1412          RETURN_HR_IF(
    1413              WSL_E_WSL2_NEEDED,
    1414              WI_IsAnyFlagSet(Flags, LXSS_IMPORT_DISTRO_FLAGS_VHD | LXSS_IMPORT_DISTRO_FLAGS_FIXED_VHD) && (Version == LXSS_WSL_VERSION_1));
    1415  
    1416          // Registering a vhd with the fixed vhd flag is not allowed.
    1417          if (WI_IsFlagSet(Flags, LXSS_IMPORT_DISTRO_FLAGS_VHD))
    1418          {
    1419              RETURN_HR_IF(E_INVALIDARG, WI_IsFlagSet(Flags, LXSS_IMPORT_DISTRO_FLAGS_FIXED_VHD));
    1420          }
    1421  
    1422          // Registering a distro with a fixed VHD is only allowed if a size is specified.
    1423          RETURN_HR_IF(E_INVALIDARG, VhdSize == 0 && WI_IsFlagSet(Flags, LXSS_IMPORT_DISTRO_FLAGS_FIXED_VHD));
    1424  
    1425          // Registering a WSL1 distro is not possible if the lxcore driver is not present.
    1426          RETURN_HR_IF(WSL_E_WSL1_NOT_SUPPORTED, (Version == LXSS_WSL_VERSION_1) && !g_lxcoreInitialized);
    1427  
    1428          DistributionRegistration registration;
    1429          LXSS_DISTRO_CONFIGURATION configuration;
    1430          std::filesystem::path distributionPath;
    1431          wil::unique_handle userToken = wsl::windows::common::security::GetUserToken(TokenImpersonation);
    1432          auto config = _GetResultantConfig(userToken.get());
    1433  
    1434          {
    1435              std::lock_guard lock(m_instanceLock);
    1436  
    1437              // Create a registration for the distribution and determine which version should be used.
    1438              ULONG flags = LXSS_DISTRO_FLAGS_DEFAULT;
    1439              WI_SetFlagIf(flags, LXSS_DISTRO_FLAGS_VM_MODE, (Version == LXSS_WSL_VERSION_2));
    1440  
    1441              GUID DistributionId{};
    1442              THROW_IF_FAILED(CoCreateGuid(&DistributionId));
    1443  
    1444              if (TargetDirectory == nullptr)
    1445              {
    1446                  distributionPath = config.DefaultDistributionLocation / wsl::shared::string::GuidToString<wchar_t>(DistributionId);
    1447              }
    1448              else
    1449              {
    1450                  distributionPath = TargetDirectory;
    1451              }
    1452  
    1453              TargetDirectory = nullptr; // Make sure this isn't reused later.
    1454  
    1455              _ValidateDistributionNameAndPathNotInUse(lxssKey.get(), distributionPath.c_str(), DistributionName);
    1456  
    1457              if (!std::filesystem::exists(distributionPath))
    1458              {
    1459                  auto impersonate = wil::CoImpersonateClient();
    1460                  wil::CreateDirectoryDeep(distributionPath.c_str());
    1461              }
    1462  
    1463              // If importing a vhd, determine if it is a .vhd or .vhdx.
    1464              std::wstring vhdName{LXSS_VM_MODE_VHD_NAME};
    1465              if ((WI_IsFlagSet(Flags, LXSS_IMPORT_DISTRO_FLAGS_VHD)) && (GetFileType(FileHandle) == FILE_TYPE_DISK))
    1466              {
    1467                  std::wstring pathBuffer;
    1468                  THROW_IF_FAILED(wil::GetFinalPathNameByHandleW(FileHandle, pathBuffer));
    1469  
    1470                  std::filesystem::path vhdPath{std::move(pathBuffer)};
    1471                  if (!wsl::windows::common::wslutil::IsVhdFile(vhdPath))
    1472                  {
    1473                      using namespace wsl::windows::common::wslutil;
    1474                      THROW_HR_WITH_USER_ERROR(
    1475                          WSL_E_IMPORT_FAILED, wsl::shared::Localization::MessageRequiresFileExtensions(c_vhdFileExtension, c_vhdxFileExtension));
    1476                  }
    1477  
    1478                  vhdName = vhdPath.filename();
    1479              }
    1480  
    1481              registration = DistributionRegistration::Create(
    1482                  lxssKey.get(),
    1483                  DistributionId,
    1484                  DistributionName,
    1485                  FilesystemVersion,
    1486                  distributionPath.c_str(),
    1487                  flags,
    1488                  LX_UID_ROOT,
    1489                  PackageFamilyName,
    1490                  vhdName.c_str(),
    1491                  WI_IsFlagClear(Flags, LXSS_IMPORT_DISTRO_FLAGS_NO_OOBE));
    1492  
    1493              configuration = s_GetDistributionConfiguration(registration, DistributionName == nullptr);
    1494  
    1495              // Add the distribution to the list of converting distributions.
    1496              _ConversionBegin(configuration.DistroId, LxssDistributionStateInstalling);
    1497          }
    1498  
    1499          // Set up a scope exit member to remove the distribution from the converting list.
    1500          auto installComplete = wil::scope_exit_log(WI_DIAGNOSTICS_INFO, [&] { _ConversionComplete(configuration.DistroId); });
    1501  
    1502          // Declare a scope exit variable to clean up on failure.
    1503          ULONG deleteFlags = 0;
    1504          auto cleanup = wil::scope_exit_log(WI_DIAGNOSTICS_INFO, [&] {
    1505              {
    1506                  auto runAsUser = wil::impersonate_token(userToken.get());
    1507                  _DeleteDistribution(configuration, deleteFlags);
    1508              }
    1509  
    1510              registration.Delete(lxssKey.get());
    1511          });
    1512  
    1513          // Initialize the filesystem.
    1514          wil::unique_handle clientProcess = wsl::windows::common::wslutil::OpenCallingProcess(GENERIC_READ | SYNCHRONIZE);
    1515          if (Version == LXSS_WSL_VERSION_2)
    1516          {
    1517              if (WI_IsFlagSet(Flags, LXSS_IMPORT_DISTRO_FLAGS_VHD))
    1518              {
    1519                  auto runAsUser = wil::impersonate_token(userToken.get());
    1520                  auto vhdFile = wsl::core::filesystem::CreateFile(
    1521                      configuration.VhdFilePath.c_str(),
    1522                      GENERIC_WRITE,
    1523                      (FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_WRITE | FILE_SHARE_DELETE),
    1524                      CREATE_NEW,
    1525                      FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL,
    1526                      GetUserSid());
    1527  
    1528                  deleteFlags = LXSS_DELETE_DISTRO_FLAGS_VHD;
    1529                  wsl::windows::common::relay::InterruptableRelay(FileHandle, vhdFile.get(), clientProcess.get(), LXSS_RELAY_BUFFER_SIZE);
    1530              }
    1531              else
    1532              {
    1533                  // Create a vhd to store the root filesystem.
    1534                  {
    1535                      auto runAsUser = wil::impersonate_token(userToken.get());
    1536                      if (VhdSize == 0)
    1537                      {
    1538                          VhdSize = config.VhdSizeBytes;
    1539                      }
    1540  
    1541                      wsl::core::filesystem::CreateVhd(
    1542                          configuration.VhdFilePath.c_str(), VhdSize, GetUserSid(), config.EnableSparseVhd, WI_IsFlagSet(Flags, LXSS_IMPORT_DISTRO_FLAGS_FIXED_VHD));
    1543  
    1544                      deleteFlags = LXSS_DELETE_DISTRO_FLAGS_VHD;
    1545                  }
    1546  
    1547                  // Create a process in the utility VM to expand the tar file from a socket.
    1548                  auto vmContext = _RunUtilityVmSetup(configuration, LxMiniInitMessageImport);
    1549  
    1550                  std::optional<wsl::windows::common::relay::ScopedRelay> errorRelay;
    1551                  if (ErrorHandle != nullptr)
    1552                  {
    1553                      errorRelay.emplace(std::move(vmContext.errorSocket), ErrorHandle);
    1554                  }
    1555  
    1556                  // Relay the filesystem file contents to the tar.gz handle.
    1557                  // Note: This is done in a separate thread because we can sometimes get stuck while writing the socket if tar exited without reading anything.
    1558                  // Note: because the tarsSocket is moved, the relay owns it, meaning it will automatically close it when the relaying thread exits.
    1559                  wsl::windows::common::relay::ScopedRelay dataRelay(FileHandle, std::move(vmContext.tarSocket));
    1560  
    1561                  // Wait for the utility VM to finish expanding the tar and ensure that
    1562                  // the operation was successful.
    1563                  auto* channel = dynamic_cast<WslCoreInstance::WslCorePort*>(vmContext.instance->GetInitPort().get());
    1564  
    1565                  gsl::span<gsl::byte> span;
    1566                  const auto& message = channel->GetChannel().ReceiveMessage<LX_MINI_INIT_IMPORT_RESULT>(&span);
    1567  
    1568                  // Flush any pending IO on the error relay before exiting.
    1569                  if (errorRelay.has_value())
    1570                  {
    1571                      errorRelay->Sync();
    1572                  }
    1573  
    1574                  // Process the import result message.
    1575                  THROW_HR_IF(WSL_E_IMPORT_FAILED, (message.Result != 0));
    1576  
    1577                  _ProcessImportResultMessage(message, span, lxssKey.get(), configuration, registration);
    1578              }
    1579          }
    1580          else
    1581          {
    1582              // Create the directory to store the root filesystem.
    1583              const auto rootFsPath = configuration.BasePath / LXSS_ROOTFS_DIRECTORY;
    1584              wsl::windows::common::filesystem::CreateRootFs(rootFsPath.c_str(), configuration.Version);
    1585              deleteFlags = LXSS_DELETE_DISTRO_FLAGS_ROOTFS;
    1586  
    1587              // Use bsdtar to extract the tar.gz file.
    1588              auto mounts = _CreateSetupMounts(configuration);
    1589              {
    1590                  auto elfContext = _RunElfBinary(
    1591                      LXSS_BSDTAR_PATH " -C " LXSS_ROOTFS_MOUNT LXSS_BSDTAR_EXTRACT_ARGS,
    1592                      configuration.BasePath.c_str(),
    1593                      clientProcess.get(),
    1594                      FileHandle,
    1595                      nullptr,
    1596                      ErrorHandle,
    1597                      mounts.data(),
    1598                      static_cast<ULONG>(mounts.size()));
    1599  
    1600                  auto exitStatus = _GetElfExitStatus(elfContext);
    1601                  THROW_HR_IF(WSL_E_IMPORT_FAILED, exitStatus != 0);
    1602              }
    1603  
    1604              // Invoke the init binary with the option to export the distribution information via stdout.
    1605              {
    1606                  std::pair<wil::unique_handle, wil::unique_handle> input;
    1607                  THROW_IF_WIN32_BOOL_FALSE(CreatePipe(&input.first, &input.second, nullptr, 0));
    1608  
    1609                  std::pair<wil::unique_handle, wil::unique_handle> output;
    1610                  THROW_IF_WIN32_BOOL_FALSE(CreatePipe(&output.first, &output.second, nullptr, 0));
    1611  
    1612                  auto elfContext = _RunElfBinary(
    1613                      LXSS_TOOLS_MOUNT "/init " LX_INIT_IMPORT_MESSAGE_ARG " " LXSS_ROOTFS_MOUNT,
    1614                      configuration.BasePath.c_str(),
    1615                      clientProcess.get(),
    1616                      input.first.get(),
    1617                      output.second.get(),
    1618                      ErrorHandle,
    1619                      mounts.data(),
    1620                      static_cast<ULONG>(mounts.size()));
    1621  
    1622                  // Close handles that were marshalled to WSL1.
    1623                  input.first.reset();
    1624                  output.second.reset();
    1625  
    1626                  // Read the import result message from stdout.
    1627                  wil::unique_handle clientProcess = wsl::windows::common::wslutil::OpenCallingProcess(GENERIC_READ | SYNCHRONIZE);
    1628                  MESSAGE_HEADER header{};
    1629                  const auto headerSpan = gslhelpers::struct_as_writeable_bytes(header);
    1630                  auto bytesRead = wsl::windows::common::relay::InterruptableRead(
    1631                      output.first.get(), gslhelpers::struct_as_writeable_bytes(header), {clientProcess.get()});
    1632  
    1633                  THROW_HR_IF(WSL_E_IMPORT_FAILED, bytesRead != headerSpan.size() || header.MessageSize <= headerSpan.size() || header.MessageType != LxMiniInitMessageImportResult);
    1634  
    1635                  std::vector<gsl::byte> buffer(header.MessageSize);
    1636                  const auto span = gsl::make_span(buffer);
    1637                  gsl::copy(headerSpan, span);
    1638  
    1639                  auto offset = headerSpan.size();
    1640                  while (offset < span.size())
    1641                  {
    1642                      bytesRead =
    1643                          wsl::windows::common::relay::InterruptableRead(output.first.get(), span.subspan(offset), {clientProcess.get()});
    1644                      if (bytesRead <= 0)
    1645                      {
    1646                          break;
    1647                      }
    1648  
    1649                      offset += bytesRead;
    1650                  }
    1651  
    1652                  THROW_HR_IF(WSL_E_IMPORT_FAILED, offset != buffer.size());
    1653  
    1654                  // Close the stdin write handle to let init exit and process the import result message.
    1655                  input.second.reset();
    1656                  auto exitStatus = _GetElfExitStatus(elfContext);
    1657                  THROW_HR_IF(WSL_E_IMPORT_FAILED, exitStatus != 0);
    1658  
    1659                  const auto message = gslhelpers::try_get_struct<LX_MINI_INIT_IMPORT_RESULT>(span);
    1660                  THROW_HR_IF(WSL_E_IMPORT_FAILED, !message);
    1661  
    1662                  _ProcessImportResultMessage(*message, span, lxssKey.get(), configuration, registration);
    1663              }
    1664          }
    1665  
    1666          // Mark the distribution as installed and delete the scope exit variable
    1667          // so the registration is persisted.
    1668          {
    1669              std::lock_guard lock(m_instanceLock);
    1670              _SetDistributionInstalled(lxssKey.get(), registration.Id());
    1671              cleanup.release();
    1672          }
    1673  
    1674          _SendDistributionRegisteredEvent(configuration);
    1675  
    1676          _LaunchOOBEIfNeeded();
    1677  
    1678          *pDistroGuid = registration.Id();
    1679          if (InstalledDistributionName != nullptr)
    1680          {
    1681              *InstalledDistributionName = wil::make_cotaskmem_string(configuration.Name.c_str()).release();
    1682          }
    1683  
    1684          result = S_OK;
    1685      }
    1686      catch (...)
    1687      {
    1688          result = wil::ResultFromCaughtException();
    1689      }
    1690  
    1691      return result;
    1692  }
    1693  
    1694  HRESULT LxssUserSessionImpl::SetDefaultDistribution(_In_ LPCGUID DistroGuid)
    1695  try
    1696  {
    1697      const wil::unique_hkey lxssKey = s_OpenLxssUserKey();
    1698  
    1699      // Ensure the distribution is in the installed state.
    1700      std::lock_guard lock(m_instanceLock);
    1701  
    1702      const auto registration = DistributionRegistration::Open(lxssKey.get(), *DistroGuid);
    1703      const DWORD state = registration.Read(Property::State);
    1704  
    1705      RETURN_HR_IF(WSL_E_DISTRO_NOT_FOUND, (state != LxssDistributionStateInstalled));
    1706  
    1707      // Set the distribution to the default.
    1708      DistributionRegistration::SetDefault(lxssKey.get(), registration);
    1709  
    1710      return S_OK;
    1711  }
    1712  CATCH_RETURN()
    1713  
    1714  HRESULT LxssUserSessionImpl::SetSparse(_In_ LPCGUID DistroGuid, _In_ BOOLEAN Sparse, _In_ BOOLEAN AllowUnsafe)
    1715  try
    1716  {
    1717      auto runAsUser = wil::CoImpersonateClient();
    1718      const wil::unique_hkey lxssKey = s_OpenLxssUserKey();
    1719      std::lock_guard lock(m_instanceLock);
    1720  
    1721      const auto registration = DistributionRegistration::Open(lxssKey.get(), *DistroGuid);
    1722      LXSS_DISTRO_CONFIGURATION configuration = s_GetDistributionConfiguration(registration);
    1723  
    1724      // Don't attempt on V1
    1725      if (WI_IsFlagClear(configuration.Flags, LXSS_DISTRO_FLAGS_VM_MODE))
    1726      {
    1727          THROW_HR_WITH_USER_ERROR(WSL_E_VM_MODE_INVALID_STATE, wsl::shared::Localization::MessageSparseVhdWsl2Only());
    1728      }
    1729  
    1730      // Allow disabling sparse mode but not enabling until the data corruption issue has been resolved.
    1731      if (Sparse && !AllowUnsafe)
    1732      {
    1733          THROW_HR_WITH_USER_ERROR(E_INVALIDARG, wsl::shared::Localization::MessageSparseVhdDisabled());
    1734      }
    1735  
    1736      // Don't attempt if running
    1737      RETURN_HR_IF(WSL_E_DISTRO_NOT_STOPPED, m_runningInstances.contains(*DistroGuid));
    1738  
    1739      const wil::unique_hfile vhd{::CreateFileW(configuration.VhdFilePath.c_str(), GENERIC_WRITE, 0, nullptr, OPEN_EXISTING, 0, nullptr)};
    1740      if (!vhd)
    1741      {
    1742          const DWORD err = GetLastError();
    1743          if (err == ERROR_SHARING_VIOLATION)
    1744          {
    1745              THROW_HR_WITH_USER_ERROR(HRESULT_FROM_WIN32(err), wsl::shared::Localization::MessageVhdInUse());
    1746          }
    1747          THROW_WIN32(err);
    1748      }
    1749  
    1750      FILE_SET_SPARSE_BUFFER buffer{
    1751          .SetSparse = Sparse,
    1752      };
    1753      THROW_IF_WIN32_BOOL_FALSE(::DeviceIoControl(vhd.get(), FSCTL_SET_SPARSE, &buffer, sizeof(buffer), nullptr, 0, nullptr, nullptr));
    1754  
    1755      return S_OK;
    1756  }
    1757  CATCH_RETURN()
    1758  
    1759  HRESULT LxssUserSessionImpl::ResizeDistribution(_In_ LPCGUID DistroGuid, _In_ HANDLE OutputHandle, _In_ ULONG64 NewSize)
    1760  try
    1761  {
    1762      std::lock_guard lock(m_instanceLock);
    1763      const wil::unique_hkey lxssKey = s_OpenLxssUserKey();
    1764      const auto registration = DistributionRegistration::Open(lxssKey.get(), *DistroGuid);
    1765      LXSS_DISTRO_CONFIGURATION configuration = s_GetDistributionConfiguration(registration);
    1766      RETURN_HR_IF(WSL_E_WSL2_NEEDED, WI_IsFlagClear(configuration.Flags, LXSS_DISTRO_FLAGS_VM_MODE));
    1767  
    1768      const auto vhdFilePath = configuration.VhdFilePath;
    1769      if (m_utilityVm && m_utilityVm->IsVhdAttached(vhdFilePath.c_str()))
    1770      {
    1771          THROW_HR_WITH_USER_ERROR(WSL_E_DISTRO_NOT_STOPPED, wsl::shared::Localization::MessageVhdInUse());
    1772      }
    1773  
    1774      auto diskHandle = wsl::core::filesystem::OpenVhd(vhdFilePath.c_str(), VIRTUAL_DISK_ACCESS_GET_INFO | VIRTUAL_DISK_ACCESS_METAOPS);
    1775      const auto diskSize = wsl::core::filesystem::GetDiskSize(diskHandle.get());
    1776  
    1777      const auto resizingLarger = NewSize > diskSize;
    1778      if (resizingLarger)
    1779      {
    1780          wsl::core::filesystem::ResizeExistingVhd(diskHandle.get(), NewSize, RESIZE_VIRTUAL_DISK_FLAG_NONE);
    1781      }
    1782  
    1783      diskHandle.reset();
    1784  
    1785      // Ensure VM exists and attach the VHD.
    1786      _CreateVm();
    1787      const auto userToken = wsl::windows::common::security::GetUserToken(TokenImpersonation);
    1788      const auto lun = m_utilityVm->AttachDisk(vhdFilePath.c_str(), WslCoreVm::DiskType::VHD, {}, true, userToken.get());
    1789  
    1790      // Resize the underlying filesystem.
    1791      //
    1792      // N.B. Passing zero as the size causes the resize to consume all available space on the block device.
    1793      {
    1794          auto cleanup = wil::scope_exit_log(WI_DIAGNOSTICS_INFO, [&] { m_utilityVm->EjectVhd(vhdFilePath.c_str()); });
    1795          m_utilityVm->ResizeDistribution(lun, OutputHandle, resizingLarger ? 0 : NewSize);
    1796      }
    1797  
    1798      // If shrinking the VHD, resize the underlying VHD file. This is only supported for .vhdx files.
    1799      //
    1800      // N.B. RESIZE_VIRTUAL_DISK_FLAG_ALLOW_UNSAFE_VIRTUAL_SIZE is required because vhdmp can't validate that the minimum safe ext4 size.
    1801      if (!resizingLarger &&
    1802          wsl::shared::string::IsEqual(vhdFilePath.extension().c_str(), wsl::windows::common::wslutil::c_vhdxFileExtension, true))
    1803      {
    1804          const auto diskHandle =
    1805              wsl::core::filesystem::OpenVhd(vhdFilePath.c_str(), VIRTUAL_DISK_ACCESS_GET_INFO | VIRTUAL_DISK_ACCESS_METAOPS);
    1806          wsl::core::filesystem::ResizeExistingVhd(diskHandle.get(), NewSize, RESIZE_VIRTUAL_DISK_FLAG_ALLOW_UNSAFE_VIRTUAL_SIZE);
    1807      }
    1808  
    1809      return S_OK;
    1810  }
    1811  CATCH_RETURN()
    1812  
    1813  HRESULT LxssUserSessionImpl::SetVersion(_In_ LPCGUID DistroGuid, _In_ ULONG Version, _In_ HANDLE StderrHandle)
    1814  {
    1815      RETURN_HR_IF(E_INVALIDARG, ((Version != LXSS_WSL_VERSION_1) && (Version != LXSS_WSL_VERSION_2)));
    1816  
    1817      DistributionRegistration registration;
    1818      LXSS_DISTRO_CONFIGURATION configuration;
    1819      wil::unique_hkey lxssKey = s_OpenLxssUserKey();
    1820      try
    1821      {
    1822          // Ensure the distribution exists.
    1823          std::lock_guard lock(m_instanceLock);
    1824          registration = DistributionRegistration::Open(lxssKey.get(), *DistroGuid);
    1825          configuration = s_GetDistributionConfiguration(registration);
    1826  
    1827          // The distro must be in the installed state.
    1828          RETURN_HR_IF(E_ILLEGAL_STATE_CHANGE, (configuration.State != LxssDistributionStateInstalled));
    1829  
    1830          // Ensure distro is not already in the requested state.
    1831          if (Version == LXSS_WSL_VERSION_1)
    1832          {
    1833              RETURN_HR_IF(WSL_E_VM_MODE_INVALID_STATE, WI_IsFlagClear(configuration.Flags, LXSS_DISTRO_FLAGS_VM_MODE));
    1834          }
    1835          else
    1836          {
    1837              // The legacy distribution does not support VM mode.
    1838              RETURN_HR_IF(WSL_E_VM_MODE_NOT_SUPPORTED, (configuration.Version == LXSS_DISTRO_VERSION_LEGACY));
    1839  
    1840              RETURN_HR_IF(WSL_E_VM_MODE_INVALID_STATE, WI_IsFlagSet(configuration.Flags, LXSS_DISTRO_FLAGS_VM_MODE));
    1841          }
    1842  
    1843          // Conversion is not possible if the lxcore driver is not present.
    1844          RETURN_HR_IF(WSL_E_WSL1_NOT_SUPPORTED, !g_lxcoreInitialized);
    1845  
    1846          // Add the distribution to the list of converting distributions.
    1847          _ConversionBegin(configuration.DistroId, LxssDistributionStateConverting);
    1848  
    1849          // Remove the distribution ID from m_updatedInitDistros so init is updated on the next launch (in the case of a conversion to WSL1).
    1850          m_updatedInitDistros.erase(
    1851              std::remove(m_updatedInitDistros.begin(), m_updatedInitDistros.end(), configuration.DistroId), m_updatedInitDistros.end());
    1852      }
    1853      CATCH_RETURN()
    1854  
    1855      // Set up a scope exit member to remove the distribution from the converting list.
    1856      auto conversionComplete = wil::scope_exit_log(WI_DIAGNOSTICS_INFO, [&] { _ConversionComplete(configuration.DistroId); });
    1857  
    1858      // Log telemetry to track how long enabling VM mode takes.
    1859      WSL_LOG_TELEMETRY(
    1860          "SetVersionBegin",
    1861          PDT_ProductAndServicePerformance,
    1862          TraceLoggingValue(configuration.Name.c_str(), "distroName"),
    1863          TraceLoggingValue(Version, "version"));
    1864  
    1865      HRESULT result;
    1866      auto setVersionComplete = wil::scope_exit([&] {
    1867          WSL_LOG_TELEMETRY(
    1868              "SetVersionEnd",
    1869              PDT_ProductAndServicePerformance,
    1870              TraceLoggingValue(configuration.Name.c_str(), "distroName"),
    1871              TraceLoggingValue(Version, "version"),
    1872              TraceLoggingValue(result, "result"));
    1873      });
    1874  
    1875      try
    1876      {
    1877          ULONG deleteFlags = 0;
    1878          wil::unique_handle userToken = wsl::windows::common::security::GetUserToken(TokenImpersonation);
    1879          auto cleanup = wil::scope_exit_log(WI_DIAGNOSTICS_INFO, [&] {
    1880              auto runAsUser = wil::impersonate_token(userToken.get());
    1881              _DeleteDistribution(configuration, deleteFlags);
    1882          });
    1883  
    1884          bool wroteLf = false;
    1885          size_t lastIndex = -1;
    1886          auto onTarOutput = [&StderrHandle, &wroteLf, &lastIndex](size_t Index, const gsl::span<gsl::byte>& Content) {
    1887              WI_ASSERT(Index == 0 || Index == 1);
    1888              auto it = Content.begin();
    1889  
    1890              while (it != Content.end())
    1891              {
    1892                  if (wroteLf || lastIndex != Index)
    1893                  {
    1894                      if (*it == static_cast<std::byte>('\n') && lastIndex != Index)
    1895                      {
    1896                          it++;
