    1897                          continue;
    1898                      }
    1899  
    1900                      // Add an extra newline if the input index changed to avoid mixing lines.
    1901                      if (lastIndex != Index && !wroteLf)
    1902                      {
    1903                          THROW_IF_WIN32_BOOL_FALSE(WriteFile(StderrHandle, "\n", 1, nullptr, nullptr));
    1904                      }
    1905  
    1906                      THROW_IF_WIN32_BOOL_FALSE(WriteFile(StderrHandle, Index == 0 ? "wsl1: " : "wsl2: ", 6, nullptr, nullptr));
    1907                      wroteLf = false;
    1908                      lastIndex = Index;
    1909                  }
    1910  
    1911                  auto lf = std::find(it, Content.end(), static_cast<std::byte>('\n'));
    1912                  if (lf != Content.end())
    1913                  {
    1914                      lf++;
    1915                      wroteLf = true;
    1916                  }
    1917  
    1918                  THROW_IF_WIN32_BOOL_FALSE(WriteFile(StderrHandle, &*it, static_cast<DWORD>(lf - it), nullptr, nullptr));
    1919  
    1920                  it = lf;
    1921              }
    1922          };
    1923  
    1924          wil::unique_handle clientProcess = wsl::windows::common::wslutil::OpenCallingProcess(GENERIC_READ | SYNCHRONIZE);
    1925          std::string commandLine{LXSS_BSDTAR_PATH};
    1926          ULONG newFlags = configuration.Flags;
    1927          if (Version == LXSS_WSL_VERSION_1)
    1928          {
    1929              auto policiesKey = wsl::windows::policies::OpenPoliciesKey();
    1930              if (!wsl::windows::policies::IsFeatureAllowed(policiesKey.get(), wsl::windows::policies::c_allowWSL1))
    1931              {
    1932                  THROW_HR_WITH_USER_ERROR(WSL_E_WSL1_DISABLED, wsl::shared::Localization::MessageWSL1Disabled());
    1933              }
    1934  
    1935              auto rootfsPath = configuration.BasePath / LXSS_ROOTFS_DIRECTORY;
    1936  
    1937              // Ensure the target directory is empty and create the root filesystem.
    1938              {
    1939                  std::lock_guard lock(m_instanceLock);
    1940                  {
    1941                      auto runAsUser = wil::impersonate_token(userToken.get());
    1942                      _DeleteDistributionLockHeld(configuration, LXSS_DELETE_DISTRO_FLAGS_ROOTFS);
    1943                  }
    1944  
    1945                  wsl::windows::common::filesystem::CreateRootFs(rootfsPath.c_str(), configuration.Version);
    1946                  deleteFlags = LXSS_DELETE_DISTRO_FLAGS_ROOTFS;
    1947              }
    1948  
    1949              // Create a utility VM to create the tar file and output it via a
    1950              // socket.
    1951              auto vmContext = _RunUtilityVmSetup(configuration, LxMiniInitMessageExport, 0, true);
    1952  
    1953              auto wsl1Pipe = wsl::windows::common::wslutil::OpenAnonymousPipe(LX_RELAY_BUFFER_SIZE, true, true);
    1954  
    1955              wsl::windows::common::relay::ScopedMultiRelay stdErrRelay(
    1956                  std::vector<HANDLE>{wsl1Pipe.first.get(), reinterpret_cast<HANDLE>(vmContext.errorSocket.get())}, onTarOutput);
    1957  
    1958              // Add mounts for the rootfs and tools.
    1959              auto mounts = _CreateSetupMounts(configuration);
    1960  
    1961              if (m_utilityVm->GetConfig().SetVersionDebug)
    1962              {
    1963                  commandLine += " -vv --totals";
    1964              }
    1965  
    1966              // Run the bsdtar elf binary expand the tar file using the socket as stdin.
    1967              commandLine += " -C " LXSS_ROOTFS_MOUNT LXSS_BSDTAR_EXTRACT_ARGS;
    1968              auto elfContext = _RunElfBinary(
    1969                  commandLine.c_str(),
    1970                  configuration.BasePath.c_str(),
    1971                  clientProcess.get(),
    1972                  reinterpret_cast<HANDLE>(vmContext.tarSocket.get()),
    1973                  nullptr,
    1974                  wsl1Pipe.second.get(),
    1975                  mounts.data(),
    1976                  static_cast<ULONG>(mounts.size()));
    1977  
    1978              wsl1Pipe.second.reset();
    1979  
    1980              // Wait for the utility VM to finish creating the tar and ensure that
    1981              // the export was successful.
    1982              LONG exitStatus = 1;
    1983              vmContext.instance->GetInitPort()->Receive(&exitStatus, sizeof(exitStatus), clientProcess.get());
    1984              THROW_HR_IF(WSL_E_EXPORT_FAILED, (exitStatus != 0));
    1985  
    1986              // Wait for the elf binary to finish expanding the tar and ensure
    1987              // that it was successful.
    1988              exitStatus = _GetElfExitStatus(elfContext);
    1989              THROW_HR_IF(WSL_E_IMPORT_FAILED, exitStatus != 0);
    1990  
    1991              // Import from the vhd was successful.
    1992              deleteFlags = LXSS_DELETE_DISTRO_FLAGS_VHD | LXSS_DELETE_DISTRO_FLAGS_WSLG_SHORTCUTS;
    1993              WI_ClearFlag(newFlags, LXSS_DISTRO_FLAGS_VM_MODE);
    1994          }
    1995          else
    1996          {
    1997              {
    1998                  std::lock_guard lock(m_instanceLock);
    1999                  _CreateVm();
    2000              }
    2001  
    2002              // Create a vhd to store the root filesystem.
    2003              {
    2004                  auto runAsUser = wil::impersonate_token(userToken.get());
    2005                  wsl::core::filesystem::CreateVhd(
    2006                      configuration.VhdFilePath.c_str(),
    2007                      m_utilityVm->GetConfig().VhdSizeBytes,
    2008                      GetUserSid(),
    2009                      m_utilityVm->GetConfig().EnableSparseVhd,
    2010                      false);
    2011  
    2012                  deleteFlags = LXSS_DELETE_DISTRO_FLAGS_VHD;
    2013              }
    2014  
    2015              // Create a process in the utility VM to expand the tar file from a socket.
    2016              auto vmContext = _RunUtilityVmSetup(configuration, LxMiniInitMessageImport, 0, true);
    2017  
    2018              auto wsl1Pipe = wsl::windows::common::wslutil::OpenAnonymousPipe(LX_RELAY_BUFFER_SIZE, true, true);
    2019  
    2020              wsl::windows::common::relay::ScopedMultiRelay stdErrRelay(
    2021                  std::vector<HANDLE>{wsl1Pipe.first.get(), reinterpret_cast<HANDLE>(vmContext.errorSocket.get())}, onTarOutput);
    2022  
    2023              // Add mounts for the rootfs and tools.
    2024              auto mounts = _CreateSetupMounts(configuration);
    2025  
    2026              if (m_utilityVm->GetConfig().SetVersionDebug)
    2027              {
    2028                  commandLine += " -vv --totals";
    2029              }
    2030  
    2031              // Run the bsdtar elf binary to create the tar file using the socket as stdout.
    2032              commandLine += " -C " LXSS_ROOTFS_MOUNT LXSS_BSDTAR_CREATE_ARGS;
    2033              auto elfContext = _RunElfBinary(
    2034                  commandLine.c_str(),
    2035                  configuration.BasePath.c_str(),
    2036                  clientProcess.get(),
    2037                  nullptr,
    2038                  reinterpret_cast<HANDLE>(vmContext.tarSocket.get()),
    2039                  wsl1Pipe.second.get(),
    2040                  mounts.data(),
    2041                  static_cast<ULONG>(mounts.size()));
    2042  
    2043              wsl1Pipe.second.reset();
    2044  
    2045              LONG exitStatus = _GetElfExitStatus(elfContext);
    2046              THROW_HR_IF(WSL_E_IMPORT_FAILED, exitStatus != 0);
    2047  
    2048              // Close the socket now that all data has been written.
    2049              vmContext.tarSocket.reset();
    2050  
    2051              // Wait for the utility VM to finish expanding the tar and ensure that
    2052              // the export was successful.
    2053              auto* channel = dynamic_cast<WslCoreInstance::WslCorePort*>(vmContext.instance->GetInitPort().get());
    2054  
    2055              gsl::span<gsl::byte> span;
    2056              const auto& message = channel->GetChannel().ReceiveMessage<LX_MINI_INIT_IMPORT_RESULT>(&span);
    2057              THROW_HR_IF(E_FAIL, (message.Result != 0));
    2058  
    2059              if (message.FlavorIndex > 0)
    2060              {
    2061                  configuration.Flavor = wsl::shared::string::MultiByteToWide(wsl::shared::string::FromSpan(span, message.FlavorIndex));
    2062                  registration.Write(Property::Flavor, configuration.Flavor.c_str());
    2063              }
    2064  
    2065              if (message.VersionIndex > 0)
    2066              {
    2067                  configuration.OsVersion = wsl::shared::string::MultiByteToWide(wsl::shared::string::FromSpan(span, message.VersionIndex));
    2068                  registration.Write(Property::OsVersion, configuration.OsVersion.c_str());
    2069              }
    2070  
    2071              // Operation was successful.
    2072              deleteFlags = LXSS_DELETE_DISTRO_FLAGS_ROOTFS;
    2073              WI_SetFlag(newFlags, LXSS_DISTRO_FLAGS_VM_MODE);
    2074          }
    2075  
    2076          // Record the new distribution state.
    2077          registration.Write(Property::Flags, newFlags);
    2078  
    2079          result = S_OK;
    2080      }
    2081      catch (...)
    2082      {
    2083          result = wil::ResultFromCaughtException();
    2084      }
    2085  
    2086      return result;
    2087  }
    2088  
    2089  HRESULT LxssUserSessionImpl::Shutdown(_In_ bool PreventNewInstances, ShutdownBehavior Behavior)
    2090  {
    2091      try
    2092      {
    2093          auto forceTerminate = [this]() {
    2094              auto vmId = m_vmId.load();
    2095              if (!IsEqualGUID(vmId, GUID_NULL))
    2096              {
    2097                  auto vmIdStr = wsl::shared::string::GuidToString<wchar_t>(vmId, wsl::shared::string::GuidToStringFlags::Uppercase);
    2098  
    2099                  auto result = wil::ResultFromException([&]() {
    2100                      auto computeSystem = wsl::windows::common::hcs::OpenComputeSystem(vmIdStr.c_str(), GENERIC_ALL);
    2101                      wsl::windows::common::hcs::TerminateComputeSystem(computeSystem.get());
    2102                  });
    2103  
    2104                  WSL_LOG("ForceTerminateVm", TraceLoggingValue(result, "Result"));
    2105              }
    2106          };
    2107  
    2108          // If the user asks for a forced termination, kill the VM
    2109          if (Behavior == ShutdownBehavior::Force)
    2110          {
    2111              forceTerminate();
    2112          }
    2113  
    2114          {
    2115              bool locked = false;
    2116              auto unlock = wil::scope_exit_log(WI_DIAGNOSTICS_INFO, [this, &locked]() {
    2117                  if (locked)
    2118                  {
    2119                      m_instanceLock.unlock();
    2120                  }
    2121              });
    2122  
    2123              if (Behavior == ShutdownBehavior::ForceAfter30Seconds)
    2124              {
    2125                  if (m_instanceLock.try_lock_for(std::chrono::seconds(30)))
    2126                  {
    2127                      locked = true;
    2128                  }
    2129                  else
    2130                  {
    2131                      WSL_LOG("VmShutdownLockTimedOut");
    2132                      forceTerminate();
    2133                  }
    2134              }
    2135  
    2136              if (!locked)
    2137              {
    2138                  m_instanceLock.lock();
    2139                  locked = true;
    2140              }
    2141  
    2142              // Stop each instance with the lock held.
    2143              while (!m_runningInstances.empty())
    2144              {
    2145                  _TerminateInstanceInternal(&m_runningInstances.begin()->first, false);
    2146              }
    2147  
    2148              // Terminate the utility VM.
    2149              _VmTerminate();
    2150  
    2151              // Reset the proxy state.
    2152              // We don't clear it in _VMTerminate because we want to cache results if possible.
    2153              m_httpProxyStateTracker.reset();
    2154  
    2155              // Clear any attached disk state.
    2156              // This is needed because wsl --shutdown might be called after the vm
    2157              // has timed out (and so the disks states would have been written in the registry)
    2158              const auto key = wsl::windows::common::registry::OpenOrCreateLxssDiskMountsKey(&m_userSid.Sid);
    2159              wsl::windows::common::registry::ClearSubkeys(key.get());
    2160  
    2161              WI_ASSERT(!PreventNewInstances || !m_disableNewInstanceCreation);
    2162  
    2163              // This is used when the session is being deleted.
    2164              // This is in place to prevent a CreateInstance() call from succeeding
    2165              // after the session is shut down since this would mean that the destructor,
    2166              // which could run on that thread (if the session already dropped its LxssUserSessionImpl reference)
    2167              // would have to do all the cleanup work.
    2168              m_disableNewInstanceCreation = PreventNewInstances;
    2169          }
    2170  
    2171          auto lock = m_terminatedInstanceLock.lock_exclusive();
    2172          m_terminatedInstances.clear();
    2173      }
    2174      CATCH_LOG()
    2175  
    2176      return S_OK;
    2177  }
    2178  
    2179  void LxssUserSessionImpl::TelemetryWorker(_In_ wil::unique_socket&& socket) const
    2180  try
    2181  {
    2182      wsl::windows::common::wslutil::SetThreadDescription(L"Telemetry");
    2183  
    2184      wsl::shared::SocketChannel channel(std::move(socket), "Telemetry", m_vmTerminating.get());
    2185  
    2186      // Check if drvfs notifications are enabled for the user.
    2187      bool drvFsNotifications{};
    2188      {
    2189          auto impersonate = wil::impersonate_token(m_userToken.get());
    2190          const auto lxssKey = wsl::windows::common::registry::OpenLxssUserKey();
    2191          drvFsNotifications =
    2192              wsl::windows::common::registry::ReadDword(lxssKey.get(), LXSS_NOTIFICATIONS_KEY, LXSS_NOTIFICATION_DRVFS_PERF_DISABLED, 0) == 0;
    2193      }
    2194  
    2195      // Aggregate information about what is running inside the VM. This is logged
    2196      // periodically because logging each event individually would be too noisy.
    2197      for (;;)
    2198      {
    2199          auto [Message, Span] = channel.ReceiveMessageOrClosed<LX_MINI_INIT_TELEMETRY_MESSAGE>();
    2200          if (Message == nullptr)
    2201          {
    2202              break;
    2203          }
    2204  
    2205          std::map<std::string, size_t> events{};
    2206  
    2207          std::string content = wsl::shared::string::FromSpan(Span, offsetof(LX_MINI_INIT_TELEMETRY_MESSAGE, Buffer));
    2208          auto values = wsl::shared::string::Split<char>(content, '/');
    2209  
    2210          THROW_HR_IF(E_UNEXPECTED, values.size() % 2 != 0);
    2211  
    2212          // Periodically log an event to track active WSL usage. This event must be marked as
    2213          // 'MICROSOFT_KEYWORD_CRITICAL_DATA' and not MICROSOFT_KEYWORD_MEASURES.
    2214          //
    2215          // N.B. The count and imageName values are unused but required because they were present in the approved critical event.
    2216          WSL_LOG(
    2217              "ExecCritical",
    2218              TelemetryPrivacyDataTag(PDT_ProductAndServiceUsage),
    2219              TraceLoggingKeyword(MICROSOFT_KEYWORD_CRITICAL_DATA),
    2220              TraceLoggingValue(0, "count"),
    2221              TraceLoggingValue("", "imageName"),
    2222              TraceLoggingLevel(WINEVENT_LEVEL_INFO));
    2223  
    2224          for (size_t i = 0; i < values.size(); i += 2)
    2225          {
    2226              // Log an aggregated account of the binary names run in WSL and their counts, used to determine popular use cases and prioritize support for issues
    2227              WSL_LOG_TELEMETRY(
    2228                  "Exec",
    2229                  PDT_ProductAndServiceUsage,
    2230                  TraceLoggingValue(std::stoull(values[i + 1]), "count"),
    2231                  TraceLoggingValue(values[i].c_str(), "imageName"),
    2232                  TraceLoggingLevel(WINEVENT_LEVEL_INFO));
    2233          }
    2234  
    2235          if (drvFsNotifications && Message->ShowDrvFsNotification && !values.empty())
    2236          {
    2237              // If a drvfs notification is requested, the first entry is the executable that triggered it.
    2238              LOG_IF_FAILED(wsl::windows::common::notifications::DisplayFilesystemNotification(values[0].c_str()));
    2239              drvFsNotifications = false;
    2240          }
    2241      }
    2242  }
    2243  CATCH_LOG()
    2244  
    2245  _Requires_lock_not_held_(m_instanceLock)
    2246  void LxssUserSessionImpl::TerminateByClientId(_In_ ULONG ClientId)
    2247  {
    2248      if (ClientId == LXSS_CLIENT_ID_INVALID)
    2249      {
    2250          return;
    2251      }
    2252  
    2253      std::lock_guard lock(m_instanceLock);
    2254      TerminateByClientIdLockHeld(ClientId);
    2255  }
    2256  
    2257  _Requires_lock_held_(m_instanceLock)
    2258  void LxssUserSessionImpl::TerminateByClientIdLockHeld(_In_ ULONG ClientId)
    2259  {
    2260      // Terminate any instances with a matching client ID.
    2261      std::vector<GUID> instances;
    2262      std::for_each(m_runningInstances.begin(), m_runningInstances.end(), [&](auto& pair) {
    2263          auto id = pair.second->GetClientId();
    2264          if ((id == ClientId) || ((ClientId == LXSS_CLIENT_ID_WILDCARD) && (id != LXSS_CLIENT_ID_INVALID)))
    2265          {
    2266              instances.push_back(pair.first);
    2267          }
    2268      });
    2269  
    2270      std::for_each(instances.begin(), instances.end(), [&](auto& guid) { _TerminateInstanceInternal(&guid, false); });
    2271  
    2272      // If the wildcard client ID was specified, the utility VM unexpectedly exited.
    2273      if (ClientId == LXSS_CLIENT_ID_WILDCARD)
    2274      {
    2275          _VmTerminate();
    2276      }
    2277  }
    2278  
    2279  HRESULT LxssUserSessionImpl::TerminateDistribution(_In_opt_ LPCGUID DistroGuid)
    2280  try
    2281  {
    2282      const wil::unique_hkey lxssKey = s_OpenLxssUserKey();
    2283      GUID defaultDistro;
    2284      {
    2285          std::lock_guard lock(m_instanceLock);
    2286  
    2287          // If no distribution GUID was supplied, use the default.
    2288          if (ARGUMENT_PRESENT(DistroGuid) == FALSE)
    2289          {
    2290              defaultDistro = _GetDefaultDistro(lxssKey.get());
    2291              DistroGuid = &defaultDistro;
    2292          }
    2293  
    2294          _TerminateInstanceInternal(DistroGuid);
    2295      }
    2296  
    2297      return S_OK;
    2298  }
    2299  CATCH_RETURN()
    2300  
    2301  HRESULT LxssUserSessionImpl::UnregisterDistribution(_In_ LPCGUID DistroGuid)
    2302  {
    2303      ExecutionContext context(Context::UnregisterDistro);
    2304  
    2305      // Set up a scope exit member to log unregistration status.
    2306      DistributionRegistration registration;
    2307      LXSS_DISTRO_CONFIGURATION configuration{};
    2308      HRESULT result = E_FAIL;
    2309      auto unregisterExit = wil::scope_exit([&] {
    2310          // Only log the end event if a distro was found.
    2311          if (configuration.Name.size() > 0)
    2312          {
    2313              WSL_LOG(
    2314                  "UnregisterDistributionEnd",
    2315                  TraceLoggingValue(configuration.Name.c_str(), "name"),
    2316                  TraceLoggingHexUInt32(result, "result"));
    2317          }
    2318      });
    2319  
    2320      try
    2321      {
    2322          wil::unique_hkey lxssKey = s_OpenLxssUserKey();
    2323  
    2324          // Set up a scope exit lambda to delete the distribution registry key
    2325          // when the function exits.
    2326          auto removedDistroString = wsl::shared::string::GuidToString<wchar_t>(*DistroGuid);
    2327          bool removeDistro = false;
    2328          auto deleteDistroKey = wil::scope_exit([&] {
    2329              if (removeDistro)
    2330              {
    2331                  wsl::windows::common::registry::DeleteKey(lxssKey.get(), removedDistroString.c_str());
    2332              }
    2333          });
    2334  
    2335          {
    2336              std::lock_guard lock(m_instanceLock);
    2337  
    2338              // Get the configuration information about the distribution.
    2339              registration = DistributionRegistration::Open(lxssKey.get(), *DistroGuid);
    2340              configuration = s_GetDistributionConfiguration(registration);
    2341  
    2342              // Log telemetry about the distribution being removed.
    2343              WSL_LOG_TELEMETRY(
    2344                  "UnregisterDistributionBegin", PDT_ProductAndServiceUsage, TraceLoggingValue(configuration.Name.c_str(), "name"));
    2345  
    2346              // Ensure that a filesystem export is not in progress.
    2347              _EnsureNotLocked(DistroGuid);
    2348  
    2349              // After this point the distribution registry key should be deleted.
    2350              removeDistro = true;
    2351  
    2352              // Terminate the distribution and mark it as uninstalling.
    2353              _TerminateInstanceInternal(DistroGuid);
    2354              registration.Write(Property::State, LxssDistributionStateUninstalling);
    2355  
    2356              // If the default distribution has been unregistered, search for another
    2357              // distribution to set as the new default.
    2358  
    2359              auto defaultDistribution = DistributionRegistration::OpenDefault(lxssKey.get());
    2360              if (defaultDistribution.has_value() && IsEqualGUID(defaultDistribution->Id(), registration.Id()))
    2361              {
    2362                  // Remove the old default.
    2363                  DistributionRegistration::DeleteDefault(lxssKey.get());
    2364  
    2365                  // If there are any other registered distributions, set the first
    2366                  // one found to the new default.
    2367                  auto distributions = _EnumerateDistributions(lxssKey.get());
    2368                  if (distributions.size() > 0)
    2369                  {
    2370                      DistributionRegistration::SetDefault(lxssKey.get(), distributions[0]);
    2371                  }
    2372              }
    2373  
    2374              {
    2375                  auto runAsUser = wil::CoImpersonateClient();
    2376                  _DeleteDistributionLockHeld(configuration);
    2377              }
    2378  
    2379              WslOfflineDistributionInformation distributionInfo;
    2380              distributionInfo.Id = configuration.DistroId;
    2381              distributionInfo.Name = configuration.Name.c_str();
    2382              distributionInfo.PackageFamilyName = configuration.PackageFamilyName.c_str();
    2383              distributionInfo.Flavor = configuration.Flavor.empty() ? nullptr : configuration.Flavor.c_str();
    2384              distributionInfo.Version = configuration.OsVersion.empty() ? nullptr : configuration.OsVersion.c_str();
    2385  
    2386              m_pluginManager.OnDistributionUnregistered(&m_session, &distributionInfo);
    2387          }
    2388  
    2389          result = S_OK;
    2390      }
    2391      catch (...)
    2392      {
    2393          result = wil::ResultFromCaughtException();
    2394      }
    2395  
    2396      return result;
    2397  }
    2398  
    2399  _Requires_lock_held_(m_instanceLock)
    2400  void LxssUserSessionImpl::_ConversionBegin(_In_ GUID DistroGuid, _In_ LxssDistributionState State)
    2401  {
    2402      _EnsureNotLocked(&DistroGuid);
    2403      _TerminateInstanceInternal(&DistroGuid);
    2404      m_lockedDistributions.emplace_back(DistroGuid, State);
    2405  }
    2406  
    2407  _Requires_lock_not_held_(m_instanceLock)
    2408  void LxssUserSessionImpl::_ConversionComplete(_In_ GUID DistroGuid)
    2409  {
    2410      std::lock_guard lock(m_instanceLock);
    2411      std::erase_if(m_lockedDistributions, [&](const auto& pair) { return (IsEqualGUID(pair.first, DistroGuid)); });
    2412  
    2413      _VmCheckIdle();
    2414  }
    2415  
    2416  _Requires_exclusive_lock_held_(m_instanceLock)
    2417  void LxssUserSessionImpl::_CreateLegacyRegistration(_In_ HKEY LxssKey, _In_ HANDLE UserToken)
    2418  {
    2419      // Delete any existing legacy registration.
    2420      const auto distroGuidString = wsl::shared::string::GuidToString<wchar_t>(LXSS_LEGACY_DISTRO_GUID);
    2421      wsl::windows::common::registry::DeleteKey(LxssKey, distroGuidString.c_str());
    2422  
    2423      // Migrate legacy default user configuration.
    2424      const ULONG defaultUid = wsl::windows::common::registry::ReadDword(LxssKey, nullptr, WSL_DISTRO_CONFIG_DEFAULT_UID, LX_UID_ROOT);
    2425      DWORD configFlags = LXSS_DISTRO_FLAGS_DEFAULT;
    2426      DWORD enabled = wsl::windows::common::registry::ReadDword(LxssKey, nullptr, LXSS_LEGACY_APPEND_NT_PATH, 1);
    2427      WI_ClearFlagIf(configFlags, LXSS_DISTRO_FLAGS_APPEND_NT_PATH, (enabled == 0));
    2428      enabled = wsl::windows::common::registry::ReadDword(LxssKey, nullptr, LXSS_LEGACY_INTEROP_ENABLED, 1);
    2429      WI_ClearFlagIf(configFlags, LXSS_DISTRO_FLAGS_ENABLE_INTEROP, (enabled == 0));
    2430  
    2431      // Create a new registration for the legacy distro.
    2432      const auto basePath = wsl::windows::common::filesystem::GetLegacyBasePath(UserToken);
    2433  
    2434      DistributionRegistration::Create(
    2435          LxssKey, LXSS_LEGACY_DISTRO_GUID, LXSS_LEGACY_INSTALL_NAME, LXSS_DISTRO_VERSION_LEGACY, basePath.c_str(), configFlags, defaultUid, nullptr, LXSS_VM_MODE_VHD_NAME, false);
    2436  
    2437      _SetDistributionInstalled(LxssKey, LXSS_LEGACY_DISTRO_GUID);
    2438  }
    2439  
    2440  std::vector<wsl::windows::common::filesystem::unique_lxss_addmount> LxssUserSessionImpl::_CreateSetupMounts(_In_ const LXSS_DISTRO_CONFIGURATION& Configuration)
    2441  {
    2442      // Add a rootfs mount.
    2443      auto runAsUser = wil::CoImpersonateClient();
    2444      const auto rootFsPath = Configuration.BasePath / LXSS_ROOTFS_DIRECTORY;
    2445      std::vector<wsl::windows::common::filesystem::unique_lxss_addmount> mounts;
    2446      mounts.emplace_back(wsl::windows::common::filesystem::CreateMount(
    2447          rootFsPath.c_str(), LXSS_ROOTFS_DIRECTORY, LXSS_ROOTFS_MOUNT, LXSS_DISTRO_USES_WSL_FS(Configuration.Version) ? LXSS_FS_TYPE_WSLFS : LXSS_FS_TYPE_LXFS, 0755));
    2448  
    2449      // Add a read only sharefs mount to the inbox tools directory which contains the bsdtar binary.
    2450      std::wstring systemDirectory;
    2451      THROW_IF_FAILED(wil::GetSystemDirectoryW(systemDirectory));
    2452  
    2453      // Add a read only sharefs mount to the packaged tools directory which contains the init binary.
    2454      const auto initPath = wsl::windows::common::wslutil::GetBasePath() / L"tools";
    2455      mounts.emplace_back(wsl::windows::common::filesystem::CreateMount(
    2456          initPath.c_str(), initPath.c_str(), LXSS_TOOLS_MOUNT, LXSS_FS_TYPE_SHAREFS, 0755, false));
    2457  
    2458      return mounts;
    2459  }
    2460  
    2461  _Requires_lock_not_held_(m_instanceLock)
    2462  std::shared_ptr<LxssRunningInstance> LxssUserSessionImpl::_CreateInstance(_In_opt_ LPCGUID DistroGuid, _In_ ULONG Flags)
    2463  {
    2464      ExecutionContext context(Context::CreateInstance);
    2465  
    2466      // Validate flags.
    2467      THROW_HR_IF(E_INVALIDARG, (WI_IsAnyFlagSet(Flags, ~LXSS_CREATE_INSTANCE_FLAGS_ALL)));
    2468  
    2469      // Clear the list of terminated instances before acquiring the instance
    2470      // list lock.
    2471      {
    2472          auto lock = m_terminatedInstanceLock.lock_exclusive();
    2473          m_terminatedInstances.clear();
    2474      }
    2475  
    2476      wil::unique_hkey lxssKey = s_OpenLxssUserKey();
    2477      DistributionRegistration registration;
    2478      wil::unique_handle userToken = wsl::windows::common::security::GetUserToken(TokenImpersonation);
    2479  
    2480      std::shared_ptr<LxssRunningInstance> instance;
    2481      {
    2482          std::lock_guard lock(m_instanceLock);
    2483  
    2484          // m_disableNewInstanceCreation is set when the session is being deleted.
    2485          // In that code path, don't create a new session.
    2486          THROW_HR_IF(RPC_E_DISCONNECTED, m_disableNewInstanceCreation);
    2487  
    2488          registration = DistributionRegistration::OpenOrDefault(lxssKey.get(), DistroGuid);
    2489  
    2490          // Check if an instance is already running for this distribution, if
    2491          // not create one.
    2492          instance = _RunningInstance(&registration.Id());
    2493          if (!instance)
    2494          {
    2495              THROW_HR_IF(E_NOT_SET, WI_IsFlagSet(Flags, LXSS_CREATE_INSTANCE_FLAGS_OPEN_EXISTING));
    2496  
    2497              // Query information about the distribution.
    2498              auto configuration = s_GetDistributionConfiguration(registration);
    2499              auto defaultUid = registration.Read(Property::DefaultUid);
    2500  
    2501              THROW_HR_IF(E_ILLEGAL_STATE_CHANGE, (configuration.State != LxssDistributionStateInstalled));
    2502  
    2503              // Determine the distribution version.
    2504              ULONG version = WI_IsFlagSet(configuration.Flags, LXSS_DISTRO_FLAGS_VM_MODE) ? LXSS_WSL_VERSION_2 : LXSS_WSL_VERSION_1;
    2505  
    2506              // Create a GUID for the instance.
    2507              GUID instanceId;
    2508              THROW_IF_FAILED(CoCreateGuid(&instanceId));
    2509  
    2510              // Log telemetry to determine how long instance creation takes.
    2511              WSL_LOG_TELEMETRY(
    2512                  "CreateInstanceBegin",
    2513                  PDT_ProductAndServicePerformance,
    2514                  TraceLoggingValue(configuration.Name.c_str(), "distroName"),
    2515                  TraceLoggingValue(version, "version"),
    2516                  TraceLoggingValue(instanceId, "instanceId"));
    2517  
    2518              HRESULT result = E_UNEXPECTED;
    2519  
    2520              auto createEnd = wil::scope_exit_log(WI_DIAGNOSTICS_INFO, [&] {
    2521                  WSL_LOG_TELEMETRY(
    2522                      "CreateInstanceEnd",
    2523                      PDT_ProductAndServicePerformance,
    2524                      TraceLoggingValue(configuration.Name.c_str(), "distroName"),
    2525                      TraceLoggingValue(version, "version"),
    2526                      TraceLoggingValue(instanceId, "instanceId"),
    2527                      TraceLoggingValue(SUCCEEDED(result), "success"),
    2528                      TraceLoggingValue(result, "error"));
    2529              });
    2530  
    2531              try
    2532              {
    2533                  auto clientKey = m_lifetimeManager.GetRegistrationId();
    2534                  if (version == LXSS_WSL_VERSION_1)
    2535                  {
    2536                      auto key = wsl::windows::policies::OpenPoliciesKey();
    2537                      if (!wsl::windows::policies::IsFeatureAllowed(key.get(), wsl::windows::policies::c_allowWSL1))
    2538                      {
    2539                          THROW_HR_WITH_USER_ERROR(
    2540                              WSL_E_WSL1_DISABLED,
    2541                              wsl::shared::Localization::MessageWSL1Disabled() + L"\n" +
    2542                                  wsl::shared::Localization::MessageUpgradeToWSL2(configuration.Name));
    2543                      }
    2544  
    2545                      instance = std::make_shared<LxssInstance>(
    2546                          instanceId,
    2547                          configuration,
    2548                          defaultUid,
    2549                          clientKey,
    2550                          std::bind(s_TerminateInstance, this, registration.Id(), false),
    2551                          std::bind(s_UpdateInit, this, configuration),
    2552                          Flags,
    2553                          _GetResultantConfig(userToken.get()).InstanceIdleTimeout);
    2554                  }
    2555                  else
    2556                  {
    2557                      // Ensure the VM has been created.
    2558                      _CreateVm();
    2559                      instance = m_utilityVm->CreateInstance(
    2560                          instanceId, configuration, LxMiniInitMessageLaunchInit, m_utilityVm->GetConfig().KernelBootTimeout, defaultUid, clientKey);
    2561                  }
    2562  
    2563                  // Log telemetry to determine how long initialization takes.
    2564                  WSL_LOG(
    2565                      "InitializeInstanceBegin",
    2566                      TraceLoggingValue(configuration.Name.c_str(), "distroName"),
    2567                      TraceLoggingValue(version, "version"),
    2568                      TraceLoggingValue(instanceId, "instanceId"));
    2569  
    2570                  auto initializeEnd = wil::scope_exit_log(WI_DIAGNOSTICS_INFO, [&] {
    2571                      WSL_LOG(
    2572                          "InitializeInstanceEnd",
    2573                          TraceLoggingKeyword(MICROSOFT_KEYWORD_CRITICAL_DATA),
    2574                          TraceLoggingValue(configuration.Name.c_str(), "distroName"),
    2575                          TraceLoggingValue(version, "version"),
    2576                          TraceLoggingValue(instanceId, "instanceId"));
    2577                  });
    2578  
    2579                  // Initialize the instance and add it to the list of running instances.
    2580                  instance->Initialize();
    2581  
    2582                  const auto* distributionInfo = instance->DistributionInformation();
    2583                  if (distributionInfo->Flavor != nullptr && distributionInfo->Flavor != configuration.Flavor)
    2584                  {
    2585                      WSL_LOG(
    2586                          "DistributionFlavorChange",
    2587                          TraceLoggingValue(distributionInfo->Flavor, "NewFlavor"),
    2588                          TraceLoggingValue(configuration.Flavor.c_str(), "OldFlavor"),
    2589                          TraceLoggingValue(configuration.Name.c_str(), "distroName"),
    2590                          TraceLoggingValue(instanceId, "instanceId"));
    2591  
    2592                      registration.Write(Property::Flavor, distributionInfo->Flavor);
    2593                  }
    2594  
    2595                  if (distributionInfo->Version != nullptr && distributionInfo->Version != configuration.OsVersion)
    2596                  {
    2597                      WSL_LOG(
    2598                          "DistributionVersionChange",
    2599                          TraceLoggingValue(distributionInfo->Version, "NewVersion"),
    2600                          TraceLoggingValue(configuration.OsVersion.c_str(), "OldVersion"),
    2601                          TraceLoggingValue(configuration.Name.c_str(), "distroName"),
    2602                          TraceLoggingValue(instanceId, "instanceId"));
    2603  
    2604                      registration.Write(Property::OsVersion, distributionInfo->Version);
    2605                  }
    2606  
    2607                  // This needs to be done before plugins are notifed because they might try to run a command inside the distribution.
    2608                  m_runningInstances[registration.Id()] = instance;
    2609  
    2610                  if (version == LXSS_WSL_VERSION_2)
    2611                  {
    2612                      auto cleanupOnFailure =
    2613                          wil::scope_exit_log(WI_DIAGNOSTICS_INFO, [&]() { m_runningInstances.erase(registration.Id()); });
    2614                      m_pluginManager.OnDistributionStarted(&m_session, instance->DistributionInformation());
    2615                      cleanupOnFailure.release();
    2616                  }
    2617  
    2618                  result = S_OK;
    2619              }
    2620              catch (...)
    2621              {
    2622                  result = wil::ResultFromCaughtException();
    2623                  throw;
    2624              }
    2625          }
    2626      }
    2627  
    2628      // Register the Plan 9 Redirector connection targets for the calling user if necessary.
    2629      // N.B. Normally this is only necessary when creating the instance, and every subsequent time
    2630      //      it's skipped because the user is already registered. However, in rare cases the
    2631      //      instance is created by the same user but under a different context, with a different
    2632      //      authentication ID, than the user's interactive session. For example, if the instance
    2633      //      was created by a scheduled task. For this reason, ensure that the calling user is
    2634      //      registered even for already running instances.
    2635      instance->RegisterPlan9ConnectionTarget(userToken.get());
    2636  
    2637      // Determine the idle timeout for the instance. A value of less than zero indicates that the instance
    2638      // should never be idle-terminated.
    2639      if (instance->GetIdleTimeout() >= 0)
    2640      {
    2641          // Register a client termination callback with the lifetime manager. If the
    2642          // ignore client callback flag is specified and there are no other clients,
    2643          // the timer is immediately queued.
    2644          wil::unique_handle currentProcess{};
    2645          if (WI_IsFlagClear(Flags, LXSS_CREATE_INSTANCE_FLAGS_IGNORE_CLIENT))
    2646          {
    2647              currentProcess = wsl::windows::common::wslutil::OpenCallingProcess(GENERIC_READ | SYNCHRONIZE);
    2648          }
    2649  
    2650          m_lifetimeManager.RegisterCallback(
    2651              instance->GetLifetimeManagerId(),
    2652              std::bind(s_TerminateInstance, this, registration.Id(), true),
    2653              currentProcess.get(),
    2654              instance->GetIdleTimeout());
    2655      }
    2656  
    2657      // If the system distro flag was specified, return the system distro for the instance.
    2658      //
    2659      // N.B. The system distro is only supported for WSL2.
    2660      if (WI_IsFlagSet(Flags, LXSS_CREATE_INSTANCE_FLAGS_USE_SYSTEM_DISTRO))
    2661      {
    2662          auto wslCoreInstance = std::dynamic_pointer_cast<WslCoreInstance>(instance);
    2663          THROW_HR_IF(WSL_E_WSL2_NEEDED, !wslCoreInstance);
    2664  
    2665          instance = wslCoreInstance->GetSystemDistro();
    2666          THROW_HR_IF(WSL_E_GUI_APPLICATIONS_DISABLED, !instance);
    2667      }
    2668  
    2669      return instance;
    2670  }
    2671  
    2672  // N.B. This methods expects the caller to impersonate the user.
    2673  void LxssUserSessionImpl::_CreateDistributionShortcut(_In_ LPCWSTR DistributionName, LPCWSTR ShortcutIcon, LPCWSTR ExecutablePath, DistributionRegistration& registration)
    2674  try
    2675  {
    2676      const auto shellLink = wil::CoCreateInstance<IShellLink>(CLSID_ShellLink);
    2677  
    2678      auto shortcutPath = wsl::windows::common::filesystem::GetKnownFolderPath(FOLDERID_StartMenu, KF_FLAG_CREATE);
    2679      shortcutPath /= DistributionName + std::wstring(L".lnk");
    2680  
    2681      THROW_IF_FAILED(shellLink->SetPath(ExecutablePath));
    2682  
    2683      // Construct the command line to set the working directory to the user's home directory.
    2684      const auto commandLine = std::format(
    2685          L"{} {} {} {}", WSL_DISTRIBUTION_ID_ARG, wsl::shared::string::GuidToString<wchar_t>(registration.Id()), WSL_CHANGE_DIRECTORY_ARG, WSL_CWD_HOME);
    2686  
    2687      THROW_IF_FAILED(shellLink->SetArguments(commandLine.c_str()));
    2688      THROW_IF_FAILED(shellLink->SetIconLocation(ShortcutIcon, 0));
    2689  
    2690      auto storage = shellLink.query<IPersistFile>();
    2691      THROW_IF_FAILED(storage->Save(shortcutPath.c_str(), true));
    2692  
    2693      registration.Write(Property::ShortcutPath, shortcutPath.c_str());
    2694  }
    2695  CATCH_LOG();
    2696  
    2697  // N.B. This methods expects the caller to impersonate the user.
    2698  void LxssUserSessionImpl::_CreateTerminalProfile(
    2699      _In_ const std::string_view& Template,
    2700      _In_ _In_ const std::filesystem::path& IconPath,
    2701      _In_ const LXSS_DISTRO_CONFIGURATION& Configuration,
    2702      wsl::windows::service::DistributionRegistration& Registration)
    2703  try
    2704  {
    2705      using namespace wsl::windows::common::string;
    2706      using namespace wsl::windows::common::wslutil;
    2707      using wsl::shared::string::WideToMultiByte;
    2708  
    2709      nlohmann::basic_json json;
    2710      nlohmann::json::iterator profiles;
    2711  
    2712      try
    2713      {
    2714          json = nlohmann::json::parse(Template, nullptr, true, false);
    2715          THROW_HR_IF(E_UNEXPECTED, !json.is_object());
    2716  
    2717          profiles = json.find("profiles");
    2718          THROW_HR_IF(E_UNEXPECTED, profiles == json.end() || !profiles->is_array());
    2719      }
    2720      catch (const nlohmann::json::parse_error& e)
    2721      {
    2722          EMIT_USER_WARNING(wsl::shared::Localization::MessageFailedToParseTerminalProfile(e.what()));
    2723          return;
    2724      }
    2725      catch (...)
    2726      {
    2727          auto error = WideToMultiByte(wsl::windows::common::wslutil::ErrorCodeToString(wil::ResultFromCaughtException()));
    2728          EMIT_USER_WARNING(wsl::shared::Localization::MessageFailedToParseTerminalProfile(error));
    2729          return;
    2730      }
    2731  
    2732      auto distributionIdString = wsl::shared::string::GuidToString<wchar_t>(Registration.Id());
    2733      auto distributionProfileId =
    2734          wsl::shared::string::GuidToString<wchar_t>(CreateV5Uuid(WslTerminalNamespace, std::as_bytes(std::span{distributionIdString})));
    2735  
    2736      auto hideGeneratedProfileGuid = WideToMultiByte(wsl::shared::string::GuidToString<wchar_t>(
    2737          CreateV5Uuid(GeneratedProfilesTerminalNamespace, std::as_bytes(std::span{Configuration.Name}))));
    2738  
    2739      bool foundHideProfile = false;
    2740  
    2741      for (auto& e : *profiles)
    2742      {
    2743          auto updates = e.find("updates");
    2744          if (updates != e.end() && (*updates) == hideGeneratedProfileGuid)
    2745          {
    2746              foundHideProfile = true;
    2747              continue;
    2748          }
    2749  
    2750          std::wstring systemDirectory;
    2751          THROW_IF_FAILED(wil::GetSystemDirectory(systemDirectory));
    2752  
    2753          e["commandline"] =
    2754              WideToMultiByte(std::format(L"{}\\{} {} {}", systemDirectory, WSL_BINARY_NAME, WSL_DISTRIBUTION_ID_ARG, distributionIdString));
    2755  
    2756          e["name"] = WideToMultiByte(Configuration.Name);
    2757          e["guid"] = WideToMultiByte(distributionProfileId);
    2758          e["icon"] = WideToMultiByte(IconPath.native());
    2759  
    2760          // Set default starting directory to home directory if not already specified
    2761          // This allows Windows Terminal to override with startingDirectory setting
    2762          if (e.find("startingDirectory") == e.end())
    2763          {
    2764              e["startingDirectory"] = "~";
    2765          }
    2766  
    2767          // See https://github.com/microsoft/terminal/pull/18195. Supported in terminal >= 1.23
    2768          e["pathTranslationStyle"] = "wsl";
    2769  
    2770          if (!Configuration.Flavor.empty())
    2771          {
    2772              e["wsl.distribution-type"] = WideToMultiByte(Configuration.Flavor);
    2773          }
    2774  
    2775          if (!Configuration.OsVersion.empty())
    2776          {
    2777              e["wsl.distribution-version"] = WideToMultiByte(Configuration.OsVersion);
    2778          }
    2779      }
    2780  
    2781      // Add an entry to hide the autogenerated terminal profile, if not provided by the distribution.
    2782      if (!foundHideProfile)
    2783      {
    2784          nlohmann::json hideProfile{{"updates", hideGeneratedProfileGuid}, {"hidden", true}};
    2785  
    2786          profiles->insert(profiles->begin(), hideProfile);
    2787      }
    2788  
    2789      auto targetFolder = wsl::windows::common::filesystem::GetLocalAppDataPath(nullptr) / L"Microsoft" / L"Windows Terminal" /
    2790                          L"Fragments" / L"Microsoft.WSL";
    2791  
    2792      wil::CreateDirectoryDeep(targetFolder.c_str());
    2793  
    2794      auto tempFilePath = wsl::windows::common::filesystem::GetTempFilename();
    2795      auto targetPath = targetFolder / (distributionProfileId + L".json");
    2796  
    2797      // Unfortunately creating & writing the file isn't atomic.
    2798      // Creating the file somewhere else and then moving it to 'targetPath' isn't an option either, because MoveFile
    2799      // will set its ownership to the Administrators group, which breaks terminal.
    2800      wil::unique_handle file{CreateFile(targetPath.c_str(), GENERIC_WRITE, 0, nullptr, CREATE_ALWAYS, 0, nullptr)};
    2801      THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(!file);
    2802  
    2803      auto cleanup = wil::scope_exit_log(WI_DIAGNOSTICS_INFO, [&]() {
    2804          file.reset();
    2805          DeleteFile(targetPath.c_str());
    2806      });
    2807  
    2808      auto content = json.dump(2);
    2809      THROW_IF_WIN32_BOOL_FALSE(WriteFile(file.get(), content.c_str(), gsl::narrow_cast<DWORD>(content.size()), nullptr, nullptr));
    2810      cleanup.release();
    2811  
    2812      Registration.Write(Property::TerminalProfilePath, targetPath.c_str());
    2813  }
    2814  CATCH_LOG();
    2815  
    2816  _Requires_exclusive_lock_held_(m_instanceLock)
    2817  void LxssUserSessionImpl::_CreateVm()
    2818  {
    2819      ExecutionContext context(Context::CreateVm);
    2820  
    2821      if (!m_utilityVm)
    2822      {
    2823  
    2824          // Return an error if a plugin failed to initialize or needs a newer WSL version.
    2825          // Note: It's better to do this here instead of CreateInstanceForCurrentUser() because we
    2826          // can return a proper error message with the plugin name since we have an execution context here.
    2827          m_pluginManager.ThrowIfFatalPluginError();
    2828  
    2829          const auto userToken = wsl::windows::common::security::GetUserToken(TokenImpersonation);
    2830          auto config = _GetResultantConfig(userToken.get());
    2831  
    2832          // Initialize policies for the plugin interface.
    2833          WSLVmCreationSettings userSettings{};
    2834          WI_SetFlagIf(userSettings.CustomConfigurationFlags, WSLUserConfigurationCustomKernel, !config.KernelPath.empty());
    2835          WI_SetFlagIf(userSettings.CustomConfigurationFlags, WSLUserConfigurationCustomKernelCommandLine, !config.KernelCommandLine.empty());
    2836  
    2837          // Duplicate the passed-in user token and pass it down to plugins.
    2838          THROW_IF_WIN32_BOOL_FALSE(
    2839              ::DuplicateTokenEx(userToken.get(), MAXIMUM_ALLOWED, nullptr, SecurityImpersonation, TokenImpersonation, &m_userToken));
    2840  
    2841          m_session.UserToken = m_userToken.get();
    2842  
    2843          GUID vmId{};
    2844          THROW_IF_FAILED(CoCreateGuid(&vmId));
    2845  
    2846          m_vmId.store(vmId);
    2847  
    2848          // Create the utility VM and register for callbacks.
    2849          m_utilityVm = WslCoreVm::Create(m_userToken, std::move(config), vmId);
    2850  
    2851          if (m_httpProxyStateTracker)
    2852          {
    2853              // this needs to be done after the VM has finished in case we fell back to NAT mode
    2854              m_httpProxyStateTracker->ConfigureNetworkingMode(m_utilityVm->GetConfig().NetworkingMode);
    2855          }
    2856  
    2857          try
    2858          {
    2859              // Mount disks after the system distro vhd is mounted in case filesystem detection is needed.
    2860              _LoadDiskMounts();
    2861  
    2862              // Save the networking settings so they can be reused on the next instantiation.
    2863              m_utilityVm->GetConfig().SaveNetworkingSettings(m_userToken.get());
    2864  
    2865              // If the telemetry is enabled, launch the telemetry agent inside the VM.
    2866              if (m_utilityVm->GetConfig().EnableTelemetry && TraceLoggingProviderEnabled(g_hTraceLoggingProvider, WINEVENT_LEVEL_INFO, 0))
    2867              {
    2868                  LPCSTR Arguments[] = {LX_INIT_TELEMETRY_AGENT, nullptr};
    2869                  auto socket = m_utilityVm->CreateRootNamespaceProcess(LX_INIT_PATH, Arguments);
    2870                  m_telemetryThread = std::thread(&LxssUserSessionImpl::TelemetryWorker, this, std::move(socket));
    2871              }
    2872  
    2873              m_pluginManager.OnVmStarted(&m_session, &userSettings);
    2874          }
    2875          catch (...)
    2876          {
    2877              LOG_CAUGHT_EXCEPTION_MSG("VM failed to start, shutting down.");
    2878  
    2879              _VmTerminate();
    2880              throw;
    2881          }
    2882  
    2883          auto callback = [this](auto Pid) {
    2884              // If the vm is currently being destroyed, the instance lock might be held
    2885              // while WslCoreVm's destructor is waiting on this thread.
    2886              // Cancel the call if the vm destruction is signaled.
    2887              // Note: This is safe because m_instanceLock is always initialized
    2888              // and because WslCoreVm's destructor waits for this thread, the session can't be gone
    2889              // until this callback completes.
    2890  
    2891              auto lock = m_instanceLock.try_lock();
    2892              while (!lock)
    2893              {
    2894                  if (m_vmTerminating.wait(100))
    2895                  {
    2896                      return;
    2897                  }
    2898                  lock = m_instanceLock.try_lock();
    2899              }
    2900  
    2901              auto unlock = wil::scope_exit([&]() { m_instanceLock.unlock(); });
    2902              TerminateByClientIdLockHeld(Pid);
    2903          };
    2904  
    2905          // N.B. The callbacks must be registered outside of the above try/catch.
    2906          // Otherwise if an exception is thrown, calling _VmTerminate() will trigger the 's_VmTerminated' termination callback
    2907          // Which can deadlock since this thread holds the instance lock and HCS can block until the VM termination callback returns before deleting the VM.
    2908  
    2909          m_utilityVm->RegisterCallbacks(std::bind(callback, _1), std::bind(s_VmTerminated, this, _1));
    2910      }
    2911  
    2912      _VmCheckIdle();
    2913  }
    2914  
    2915  _Requires_exclusive_lock_held_(m_instanceLock)
    2916  void LxssUserSessionImpl::_DeleteDistribution(_In_ const LXSS_DISTRO_CONFIGURATION& Configuration, _In_ ULONG Flags)
    2917  {
    2918      std::lock_guard lock(m_instanceLock);
    2919      _DeleteDistributionLockHeld(Configuration, Flags);
    2920  }
    2921  
    2922  // Function signature of the API to remove WSLg start menu shortcuts.
    2923  HRESULT RemoveAppProvider(LPCWSTR);
    2924  
    2925  _Requires_exclusive_lock_held_(m_instanceLock)
    2926  void LxssUserSessionImpl::_DeleteDistributionLockHeld(_In_ const LXSS_DISTRO_CONFIGURATION& Configuration, _In_ ULONG Flags) const
    2927  {
    2928      THROW_HR_IF(E_UNEXPECTED, (WI_IsAnyFlagSet(Flags, ~LXSS_DELETE_DISTRO_FLAGS_ALL)));
    2929  
    2930      // For WSL1 distributions delete rootfs, temp, and the 9p socket.
    2931      std::filesystem::path deletePath{};
    2932      if (WI_IsFlagSet(Flags, LXSS_DELETE_DISTRO_FLAGS_ROOTFS))
    2933      {
    2934          deletePath = Configuration.BasePath / LXSS_ROOTFS_DIRECTORY;
    2935          if (PathFileExistsW(deletePath.c_str()))
    2936          {
    2937              LOG_IF_FAILED(wil::RemoveDirectoryRecursiveNoThrow(deletePath.c_str()));
    2938          }
    2939  
    2940          deletePath = Configuration.BasePath / LXSS_TEMP_DIRECTORY;
    2941          if (PathFileExistsW(deletePath.c_str()))
    2942          {
    2943              LOG_IF_FAILED(wil::RemoveDirectoryRecursiveNoThrow(deletePath.c_str()));
    2944          }
    2945  
    2946          deletePath = Configuration.BasePath / LXSS_PLAN9_UNIX_SOCKET;
    2947          if (PathFileExistsW(deletePath.c_str()))
    2948          {
    2949              LOG_IF_WIN32_BOOL_FALSE(DeleteFileW(deletePath.c_str()));
    2950          }
    2951      }
    2952  
    2953      // For WSL2 distributions, unmount and delete the VHD.
    2954      if (WI_IsFlagSet(Flags, LXSS_DELETE_DISTRO_FLAGS_VHD) || WI_IsFlagSet(Flags, LXSS_DELETE_DISTRO_FLAGS_UNMOUNT))
    2955      {
    2956          if (PathFileExistsW(Configuration.VhdFilePath.c_str()))
    2957          {
    2958              if (m_utilityVm)
    2959              {
    2960                  try
    2961                  {
    2962                      m_utilityVm->EjectVhd(Configuration.VhdFilePath.c_str());
    2963                  }
    2964                  CATCH_LOG()
    2965              }
    2966  
    2967              if (WI_IsFlagSet(Flags, LXSS_DELETE_DISTRO_FLAGS_VHD))
    2968              {
    2969                  LOG_IF_WIN32_BOOL_FALSE(DeleteFileW(Configuration.VhdFilePath.c_str()));
    2970              }
    2971          }
    2972      }
    2973  
    2974      if (WI_IsFlagSet(Flags, LXSS_DELETE_DISTRO_FLAGS_SHORTCUTS))
    2975      {
    2976          // Delete the shortcut icon, if any
    2977          const auto shortcutIconPath = Configuration.BasePath / c_shortIconName;
    2978          if (std::filesystem::exists(shortcutIconPath))
    2979          {
    2980              LOG_IF_WIN32_BOOL_FALSE_MSG(DeleteFileW(shortcutIconPath.c_str()), "Failed to delete %ls", shortcutIconPath.c_str());
    2981          }
    2982  
    2983          // Remove start menu entry for the distribution, if any.
    2984          if (Configuration.ShortcutPath.has_value())
    2985          {
    2986              LOG_IF_WIN32_BOOL_FALSE_MSG(
    2987                  DeleteFileW(Configuration.ShortcutPath->c_str()), "Failed to delete %ls", Configuration.ShortcutPath->c_str());
    2988          }
    2989  
    2990          // Remove the terminal profile, if any.
    2991          try
    2992          {
    2993              const auto lxssKey = wsl::windows::common::registry::OpenLxssUserKey();
    2994              const auto profile = DistributionRegistration::Open(lxssKey.get(), Configuration.DistroId).Read(Property::TerminalProfilePath);
    2995  
    2996              if (profile.has_value())
    2997              {
    2998                  LOG_IF_WIN32_BOOL_FALSE_MSG(DeleteFileW(profile->c_str()), "Failed to delete %ls", profile->c_str());
    2999              }
    3000          }
    3001          CATCH_LOG()
    3002      }
    3003  
    3004      // Remove start menu shortcuts for WSLg applications.
    3005      if (WI_IsFlagSet(Flags, LXSS_DELETE_DISTRO_FLAGS_WSLG_SHORTCUTS))
    3006      {
    3007          try
    3008          {
    3009              const auto dllPath = wsl::windows::common::wslutil::GetBasePath() / WSLG_TS_PLUGIN_DLL;
    3010              static LxssDynamicFunction<decltype(RemoveAppProvider)> removeAppProvider(dllPath.c_str(), "RemoveAppProvider");
    3011              LOG_IF_FAILED(removeAppProvider(Configuration.Name.c_str()));
    3012          }
    3013          CATCH_LOG()
    3014      }
    3015  
    3016      // If the basepath is empty, delete it.
    3017      try
    3018      {
    3019          if (std::filesystem::is_empty(Configuration.BasePath))
    3020          {
    3021              LOG_IF_WIN32_BOOL_FALSE_MSG(
    3022                  RemoveDirectory(Configuration.BasePath.c_str()), "Failed to delete %ls", Configuration.BasePath.c_str());
    3023          }
    3024      }
    3025      CATCH_LOG();
    3026  }
    3027  
    3028  _Requires_exclusive_lock_held_(m_instanceLock)
    3029  std::vector<DistributionRegistration> LxssUserSessionImpl::_EnumerateDistributions(
    3030      _In_ HKEY LxssKey, _In_ bool ListAll, _In_ const std::optional<GUID>& Exclude)
    3031  {
    3032      // Iterate through all subkeys looking for distributions.
    3033      std::vector<DistributionRegistration> distributions;
    3034      std::vector<GUID> orphanedDistributions;
    3035      for (const auto& distro : wsl::windows::common::registry::EnumGuidKeys(LxssKey))
    3036      {
    3037          if (Exclude.has_value() && IsEqualGUID(Exclude.value(), distro.first))
    3038          {
    3039              continue;
    3040          }
    3041  
    3042          // Validate that the distribution's package is still installed.
    3043          if (!_ValidateDistro(LxssKey, &distro.first))
    3044          {
    3045              orphanedDistributions.push_back(distro.first);
    3046              continue;
    3047          }
    3048  
    3049          auto registration = DistributionRegistration::Open(LxssKey, distro.first);
    3050  
    3051          // Add the distribution to the list if the caller requested all, or if
    3052          // it is installed or upgrading.
    3053          const DWORD state = registration.Read(Property::State);
    3054          if ((ListAll) || (state == LxssDistributionStateInstalled))
    3055          {
    3056              distributions.push_back(std::move(registration));
    3057          }
    3058      }
    3059  
    3060      // Unregister each orphaned distribution.
    3061      for (GUID Distro : orphanedDistributions)
    3062      {
    3063          // TODO: This can fail if the registration is broken.
    3064          auto configuration = s_GetDistributionConfiguration(DistributionRegistration::Open(LxssKey, Distro));
    3065          _UnregisterDistributionLockHeld(LxssKey, configuration);
    3066      }
    3067  
    3068      // Ensure that the default distribution is still valid.
    3069      if (!orphanedDistributions.empty())
    3070      {
    3071          try
    3072          {
    3073              _GetDefaultDistro(LxssKey);
    3074          }
    3075          CATCH_LOG()
    3076      }
    3077  
    3078      return distributions;
    3079  }
    3080  
    3081  _Requires_lock_held_(m_instanceLock)
    3082  void LxssUserSessionImpl::_EnsureNotLocked(_In_ LPCGUID DistroGuid, const std::source_location& location)
    3083  {
    3084      const auto found = std::find_if(m_lockedDistributions.begin(), m_lockedDistributions.end(), [&DistroGuid](const auto& entry) {
    3085          return IsEqualGUID(entry.first, *DistroGuid);
    3086      });
    3087  
    3088      THROW_HR_IF_MSG(
    3089          E_ILLEGAL_STATE_CHANGE,
    3090          (found != m_lockedDistributions.end()),
    3091          "%hs, %hs:%u",
    3092          location.function_name(),
    3093          location.file_name(),
    3094          location.line());
    3095  }
    3096  
    3097  _Requires_exclusive_lock_held_(m_instanceLock)
    3098  GUID LxssUserSessionImpl::_GetDefaultDistro(_In_ HKEY LxssKey)
    3099  {
    3100      ExecutionContext context(Context::GetDefaultDistro);
    3101  
    3102      GUID defaultDistroId = {};
    3103      HRESULT result;
    3104      try
    3105      {
    3106          const auto defaultDistro = DistributionRegistration::OpenDefault(LxssKey);
    3107  
    3108          THROW_HR_IF(WSL_E_DEFAULT_DISTRO_NOT_FOUND, !defaultDistro.has_value());
    3109  
    3110          // Ensure that the default distribution is valid.
    3111          if (!_ValidateDistro(LxssKey, &defaultDistro->Id()))
    3112          {
    3113              // Delete the old default distribution.
    3114              DistributionRegistration::DeleteDefault(LxssKey);
    3115  
    3116              const auto configuration = s_GetDistributionConfiguration(defaultDistro.value());
    3117              _UnregisterDistributionLockHeld(LxssKey, configuration);
    3118  
    3119              // Validate remaining WSL distributions, if there are any remaining
    3120              // set the first one found to the new default.
    3121              const auto distros = _EnumerateDistributions(LxssKey);
    3122              THROW_HR_IF(WSL_E_DEFAULT_DISTRO_NOT_FOUND, (distros.size() == 0));
    3123  
    3124              DistributionRegistration::SetDefault(LxssKey, distros[0]);
    3125              defaultDistroId = distros[0].Id();
    3126          }
    3127          else
    3128          {
    3129              defaultDistroId = defaultDistro->Id();
    3130          }
    3131  
    3132          result = S_OK;
    3133      }
    3134      catch (...)
    3135      {
    3136          result = WSL_E_DEFAULT_DISTRO_NOT_FOUND;
    3137      }
    3138  
    3139      THROW_IF_FAILED(result);
    3140  
    3141      return defaultDistroId;
    3142  }
    3143  
    3144  LONG LxssUserSessionImpl::_GetElfExitStatus(_In_ const LXSS_RUN_ELF_CONTEXT& Context)
    3145  {
    3146      // Wait for the instance to terminate or the client process to exit.
    3147      const wil::unique_handle clientProcess = wsl::windows::common::wslutil::OpenCallingProcess(GENERIC_READ | SYNCHRONIZE);
    3148      THROW_HR_IF(E_ABORT, !wsl::windows::common::relay::InterruptableWait(Context.instanceTerminatedEvent.get(), {clientProcess.get()}));
    3149  
    3150      // Ensure that the process exited successfully. If the process encountered
    3151      // an error, wait for the stderr worker thread and log the error message.
    3152      LONG exitStatus;
    3153      THROW_IF_NTSTATUS_FAILED(LxssClientInstanceGetExitStatus(Context.instanceHandle.get(), &exitStatus));
    3154  
    3155      return exitStatus;
    3156  }
