    3158  wsl::core::Config LxssUserSessionImpl::_GetResultantConfig(_In_ const HANDLE userToken)
    3159  {
    3160      const auto configFilePath = wsl::windows::common::helpers::GetWslConfigPath(userToken);
    3161      // Open the config file (%userprofile%\.wslconfig).
    3162      wsl::core::Config config(configFilePath.c_str(), userToken);
    3163  
    3164      _LoadNetworkingSettings(config, userToken);
    3165      return config;
    3166  }
    3167  
    3168  void LxssUserSessionImpl::_LoadDiskMount(_In_ HKEY Key, _In_ const std::wstring& LunStr) const
    3169  try
    3170  {
    3171      // Get the disk path
    3172      const auto path = wsl::windows::common::registry::ReadString(Key, nullptr, c_diskValueName);
    3173  
    3174      // Get the disk type; throw if unexpected type
    3175      const auto diskType = static_cast<WslCoreVm::DiskType>(wsl::windows::common::registry::ReadDword(
    3176          Key, nullptr, c_disktypeValueName, static_cast<DWORD>(WslCoreVm::DiskType::PassThrough)));
    3177  
    3178      THROW_HR_IF(E_UNEXPECTED, (diskType != WslCoreVm::DiskType::VHD && diskType != WslCoreVm::DiskType::PassThrough));
    3179  
    3180      // Attach the disk to the VM, reusing the same LUN if possible.
    3181      //
    3182      // N.B. The user token is not provided because the key that holds the disk
    3183      // state can only be written by elevated users.
    3184      auto lun = std::stoul(LunStr);
    3185      m_utilityVm->AttachDisk(path.c_str(), diskType, lun, true, nullptr);
    3186  
    3187      // Restore each mount point.
    3188      for (const auto& e : wsl::windows::common::registry::EnumKeys(Key, KEY_READ))
    3189      {
    3190          auto optionalValue = [&](std::wstring& storage, LPCWSTR name) -> LPCWSTR {
    3191              try
    3192              {
    3193                  storage = wsl::windows::common::registry::ReadString(e.second.get(), nullptr, name);
    3194                  return storage.c_str();
    3195              }
    3196              catch (...)
    3197              {
    3198                  LOG_CAUGHT_EXCEPTION();
    3199                  return nullptr;
    3200              }
    3201          };
    3202  
    3203          std::wstring options;
    3204          std::wstring type;
    3205  
    3206          // Get the mount name
    3207          auto diskName = wsl::windows::common::registry::ReadString(e.second.get(), nullptr, c_mountNameValueName, L"");
    3208  
    3209          // If there was not a disk name stored, set it to the default generated name when mounting
    3210          const auto result = m_utilityVm->MountDisk(
    3211              path.c_str(),
    3212              diskType,
    3213              std::stoul(e.first),
    3214              diskName.empty() ? nullptr : diskName.c_str(),
    3215              optionalValue(type, c_typeValueName),
    3216              optionalValue(options, c_optionsValueName));
    3217  
    3218          LOG_HR_IF_MSG(
    3219              E_UNEXPECTED,
    3220              result.Result != 0,
    3221              "Failed to restore disk mount. Device: '%ls', Partition: '%ls', error: %i, step: %i",
    3222              path.c_str(),
    3223              e.first.c_str(),
    3224              result.Result,
    3225              result.Step);
    3226      }
    3227  
    3228      return;
    3229  }
    3230  CATCH_LOG()
    3231  
    3232  void LxssUserSessionImpl::_LoadNetworkingSettings(_Inout_ wsl::core::Config& config, _In_ HANDLE userToken)
    3233  try
    3234  {
    3235      const auto autoProxyRequested = config.EnableAutoProxy;
    3236      if (config.EnableAutoProxy)
    3237      {
    3238          if (SUCCEEDED(HttpProxyStateTracker::s_LoadWinHttpProxyMethods()))
    3239          {
    3240              if (!m_httpProxyStateTracker)
    3241              {
    3242                  try
    3243                  {
    3244                      m_httpProxyStateTracker =
    3245                          std::make_shared<HttpProxyStateTracker>(config.InitialAutoProxyTimeout, userToken, config.NetworkingMode);
    3246                  }
    3247                  catch (...)
    3248                  {
    3249                      LOG_CAUGHT_EXCEPTION_MSG("autoProxy failed to start");
    3250                      config.EnableAutoProxy = false;
    3251                  }
    3252              }
    3253          }
    3254          else
    3255          {
    3256              config.EnableAutoProxy = false;
    3257          }
    3258      }
    3259  
    3260      WSL_LOG(
    3261          "AutoProxyEnabled",
    3262          TraceLoggingValue(autoProxyRequested, "autoProxyRequested"),
    3263          TraceLoggingValue(config.EnableAutoProxy, "autoProxyEnabled"));
    3264  }
    3265  CATCH_LOG();
    3266  
    3267  void LxssUserSessionImpl::_LoadDiskMounts()
    3268  try
    3269  {
    3270      const auto key = wsl::windows::common::registry::OpenOrCreateLxssDiskMountsKey(&m_userSid.Sid);
    3271      for (const auto& e : wsl::windows::common::registry::EnumKeys(key.get(), KEY_READ))
    3272      {
    3273          _LoadDiskMount(e.second.get(), e.first);
    3274      }
    3275  
    3276      // Clear the state from the registry now that the mounts have been loaded
    3277      wsl::windows::common::registry::ClearSubkeys(key.get());
    3278      return;
    3279  }
    3280  CATCH_LOG()
    3281  
    3282  void LxssUserSessionImpl::_ProcessImportResultMessage(
    3283      const LX_MINI_INIT_IMPORT_RESULT& Message,
    3284      const gsl::span<gsl::byte> Span,
    3285      HKEY LxssKey,
    3286      LXSS_DISTRO_CONFIGURATION& Configuration,
    3287      wsl::windows::service::DistributionRegistration& Registration)
    3288  {
    3289      THROW_HR_IF(WSL_E_NOT_A_LINUX_DISTRO, !Message.ValidDistribution);
    3290  
    3291      if (Configuration.Name.empty())
    3292      {
    3293          THROW_HR_IF(WSL_E_DISTRIBUTION_NAME_NEEDED, Message.DefaultNameIndex <= 0);
    3294  
    3295          auto distributionName = wsl::shared::string::MultiByteToWide(wsl::shared::string::FromSpan(Span, Message.DefaultNameIndex));
    3296  
    3297          // Validate that name is valid, and doesn't conflict with existing distributions.
    3298          s_ValidateDistroName(distributionName.c_str());
    3299          _ValidateDistributionNameAndPathNotInUse(LxssKey, nullptr, distributionName.c_str(), Registration.Id());
    3300  
    3301          Configuration.Name = std::move(distributionName);
    3302          Registration.Write(Property::Name, Configuration.Name.c_str());
    3303      }
    3304  
    3305      if (Message.FlavorIndex > 0)
    3306      {
    3307          Configuration.Flavor = wsl::shared::string::MultiByteToWide(wsl::shared::string::FromSpan(Span, Message.FlavorIndex));
    3308          Registration.Write(Property::Flavor, Configuration.Flavor.c_str());
    3309      }
    3310  
    3311      if (Message.VersionIndex != 0)
    3312      {
    3313          Configuration.OsVersion = wsl::shared::string::MultiByteToWide(wsl::shared::string::FromSpan(Span, Message.VersionIndex));
    3314          Registration.Write(Property::OsVersion, Configuration.OsVersion.c_str());
    3315      }
    3316  
    3317      // Do not create start menu shortcut or terminal profiles for appx based distributions.
    3318      if (Configuration.PackageFamilyName.empty())
    3319      {
    3320          auto impersonate = wil::CoImpersonateClient();
    3321  
    3322          Registration.Write(Property::Modern, 1);
    3323  
    3324          std::filesystem::path iconPath;
    3325          const auto basePath = wsl::windows::common::wslutil::GetBasePath();
    3326  
    3327          if (Message.ShortcutIconIndex != 0)
    3328          {
    3329              iconPath = Configuration.BasePath / c_shortIconName;
    3330              const wil::unique_handle icon{CreateFileW(iconPath.c_str(), GENERIC_WRITE, 0, nullptr, CREATE_ALWAYS, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, nullptr)};
    3331              THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(!icon);
    3332  
    3333              const auto iconData = Span.subspan(Message.ShortcutIconIndex, Message.ShortcutIconSize);
    3334              THROW_IF_WIN32_BOOL_FALSE(WriteFile(icon.get(), iconData.data(), static_cast<DWORD>(iconData.size_bytes()), nullptr, nullptr));
    3335          }
    3336          else
    3337          {
    3338              iconPath = basePath / L"wsl.exe";
    3339          }
    3340  
    3341          if (Message.GenerateShortcut)
    3342          {
    3343              _CreateDistributionShortcut(Configuration.Name.c_str(), iconPath.c_str(), (basePath / L"wsl.exe").c_str(), Registration);
    3344          }
    3345  
    3346          // Generate a Windows Terminal profile, as long as the distribution didn't opt-out of it.
    3347          if (Message.GenerateTerminalProfile)
    3348          {
    3349              if (Message.TerminalProfileIndex != 0)
    3350              {
    3351                  const auto terminalProfileSpan = Span.subspan(Message.TerminalProfileIndex);
    3352                  const std::string_view terminalProfile(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(terminalProfileSpan.data()), Message.TerminalProfileSize);
    3353                  _CreateTerminalProfile(terminalProfile, iconPath, Configuration, Registration);
    3354              }
    3355              else
    3356              {
    3357                  constexpr auto defaultProfile = R"(
    3358                              {
    3359                                  "profiles": [{
    3360                                  "startingDirectory": "~"
    3361                                  }]
    3362                              })";
    3363  
    3364                  _CreateTerminalProfile(defaultProfile, iconPath, Configuration, Registration);
    3365              }
    3366          }
    3367      }
    3368  }
    3369  
    3370  LXSS_RUN_ELF_CONTEXT LxssUserSessionImpl::_RunElfBinary(
    3371      _In_ LPCSTR CommandLine,
    3372      _In_ LPCWSTR TargetDirectory,
    3373      _In_ HANDLE ClientProcess,
    3374      _In_opt_ HANDLE StdIn,
    3375      _In_opt_ HANDLE StdOut,
    3376      _In_opt_ HANDLE StdErr,
    3377      _In_opt_count_(NumMounts) PLX_KMAPPATHS_ADDMOUNT Mounts,
    3378      _In_opt_ ULONG NumMounts)
    3379  {
    3380      GUID instanceId;
    3381      THROW_IF_FAILED(CoCreateGuid(&instanceId));
    3382  
    3383      // If the caller did not provide stdin, stdout, or stderr handles use the nul device.
    3384      wil::unique_hfile stdInLocal;
    3385      if (!ARGUMENT_PRESENT(StdIn))
    3386      {
    3387          stdInLocal = wsl::windows::common::filesystem::OpenNulDevice(GENERIC_READ);
    3388          StdIn = stdInLocal.get();
    3389      }
    3390  
    3391      wil::unique_hfile stdOutLocal;
    3392      if (!ARGUMENT_PRESENT(StdOut))
    3393      {
    3394          stdOutLocal = wsl::windows::common::filesystem::OpenNulDevice(GENERIC_WRITE);
    3395          StdOut = stdOutLocal.get();
    3396      }
    3397  
    3398      wil::unique_hfile stdErrLocal;
    3399      if (!ARGUMENT_PRESENT(StdErr))
    3400      {
    3401          stdErrLocal = wsl::windows::common::filesystem::OpenNulDevice(GENERIC_WRITE);
    3402          StdErr = stdErrLocal.get();
    3403      }
    3404  
    3405      // Get the user and instance tokens.
    3406      const auto userToken = wsl::windows::common::security::GetUserToken(TokenImpersonation);
    3407      const wil::unique_handle instanceToken(wsl::windows::common::security::CreateRestrictedToken(userToken.get()));
    3408  
    3409      // Open handles to the root directory and temp directory while impersonating
    3410      // the client.
    3411      wil::unique_hfile rootDirectory;
    3412      wil::unique_hfile tempDirectory;
    3413      {
    3414          auto runAsUser = wil::impersonate_token(userToken.get());
    3415          rootDirectory = wsl::windows::common::filesystem::OpenDirectoryHandle(TargetDirectory, true);
    3416          const auto tempFolder = std::filesystem::path(TargetDirectory) / LXSS_TEMP_DIRECTORY;
    3417          wsl::windows::common::filesystem::EnsureDirectory(tempFolder.c_str());
    3418          const auto instanceIdString = wsl::shared::string::GuidToString<wchar_t>(instanceId);
    3419          const auto tempPath = tempFolder / instanceIdString;
    3420          tempDirectory = wsl::windows::common::filesystem::WipeAndOpenDirectory(tempPath.c_str());
    3421      }
    3422  
    3423      // Create manual reset event that is signaled on instance termination
    3424      LXSS_RUN_ELF_CONTEXT elfContext;
    3425      elfContext.instanceTerminatedEvent.create(wil::EventOptions::ManualReset);
    3426      THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(!elfContext.instanceTerminatedEvent);
    3427  
    3428      // Create and initialize a job object for the instance.
    3429      const wil::unique_handle instanceJob(CreateJobObjectW(nullptr, nullptr));
    3430      THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF(!instanceJob);
    3431  
    3432      Security::InitializeInstanceJob(instanceJob.get());
    3433  
    3434      // Create a new instance with bsdtar as the init process to perform the extraction.
    3435      LX_KINSTANCECREATESTART createParameters = {};
    3436      createParameters.InstanceId = instanceId;
    3437      createParameters.RootFsType = LXSS_FS_TYPE_TMPFS;
    3438      createParameters.RootDirectoryHandle = HandleToULong(rootDirectory.get());
    3439      createParameters.TempDirectoryHandle = HandleToULong(tempDirectory.get());
    3440      createParameters.JobHandle = HandleToULong(instanceJob.get());
    3441      createParameters.TokenHandle = HandleToULong(instanceToken.get());
    3442      createParameters.InstanceTerminatedEventHandle = HandleToULong(elfContext.instanceTerminatedEvent.get());
    3443      createParameters.NumPathsToMap = NumMounts;
    3444      createParameters.PathsToMap = Mounts;
    3445  
    3446      // Format the kernel command line.
    3447      std::string kernelCommandLine("init=");
    3448      kernelCommandLine += CommandLine;
    3449      createParameters.KernelCommandLine = kernelCommandLine.c_str();
    3450  
    3451      // Set up the file descriptors that will be passed to the init process.
    3452      LX_KINIT_FILE_DESCRIPTOR initFileDescriptors[] = {
    3453          {StdIn, LX_O_RDONLY, LX_FD_CLOEXEC}, {StdOut, LX_O_WRONLY, LX_FD_CLOEXEC}, {StdErr, LX_O_WRONLY, LX_FD_CLOEXEC}};
    3454  
    3455      createParameters.NumInitFileDescriptors = RTL_NUMBER_OF(initFileDescriptors);
    3456      createParameters.InitFileDescriptors = initFileDescriptors;
    3457  
    3458      {
    3459          // Acquire assign primary token privilege in order to pass the primary token for init process.
    3460          auto revertPriv = wsl::windows::common::security::AcquirePrivilege(SE_ASSIGNPRIMARYTOKEN_NAME);
    3461          THROW_IF_NTSTATUS_FAILED(LxssClientInstanceCreate(&createParameters, &elfContext.instanceHandle));
    3462      }
    3463  
    3464      // Start the instance.
    3465      THROW_IF_NTSTATUS_FAILED(LxssClientInstanceStart(elfContext.instanceHandle.get(), ClientProcess));
    3466  
    3467      return elfContext;
    3468  }
    3469  
    3470  _Requires_lock_held_(m_instanceLock)
    3471  std::shared_ptr<LxssRunningInstance> LxssUserSessionImpl::_RunningInstance(_In_ LPCGUID DistroGuid)
    3472  {
    3473      _EnsureNotLocked(DistroGuid);
    3474      const auto instance = m_runningInstances.find(*DistroGuid);
    3475      if (instance != m_runningInstances.end())
    3476      {
    3477          return instance->second;
    3478      }
    3479  
    3480      return nullptr;
    3481  }
    3482  
    3483  LXSS_VM_MODE_SETUP_CONTEXT
    3484  LxssUserSessionImpl::_RunUtilityVmSetup(_In_ const LXSS_DISTRO_CONFIGURATION& Configuration, _In_ LX_MESSAGE_TYPE MessageType, ULONG ExportFlags, bool SetVersion)
    3485  {
    3486      THROW_HR_IF(E_INVALIDARG, ((MessageType != LxMiniInitMessageImport) && (MessageType != LxMiniInitMessageExport) && (MessageType != LxMiniInitMessageImportInplace)));
    3487  
    3488      // Open the client process so the operation can be aborted if client exits.
    3489      wil::unique_handle clientProcess = wsl::windows::common::wslutil::OpenCallingProcess(GENERIC_READ | SYNCHRONIZE);
    3490  
    3491      // Ensure that the Linux utility VM has been created.
    3492      std::lock_guard lock(m_instanceLock);
    3493      _CreateVm();
    3494  
    3495      WI_SetFlagIf(ExportFlags, LXSS_EXPORT_DISTRO_FLAGS_VERBOSE, SetVersion && m_utilityVm->GetConfig().SetVersionDebug);
    3496  
    3497      // Generate a GUID for the instance.
    3498      GUID instanceId;
    3499      THROW_IF_FAILED(CoCreateGuid(&instanceId));
    3500  
    3501      LXSS_VM_MODE_SETUP_CONTEXT context{};
    3502      ULONG connectPort{};
    3503      context.instance = m_utilityVm->CreateInstance(instanceId, Configuration, MessageType, 0, 0, 0, ExportFlags, &connectPort);
    3504  
    3505      // Establish the socket that will be used to transfer the tar file contents.
    3506      context.tarSocket = wsl::windows::common::hvsocket::Connect(m_utilityVm->GetRuntimeId(), connectPort);
    3507      context.errorSocket = wsl::windows::common::hvsocket::Connect(m_utilityVm->GetRuntimeId(), connectPort);
    3508      WI_ASSERT(context.tarSocket.is_valid());
    3509  
    3510      return context;
    3511  }

    3513  void LxssUserSessionImpl::_SendDistributionRegisteredEvent(_In_ const LXSS_DISTRO_CONFIGURATION& Configuration) const

    3515      WslOfflineDistributionInformation distributionInfo{};
    3516      distributionInfo.Id = Configuration.DistroId;
    3517      distributionInfo.Name = Configuration.Name.c_str();
    3518      distributionInfo.PackageFamilyName = Configuration.PackageFamilyName.c_str();
    3519      distributionInfo.Flavor = Configuration.Flavor.c_str();
    3520      distributionInfo.Version = Configuration.OsVersion.c_str();
    3521      m_pluginManager.OnDistributionRegistered(&m_session, &distributionInfo);
    3522  }

    3524  _Requires_lock_held_(m_instanceLock)
    3525  void LxssUserSessionImpl::_SetDistributionInstalled(_In_ HKEY LxssKey, _In_ const GUID& DistroGuid)
    3526  {
    3527      // Mark the distribution as installed.
    3528      auto registration = DistributionRegistration::Open(LxssKey, DistroGuid);
    3529      registration.Write(Property::State, LxssDistributionStateInstalled);
    3530  
    3531      // Set this distribution as the default if there is not already a default
    3532      // distribution.
    3533      const auto defaultDistro = DistributionRegistration::OpenDefault(LxssKey);
    3534      if (!defaultDistro.has_value())
    3535      {
    3536          DistributionRegistration::SetDefault(LxssKey, registration);
    3537      }
    3538  }
    3539  
    3540  _Requires_lock_not_held_(m_instanceLock)
    3541  bool LxssUserSessionImpl::_TerminateInstance(_In_ LPCGUID DistroGuid, _In_ bool CheckForClients)
    3542  {
    3543      std::lock_guard lock(m_instanceLock);
    3544      return _TerminateInstanceInternal(DistroGuid, CheckForClients);
    3545  }
    3546  
    3547  _Requires_exclusive_lock_held_(m_instanceLock)
    3548  bool LxssUserSessionImpl::_TerminateInstanceInternal(_In_ LPCGUID DistroGuid, _In_ bool CheckForClients)
    3549  {
    3550      ExecutionContext context(Context::TerminateDistro);
    3551  
    3552      // Look up an instance with the matching distro identifier. If the are no
    3553      // more active clients, it is stopped and removed from the list.
    3554      bool success = true;
    3555      const auto instance = m_runningInstances.find(*DistroGuid);
    3556  
    3557      if (instance != m_runningInstances.end())
    3558      {
    3559          const auto clientKey = instance->second->GetLifetimeManagerId();
    3560          if ((CheckForClients == false) || (!m_lifetimeManager.IsAnyProcessRegistered(clientKey)))
    3561          {
    3562              // Stop the instance and move it to a list of terminated instances.
    3563              // This allows the instance destructor to run without the instance
    3564              // lock held, and allows in-flight termination callbacks to complete.
    3565              const bool force = !CheckForClients;
    3566              try
    3567              {
    3568                  success = instance->second->RequestStop(force);
    3569              }
    3570              CATCH_LOG()
    3571  
    3572              success = (success || force);
    3573              if (success)
    3574              {
    3575                  if (const auto* wslcoreInstance = dynamic_cast<WslCoreInstance*>(instance->second.get()); wslcoreInstance != nullptr)
    3576                  {
    3577                      m_pluginManager.OnDistributionStopping(&m_session, wslcoreInstance->DistributionInformation());
    3578                  }
    3579  
    3580                  instance->second->Stop();
    3581  
    3582                  const auto clientId = instance->second->GetClientId();
    3583                  {
    3584                      auto lock = m_terminatedInstanceLock.lock_exclusive();
    3585                      m_terminatedInstances.push_back(std::move(instance->second));
    3586                  }
    3587  
    3588                  m_lifetimeManager.RemoveCallback(clientKey);
    3589  
    3590                  m_runningInstances.erase(instance);
    3591  
    3592                  // If the instance that was terminated was a WSL2 instance,
    3593                  // check if the VM is now idle.
    3594                  if (clientId != LXSS_CLIENT_ID_INVALID)
    3595                  {
    3596                      _VmCheckIdle();
    3597                  }
    3598              }
    3599          }
    3600      }
    3601  
    3602      return success;
    3603  }
    3604  
    3605  void LxssUserSessionImpl::_UpdateInit(_In_ const LXSS_DISTRO_CONFIGURATION& Configuration)
    3606  {
    3607      // Only update the init binary once per-distro, per-session.
    3608      auto lock = m_initUpdateLock.lock_exclusive();
    3609      if (std::find(m_updatedInitDistros.begin(), m_updatedInitDistros.end(), Configuration.DistroId) == m_updatedInitDistros.end())
    3610      {
    3611          wsl::windows::common::filesystem::UpdateInit(Configuration.BasePath.c_str(), Configuration.Version);
    3612          m_updatedInitDistros.emplace_back(Configuration.DistroId);
    3613      }
    3614  }

    3616  HRESULT LxssUserSessionImpl::MountRootNamespaceFolder(_In_ LPCWSTR HostPath, _In_ LPCWSTR GuestPath, _In_ bool ReadOnly, _In_ LPCWSTR Name)
    3617  {
    3618      std::lock_guard lock(m_instanceLock);
    3619      RETURN_HR_IF(E_NOT_VALID_STATE, !m_utilityVm);

    3624  
    3625  HRESULT LxssUserSessionImpl::CreateLinuxProcess(_In_opt_ const GUID* Distro, _In_ LPCSTR Path, _In_ LPCSTR* Arguments, _Out_ SOCKET* Socket)
    3626  {
    3627      std::lock_guard lock(m_instanceLock);
    3628      RETURN_HR_IF(E_NOT_VALID_STATE, !m_utilityVm);
    3629  
    3630      if (Distro == nullptr)
    3631      {
    3632          *Socket = m_utilityVm->CreateRootNamespaceProcess(Path, Arguments).release();
    3633      }
    3634      else
    3635      {
    3636          const auto distro = _RunningInstance(Distro);
    3637          THROW_HR_IF(WSL_E_VM_MODE_INVALID_STATE, !distro);
    3638  
    3639          const auto wsl2Distro = dynamic_cast<WslCoreInstance*>(distro.get());
    3640          THROW_HR_IF(WSL_E_WSL2_NEEDED, !wsl2Distro);
    3641  
    3642          *Socket = wsl2Distro->CreateLinuxProcess(Path, Arguments).release();
    3643      }
    3644      return S_OK;
    3645  }
    3646  
    3647  _Requires_exclusive_lock_held_(m_instanceLock)
    3648  void LxssUserSessionImpl::_UnregisterDistributionLockHeld(_In_ HKEY LxssKey, _In_ const LXSS_DISTRO_CONFIGURATION& Configuration)
    3649  {
    3650      ExecutionContext context(Context::UnregisterDistro);
    3651  
    3652      try
    3653      {
    3654          const auto removedDistroString = wsl::shared::string::GuidToString<wchar_t>(Configuration.DistroId);
    3655  
    3656          // Terminate any running instance of the distro and delete the distro.
    3657          _TerminateInstanceInternal(&Configuration.DistroId);
    3658  
    3659          // Impersonate the user and delete the distro filesystem.
    3660          {
    3661              auto runAsUser = wil::CoImpersonateClient();
    3662              _DeleteDistributionLockHeld(Configuration);
    3663          }
    3664  
    3665          // Delete the distro registry key.
    3666          wsl::windows::common::registry::DeleteKey(LxssKey, removedDistroString.c_str());
    3667      }
    3668      CATCH_LOG()
    3669  }
    3670  
    3671  void LxssUserSessionImpl::_TimezoneUpdated()
    3672  try
    3673  {
    3674      WSL_LOG("Received timezone change notification");
    3675  
    3676      // Update the timezone information for each running instance.
    3677      std::lock_guard lock(m_instanceLock);
    3678      std::for_each(m_runningInstances.begin(), m_runningInstances.end(), [&](auto& pair) { pair.second->UpdateTimezone(); });
    3679  
    3680      return;
    3681  }
    3682  CATCH_LOG()
    3683  
    3684  _Requires_exclusive_lock_held_(m_instanceLock)
    3685  bool LxssUserSessionImpl::_ValidateDistro(_In_ HKEY LxssKey, _In_ LPCGUID DistroGuid)
    3686  {
    3687      bool isValid = false;
    3688      std::wstring packageFamilyName;
    3689      try
    3690      {
    3691          // Ensure a subkey exists for the distribution.
    3692          auto configuration = s_GetDistributionConfiguration(DistributionRegistration::Open(LxssKey, *DistroGuid));
    3693          packageFamilyName = configuration.PackageFamilyName;
    3694  
    3695          // If there is no package family name associated with the distribution,
    3696          // the user is responsible for unregistering the distribution.
    3697          // Otherwise, ensure that the package is still installed. If the
    3698          // package is installed ensure that the root file system is present.
    3699          //
    3700          // N.B. This covers the case where a package was uninstalled and
    3701          //      reinstalled without the service being invoked.
    3702          isValid = true;
    3703  
    3704          // TODO: Below block needs test coverage
    3705          if (!packageFamilyName.empty())
    3706          {
    3707              std::filesystem::path localPath;
    3708              PCWSTR path;
    3709              if (WI_IsFlagClear(configuration.Flags, LXSS_DISTRO_FLAGS_VM_MODE))
    3710              {
    3711                  localPath = configuration.BasePath / LXSS_ROOTFS_DIRECTORY;
    3712                  path = localPath.c_str();
    3713              }
    3714              else
    3715              {
    3716                  path = configuration.VhdFilePath.c_str();
    3717              }
    3718  
    3719              auto runAsUser = wil::CoImpersonateClient();
    3720  
    3721              // If the path is not found and the package is removed, then the distro can be considered to be uninstalled.
    3722              // Only do this if the path is actually missing to prevent any accidental distro deletion if the store API
    3723              // can't find the package for transient reasons.
    3724              if (!PathFileExistsW(path) && !wsl::windows::common::helpers::IsPackageInstalled(packageFamilyName.c_str()))
    3725              {
    3726                  isValid = false;
    3727              }
    3728          }
    3729      }
    3730      CATCH_LOG()
    3731  
    3732      if (!isValid)
    3733      {
    3734          WSL_LOG("ValidateDistributionFailed", TraceLoggingValue(packageFamilyName.c_str(), "packageFamilyName"));
    3735      }
    3736  
    3737      return isValid;
    3738  }
    3739  
    3740  void LxssUserSessionImpl::_ValidateDistributionNameAndPathNotInUse(
    3741      _In_ HKEY LxssKey, _In_opt_ LPCWSTR Path, _In_opt_ LPCWSTR Name, const std::optional<GUID>& Exclude)
    3742  {
    3743      // Use the canonical path to compare distribution registration paths.
    3744      // The canonical path allows us to compare paths regardless of symlinks.
    3745      //
    3746      // Even with this, it's theoretically possible to use different drive mounts to have two paths
    3747      // that will point to the same underlying folder. To catch this, we'd need to use BY_HANDLE_FILE_INFORMATION and compare file & volume indexes.
    3748      // Unfortunately this is tricky because this doesn't work of the folder doesn't exist yet (or if a registered distribution's folder has been deleted).
    3749      // For the sake of simplicity, this isn't implemented given that trying to double register a distribution will fail at the VHD creation step regardless.
    3750  
    3751      std::error_code error;
    3752      std::filesystem::path canonicalPath;
    3753  
    3754      if (Path != nullptr)
    3755      {
    3756          canonicalPath = std::filesystem::weakly_canonical(Path, error);
    3757          if (error)
    3758          {
    3759              LOG_WIN32(error.value());
    3760          }
    3761          else
    3762          {
    3763              Path = canonicalPath.c_str();
    3764          }
    3765      }
    3766  
    3767      // Ensure no existing distributions have the same name or install path.
    3768      for (const auto& distro : _EnumerateDistributions(LxssKey, true, Exclude))
    3769      {
    3770          // Return an appropriate failure code for the two possible
    3771          // conditions here:
    3772          //
    3773          //     1. The distribution is already registered successfully.
    3774          //     2. The distribution is currently being registered or unregistered by another thread.
    3775  
    3776          LXSS_DISTRO_CONFIGURATION configuration{};
    3777          try
    3778          {
    3779              configuration = s_GetDistributionConfiguration(distro);
    3780          }
    3781          catch (...)
    3782          {
    3783              // Don't break registration of new distro if one registration is invalid.
    3784              LOG_CAUGHT_EXCEPTION();
    3785              continue;
    3786          }
    3787  
    3788          if (Name != nullptr && wsl::shared::string::IsEqual(Name, configuration.Name, true))
    3789          {
    3790              THROW_HR_MSG(
    3791                  (configuration.State == LxssDistributionStateInstalled) ? HRESULT_FROM_WIN32(ERROR_ALREADY_EXISTS) : E_ILLEGAL_STATE_CHANGE,
    3792                  "%ls already registered (state = %d)",
    3793                  Name,
    3794                  configuration.State);
    3795          }
    3796  
    3797          if (Path != nullptr)
    3798          {
    3799              auto canonicalDistroPath = std::filesystem::weakly_canonical(configuration.BasePath, error);
    3800              if (error)
    3801              {
    3802                  LOG_WIN32(error.value());
    3803              }
    3804  
    3805              // Ensure another distribution by a different name is not already registered to the same location.
    3806              THROW_HR_IF(
    3807                  HRESULT_FROM_WIN32(ERROR_FILE_EXISTS),
    3808                  wsl::windows::common::string::IsPathComponentEqual(error ? configuration.BasePath.native() : canonicalDistroPath.native(), Path));
    3809          }
    3810      }
    3811  }
    3812  
    3813  _Requires_exclusive_lock_held_(m_instanceLock)
    3814  void LxssUserSessionImpl::_VmCheckIdle()
    3815  {
    3816      // If the VM is idle, queue a timer to terminate the VM.
    3817      // Otherwise, cancel any pending termination timers.
    3818      //
    3819      // N.B. A negative timeout means that the VM will continue running until it
    3820      //      is terminated via wsl.exe --shutdown, or the service is stopped.
    3821      if (_VmIsIdle())
    3822      {
    3823          const auto timeout = m_utilityVm->GetVmIdleTimeout();
    3824          if (timeout >= 0)
    3825          {
    3826              auto dueTime = wil::filetime::from_int64(-wil::filetime_duration::one_millisecond * timeout);
    3827              SetThreadpoolTimer(m_vmTerminationTimer.get(), &dueTime, 0, 0);
    3828          }
    3829      }
    3830      else
    3831      {
    3832          SetThreadpoolTimer(m_vmTerminationTimer.get(), nullptr, 0, 0);
    3833      }
    3834  }
    3835  
    3836  void LxssUserSessionImpl::_VmIdleTerminate()
    3837  {
    3838      std::lock_guard lock(m_instanceLock);
    3839      if (_VmIsIdle())
    3840      {
    3841          WSL_LOG("StopVm");
    3842          m_utilityVm->SaveAttachedDisksState();
    3843          _VmTerminate();
    3844      }
    3845  }
    3846  
    3847  _Requires_exclusive_lock_held_(m_instanceLock)
    3848  bool LxssUserSessionImpl::_VmIsIdle()
    3849  {
    3850      const auto found = std::find_if(m_runningInstances.begin(), m_runningInstances.end(), [&](auto& pair) {
    3851          return (pair.second->GetClientId() != LXSS_CLIENT_ID_INVALID);
    3852      });
    3853  
    3854      return (m_utilityVm && m_lockedDistributions.empty() && (found == m_runningInstances.end()));
    3855  }
    3856  
    3857  _Requires_exclusive_lock_held_(m_instanceLock)
    3858  void LxssUserSessionImpl::_VmTerminate()
    3859  {
    3860      // Cancel any pending termination timers and terminate the system distro and VM.
    3861      SetThreadpoolTimer(m_vmTerminationTimer.get(), nullptr, 0, 0);
    3862  
    3863      if (m_utilityVm != nullptr)
    3864      {
    3865          m_pluginManager.OnVmStopping(&m_session);
    3866      }
    3867  
    3868      m_vmTerminating.SetEvent();
    3869      if (m_telemetryThread.joinable())
    3870      {
    3871          m_telemetryThread.join();
    3872      }
    3873  
    3874      m_utilityVm.reset();
    3875      m_vmId.store(GUID_NULL);
    3876  
    3877      // Reset the user's token since its lifetime is tied to the VM.
    3878      m_userToken.reset();
    3879      m_session.UserToken = nullptr;
    3880  
    3881      // Reset the event since the VM can be recreated.
    3882      // This can done safely because WslCoreVm's destructor waits until
    3883      // its distro exit callback is done before returning, so at this point
    3884      // it's guaranteed that no one is waiting (or about to wait) on the event.
    3885      // Note: Using an auto-reset event wouldn't work since the callback can be invoked
    3886      // more than once while the vm is being destroyed.
    3887      m_vmTerminating.ResetEvent();
    3888  }
    3889  
    3890  void LxssUserSessionImpl::_SetHttpProxyInfo(std::vector<std::string>& environment) const noexcept
    3891  try
    3892  {
    3893      // Copy guarantees a ref is held on the original instance, or it's null.
    3894      const auto localTracker = m_httpProxyStateTracker;
    3895      if (localTracker)
    3896      {
    3897          WSL_LOG("_SetHttpProxyInfo: Attempting to set proxy info");
    3898          const std::optional<HttpProxySettings> proxySettings = localTracker->WaitForInitialProxySettings();
    3899  
    3900          if (proxySettings.has_value())
    3901          {
    3902              if (proxySettings->UnsupportedProxyDropReason != UnsupportedProxyReason::Supported)
    3903              {
    3904                  switch (proxySettings->UnsupportedProxyDropReason)
    3905                  {
    3906                  case UnsupportedProxyReason::LoopbackNotMirrored:
    3907                      EMIT_USER_WARNING(wsl::shared::Localization::MessageProxyLocalhostSettingsDropped());
    3908                      break;
    3909                  case UnsupportedProxyReason::Ipv6NotMirrored:
    3910                      EMIT_USER_WARNING(wsl::shared::Localization::MessageProxyV6SettingsDropped());
    3911                      break;
    3912                  case UnsupportedProxyReason::LoopbackV6:
    3913                      EMIT_USER_WARNING(wsl::shared::Localization::MessageProxyLoopbackV6SettingsDropped());
    3914                      break;
    3915                  case UnsupportedProxyReason::UnsupportedError:
    3916                      EMIT_USER_WARNING(wsl::shared::Localization::MessageProxyUnexpectedSettingsDropped());
    3917                      break;
    3918                  case UnsupportedProxyReason::Supported:
    3919                  default:
    3920                      WSL_LOG("_SetHttpProxyInfo: Unexpected UnsupportedProxyReason");
    3921                  }
    3922              }
    3923              if (proxySettings->HasSettingsConfigured())
    3924              {
    3925                  s_AddHttpProxyToEnvironment(proxySettings.value(), environment);
    3926  
    3927                  WSL_LOG(
    3928                      "AutoProxyConfiguration",
    3929                      TraceLoggingValue(!proxySettings->Proxy.empty(), "ProxySet"),
    3930                      TraceLoggingValue(!proxySettings->SecureProxy.empty(), "SecureProxySet"),
    3931                      TraceLoggingValue(proxySettings->ProxyBypasses.size(), "ProxyBypassesCount"),
    3932                      TraceLoggingValue(!proxySettings->PacUrl.empty(), "PacUrlSet"));
    3933              }
    3934              else
    3935              {
    3936                  WSL_LOG("_SetHttpProxyInfo: No HttpProxy settings detected so not configuring env vars.");
    3937              }
    3938          }
    3939          else
    3940          {
    3941              // User will get a notification to restart WSL if proxy query completes later.
    3942              WSL_LOG("_SetHttpProxyInfo: Initial HttpProxy query timeout, start WSL process anyway.");
    3943          }
    3944      }
    3945  }
    3946  CATCH_LOG()
    3947  
    3948  void LxssUserSessionImpl::_LaunchOOBEIfNeeded() noexcept
    3949  try
    3950  {
    3951      // Impersonate the user and open their lxss registry key.
    3952      const wil::unique_hkey lxssKey = s_OpenLxssUserKey();
    3953  
    3954      // OOBE hasn't run if the value is not present or set to 0.
    3955      if (wsl::windows::common::registry::ReadDword(lxssKey.get(), nullptr, LXSS_OOBE_COMPLETE_NAME, false) != false)
    3956      {
    3957          return;
    3958      }
    3959  
    3960      // Don't run OOBE for existing users who already have a distro.
    3961      wil::unique_cotaskmem_array_ptr<LXSS_ENUMERATE_INFO> distributions;

    4034  // Note that if the user defines proxy variables via WSLENV, these values will be overwritten by those when init spawns process
    4035  void LxssUserSessionImpl::s_AddHttpProxyToEnvironment(_In_ const HttpProxySettings& proxySettings, _Inout_ std::vector<std::string>& environment) noexcept
    4036  try
    4037  {
    4038      if (!proxySettings.Proxy.empty())
    4039      {
    4040          // Note that we add both lower and uppercase as some Linux apps use upper, others lower.
    4041          environment.emplace_back(std::format("{}={}", c_httpProxyLower, proxySettings.Proxy));
    4042          environment.emplace_back(std::format("{}={}", c_httpProxyUpper, proxySettings.Proxy));
    4043      }
    4044  
    4045      if (!proxySettings.SecureProxy.empty())
    4046      {
    4047          environment.emplace_back(std::format("{}={}", c_httpsProxyLower, proxySettings.SecureProxy));
    4048          environment.emplace_back(std::format("{}={}", c_httpsProxyUpper, proxySettings.SecureProxy));
    4049      }
    4050  
    4051      if (!proxySettings.ProxyBypassesComma.empty())
    4052      {
    4053          environment.emplace_back(std::format("{}={}", c_proxyBypassLower, proxySettings.ProxyBypassesComma));
    4054          environment.emplace_back(std::format("{}={}", c_proxyBypassUpper, proxySettings.ProxyBypassesComma));
    4055      }
    4056  
    4057      if (!proxySettings.PacUrl.empty())
    4058      {
    4059          // We only add uppercase as there is no standard environment variable for PAC proxies.
    4060          // This at least makes the PAC url available to the user in case they wish to use it.
    4061          environment.emplace_back(std::format("{}={}", c_pacProxy, proxySettings.PacUrl));
    4062      }
    4063  }

      66  bool MirroredNetworking::IsHyperVFirewallSupported(const wsl::core::Config& vmConfig) noexcept
      67  {
      68      PCSTR executionStep = "";
      69      try
      70      {
      71          const auto hyperVFirewallSupport = wsl::core::networking::GetHyperVFirewallSupportVersion(vmConfig.FirewallConfig);
      72  
      73          if (hyperVFirewallSupport == wsl::core::networking::HyperVFirewallSupport::None)
      74          {
      75              WSL_LOG("IsHyperVFirewallSupported returning false: No Hyper-V Firewall API present");
      76              return false;
      77          }
      78  
      79          if (hyperVFirewallSupport == wsl::core::networking::HyperVFirewallSupport::Version1)
      80          {
      81              // not allowing Hyper-V Firewall support with WSL with just the Version1 Hyper-V Firewall API
      82              WSL_LOG("IsHyperVFirewallSupported returning false: WSL requires Hyper-V Firewall version2 but version1 is present");
      83              return false;
      84          }
      85  
      86          executionStep = "HcnEnumerateNetworks";
      87          // Check to see if the network is already created without Hyper-V Firewall.
      88          // HNS only supports one networking configuration per boot cycle, so if it was configured with the
      89          // Mirrored flag but without the Hyper-V Firewall flag, then we MUST NOT attempt to enable Hyper-V Firewall.
      90          for (const auto& id : wsl::core::networking::EnumerateNetworks())
      91          {
      92              executionStep = "HcnOpenNetwork";
      93              auto network = wsl::core::networking::OpenNetwork(id);
      94  
      95              executionStep = "HcnQueryNetworkProperties";
      96              auto [networkProperties, propertiesString] = wsl::core::networking::QueryNetworkProperties(network.get());
      97              if (WI_IsFlagSet(static_cast<uint32_t>(networkProperties.Flags), WI_EnumValue(wsl::shared::hns::NetworkFlags::EnableFlowSteering)) &&
      98                  !WI_IsFlagSet(static_cast<uint32_t>(networkProperties.Flags), WI_EnumValue(wsl::shared::hns::NetworkFlags::EnableFirewall)))
      99              {
     100                  WSL_LOG(
     101                      "IsHyperVFirewallSupported returning false: HNS Mirrored-network already created without Hyper-V Firewall "
     102                      "support, cannot enable Hyper-V Firewall");
     103                  return false;
     104              }
     105          }
     106  
     107          return true;
     108      }
     109      catch (...)
     110      {
     111          const auto hr = wil::ResultFromCaughtException();
     112          WSL_LOG(
     113              "IsHyperVFirewallSupportedFailed",
     114              TraceLoggingHResult(hr, "result"),
     115              TraceLoggingValue(executionStep, "executionStep"),
     116              TraceLoggingValue("Mirrored", "networkingMode"));
     117  
     118          return false;
     119      }

     122  // static
     123  bool MirroredNetworking::IsExternalInterfaceConstrained(const HCN_NETWORK network) noexcept
     124  {
     125      try
     126      {
     127          // Read interface constraint
     128          const auto lxssKey = windows::common::registry::OpenLxssMachineKey(KEY_READ);
     129          const auto interfaceConstraint =
     130              windows::common::registry::ReadString(lxssKey.get(), nullptr, networking::c_interfaceConstraintKey, L"");
     131  
     132          if (!interfaceConstraint.empty())
     133          {
     134              // The user has configured an ExternalInterfaceConstraint
     135  
     136              // Use GetAdapterAddresses to obtain the InterfaceGuid of the interface corresponding to the constraint
     137              constexpr auto GET_ADAPTER_ADDRESSES_BUFFER_SIZE_INITIAL = (15 * 1024);
     138              constexpr auto GAA_FLAGS = GAA_FLAG_SKIP_ANYCAST | GAA_FLAG_SKIP_MULTICAST | GAA_FLAG_SKIP_UNICAST | GAA_FLAG_SKIP_DNS_SERVER;
     139  
     140              ULONG result = ERROR_SUCCESS;
     141              ULONG bufferSize = GET_ADAPTER_ADDRESSES_BUFFER_SIZE_INITIAL;
     142              std::vector<std::byte> buffer;
     143              PIP_ADAPTER_ADDRESSES adapter;
     144  
     145              do
     146              {
     147                  buffer.resize(bufferSize);
     148                  adapter = gslhelpers::get_struct<IP_ADAPTER_ADDRESSES>(gsl::make_span(buffer));
     149                  result = GetAdaptersAddresses(AF_UNSPEC, GAA_FLAGS, nullptr, adapter, &bufferSize);
     150              } while (result == ERROR_BUFFER_OVERFLOW);
     151  
     152              THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF_MSG(result != ERROR_SUCCESS, "GetAdaptersAddresses");
     153  
     154              // Find the external interface constraint adapter (i.e. the adapter which has its friendly name matching the regkey value)
     155              bool interfaceConstraintPresent = false;
     156              while (adapter != nullptr)
     157              {
     158                  if (wsl::shared::string::IsEqual(interfaceConstraint, adapter->FriendlyName, true))
     159                  {
     160                      interfaceConstraintPresent = true;
     161                      break;
     162                  }
     163                  adapter = adapter->Next;
     164              }
     165  
     166              if (interfaceConstraintPresent)
     167              {
     168                  // Retrieve the interfaceGuid corresponding to this endpoint by querying the HNS network
     169                  GUID endpointInterfaceGuid{};
     170                  wil::unique_cotaskmem_string error;
     171                  wil::unique_cotaskmem_string networkPropertiesString;
     172                  wsl::shared::hns::HNSNetwork networkProperties;
     173                  try
     174                  {
     175                      std::tie(networkProperties, networkPropertiesString) = wsl::core::networking::QueryNetworkProperties(network);
     176                  }
     177                  catch (...)
     178                  {
     179                      WSL_LOG(
     180                          "IsExternalInterfaceConstrainedFailed",
     181                          TraceLoggingHResult(wil::ResultFromCaughtException(), "result"),
     182                          TraceLoggingValue("HcnQueryNetworkProperties", "executionStep"),
     183                          TraceLoggingValue("Mirrored", "networkingMode"));
     184  
     185                      return false;
     186                  }
     187  
     188                  // Successfully read the interfaceGuid for this endpoint
     189                  endpointInterfaceGuid = networkProperties.InterfaceConstraint.InterfaceGuid;
     190  
     191                  // Obtain ExternalInterfaceConstraint's interfaceGuid to compare against the endpoint's interfaceGuid
     192                  GUID externalInterfaceConstraintGuid{};
     193                  THROW_IF_WIN32_ERROR(ConvertInterfaceLuidToGuid(&(adapter->Luid), &externalInterfaceConstraintGuid));
     194  
     195                  if (externalInterfaceConstraintGuid == endpointInterfaceGuid)
     196                  {
     197                      // This interface matches the one we are looking for.
     198                      // There is an external interface constraint configured, the constrained
     199                      // interface is present, and the interface in question is the ExternalInterfaceConstraint.
     200                      // This interface is allowed to operate normally and must not be constrained.
     201                      WSL_LOG(
     202                          "IsExternalInterfaceConstrainedInterface",
     203                          TraceLoggingValue(endpointInterfaceGuid, "InterfaceGuid"),
     204                          TraceLoggingValue(
     205                              "ExternalInterfaceConstraint is configured and this interface is the "
     206                              "ExternalInterfaceConstraint. This interface must NOT be constrained",
     207                              "state"));
     208                      return false;
     209                  }
     210  
     211                  // There is an external interface constraint configured and the constrained
     212                  // interface is present, but this is not the ExternalInterfaceConstraint.
     213                  // Thus, this interface must be constrained.
     214                  WSL_LOG(
     215                      "IsExternalInterfaceConstrainedInterface",
     216                      TraceLoggingValue(endpointInterfaceGuid, "InterfaceGuid"),
     217                      TraceLoggingValue(
     218                          "ExternalInterfaceConstraint is configured and the ExternalInterfaceConstraint is "
     219                          "found. This interface must be constrained.",
     220                          "state"));
     221                  return true;
     222              }
     223              // There is an ExternalInterfaceConstraint configured, but it is not present/up.
     224              // Thus, this interface must be constrained.
     225              WSL_LOG(
     226                  "IsExternalInterfaceConstrainedInterface",
     227                  TraceLoggingValue(
     228                      "ExternalInterfaceConstraint is configured and the ExternalInterfaceConstraint is NOT "
     229                      "found. All interfaces must be constrained.",
     230                      "state"));
     231              return true;
     232          }
     233  
     234          // There is no ExternalInterfaceConstraint configured.
     235          // This, this interface must NOT be constrained.

     237              "IsExternalInterfaceConstrainedInterface",
     238              TraceLoggingValue("ExternalInterfaceConstraint is not configured. All interfaces must NOT be constrained.", "state"));

     247  void MirroredNetworking::Initialize()
     248  {
     249      // Configure IPV6 before anything else happens (IPV6 configuration needs to be done early).
     250      m_networkingQueue.submit([this] {
     251          return wil::ResultFromException([&]() { m_gnsChannel.SendNetworkDeviceMessage(LxGnsMessageSetupIpv6, L"{}"); });
     252      });
     253  
     254      m_gnsRpcServer = GnsRpcServer::GetOrCreate();
     255      m_guestNetworkService.CreateGuestNetworkService(
     256          m_config.FirewallConfig.Enabled(), m_config.IgnoredPorts, m_runtimeId, m_gnsRpcServer->GetServerUuid(), s_GuestNetworkServiceCallback, this);
     257      m_ephemeralPortRange = m_guestNetworkService.AllocateEphemeralPortRange();
     258  
     259      networking::ConfigureHyperVFirewall(m_config.FirewallConfig, wsl::windows::common::wslutil::c_vmOwner);
     260  
     261      // must keep all m_networkManager interactions (including) creation queued
     262      // also must queue GNS callbacks to keep them serialized
     263      // the queue also prevents losing change notifications while we are still processing add notifications
     264      // calling submit_with_results to get a WslThreadPoolWaitableResult so we can conditionally wait for this workitem to complete to determine if it succeeded
     265      const auto workItemTracker = m_networkingQueue.submit_with_results<HRESULT>([this] {
     266          try
     267          {
     268              auto addNetworkEndpointCallback = [this](const GUID& networkId) {
     269                  m_networkingQueue.submit([this, networkId] { this->AddNetworkEndpoint(networkId); });
     270              };
     271  
     272              // Create and start the network manager.
     273              //
     274              // N.B. Mirrored networks may not yet exist and the NetworkManager c'tor will cause HCS to create them asynchronously.
     275              //      This is done by the query submitted to HcnEnumerateNetworks.
     276              //      Once the networks are created, the network change callback will be invoked and endpoints will be hot-added.
     277              // implement wsl::core::networking::GnsMessageCallbackWithCallbackResult so WSL can serialize messages to Linux
     278              auto networkManagerGnsMessageCallbackWithCallbackResult = [this](
     279                                                                            LX_MESSAGE_TYPE messageType,
     280                                                                            const std::wstring& notificationString,
     281                                                                            networking::GnsCallbackFlags callbackFlags,
     282                                                                            _Out_opt_ int* returnedResult) -> HRESULT {
     283                  // NetworkManagerGnsMessageCallback queues the actual work to the m_gnsMessageQueue
     284                  return NetworkManagerGnsMessageCallback(messageType, notificationString, callbackFlags, returnedResult);
     285              };
     286  
     287              m_networkManager = std::make_unique<wsl::core::networking::WslMirroredNetworkManager>(
     288                  m_system, m_config, std::move(networkManagerGnsMessageCallbackWithCallbackResult), std::move(addNetworkEndpointCallback), m_ephemeralPortRange);
     289  
     290              // Register notifications for DNS suffix changes
     291              m_dnsSuffixRegistryWatcher.emplace(
     292                  [this] { m_networkingQueue.submit([this] { m_networkManager->OnDnsSuffixChange(); }); });
     293  
     294              // Send the requisite notifications for the required network devices
     295              m_networkManager->SendCreateNotificationsForInitialEndpoints();
     296  
     297              // HNS now has all host interfaces that will be mirrored mapped into NetworkIds
     298              std::vector<GUID> networkIds;
     299              THROW_IF_FAILED(m_networkManager->EnumerateNetworks(networkIds));
     300  
     301              // Create an endpoint on each mirrored network.
     302              for (auto& networkId : networkIds)
     303              {
     304                  AddNetworkEndpoint(networkId);
     305              }
     306  
     307              // At this point all endpoints are configured, mark the GuestNetworkService as 'Synchronized'
     308              m_guestNetworkService.SetGuestNetworkServiceState(hns::GuestNetworkServiceState::Synchronized);
     309          }
     310          catch (...)
     311          {
     312              const auto hr = wil::ResultFromCaughtException();
     313              WSL_LOG(
     314                  "FailedToStartNetworkManager",
     315                  TraceLoggingValue(m_runtimeId, "vmId"),
     316                  TraceLoggingValue(hr, "error"),
     317                  TraceLoggingValue(ToString(m_config.NetworkingMode), "networkConfiguration"));
     318  
     319              return hr;
     320          }
     321          return S_OK;
     322      });
     323  
     324      // Wait for initial mirroring to give users a consistent experience.
     325      // the wait should not timeout - we are waiting infinite
     326      const auto waitResult = workItemTracker->wait(INFINITE);
     327      WI_ASSERT(ERROR_SUCCESS == waitResult);
     328      // now we can read the HRESULT returned from the work item
     329      const auto hr = workItemTracker->read_result();
     330      if (SUCCEEDED(hr))
     331      {
     332          // We must wait for the goal state to be reached outside of the queue, since operations
     333          // required to reach the goal state require processing in the queue.
     334          const auto goalStateHr = m_networkManager->WaitForMirroredGoalState();
     335          if (FAILED(goalStateHr))
     336          {
     337              WSL_LOG(
     338                  "WaitForMirroredGoalStateFailed",
     339                  TraceLoggingHResult(goalStateHr, "hr"),
     340                  TraceLoggingValue(m_config.EnableDnsTunneling, "DnsTunnelingEnabled"),
     341                  TraceLoggingValue(m_config.FirewallConfig.Enabled(), "HyperVFirewallEnabled"),
     342                  TraceLoggingValue(m_config.EnableAutoProxy, "AutoProxyFeatureEnabled"));
     343          }
     344      }
     345  
     346      THROW_IF_FAILED(hr);
     347      // else we don't need to wait on the result
     348      // it can safely go out of scope and we can exit (it's a shared_ptr)
     349  }

     351  void MirroredNetworking::FillInitialConfiguration(LX_MINI_INIT_NETWORKING_CONFIGURATION& message)
     352  {
     353      message.NetworkingMode = LxMiniInitNetworkingModeMirrored;

     466                                                                                               : hns::FirewallPolicyFlags::None;

     469              endpointFirewallPolicy.Type = hns::EndpointPolicyType::Firewall;

     632  // must be called from m_networkingQueue so all GNS interactions are correctly serialized
     633  // OnNetworkEndpointChange is called from GNS
     634  HRESULT MirroredNetworking::OnNetworkEndpointChange(const GUID& EndpointId, _In_ LPCWSTR Settings) const noexcept
     635  try
     636  {
     637      WI_ASSERT(m_networkingQueue.isRunningInQueue());
     638  
     639      const auto notification = FromJson<hns::ModifyGuestEndpointSettingRequest<void>>(Settings);
     640  
     641      // not sending Neighbor updates into the container
     642      if (notification.ResourceType == hns::GuestEndpointResourceType::Neighbor)
     643      {
     644          return E_NOTIMPL;
     645      }
     646  
     647      // a network property changed on some interface that HNS is tracking
     648      // we're using this notification as a trigger to rediscover the preferred interface
     649      WSL_LOG(
     650          "MirroredNetworking::OnNetworkEndpointChange [GNS server notification]",
     651          TraceLoggingValue(wsl::shared::string::GuidToString<wchar_t>(EndpointId).c_str(), "Endpoint"),
     652          TraceLoggingValue(Settings, "Payload"));
     653      m_networkManager->OnNetworkEndpointChange();
     654  
     655      return S_OK;
     656  }
     657  CATCH_RETURN()

     659  HRESULT MirroredNetworking::NetworkManagerGnsMessageCallback(
     660      LX_MESSAGE_TYPE messageType, std::wstring notificationString, networking::GnsCallbackFlags callbackFlags, _Out_opt_ int* returnedValueFromGns) noexcept
     661  try
     662  {
     663      // only pass the OUT returnedValueFromGns int* if the callback flags are set to wait
     664      if (returnedValueFromGns)
     665      {
     666          *returnedValueFromGns = ERROR_FATAL_APP_EXIT;
     667          WI_ASSERT(WI_IsFlagSet(callbackFlags, wsl::core::networking::GnsCallbackFlags::Wait));
     668      }
     669  
     670      auto sendGnsMessage =
     671          [this, messageType, capturedNotificationString = std::move(notificationString), callbackFlags, returnedValueFromGns]() mutable {
     672              try
     673              {
     674                  auto retryCount = 0ul;
     675                  // RetryWithTimeout throws if fails after the timeout has elapsed - which is caught and returned by m_gnsMessageQueue below
     676                  return wsl::shared::retry::RetryWithTimeout<HRESULT>(
     677                      [&]() {
     678                          const auto hr = wil::ResultFromException([&] {
     679                              if (returnedValueFromGns && WI_IsFlagSet(callbackFlags, wsl::core::networking::GnsCallbackFlags::Wait))
     680                              {
     681                                  *returnedValueFromGns =
     682                                      m_gnsChannel.SendNetworkDeviceMessageReturnResult(messageType, capturedNotificationString.c_str());
     683                              }
     684                              else
     685                              {
     686                                  m_gnsChannel.SendNetworkDeviceMessage(messageType, capturedNotificationString.c_str());
     687                              }
     688                          });
     689                          WSL_LOG(
     690                              "MirroredNetworking::NetworkManagerGnsMessageCallback",
     691                              TraceLoggingValue(ToString(messageType), "messageType"),
     692                              TraceLoggingValue(capturedNotificationString.c_str(), "notificationString"),
     693                              TraceLoggingValue(hr, "hr"),
     694                              TraceLoggingValue(returnedValueFromGns ? *returnedValueFromGns : 0xFFFFFFFF, "returnedValueFromGns"),
     695                              TraceLoggingValue(retryCount, "retryCount"));
     696  
     697                          ++retryCount;
     698                          return hr;
     699                      },
     700                      std::chrono::milliseconds(100),
     701                      std::chrono::seconds(3));
     702              }
     703              CATCH_RETURN()
     704          };
     705  
     706      if (WI_IsFlagSet(callbackFlags, wsl::core::networking::GnsCallbackFlags::Wait))
     707      {
     708          return m_gnsMessageQueue.submit_and_wait(std::move(sendGnsMessage));
     709      }
     710  
     711      m_gnsMessageQueue.submit(std::move(sendGnsMessage));
     712      return S_OK;
     713  }
     714  CATCH_RETURN()

     115              LOG_HR_MSG(E_UNEXPECTED, "Plugin value: '%ls' has incorrect type: %lu, skipping", e.first.c_str(), e.second);
     116              continue;
     117          }
     118  
     119          auto path = common::registry::ReadString(key.get(), nullptr, e.first.c_str());
     120  
     121          if (!loaded.insert(path).second)
     122          {
     123              LOG_HR_MSG(E_UNEXPECTED, "Module '%ls' has already been loaded, skipping plugin '%ls'", path.c_str(), e.first.c_str());
     124              continue;
     125          }
     126  
     127          auto loadResult = wil::ResultFromException(WI_DIAGNOSTICS_INFO, [&]() { LoadPlugin(e.first.c_str(), path.c_str()); });
     128  
     129          // Logs when a WSL plugin is loaded, used for evaluating plugin populations
     130          WSL_LOG_TELEMETRY(
     131              "PluginLoad",
     132              PDT_ProductAndServiceUsage,
     133              TraceLoggingValue(e.first.c_str(), "Name"),
     134              TraceLoggingValue(path.c_str(), "Path"),
     135              TraceLoggingValue(loadResult, "Result"));
     136  
     137          if (FAILED(loadResult))
     138          {
     139              // If this plugin reported an error, record it to display it to the user
     140              m_pluginError.emplace(PluginError{e.first, loadResult});
     141          }
     142      }
     143  }
     144  
     145  void PluginManager::LoadPlugin(LPCWSTR Name, LPCWSTR ModulePath)
     146  {
     147      // Validate the plugin signature before loading it.
     148      // The handle to the module is kept open after validating the signature so the file can't be written to
     149      // after the signature check.
     150      wil::unique_hfile pluginHandle;
     151      if constexpr (wsl::shared::OfficialBuild)
     152      {
     153          pluginHandle = wsl::windows::common::wslutil::ValidateFileSignature(ModulePath);
     154          WI_ASSERT(pluginHandle.is_valid());
     155      }
     156  
     157      LoadedPlugin plugin{};
     158      plugin.name = Name;
     159  
     160      plugin.module.reset(LoadLibrary(ModulePath));
     161      THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF_NULL(plugin.module);
     162  
     163      const WSLPluginAPI_EntryPointV1 entryPoint =
     164          reinterpret_cast<WSLPluginAPI_EntryPointV1>(GetProcAddress(plugin.module.get(), GSL_STRINGIFY(WSLPLUGINAPI_ENTRYPOINTV1)));
     165  
     166      THROW_LAST_ERROR_IF_NULL(entryPoint);
     167      THROW_IF_FAILED_MSG(entryPoint(&ApiV1, &plugin.hooks), "Error returned by plugin: '%ls'", ModulePath);
     168  
     169      m_plugins.emplace_back(std::move(plugin));
     170  }

     283  
     284  void PluginManager::ThrowIfPluginError(HRESULT Result, WSLSessionId Session, LPCWSTR Plugin)
     285  {
     286      const auto message = std::move(g_pluginErrorMessage);
     287      g_pluginErrorMessage.reset(); // std::move() doesn't clear the previous std::optional
     288  
     289      if (FAILED(Result))
     290      {
     291          if (message.has_value())
     292          {
     293              THROW_HR_WITH_USER_ERROR(Result, wsl::shared::Localization::MessageFatalPluginErrorWithMessage(Plugin, message->c_str()));
     294          }
     295          else
     296          {
     297              THROW_HR_WITH_USER_ERROR(Result, wsl::shared::Localization::MessageFatalPluginError(Plugin));
     298          }
     299      }
     300      else if (message.has_value())
     301      {
     302          THROW_HR_MSG(E_ILLEGAL_STATE_CHANGE, "Plugin '%ls' emitted an error message but returned success", Plugin);
     303      }
     304  }
     305  
     306  void PluginManager::ThrowIfFatalPluginError() const
     307  {
     308      ExecutionContext context(Context::Plugin);
     309  
     310      if (!m_pluginError.has_value())
     311      {
     312          return;
     313      }
     314      else if (m_pluginError->error == WSL_E_PLUGIN_REQUIRES_UPDATE)
     315      {
     316          THROW_HR_WITH_USER_ERROR(
     317              WSL_E_PLUGIN_REQUIRES_UPDATE, wsl::shared::Localization::MessagePluginRequiresUpdate(m_pluginError->plugin));
     318      }
     319      else
     320      {
     321          THROW_HR_WITH_USER_ERROR(m_pluginError->error, wsl::shared::Localization::MessageFatalPluginError(m_pluginError->plugin));
     322      }
     323  }
